records.etiology_en:
Diarrhea has undoubtedly been a common symptom troubling people throughout the past millennia, and the ancients therefore left behind many names and records describing it. The Huangdi Neijing (Yellow Emperor's Inner Classic), for example, mentions terms such as sun xie (undigested-food diarrhea), dong xie (cavernous diarrhea), tang xie (loose-stool diarrhea), shui xie (watery diarrhea), and ru xie (damp diarrhea), among others.

Diarrhea is primarily a disease of the stomach and intestines. These organs lie in the abdomen, through which a great many meridians pass. The principal meridians are the Conception Vessel (Ren Mai), Kidney meridian, Stomach meridian, Liver meridian, Spleen meridian, and Gallbladder meridian. The Large Intestine, Small Intestine, and Triple Burner (San Jiao) meridians also traverse the abdomen, and the Lung meridian ultimately connects downward to the large intestine; diarrhea is therefore closely related to all of these meridians.

Because these meridians show energy changes throughout the four seasons, meridian testing can be used to directly observe the meridian phenomena in people with diarrhea, revealing the relationship between the meridians and diarrhea. The meridian changes relating to diarrhea across the four seasons are summarized below.

1. Early spring: Deficiency of the Lung meridian and the three Hand Yang meridians

As the saying goes, "the whole year's plan begins in spring" — so let us begin with spring. For people in most regions of the Northern Hemisphere, spring is when nature's Yang Qi begins to rise, yet the weather remains very cold.

This sensation of cold can even feel colder than winter (click to read), and it does not change clearly and stably until early summer (May).

During this period, the meridian pattern with the greatest influence is the pattern of "Deficiency of the Lung, Triple Burner, and Large Intestine meridians."

As the figure below shows, this phenomenon becomes evident from late autumn (October) onward and continues until it peaks in late spring (April). This is the typical diarrhea caused by Deficiency-Cold of the Large Intestine meridian and the abdomen.

When the Lung, Triple Burner, and Large Intestine meridians are in Deficiency, diarrhea occurs readily.

According to the observations of many members, when a person contracts an external invasion of the six pathogenic factors (the common cold), since the Lung and Large Intestine meridians are an exterior-interior pair, abnormal bowel movements with diarrhea do indeed tend to appear.

Thus colds occurring between spring and summer also readily produce diarrhea — what modern people call "gastrointestinal flu" (stomach flu).

There is an even more severe version of this meridian pattern, in which the Small Intestine meridian of the three Hand Yang meridians also joins the ranks of Deficiency; in that case diarrhea is truly hard to avoid.

When the Small Intestine meridian of the three Hand Yang meridians also becomes Deficient, diarrhea is even more likely.

There are many causes of this meridian phenomenon. Besides the influence of external Cold in cold weather, Dampness is a "Yin pathogen" that readily damages Yang Qi; therefore, when using meridian testing to assess Dampness, one can also observe the energy of the three Hand Yang meridians.

Through long-term observation, some members have found that during rainy seasons, when the home is too damp, or after drinking too much iced water, these three Hand Yang meridians show Deficiency patterns.

Since all three of these meridians ultimately lead to the abdomen, diarrhea then occurs easily.

This meridian phenomenon is in fact what traditional Chinese medicine calls "Cold-Damp diarrhea": clear, thin stools without foul odor, abdominal pain, abdominal bloating, poor appetite, heavy limbs, fatigue, clear pale urine, a white greasy tongue coating, and a soggy or moderate pulse. This is diarrhea caused by Dampness encumbering the Spleen and Stomach.[@ad:1]

For most people, the energy of these three Yang meridians is quite strong and abundant. In some people who drink large amounts of iced water in summer, or whose abdomen catches cold during sleep at night, this meridian phenomenon also appears.

There are many such cases, and anyone can verify this at any time. Take member Mr. H as an example: he has used meridian testing for over 8 years. As a computer software engineer, he uses his brain all day long.

His Spleen meridian therefore frequently shows Deficiency. He observed a very particular phenomenon: whenever his three Hand Yang meridians showed Deficiency, he would begin to have diarrhea — most notably with the Small Intestine meridian — and after entering autumn and winter this phenomenon became very frequent.

Sometimes, when testing his meridians casually before any diarrhea had even started, the Small Intestine meridian Deficiency would appear, and sure enough, diarrhea would begin shortly afterward.

He was thus astonished to discover that meridian testing can truly predict disease — even foretelling impending diarrhea before it begins!

Deficiency of the three Hand Yang meridians readily causes shoulder and neck soreness as well as diarrhea.

One day, he saw TCM practitioner Dr. Yu Ya-wen's advice on television and tried eating Si Shen Tang (Four Spirits Decoction), red beans, coix seed (Job's tears), winter melon, and other Dampness-eliminating foods — and his diarrhea genuinely decreased dramatically.

As he gradually came to appreciate the importance of eliminating internal Dampness, he now places a dehumidifier wherever he regularly works, and his formerly frequent diarrhea has gradually disappeared.

Dr. Lu Zhizheng, chief state physician of Zhongnanhai, who has practiced medicine for over seventy years, noted in his book "Eliminate the Body's Dampness: Drive Away Spleen-Stomach Diseases, Skin Diseases, Chronic Diseases, and the Three Highs" that more than 90% of people have at some point fallen ill because of the Damp pathogen. In his lifetime of clinical experience, the "Damp pathogen" has become the greatest enemy threatening the health of modern people.

2. Summer: Excess of the three Hand Yang meridians

Continuing from the "Deficiency of the Lung, Triple Burner, and Large Intestine meridians" described above: upon entering summer, a dramatic change occurs — the three meridians that were originally in "Deficiency" transform into "Excess."

As the figure below shows, after May these three meridians turn to Excess, continuing until they peak in September.

When the three Hand Yang meridians show Excess, internal Fire-Heat combined with Dampness produces diarrhea.

Every reader can verify this phenomenon: as long as one does not drink too much iced water in summer, almost everyone's three Hand Yang meridians are in Excess — especially the Large Intestine and Triple Burner meridians.

At this stage, this readily combines with summer's dominant climatic factor (Dampness) to produce acute Damp-Heat diarrhea: yellow watery stools or stools with mucus, foul fishy odor, abdominal pain, burning pain of the anus, dry mouth and thirst, chest oppression, yellow urine, a yellow greasy tongue coating, and a slippery rapid pulse.

Cloud TCM articles often mention that Excess of the Triple Burner meridian can indicate internal Fire; the higher the internal Fire, the higher the Triple Burner meridian's energy, and many members have reported confirming this phenomenon themselves.

One member's situation was a severe year-round Triple Burner Excess, with energy frequently reaching above 150.

In many people with strong internal Fire, the three Hand Yang meridians all show Excess.

She found that each time she took Fire-draining Chinese herbs, her Triple Burner meridian would indeed come down. On one occasion she ate spicy hot pot (mala hot pot) and afterward developed diarrhea with very foul-smelling stools.

Consulting Chinese medical texts, she found this was very likely caused by excessive internal Heat, and after taking Gegen Qinlian Tang (Kudzu, Scutellaria and Coptis Decoction) she recovered rapidly.

One day, chatting with a TCM physician about this case, that physician also shared that whenever patients suffered hangover with diarrhea from drinking too much alcohol, he would prescribe Wei Ling Tang (Stomach-Calming Poria Decoction) with excellent results. This too is caused by alcohol generating excessive accumulated Heat in the body.

This change in meridian phenomena may well be the cause of what ancient China called "warm diseases" (wen bing): in winter, the Cold pathogen lies latent in the body, and only after Yang Qi gradually rises in spring does a series of cold-like symptoms of illness appear (latent Qi), reflected in Excess of these three meridians.

3. Summer: Liver meridian exuberant, Spleen meridian deficient (Wood overcontrolling Earth)

TCM often says "nourish the Liver in spring, nourish the Heart in summer," and tradition holds that spring and summer are chiefly the seasons of "Liver disease" or "Heart disease."

In fact, observation of large volumes of meridian data from modern people shows that the most obvious change after entering summer is that Liver meridian energy becomes overly strong while Spleen meridian energy becomes very weak — something easily verified for oneself.

This fully confirms the Five Phases principle of Chinese medicine: once Liver meridian energy rises rapidly and Wood Qi becomes exuberant, the energy of the Spleen meridian, which belongs to Earth, duly begins to decline — operating by this same law every year.

For people living near the equator, where it is spring-like year round, if they do not spend long periods in air-conditioned rooms, their meridian pattern is virtually like this all year.

After entering spring and summer, most people show Liver meridian Excess with Spleen meridian Deficiency.

Diarrhea of this pattern corresponds, per the descriptions in authoritative TCM texts, to "Liver constraint overwhelming the Spleen" (Liver Qi invading the Spleen and Stomach) and "Spleen Deficiency with food stagnation" types of diarrhea; summer "Damp-Heat" also causes diarrhea.

Therefore, each year after April-May in the Northern Hemisphere, diarrhea becomes a common symptom, and the most commonly used formulas are Si Ni San (Frigid Extremities Powder) and Tong Xie Yao Fang (Essential Formula for Painful Diarrhea).

Million-copy bestselling author and TCM physician Dr. Wu Guozhong, in his book "Nourish Yang Qi: Raising Your Own Yang Qi Is the Remedy for All Diseases," also stated his view that the pathogen most invasive of modern people's Yang Qi is the Damp pathogen.

Most of the body's Dampness arises from Spleen Deficiency, because a poor transportation-transformation capacity of the Spleen leads to Dampness accumulating. Thus a person with Spleen Deficiency and heavy Dampness will very easily develop diarrhea.[@ad:1]

4. Early autumn: Spleen meridian Deficiency and Large Intestine Excess at their extreme

Continuing from the above, the Spleen meridian's Deficiency grows progressively worse from April onward, and it is upon truly entering early autumn — between the solar terms Beginning of Autumn (Liqiu) and End of Heat (Chushu), i.e., August-September each year — that the weather reaches its hottest extreme (the "autumn tiger" heat wave).

At this time the body's Large Intestine meridian energy reaches its most exuberant of the year, while the Spleen meridian reaches its lowest point of the year.

In early autumn, Spleen meridian Deficiency and Large Intestine meridian Excess both reach their extremes.

At this time, because the weather is sweltering and southern East Asia frequently receives heavy rains, so-called "Damp-Heat diarrhea" and "Spleen-Deficiency diarrhea" appear most readily.

In 2021, one member reported that after entering August, with frequent heavy rains, he often had diarrhea three times a day, with thirst, yellow urine, and very foul-smelling stools. His meridian chart showed Excess of the Large Intestine and Triple Burner meridians with severe Spleen meridian Deficiency.

The meridian phenomena of diarrhea beginning after entry into early autumn.

The cause of this diarrhea is in fact the same as in summer, only its severity is more pronounced. Modern medicine has found that after entering autumn, the probability of diarrhea caused by infections — chiefly rotavirus — rises.

Coincidentally, during this period the meridians also enter this diarrhea-prone stage. Perhaps it is because immunity is low at this time and resistance to viruses is weakened that disease has the opportunity to develop.

5. Winter: Spleen-Kidney Yang Deficiency, Yang Deficiency of the legs

Modern medicine observes that each year, from autumn onward — September to January of the following year, and especially October through December — is the peak period for epidemic diarrhea. Besides viruses, cold weather is also a cause of diarrhea.

Dr. Wang Hongyuan has pointed out that this is because cold weather triggers the gastrointestinal sympathetic nerves, prompting frequent gastrointestinal peristalsis and causing diarrhea; compared with the intestines, the stomach is more susceptible to climate. This is a modern anatomical interpretation of the TCM mechanism by which Cold causes diarrhea.

This too can be traced through observation of meridian phenomena: after entering winter there is a high probability of Deficiency of the Gallbladder, Stomach, Kidney, and Spleen meridians — this is what traditional Chinese medicine commonly calls "Kidney-Deficiency diarrhea" or "Spleen-Kidney Yang Deficiency" diarrhea. People with this diarrhea-prone constitution ordinarily tend to have abdominal pain, frequent bowel movements, poor appetite, indigestion, sore lower back, cold limbs, easy fatigue, and low spirits.

Member Mr. S was often forced out of bed by abdominal pain in the early morning. After November 2020, when Taiwan began to turn cold, he found that his meridian chart automatically became a Yang-Deficiency chart. At the time he searched Google, found the term "fifth-watch diarrhea" (daybreak diarrhea), and discovered it truly matched his symptoms.

As a planning specialist who overuses his brain, he shows Spleen meridian Deficiency in all four seasons; after winter arrived he found his Kidney meridian also showed Deficiency. He said: "At that moment, I truly saw with my own eyes what 'Spleen-Kidney Yang Deficiency' means."

Spleen-Kidney Yang Deficiency causing diarrhea can be seen clearly from the chart.

From his meridian chart one can also clearly see Deficiency of the Gallbladder and Stomach meridians (Yang meridians) — truly Yang Deficiency plus Spleen-Kidney Yang Deficiency in the fullest sense.

Having confirmed this pattern, and being fond of studying Chinese medicine, he bought a bottle of Si Shen Wan (Four Spirits Pill) in scientific (granule) form to take; its ingredients are nutmeg (Rou Dou Kou), psoralea (Bu Gu Zhi), schisandra (Wu Wei Zi), evodia (Wu Zhu Yu), fresh ginger, and jujube. After only a few days of taking it, his diarrhea genuinely improved by more than half — this is the main reason he loves studying Chinese medicine.

In March 2022 he gave an update: "To this day, I still often get diarrhea when the weather turns cold, and it still improves quickly after taking the medicine. But my meridian pattern remains the same — clearly, a Cold-type Yang-Deficient constitution is truly not easy to change!"

Fundamentals for improving chronic diarrhea

The meridian patterns causing diarrhea across the four seasons have been clearly laid out above, and they share consistent underlying causes. With attention to health cultivation, frequent diarrhea can be avoided, summarized as follows:

1. Eat fewer raw, cold, and cooling foods

As noted above, warming the abdomen can improve diarrhea; conversely, making the abdomen colder makes diarrhea worse. Therefore, if diarrhea appears during autumn and winter, one must reduce or stop eating raw, cold, and cooling foods.

The concept of eating fewer raw and cold foods dates back to the Han dynasty: the chief dietary prohibition when taking Gui Zhi Tang (Cinnamon Twig Decoction) for colds was to avoid raw and cold foods — a concept that has been followed for nearly two thousand years.

Eating fewer raw and cold foods can improve autumn-winter diarrhea.

If a person's Spleen and Stomach are already weak, and in summer the Spleen meridian is Deficient as well, and they then drink iced water and eat watermelon, causing Deficiency of the three Hand Yang meridians, it will be very hard to avoid diarrhea.

2. Dietary therapy or Chinese herbs to eliminate internal Dampness

Chinese medicine has many herbs and foods that expel internal Dampness; Cloud TCM has compiled a number of them over the past several years, and readers are advised to read and apply them (click to open).

Shen Ling Baizhu San (Ginseng, Poria and White Atractylodes Powder) must be mentioned here — its ingredients are nearly all foods. Member Ms. J once shared: "Shen Ling Baizhu San works like magic for me; there has hardly ever been a time it failed to stop my diarrhea!" Using dietary therapy to improve health is the concept people accept most readily.

In fact, judging from this formula's composition, it can hardly be called medicine at all — it is essentially a collection of foods, a dietary-therapy product worth promoting.

Its ingredients are: licorice (Gan Cao), fresh ginger, jujube, white hyacinth bean (Bai Bian Dou), white atractylodes (Bai Zhu), poria (Fu Ling), platycodon (Jie Geng), lotus seed (Lian Zi), ginseng (Ren Shen), amomum (Sha Ren), Chinese yam (Shan Yao), and coix seed (Yi Yi Ren). These ingredients can also be simmered into a medicinal congee.

The ingredients above are numerous; there is a simpler, scaled-down medicinal-diet version — Si Shen Tang (Four Spirits Soup), composed of poria, Chinese yam, lotus seed, euryale seed (Qian Shi), and coix seed. Many vendors add pork small intestine and stew them together; this too can improve diarrhea, promote digestion, and thereby adjust the constitution and strengthen resistance.

Member Mr. T once said: "When I get winter diarrhea, Fuzi Lizhong Tang (Aconite Center-Rectifying Decoction) works almost every single time!" Ms. M had long felt Deficiency-Cold in her abdomen; whenever she ate watermelon she would invariably get diarrhea, and meridian testing indeed showed frequent Deficiency of her three Hand Yang meridians.

She then experimented on herself: whenever diarrhea appeared, taking Fuzi Lizhong Tang would reliably bring rapid improvement, so this scientific Chinese medicine is a life-saving elixir for her.

Mr. B is a manual-therapy (tuina/bone-setting) practitioner who joined as a member around the end of 2019. In mid-March 2020 he began experiencing abdominal pain and diarrhea; after taking Tong Xie Yao Fang for one day, his symptoms improved markedly.

He recalled that once, while studying Chinese medicine, he took Huoxiang Zhengqi San (Agastache Qi-Correcting Powder) for diarrhea; not only did the diarrhea resolve, but his heavy-headed dizziness and poor appetite disappeared as well, which is why he has always believed in Chinese medicine.

Because these herbs travel the Spleen and Stomach meridians, taking them in the morning gives better results. Those unfamiliar with Chinese medicine can discuss their constitutional state with a physician to clearly identify the formula that suits them.

3. Let yourself sweat; spend less time in air-conditioned rooms

Summer is nature's gift to humanity — a golden opportunity to expel the Cold accumulated over the harsh winter. Yet modern people invented air conditioning and threw this opportunity away, with the result that modern people almost universally show a Yang-Deficient meridian constitution, a phenomenon confirmed by large volumes of meridian data.

So those who wish to cultivate health need only use the great opportunity nature grants in spring and summer: sweat as much as possible and spend less time in air-conditioned rooms. Much of the excess Cold accumulated in the body will then disappear, achieving a state of self-healing.

4. Pay attention to dietary habits

Chinese medicine often speaks of "food-stagnation diarrhea": overeating, or excessive consumption of rich, fatty, and sweet foods, damages the Spleen and Stomach, leading to indigestion and hence diarrhea. TCM therefore favors Bao He Wan (Harmony-Preserving Pill) to disperse food and relieve stagnation.

During spring and summer — the entire stage of Spleen meridian Deficiency — it is truly not advisable to eat too much. Maintaining good dietary habits — regular mealtimes and portions, chewing slowly and thoroughly, avoiding binge eating and drinking, and avoiding overly cold, spicy, grilled, fried, or greasy foods — can prevent diarrhea.

records.etiology_zh:
嘔吐這一症狀在中國已困擾人們千年以上，古代醫書如《黃帝內經》、《傷寒雜病論》等，幾乎無不對其進行探討，並累積了大量治療經驗與案例。

嘔吐與噁心常常同時出現，噁心可能是嘔吐的前兆，嘔吐通常伴隨噁心，但噁心未必導致嘔吐。本文所探討的，主要是指將胃中食物吐出的情況。

由於嘔吐是臨床上常見的症狀，雲端中醫資料庫已累積了大量關於嘔吐時的經絡數據，這些數據來自患者發生嘔吐當天的經絡檢測結果。

若能將這些經絡數據與傳統中醫的證候分析結合，不僅能進一步印證古人對證候的推斷，還能提升現代中醫對嘔吐機制的理解與應用。

古人認為，一個人會嘔吐有以下的幾種證候，分別列述如下：

1.外感風寒

古人認為，感冒的時候最容易引起嘔吐，夏天的「暑濕感冒」更容易引起嘔吐。

古人認為感冒主要指兩種情況，一種是「寒邪侵襲體表」，另一種是「暑濕」影響人體的防禦機能。

《傷寒論》中提到：「或已發熱，或未發熱，必惡寒，體痛，嘔逆，脈陰陽俱緊」，風寒感冒會引起嘔吐。

感冒傷寒有機會出現噁心嘔吐

這種嘔吐是因為寒邪包裹肌膚，使得人體的陽氣無法正常發散，氣無法向外排出，於是堆積在體內，導致胃氣上逆，引發嘔吐，最常運用「桂枝湯」進行調整。

暑濕感冒影響人體的嘔吐類型，是因為濕氣困住中焦（即腸胃功能受影響），因此除了嘔吐，還會出現胃腹脹悶、食慾不振、身體沉重、四肢無力...等症狀，最常運用「藿香正氣散」調理。

由於感冒並沒有特定的經絡型態，通常感冒的經絡型態就是每個人平日常見的經絡型態，所以可參考下面提到的各種可能性。[@ad:1]

2.胃寒

古人認為，胃寒最容易出現嘔吐，如果一個人本身脾胃虛弱（中焦陽氣不足），那麼吃完飯後不久就容易反胃嘔吐，還常伴隨胃痛、打嗝、怕冷、身體消瘦、四肢無力等症狀。

最常見的現象是，突然吃了太多生冷的食物，就會引起胃部劇烈疼痛，嘔吐時先吐出大量清水，接著才吐出剛吃下的食物，吐完後會覺得比較舒服。

要印證胃寒所造成的嘔吐現象，這就相當容易了，有不少出現嘔吐的經絡現象，就是呈現所謂的陽虛經絡現象(見下圖)

胃寒出現嘔吐的經絡型態

遇到胃寒造成的嘔吐，治療的原則就是溫暖胃部、祛除寒氣、降低胃氣上逆，常用的是「理中湯」、「附子理中湯」。

3.胃熱

從大量現代人經絡數據都經常可以印證一個現象，絕大多數的疾病，都是體內極端寒或極端產生出來的結果。

所以胃寒會嘔吐，胃熱也會嘔吐，而且胃熱嘔吐的機率確實蠻高的。

胃熱所引起的嘔吐，通常還會伴隨胃酸、打嗝有酸腐味（噯腐）、口臭，並且感覺胃部脹悶、小便偏黃、便秘。

這種情況大多是因為飲食過於油膩、辛辣，或者經常喝酒，導致體內濕熱堆積在中焦（胃部），除了嘔吐，還會有反酸、口臭、胃悶、便秘、舌苔黃厚等胃熱的症狀。

在雲端中醫的資料庫諸多案例中發現，胃經、膽經實證時，代表體內火氣大，確實很容易出現嘔吐(見下圖)。

胃熱嘔吐經絡型態，可見胃經實證，心包經虛證

最值得觀察的現象是，通常胃經實證的時候，心包經都會出現虛證。印證傳統中醫所說的「臟腑別通理論」是真實的，所以心包經的「內關穴」，千年以來常用來治療噁心嘔吐。

最常用運用的方法，就是運用一些苦寒性的中藥來降胃火，通常效果是很快速的。

4.肝胃不和

從大量現代人經絡數據中發現，不少肝經＋胃經的經絡數據，都會出現嘔吐。

這種經絡型態，通常都會伴隨脾經＋膀胱經虛證，形成典型的鐵三角經絡型態，由於真實案例太多，下面一次列出9個人的經絡圖如下：

肝胃不和造成嘔吐常見的經絡型態

以上這些真實的經絡現象，都是出現嘔吐、噁心反胃時進行檢測的，可以清楚看見肝經＋胃經嚴重實證，這很容易出現肝胃不和。

這種情況通常是長期的慢性現象，因為肝氣鬱結不順暢，影響到胃的正常運作，導致胃氣上逆，頻繁出現嘔吐與噁心，但不會劇烈到無法忍受。除了嘔吐之外，還會伴隨胸悶、胃部脹滿、肋骨周圍疼痛、口苦...等等。

如果在情緒波動（如生氣、壓力大、焦慮）時，嘔吐的症狀會變得更加嚴重，最常運用小柴胡湯合左金丸改善。

大家也可以親自驗證，經常容易生氣或情緒鬱悶的人，確實很容易出現「鐵三角」經絡型態，進而出現各種種消化系統的疾病。

此外，傳統中醫認為胃陰虛也會造成嘔吐，這可以是肝胃不和的延伸現象。同時，傷食(吃太飽)也會嘔吐，這與現代醫學理解的是一致的。

從上面歸納出來經絡型態也可以清楚得知，許多的症狀，背後都有類似的經絡現象，如何改善這些經絡現象，是預防與治療疾病的關鍵秘訣。

如果有一個人長期處於上面提到的經絡現象，就很容易在生病的時候出現嘔吐，每個人都可以親身驗證。
records.western_pathology_zh:
嘔吐是一種常見的生理反應，可能由多種原因引起，涉及消化系統、中樞神經系統、內分泌系統...等原因。

消化系統相關原因包含腸胃炎(由病毒或細菌感染引起）、食物中毒、胃食道逆流、消化性潰瘍、腸道阻塞...等等。

中樞神經系統相關原因包含：偏頭痛、顱內壓增高(腦腫瘤、腦出血)、暈動症(暈車、暈船)等，刺激嘔吐中樞而引起嘔吐。

部分孕婦在早孕期間會出現噁心、嘔吐(孕吐)，糖尿病酮症酸中毒時也會嘔吐，一些藥物副作用、情緒壓力都會造成嘔吐。

嘔吐的原因多種多樣，平時生活中一些不明原因的嘔吐，也可以從中醫經絡的觀點來探討，提供不同方面的觀點。

《諸病源候論》/巢元方 十四、咳逆上氣嘔吐候 五臟皆稟氣於肺，肺感微寒則咳嗽也。寒搏於氣，氣聚還肺，而邪有動息。邪動則氣奔逆上，氣上則五臟傷動，動於胃氣者，則胃氣逆而嘔吐也。此是肺咳連滯，氣動於胃而嘔吐者也。凡諸咳嗽，甚則嘔吐，各隨證候，知其腑臟也。

《本草綱目》/李時珍 嘔吐（有痰熱，有虛寒，有積滯）。【痰熱】〔草部〕葛根（大熱嘔吐，小兒嘔吐，蕩粉食。），澤瀉（行水止吐。），香附（妊娠惡阻，同藿香、甘草煎服。），黃連，苦耽（勞乏嘔逆。），麥門冬（止嘔吐燥渴。），前胡（化痰止吐。），蘆根（主嘔逆不食，除膈間客熱，水煮服。或入童尿。），乾薹（煮汁。），赤小豆，豌豆（止嘔逆。），綠豆粉，蒒草子，〔果木〕茯苓，豬苓，梔子，楸白皮，梓白皮（止嘔逆，下氣。），蘇枋木（人常嘔吐，用水煎服。），楊梅（止嘔吐，除煩憒。），枇杷（止吐下氣。），木白皮（止嘔逆，煮服大佳。），葉（止嘔吐不止。），〔水石〕黃丹（止吐逆。），胡粉，水銀，鉛，滑石（暴得吐逆，湯服二錢。），石膏（胃火吐逆。），陰陽水（飲數口，即定。），〔蟲獸〕蟬蛻（胃熱吐食，同滑石末，水服。），蘆蠹蟲（小兒乳後吐逆，二枚，煮汁服。），羊屎（嘔吐酸水，以十枚煎酒服。），牛乳（小兒吐乳，入蔥、姜煎服。），兔頭骨（天行吐不止，燒研，飲服。），〔人部〕人乳（小兒初生吐乳，同籧篨篾、鹽少許，煎汁，入牛黃服。）。【虛寒】〔草部〕細辛（虛寒嘔吐，同丁香末服。），蒼朮（暖胃消穀，止嘔吐。），白朮（胃虛嘔逆，及產後嘔吐。），人參（止嘔吐，胃虛有痰，煎汁入薑汁、竹瀝服；胃寒，同丁香、藿香、橘皮煎服；妊娠吐水，同乾薑丸服。），艾葉（口吐清水，煎服。），半夏（嘔逆厥冷，內有寒痰，同面作彈丸，煮吞之；妊娠嘔吐，同人參、乾薑丸服；小兒痰吐，同麵包丁香，煨熟，丸服。），南星（除痰下氣止嘔。），旋覆花（止嘔逆不下食，消痰下氣。），蘇子（止吐。），香薷（傷暑嘔吐。），藿香（脾胃吐逆為要藥。），木香，當歸（溫中，止嘔逆。），茅香（溫胃止吐。），白豆蔻（止吐逆，散冷氣，胃冷忽噁心，嚼數枚酒下。小兒胃寒吐乳，同縮砂、甘草末飲服。），生附子（胃寒有痰，同半夏、生薑煎服。），縮砂仁，廉姜，白芷，紅豆蔻，高良薑（溫中下氣消食。忽嘔清水，含咽即平。），肉豆蔻（溫中下氣止吐，及小兒乳霍。），益智子（胃冷。），〔谷菜〕糯米（虛寒吐逆。），燒酒，白扁豆，豇豆，乾薑，生薑（煎醋食。又同半夏煎服，去痰下氣，殺蟲止嘔吐。），芥子（胃寒吐食。），白芥子，〔果木〕橘皮（止吐消痰溫中。嘈雜吐清水，去白研末，時舐之。），蜀椒（止吐殺蟲。），胡椒（去胃中寒痰，食已即吐水，甚驗。），畢澄茄，吳茱萸，食茱萸（並止冷吐。），檳榔（止吐水，同橘皮煎服。），沉香，檀香，丁香（治吐，同陳皮煎服；小兒丸服；或同半夏丸服。

《外臺秘要》/王燾 咳逆上氣嘔吐方四首 《病源》五臟皆稟氣於肺，肺感微寒則成咳嗽也。寒搏於氣，氣聚還肺，而邪有動息，邪動則氣奔逆上，氣上則五臟傷動，動於胃氣者，則胃氣逆而嘔吐也，此是肺咳，連滯氣動於胃而嘔吐者也。又有季夏脾王之時，而脾氣虛不能王，有寒氣傷之而咳嗽者，謂之脾咳，其狀咳則右脅下痛，陰陰引膊背，甚則不可動，動則咳發。脾與胃合，脾咳不已，則胃受之。其狀咳嗽而嘔，嘔甚則長蟲出是也。凡諸咳嗽甚則嘔吐，各隨證候知其腑臟也。
 

《三指禪》/周學霆 嘔吐脈論 嘔吐之症，一曰寒，一曰熱，一曰虛。寒則脈遲，熱則脈數，虛則脈虛，即其脈可以分其症。最易治者，寒，陽明為消磨五穀之所，喜溫而惡寒，一自寒犯於內，兩相齟齬，食入即吐，不食亦嘔。彼法夏、丁香、白蔻、砂仁，本草所注一派止嘔定吐之品，非不神效，不如一碗生薑湯，而其效更速者，經所謂寒氣客於腸胃，厥逆上出，故痛而嘔是也。最誤治者，熱（寒涼燥烈之性，功過參半焉者也。夫嘔吐，病之最淺者也，噎膈，病之至深者也，極為易辨。嘔吐，其來也猝；噎膈，其來也緩。嘔吐，得食則吐，不食亦有欲嘔之狀；噎膈，食入方吐，不食不嘔。嘔吐，或寒或熱或虛，外見寒熱與虛之形；噎膈，不食亦與平人一般。嘔吐不論年之老幼；噎膈多得之老人。嘔吐，脈有遲、有數、有虛；噎膈，脈緩。

《沈氏尊生書．嘔吐噦源流》：「嘔苦水則由邪在膽，膽上乘胃，故逆而吐膽汁，以致所嘔為苦水也(宜吳萸、黃連、乾薑、茯苓、黃芩)。嘔清水則渴欲飲水，水入即吐，名為水逆（宜神朮丸、五苓散)。吐涎沬則以脾虛不能約束津液，故涎沬自出(宜六君子湯加益智仁、生薑，或以半夏、乾薑等分為末)。…然而嘔吐又有總治之法(宜白豆蔻湯)。」

《丹溪心法．嘔吐》：「大吐，渴飲水者即死，童便飲之，最妙。
records.western_pathology_en:
Vomiting is a common physiological response that can arise from many causes involving the digestive system, central nervous system, endocrine system, and other origins.

Digestive-system causes include gastroenteritis (caused by viral or bacterial infection), food poisoning, gastroesophageal reflux, peptic ulcer, intestinal obstruction, and so on.

Central nervous system causes include migraine, increased intracranial pressure (brain tumor, intracerebral hemorrhage), and motion sickness (carsickness, seasickness), which stimulate the vomiting center and induce vomiting.

Some pregnant women experience nausea and vomiting in early pregnancy (morning sickness); vomiting also occurs in diabetic ketoacidosis, and certain drug side effects and emotional stress can likewise cause vomiting.

The causes of vomiting are many and varied. Episodes of unexplained vomiting in daily life can also be explored from the perspective of TCM meridians, offering a different point of view.

records.etiology_en:
The symptom of vomiting has troubled people in China for well over a millennium. Ancient medical classics such as the Huangdi Neijing (Yellow Emperor's Inner Classic) and the Shanghan Zabing Lun (Treatise on Cold Damage and Miscellaneous Diseases) almost all discuss it, accumulating a wealth of therapeutic experience and case records.

Vomiting and nausea often appear together: nausea may be a precursor to vomiting, and vomiting is usually accompanied by nausea, but nausea does not necessarily lead to vomiting. This article primarily addresses the expulsion of stomach contents through the mouth.

Because vomiting is a common clinical symptom, the Cloud TCM database has accumulated a large volume of meridian data recorded on the very day patients experienced vomiting.

If these meridian data can be combined with traditional TCM pattern (syndrome) analysis, this not only further corroborates the ancients' inferences about patterns, but can also advance modern TCM's understanding and application of the mechanisms of vomiting.

The ancients held that vomiting arises from the following patterns, described in turn below:

1. External invasion of Wind-Cold

The ancients believed that vomiting most readily arises during the common cold, and that summer "Summerheat-Damp colds" are even more likely to cause vomiting.

The ancients understood the common cold as chiefly two situations: one is "Cold pathogen invading the body surface," the other is "Summerheat-Damp" impairing the body's defensive function.

The Shanghan Lun (Treatise on Cold Damage) states: "Whether fever has appeared or not, there is invariably aversion to cold, body pain, and retching counterflow, with tight Yin and Yang pulses" — Wind-Cold colds can cause vomiting.

Cold damage from external invasion may present with nausea and vomiting.

This type of vomiting occurs because the Cold pathogen envelops the skin, preventing the body's Yang Qi from dispersing normally; unable to vent outward, the Qi accumulates internally, causing Stomach Qi to ascend counterflow and triggering vomiting. Gui Zhi Tang (Cinnamon Twig Decoction) is most often used to regulate this.

In the Summerheat-Damp type of cold affecting the body, vomiting occurs because Dampness encumbers the Middle Burner (i.e., gastrointestinal function is affected); besides vomiting, there are also epigastric and abdominal distension and oppression, poor appetite, heaviness of the body, weakness of the limbs, and similar symptoms. Huoxiang Zhengqi San (Agastache Qi-Correcting Powder) is most often used for regulation.

Since the common cold has no specific meridian pattern — the meridian pattern during a cold is usually whatever pattern the person commonly shows in daily life — the various possibilities discussed below may be consulted.[@ad:1]

2. Stomach Cold

The ancients held that Stomach Cold most readily produces vomiting. If a person's Spleen and Stomach are inherently weak (insufficient Middle Burner Yang Qi), they will easily regurgitate and vomit shortly after meals, often accompanied by stomach pain, belching, aversion to cold, emaciation, and weakness of the limbs.

The most common presentation is that suddenly eating too much raw, cold food provokes intense stomach pain; when vomiting, large amounts of clear fluid come up first, followed by the food just eaten, and the person feels more comfortable after vomiting.

Verifying vomiting caused by Stomach Cold is quite easy: many meridian presentations at the time of vomiting show the so-called Yang-Deficiency meridian phenomenon (see figure below).

The meridian pattern of vomiting from Stomach Cold.

For vomiting caused by Stomach Cold, the treatment principles are to warm the stomach, dispel Cold, and subdue the counterflow ascent of Stomach Qi; the commonly used formulas are Lizhong Tang (Center-Rectifying Decoction) and Fuzi Lizhong Tang (Aconite Center-Rectifying Decoction).

3. Stomach Heat

A phenomenon repeatedly confirmed by large volumes of meridian data from modern people is that the great majority of diseases are the result of extreme internal Cold or extreme internal Heat.

Thus, just as Stomach Cold causes vomiting, Stomach Heat also causes vomiting — and the probability of Stomach-Heat vomiting is indeed quite high.

Vomiting caused by Stomach Heat is usually accompanied by acid reflux, belching with a sour, rotten odor (putrid eructation), bad breath, a feeling of distension and oppression in the stomach, darker yellow urine, and constipation.

This situation mostly arises from an overly greasy or spicy diet, or habitual alcohol consumption, which causes Damp-Heat to accumulate in the Middle Burner (the stomach region); besides vomiting, there are Stomach-Heat symptoms such as acid regurgitation, halitosis, epigastric oppression, constipation, and a thick yellow tongue coating.

Among the many cases in the Cloud TCM database, it has been found that Excess of the Stomach and Gallbladder meridians, indicating strong internal Fire, is indeed readily associated with vomiting (see figure below).

The Stomach-Heat vomiting meridian pattern: Stomach meridian Excess with Pericardium meridian Deficiency.

The phenomenon most worth observing is that when the Stomach meridian is in Excess, the Pericardium meridian usually shows Deficiency. This corroborates the truth of the traditional TCM "zang-fu paired-communication (bie tong) theory," which is why the Pericardium meridian's Neiguan point (PC-6) has been used for a thousand years to treat nausea and vomiting.

The most commonly used method is to apply bitter, cold-natured Chinese herbs to drain Stomach Fire, and the effect is usually very rapid.

4. Liver-Stomach disharmony

Large volumes of meridian data from modern people show that many datasets combining Liver meridian and Stomach meridian abnormality are associated with vomiting.

This meridian pattern is usually accompanied by Deficiency of the Spleen and Bladder meridians, forming the typical "Iron Triangle" meridian pattern. Because real cases are so numerous, the meridian charts of 9 individuals are presented together below:

Common meridian patterns of vomiting from Liver-Stomach disharmony.

All of these real meridian findings were recorded during episodes of vomiting or nausea, clearly showing severe Excess of the Liver and Stomach meridians — a state highly prone to Liver-Stomach disharmony.

This situation is usually a long-term, chronic phenomenon: Liver Qi becomes constrained and does not flow smoothly, disturbing the stomach's normal function, causing Stomach Qi to ascend counterflow, with frequent vomiting and nausea that are nonetheless not so intense as to be unbearable. Besides vomiting, there are also chest oppression, epigastric fullness and distension, pain around the ribs, a bitter taste in the mouth, and so on.

During emotional fluctuations (such as anger, heavy stress, or anxiety), the vomiting worsens; Xiao Chaihu Tang (Minor Bupleurum Decoction) combined with Zuo Jin Wan (Left Metal Pill) is most often used to bring improvement.

Anyone can verify this personally: people who are frequently prone to anger or emotional depression do indeed readily develop the "Iron Triangle" meridian pattern, and thence various diseases of the digestive system.

In addition, traditional Chinese medicine holds that Stomach Yin Deficiency can also cause vomiting, which may be an extension of Liver-Stomach disharmony. Likewise, food damage (overeating) can cause vomiting, which is consistent with the understanding of modern medicine.

From the meridian patterns summarized above it is also clear that many symptoms share similar underlying meridian phenomena; how to improve these meridian phenomena is the key secret to preventing and treating disease.

If a person remains long-term in the meridian states described above, they will very easily vomit when they fall ill — something everyone can verify for themselves.

records.etiology_zh:
常聽人說「十人九痔」，可見這是千古以來一個常見的症狀，中國古代就有很多類似的名稱。例如：牡痔、牝痔、脈痔、血痔、血痔、腸痔、外痔、內痔、二十五痔、七十二痔...等等。

主要是古代的痔，還包含鼻痔、耳痔..等等數種，不只有肛門直腸末端的痔。必須注意的是：不論古今，嚴重的痔瘡都屬於外科領域，現代外科醫學是值得信賴的方法。

傳統中醫討論的痔瘡，主要是站在痔瘡形成的原因以預防養生的角度來探討，主要有以下幾種證候，分述如下：

一、大腸實熱、燥熱

《傷寒雜病論》提到：「小腸有寒者，其人下重便血，有熱者，必痔」。喜歡食用燥熱或辛辣的食物造成大腸實熱，是典型痔瘡形成的原因。秋天天氣燥熱，外感燥熱之邪也容易出現此證。

症狀是：肛門附近疼痛劇烈、大便乾燥秘結(像羊糞很小粒)、面紅口臭、失眠心煩、小便深黃且量少、口乾舌燥、舌紅少津，苔黃燥、脈浮數或洪。

現代人體內三焦經與大腸經能量旺盛，只要飲食與生活習慣不當，就很容易產生大腸火。

二、大腸濕熱蘊結

天氣太濕熱，濕氣之氣入侵體內也會造成大腸的熱。如果經常飲食不節制，吃太多、太飽或太油膩，喝酒辛辣，久了會導致濕熱內生，蘊結大腸，逐漸形成痔瘡。

症狀是：大便排出不暢、裡急後重、腹脹、食慾不佳、身重疲倦沈重、舌苔黃膩，脈滑數。

三、脾氣虛，中氣下陷

現代人因為長期思慮過多、勞累過度造成脾虛，導致身體中氣不足。過度勞累再加上久站、久坐，會使中氣下陷，濕熱之氣鬱積於下焦，導致肛門腫脹，進而誘使痔瘡發作。

症狀：肛門下墜、大便排出無力、氣短疲倦、食慾不佳、面色白，舌淡苔白，脈虛。

這種類型的痔瘡，必須先提升脾胃升陽之氣，才有辦法從根本改善痔瘡。

四、肝氣鬱結

現代人工作壓力大、又容易生氣、經常熬夜，導致肝氣鬱結、氣機不暢。基於臟腑別通關係，肝臟與大腸互為臟腑別通，所以只要肝不好，大腸也不會好！

這種痔瘡的症狀是：容易生氣鬱悶、生氣之後肋間疼痛、胸悶、肚子脹氣、食慾不佳、失眠。

五、經絡氣滯血瘀

因為久坐、久站，造成臀部、肛門附近氣血運行不佳形成痔瘡。長期便祕的人氣血瘀滯下焦，也會造成痔瘡腫脹。

現代人久坐居多，常常造成臀部附近經絡阻塞，從經絡檢測也可以發現，現代人只要疲勞時就膀胱經虛證，久了之後就會造成痔瘡。
records.western_pathology_zh:
痔瘡是指肛管的血管組織腫脹或發炎時呈現的病態現象，依照台灣地區成大醫院統計，罹患痔瘡機率竟高達 86%！

痔瘡的症狀，最常見的是不帶疼痛的排便出血(內痔)、肛門搔癢灼熱感、肛門不適或疼痛的情形，甚至有塊狀物從肛門脫出。

造成痔瘡的確切病原因不明，最常見的就是因為久坐或久站，臀部的氣血循環不良，而如果久坐又熬夜、吸菸、酗酒、纖維及水分攝取不足、愛吃辣、長期便秘，則有更高的風險會得到痔瘡。

痔瘡依照發生位置及種類而定，可分為內痔、外痔、混合痔。有潰瘍病史、酗酒及肝病、有吸菸習慣的人也容易痔瘡。

現代醫學治療痔瘡，主要是擦藥膏，或是進行簡單的門診手術，例如：橡皮筋結紮術、電刀切除，嚴重的痔瘡則須以傳統手術切除。

若要改善或移除痔瘡息肉，現代醫學已經掌握的很成熟。但是如果要長久預防罹患痔瘡或復發時，則可以配合運用中醫的理論。

現代人久坐，臀部經絡氣血運作不佳
records.classical_references_zh:
《素問、生氣通天論》說：「因而飽食，筋脈橫解，腸澼為痔。」

《奇效良方．腸癖痔漏門》：「且夫痔與漏，初致之由雖同，所患之病實異。初生肛邊，成不破者曰痔。破潰而出膿血，黃水浸淫、淋瀝久不止者，曰漏也。」

《普濟方痔漏門》：「蓋熱則血傷，血傷則經滯，經滯則氣不周行，氣與血俱滯，乘虛而墜入大腸，此其所以為痔也。」

《醫學綱目．痔漏》：「如大澤之中有小山突出為痔。人於九竅中，凡有小肉突出皆曰痔，不獨於肛門邊生也。」

《外科正宗》：「夫痔者，乃素積濕熱，過食炙煿，或因久坐而血脈不行，又因七情而過傷生冷，以及擔輕負重，竭力遠行，氣血縱橫，經絡交錯，又或酒色過度，脾胃受傷，以致濁氣瘀血，流注肛門，俱能發痔。」
records.western_pathology_en:
Hemorrhoids refer to the pathological state in which the vascular tissue (cushions) of the anal canal becomes swollen or inflamed. According to statistics from National Cheng Kung University Hospital in Taiwan, the prevalence of hemorrhoids reaches as high as 86%.

The most common symptoms of hemorrhoids are painless bleeding with defecation (internal hemorrhoids), anal itching and burning sensations, anal discomfort or pain, and even prolapse of a mass from the anus.

The exact cause of hemorrhoids is unknown. The most common factor is poor circulation of Qi and Blood in the buttocks due to prolonged sitting or standing; and if prolonged sitting is combined with staying up late, smoking, heavy alcohol use, insufficient fiber and fluid intake, a fondness for spicy food, or chronic constipation, the risk of developing hemorrhoids is even higher.

Depending on location and type, hemorrhoids are classified as internal, external, or mixed. People with a history of ulcers, alcohol abuse and liver disease, or a smoking habit are also prone to hemorrhoids.

Modern medical treatment of hemorrhoids mainly involves topical ointments or simple outpatient procedures, such as rubber band ligation and electrocautery excision; severe hemorrhoids require conventional surgical excision.

For improving or removing hemorrhoidal tissue, modern medicine is already very mature. But for long-term prevention of hemorrhoids or their recurrence, the theories of Chinese medicine can be applied in conjunction.

Modern people sit for long periods, impairing the movement of Qi and Blood in the meridians of the buttocks.

records.etiology_en:
One often hears the saying "nine out of ten people have hemorrhoids," showing that this has been a common complaint throughout the ages, and ancient China had many similar names for it — for example: mu zhi (male hemorrhoid), pin zhi (female hemorrhoid), mai zhi (vessel hemorrhoid), xue zhi (blood hemorrhoid), chang zhi (intestinal hemorrhoid), external hemorrhoid, internal hemorrhoid, the twenty-five hemorrhoids, the seventy-two hemorrhoids, and so on.

This is chiefly because the ancient concept of zhi (hemorrhoid) also encompassed several other growths such as nasal polyps ("nose hemorrhoids") and aural polyps ("ear hemorrhoids"), not only those of the anus and distal rectum. It must be noted that in both ancient and modern times, severe hemorrhoids belong to the domain of surgery, and modern surgical medicine is a trustworthy approach.

Traditional Chinese medicine's discussion of hemorrhoids mainly approaches the causes of their formation from the perspective of prevention and health cultivation. The principal patterns are as follows:

1. Large Intestine Excess Heat and Dryness-Heat

The Shanghan Zabing Lun (Treatise on Cold Damage and Miscellaneous Diseases) states: "When the small intestine has Cold, the person has rectal heaviness and blood in the stool; when it has Heat, hemorrhoids inevitably result." A fondness for heating (dry-hot) or spicy foods producing Excess Heat in the Large Intestine is a classic cause of hemorrhoid formation. In autumn, when the weather is dry and hot, external invasion by the Dryness-Heat pathogen also readily produces this pattern.

The symptoms are: severe pain around the anus; dry, hard, constipated stools (small pellets like goat droppings); flushed face and bad breath; insomnia and vexation; deep-yellow, scanty urine; dry mouth and tongue; a red tongue with little fluid and a yellow dry coating; and a floating-rapid or surging pulse.

In modern people the Triple Burner and Large Intestine meridians are energetically exuberant, so with improper diet and lifestyle habits, Large Intestine Fire arises very easily.

2. Damp-Heat accumulating and binding in the Large Intestine

When the weather is excessively damp and hot, Damp Qi invading the body can also generate Heat in the Large Intestine. Habitual dietary excess — eating too much, too fully, or too greasily, along with alcohol and spicy food — over time engenders internal Damp-Heat that accumulates and binds in the Large Intestine, gradually forming hemorrhoids.

The symptoms are: unsmooth passage of stool, tenesmus (urgency with rectal heaviness), abdominal distension, poor appetite, generalized heaviness and fatigue, a yellow greasy tongue coating, and a slippery rapid pulse.

3. Spleen Qi Deficiency with sinking of Middle Qi

Modern people, through chronic overthinking and overwork, develop Spleen Deficiency, leading to insufficiency of the body's Middle Qi. Excessive fatigue combined with prolonged standing or sitting causes the Middle Qi to sink; Damp-Heat then stagnates and accumulates in the Lower Burner, causing anal swelling and thereby precipitating hemorrhoid flare-ups.

Symptoms: a bearing-down sensation at the anus, weak ineffective straining at stool, shortness of breath and fatigue, poor appetite, a pale complexion, a pale tongue with white coating, and a deficient pulse.

For this type of hemorrhoid, one must first raise the ascending Yang Qi of the Spleen and Stomach in order to improve the hemorrhoids at their root.

4. Liver Qi constraint (Liver Qi stagnation)

Modern people face heavy work pressure, are prone to anger, and often stay up late, leading to Liver Qi stagnation and inhibited Qi dynamics. According to the zang-fu paired-communication (bie tong) relationship, the Liver and the Large Intestine communicate as a zang-fu pair — so when the Liver is unwell, the Large Intestine will not be well either!

The symptoms of this type of hemorrhoid are: proneness to anger and depression, intercostal pain after anger, chest oppression, abdominal bloating, poor appetite, and insomnia.

5. Qi stagnation and Blood stasis in the meridians

Prolonged sitting or standing causes poor movement of Qi and Blood in the buttocks and around the anus, forming hemorrhoids. In people with chronic constipation, Qi and Blood stagnate in the Lower Burner, which also causes hemorrhoidal swelling.

Modern people mostly sit for long periods, which frequently causes obstruction of the meridians around the buttocks. Meridian testing also shows that modern people exhibit Bladder meridian Deficiency whenever fatigued, and over time this leads to hemorrhoids.

records.classical_references_zh:
《景岳全書．雜證謨．不寐》：「不寐雖病有不一，然惟知邪正二字則盡之矣。蓋寐本乎陰，神其主也，神安則寐，神不安則不寐。其所以不安者，一由邪之擾，一由營氣不足耳。有邪者多實證，無邪者皆虛證。」

《溫病條辨．下焦篇》汪按：「不寐之因甚多，有陰虛不受陽納者，有陽亢不入於陰者，有膽熱者，有肝用不足者，有心氣虛者，有心液虛者，有蹻脈不和者，有痰飲擾心者。」

《內經》：「胃不和則臥不安。」

《溫病條辨·中焦篇》：「不寐，中焦濕聚，阻遏陽氣不得下交於陰也。」

《馮氏錦囊·卷十二》：「壯年人腎陰強盛，則睡沉熟而長，老年人陰氣衰弱，則睡輕微易知；」

records.etiology_zh: 焦慮症屬中醫「鬱證」、「臟躁」範疇，病機多因情志所傷、肝失疏泄，氣機鬱結日久化火，上擾心神，發為心煩易怒、坐臥不安；或思慮勞倦傷及心脾，氣血生化不足，心神失養而見忐忑不安、易驚善恐；素體陰虛或病久傷陰者，肝腎陰虛、虛火內擾，心神不寧尤甚；痰熱內蘊、上蒙清竅亦可見胸悶煩躁、坐臥難安。臨床以肝鬱化火、心脾兩虛、陰虛火旺、痰熱擾心為常見證型。
records.western_pathology_zh: 西醫認為廣泛性焦慮症與恐懼、擔憂相關腦區的功能失調有關，涉及杏仁核過度活化與前額葉調控功能不足，導致對威脅性刺激的評估與抑制失衡；神經傳導物質方面與 GABA 抑制性訊號不足、麩胺酸系統失調及血清素、正腎上腺素路徑異常有關；下視丘—腦垂體—腎上腺軸（HPA 軸）長期過度活化，皮質醇分泌失調，亦與慢性焦慮狀態相關。發病為遺傳體質與慢性壓力、創傷等環境因素交互作用的結果，常合併自律神經症狀如心悸、肌肉緊繃、腸胃不適。
records.etiology_en: Anxiety disorder falls within the TCM categories of "depression pattern" (yu zheng) and "visceral agitation" (zang zao). The pathogenesis often begins with emotional disturbance impairing the liver's free-coursing function; prolonged qi stagnation transforms into fire that disturbs the heart spirit, producing irritability and restlessness. Overthinking and fatigue can injure the heart and spleen, depleting qi and blood so the heart spirit lacks nourishment, producing unease and easy fright. In those with constitutional yin deficiency or after prolonged illness, liver-kidney yin deficiency with internal deficient fire further unsettles the spirit; phlegm-heat accumulating and clouding the clear orifices can also cause chest oppression and restlessness. Common clinical patterns include liver depression transforming into fire, heart-spleen deficiency, yin deficiency with effulgent fire, and phlegm-heat harassing the heart.

records.western_pathology_en: In Western medicine, generalized anxiety disorder is associated with dysfunction in brain circuits governing fear and worry, including amygdala hyperactivation and insufficient prefrontal cortical regulation, which unbalances the appraisal and inhibition of threat-related stimuli. Neurotransmitter abnormalities include reduced inhibitory GABA signaling, glutamatergic system dysregulation, and disturbances in serotonergic and noradrenergic pathways. Chronic overactivation of the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis with dysregulated cortisol secretion is also linked to sustained anxiety states. The disorder arises from interaction between genetic predisposition and environmental factors such as chronic stress and trauma, and is commonly accompanied by autonomic symptoms such as palpitations, muscle tension, and gastrointestinal discomfort.

records.etiology_zh:
要治療神經衰弱最簡單的方法，就是放慢步調，遠離電腦、手機，讓腦子徹底休息。由於古代中國人沒有現代科技，所以要罹患這種疾病的機率應該很低。

要理解神經衰弱的真正原因是什麼，最簡單直接的方法就是去找一個神經衰弱的人，長期檢測他/她的經絡，就可以知道是什麼經絡異常所造成的。

由於過去幾年來回報受到神經衰弱困擾的會員實在是非常多，所以透過歸納這些經絡型態，就可以找出一些背後的主要原因，主要有以下幾種：

1.肝氣鬱結、心脾兩虛、心血虛

傳統中醫認為「心主血脈」，如果一個人思慮過度時，就會耗傷心血，導致心血不足。會出現心悸、失眠、多夢、容易驚嚇、健忘、頭暈...等症狀。

當心臟的精神功能失調時，可能會表現為心神不寧、精神恍惚、悲傷想哭、無法控制自己的情緒、心中煩亂、睡眠不安、連連打哈欠，嚴重時甚至會出現語言異常。

古人把這種症狀稱為「臟躁證」，這與現代所說的神經衰弱症有些相似，運用「甘麥大棗湯」加以改善。

古人認為「思傷脾」，過度思考不僅會損傷心臟的血液，還會影響到脾臟和胃的功能，這是身體生成氣血的重要部分，功能都受損時，會導致精神無法穩定。

古人認為「思傷脾」，思考過度傷害脾胃

中醫也認為「肝主一身之氣」，掌管人體內所有氣之流動，肝氣一定要舒展暢達，如果「鬱滯」時，七情(喜、怒、憂、思、悲、恐、驚)就無法調節順暢，所以肝氣鬱結時也會神經衰弱。

如果這個肝氣鬱結在體內累積一段時間之後，就會出現「化火」現象，這時候神經衰弱就會更嚴重。

綜合以上的所有描述，完全可以運用經絡檢測來印證這件事情。從大量神經衰弱的經絡型態中可以看出，有較高的機率是出現「鐵三角經絡型態的極致現象」。(開啟閱讀深入理解)

這種經絡型態，脾虛胃強、肝胃不和、肝脾不調、心脾兩虛，同時心經、心包經虛證。少陽經、陽明經實證，所以體內很火熱。

有一定比例的人，一年四季都呈現這種經絡型態，這是非常容易出現神經衰弱的一種經絡模型。

鐵三角經絡型態的極致現象

尤其是這種經絡型態，幾乎是一年四季都是膀胱經虛證、腎經虛證。「膀胱經」與「督脈」牽動中樞神經系統，腎臟與腦部關係密切，因為能量過度消耗，很可能就是造成神經衰弱的主因。

膀胱經與督脈氣血不足時，容易出現神經衰弱症

2024年有一位會員就分享，他說「思傷脾」這件事完全可以理解，因為他只要有一陣子特別用腦寫程式，就會出現胃脹氣、消化不良，最後確實會出現神經衰弱的感覺。而他的經絡現象，確實就是出現鐵三角經絡型態。

通常出現這種經絡型態的人，過去都是到處看病，怎麼看都看不好，這就是典型自律神經失調、神經衰弱的現象。

2.心腎不交、腎精不足

心腎不交時也會造成神經衰弱，這是中醫特有的概念，根據五行理論，心屬火、腎屬水。

在正常情況下，水與火相融，心與腎應相互配合。當這兩者無法順利交融，便會導致心腎不交的狀態。

中醫學中有「腎藏精」的觀點，中醫的腎與現代醫學的腦部有著密切的關聯。腎精不足會影響身體的激素平衡，進而可能引起各種腦部相關疾病。

某會員患有神經衰弱持續至少10年以上，他從2020年開始觀察經絡，發現自己的經絡數據是非常穩定的，為什麼呢？因為他經常可以看到自己心經實證，脾經與腎經虛證的現象。

男性長期神經衰弱，常見的經絡型態

他說自己的每天常見症狀，與神經衰弱的症狀99%吻合。可見中醫說的心腎不交、腎精不足有可能造成神經衰弱，這應該是真的。透過觀察經絡，也可以印證這個現象。

從大量現代人的經絡數據發現，脾經與腎經虛證是常態，基於此現代人有很高的機率會出現神經衰弱。

傳統中醫認為，「腎陰虛化火」的人，也有機會出現神經衰弱症。上面提到的鐵三角經絡型態極致現象，有一定比例的人腎經就是實證，或許可以用來解釋什麼叫做腎陰虛化火。

3.上虛下實、任督不通

神經衰弱的經絡型態還有很多種類型，自從疫情之後最常見的類型就是「上虛下實」，這種經絡型態的特點，可以說是整個胸部與腹部的經絡氣血都是阻塞的。

如果從經絡的角度來看，也可以說是任督二脈不通，上下無法交通，所以也有可能出現神經衰弱。

上虛下實、上實下虛的人，容易任督二脈不通

4.上實下虛、寒氣深重

由於綜合經絡型態是最常見的經絡型態，所以有一定比例的人出現神經衰弱，也是這種「鐵三角」加上「陽虛」經絡型態所造成的現象。

這種經絡型態膽經、胃經與膀胱經能量都是很虛弱的，這會導致通往頭部的氣血不足，所以很容易出現腦神經衰弱的現象。嚴重時就會出現「上實下虛」，導致任督二脈不通。

既然神經衰弱是用腦過多所造成的，最好的治療方法就是不要用腦，經常放空腦袋，運用經絡穴道拍打是一個很好的改善方式。

無論哪一種經絡型態，只要知道自己的異常經絡，經常運用經絡拍打或按摩，去疏通這些異常經絡，就可以緩解腦神經衰弱的現象。

如果可以配合冥想、瑜伽呼吸法，這是改善神經衰弱的最根本方法。名醫陳慕純醫師，就是長期指導病患練習內核心呼吸法，用來治療失眠卻不依賴安眠藥。

運用中藥改善神經衰弱的原理，主要是調整體內的脾胃系統， 讓所謂的「腦腸軸」暢通(開啟閱讀)，自然也可以改善神經衰弱的現象， 可見中醫的脾胃是與腦部密切相關的。
records.western_pathology_zh:
人腦是一個很神秘的器官，其實是相當耐操的！大腦皮質的神經細胞，就像那些可以連續工作超時的不倒翁，只要給它們足夠的睡眠和休息，它們就能迅速恢復元氣，再次投入戰鬥。

不過，在現代社會的龐大壓力下，神經衰弱症已經成為不少人的隱形敵人，當腦神經被長時間過度使用，好比開了個不停的馬拉松，終有一刻會越耐受極限。

現代人資訊焦慮，普遍用腦過多

當一個人遭遇腦神經衰弱時，他的生活就好比被施了一個怪異的咒語。忘記東西變得司空見慣，就像個擁有短暫記憶的金魚。

整天無精打采，仿佛所有生活動力都被抽走了。不論做什麼都提不起勁，最終只想找個安靜的角落坐下或躺著。

反應變慢，對周遭的人事物漠不關心，這讓旁人可能會誤以為是憂鬱症。情緒波動大，可能因為一點小事就陷入深深的鬱悶，或是突然爆發出怒氣。

睡眠再也不是一件輕鬆事，常常被一點小聲音驚醒，然後輾轉反側難以再次入眠。

這種狀態常被歸類為「精神官能症」、「自律神經失調」或「身心症」。但是到醫院檢查，常會得到一個讓人哭笑不得的答案：「你沒有病！」讓人更感到無助。

這時候，中醫提供了另一種角度來看待和治療神經衰弱，提供另一條全新的思路！
records.classical_references_zh:
《靈樞/本神篇》：「是故怵惕思慮者則傷神，神傷則恐懼，流淫而不止，因悲哀動中者，竭絕而失生。喜樂者，神憚散而不藏；愁憂者，氣閉塞而不行；盛怒者，迷惑而不治；恐懼者，神蕩憚而不收。」

《靈樞・本神篇》：「故智者之養生也，必順四時而適寒暑，和喜怒而安居處，節陰陽而調剛柔，如是則僻邪不至，長生久視。」

《女科經綸/胎前證下》：「無故悲傷屬肺病，臟躁者，肺之臟躁也。胎前氣血壅養胎元，則津液不能充潤，而肺為之燥，肺燥當補母，故有甘草大棗以補脾，若立齋用八珍湯補養氣血，真佐前人未盡。」
records.western_pathology_en:
The human brain is a mysterious organ — and in fact a remarkably durable one! The nerve cells of the cerebral cortex are like tireless tumbler dolls able to work overtime continuously: given sufficient sleep and rest, they can quickly recover their vitality and throw themselves back into the fight.

However, under the enormous pressures of modern society, neurasthenia has become an invisible enemy for many people. When the brain's nerves are overused for long periods — like running a marathon that never stops — a moment will eventually come when the limit of endurance is exceeded.

Modern people suffer information anxiety and generally overuse their brains.

When a person suffers neurasthenia, life seems as though placed under a strange curse. Forgetting things becomes commonplace, like a goldfish with only short-term memory.

They are listless all day, as if all motivation for living has been drained away. Nothing they do can rouse their interest, and ultimately they only want to find a quiet corner to sit or lie down.

Reactions slow, and they grow indifferent to the people and things around them, which may lead others to mistake it for depression. Emotional swings are large: a small matter may plunge them into deep gloom, or anger may suddenly erupt.

Sleep is no longer easy: they are often startled awake by the slightest sound, then toss and turn, unable to fall asleep again.

This state is often classified as "psychoneurosis," "autonomic nervous system dysregulation (dysautonomia)," or "psychosomatic disorder." But on examination at the hospital, one often receives an answer that leaves one not knowing whether to laugh or cry — "There is nothing wrong with you!" — which makes the person feel even more helpless.

At this point, Chinese medicine offers another perspective for viewing and treating neurasthenia — an entirely new line of thinking!

records.etiology_en:
The simplest way to treat neurasthenia is to slow down, stay away from computers and mobile phones, and let the brain rest completely. Since the ancient Chinese had no modern technology, their probability of developing this illness must have been very low.

To understand the true cause of neurasthenia, the simplest and most direct method is to find a person with neurasthenia and test their meridians over the long term; one can then know which meridian abnormalities are responsible.

Because a great many members have reported being troubled by neurasthenia over the past several years, summarizing these meridian patterns reveals some of the principal underlying causes, chiefly the following:

1. Liver Qi stagnation, Heart-Spleen dual Deficiency, Heart Blood Deficiency

Traditional Chinese medicine holds that "the Heart governs the Blood and vessels." When a person overthinks, Heart Blood is consumed and damaged, leading to insufficiency of Heart Blood, with symptoms such as palpitations, insomnia, excessive dreaming, being easily startled, forgetfulness, and dizziness.

When the Heart's Spirit functions are disturbed, this may manifest as restlessness of the Heart Spirit, mental abstraction, sadness with a desire to weep, inability to control one's emotions, inner agitation, unquiet sleep, and repeated yawning; in severe cases even speech abnormalities may appear.

The ancients called this symptom picture "visceral agitation (zang zao)," which somewhat resembles what is now called neurasthenia; Gan Mai Dazao Tang (Licorice, Wheat and Jujube Decoction) is used to improve it.

The ancients held that "pensiveness damages the Spleen": excessive thinking not only damages the Heart's Blood but also affects the functions of the Spleen and Stomach — the body's essential source for generating Qi and Blood. When both are impaired, the Spirit cannot be stabilized.

The ancients held that "pensiveness damages the Spleen" — excessive thinking harms the Spleen and Stomach.

Chinese medicine also holds that "the Liver governs the Qi of the whole body," directing the movement of all Qi within the human body. Liver Qi must remain unimpeded and free-flowing; when it becomes "constrained and stagnant," the seven emotions (joy, anger, worry, pensiveness, sadness, fear, fright) cannot be regulated smoothly — thus Liver Qi stagnation can also produce neurasthenia.

If this constrained Liver Qi accumulates in the body for a period of time, a "transformation into Fire" occurs, at which point the neurasthenia becomes even more severe.

All of the above descriptions can be verified through meridian testing. From large numbers of neurasthenia meridian patterns, there is a relatively high probability of finding "the extreme form of the Iron Triangle meridian pattern." (Open to read for deeper understanding.)

In this meridian pattern there are Spleen Deficiency with Stomach Excess, Liver-Stomach disharmony, Liver-Spleen disharmony, and Heart-Spleen dual Deficiency, together with Deficiency of the Heart and Pericardium meridians. The Shaoyang and Yangming meridians are in Excess, so the interior of the body is very hot.

A certain proportion of people display this meridian pattern in all four seasons; it is a meridian model extremely prone to neurasthenia.

The extreme form of the Iron Triangle meridian pattern.

In this meridian pattern especially, the Bladder meridian and Kidney meridian are Deficient virtually year-round. The Bladder meridian and the Governing Vessel (Du Mai) engage the central nervous system, and the Kidney is closely related to the brain; excessive energy consumption may well be the chief cause of the neurasthenia.

When the Qi and Blood of the Bladder meridian and Governing Vessel are insufficient, neurasthenia readily appears.

In 2024 a member shared that the saying "pensiveness damages the Spleen" was something he could completely understand: whenever he spent a stretch of time intensely programming, he would develop stomach bloating and indigestion, and eventually a genuine feeling of neurasthenia. And his meridian findings indeed showed the Iron Triangle meridian pattern.

People showing this meridian pattern have usually sought medical care everywhere without ever getting better — the classic picture of autonomic dysregulation and neurasthenia.

2. Heart and Kidney failing to communicate; insufficiency of Kidney Essence

When the Heart and Kidney fail to communicate, neurasthenia can also result. This is a concept unique to Chinese medicine: according to Five Phases theory, the Heart belongs to Fire and the Kidney to Water.

Under normal circumstances Water and Fire blend, and Heart and Kidney should cooperate with each other. When the two cannot merge smoothly, the state of Heart-Kidney non-communication results.

Chinese medicine holds the view that "the Kidney stores Essence," and the TCM Kidney is closely related to the brain of modern medicine. Insufficient Kidney Essence affects the body's hormonal balance and may in turn give rise to various brain-related diseases.

One member had suffered neurasthenia for at least 10 years. Observing his meridians from 2020 onward, he found his meridian data to be remarkably stable. Why? Because he could regularly see the phenomenon of Heart meridian Excess with Deficiency of the Spleen and Kidney meridians.

The meridian pattern commonly seen in men with chronic neurasthenia.

He said his everyday symptoms matched the symptoms of neurasthenia 99%. Evidently the TCM concepts of Heart-Kidney non-communication and Kidney Essence insufficiency may truly cause neurasthenia — and observing the meridians can corroborate this phenomenon.

Large volumes of meridian data from modern people show that Deficiency of the Spleen and Kidney meridians is the norm; on this basis, modern people have a very high probability of developing neurasthenia.

Traditional Chinese medicine also holds that people with "Kidney Yin Deficiency transforming into Fire" may develop neurasthenia. In the extreme Iron Triangle meridian pattern mentioned above, a certain proportion of people show Kidney meridian Excess — perhaps this can serve to explain what Kidney Yin Deficiency transforming into Fire means.

3. Deficiency above, Excess below; Conception and Governing Vessels blocked

There are many more types of neurasthenia meridian patterns. Since the pandemic, the most common type has been "Deficiency above, Excess below." The hallmark of this meridian pattern is that the Qi and Blood of the meridians of the entire chest and abdomen are obstructed.

Viewed from the meridian perspective, one could also say the Conception Vessel (Ren Mai) and Governing Vessel (Du Mai) are blocked, so that above and below cannot communicate — hence neurasthenia may also arise.

People with Deficiency above/Excess below or Excess above/Deficiency below readily have blockage of the Conception and Governing Vessels.

4. Excess above, Deficiency below; deep-seated Cold

Since the composite meridian pattern is the most common meridian pattern, a certain proportion of neurasthenia cases likewise arise from this "Iron Triangle" plus "Yang Deficiency" meridian pattern.

In this pattern the energies of the Gallbladder, Stomach, and Bladder meridians are all very weak, resulting in insufficient Qi and Blood reaching the head — hence cerebral neurasthenia appears readily. In severe cases it becomes "Excess above, Deficiency below," causing blockage of the Conception and Governing Vessels.

Since neurasthenia is caused by overuse of the brain, the best treatment is not to use the brain — to empty the mind regularly. Meridian and acupoint patting (tapping therapy) is an excellent method of improvement.

Whatever the meridian pattern, once you know your own abnormal meridians, regularly applying meridian patting or massage to unblock these abnormal meridians can relieve cerebral neurasthenia.

Combining this with meditation and yogic breathing methods is the most fundamental way to improve neurasthenia. The renowned physician Dr. Chen Mu-chun has long taught patients his inner-core breathing method to treat insomnia without dependence on sleeping pills.

The principle of using Chinese herbs to improve neurasthenia is mainly to regulate the body's Spleen-Stomach system and keep the so-called "brain-gut axis" unobstructed (open to read); this naturally also improves neurasthenia — showing that the TCM Spleen and Stomach are intimately connected with the brain.

records.etiology_zh: 恐慌症屬中醫「驚悸」、「奔豚氣」範疇，病機多因素體心膽氣虛，復受驚恐所傷，心神失於潛藏，稍遇刺激即發心悸怔忡、惕惕不安；或肝鬱氣滯，鬱久化火，氣火上逆如豚豚奔突，發為陣發性胸悶氣促、瀕死驚恐感；痰飲內停者，痰隨氣逆，蒙蔽心竅，亦可誘發驚悸眩暈、喉中窒塞感。發作間歇期常見心膽氣虛、預期性焦慮不安。臨床以心膽氣虛、肝鬱化火、痰飲上逆為常見證型。
records.western_pathology_zh: 恐慌症的西醫病理機轉與腦幹藍斑核（locus coeruleus）正腎上腺素系統的陣發性過度放電有關，引發突發性心跳加速、呼吸急促、出汗、顫抖等交感神經症狀；杏仁核對於窒息感與內在生理訊號的過度敏感反應，是「假性窒息警報」假說的核心，患者對輕微的生理變化（如心跳加快、換氣過度）產生災難化誤判，進而加劇恐慌發作；長期反覆發作可導致預期性焦慮與場所畏懼，遺傳因素與壓力事件亦是重要誘因。
records.etiology_en: Panic disorder falls within the TCM categories of "fright palpitations" (jing ji) and "running piglet qi" (ben tun qi). The pathogenesis often arises from constitutional heart-gallbladder qi deficiency compounded by fright, so that the heart spirit fails to stay anchored and even minor stimuli trigger palpitations and restless unease. In other cases, liver qi stagnation transforms into fire over time, and the counterflow of qi and fire surges upward like a bolting piglet, producing paroxysmal chest oppression, shortness of breath, and a sense of impending doom. Where phlegm-fluid accumulates internally, phlegm rising with counterflow qi can cloud the heart orifices and trigger palpitations, dizziness, and a sensation of throat constriction. Between attacks, anticipatory anxiety with heart-gallbladder qi deficiency is common. Frequently seen clinical patterns include heart-gallbladder qi deficiency, liver depression transforming into fire, and phlegm-fluid counterflow.

records.western_pathology_en: In Western medicine, the pathophysiology of panic disorder is linked to paroxysmal bursts of noradrenergic discharge from the locus coeruleus in the brainstem, triggering sudden sympathetic symptoms such as tachycardia, rapid breathing, sweating, and trembling. Amygdala hypersensitivity to suffocation cues and internal physiological signals underlies the "false suffocation alarm" hypothesis, in which patients catastrophically misinterpret minor physiological changes — such as a faster heartbeat or hyperventilation — amplifying the panic response. Repeated attacks over time can lead to anticipatory anxiety and agoraphobia; genetic predisposition and stressful life events are also important precipitating factors.

records.name_zh: 創傷後壓力症（文件情境）
records.etiology_zh: 創傷後壓力症屬中醫「驚悸」、「臟躁」範疇，病機以卒受驚恐、驚則氣亂為先導，致心神浮越、不能自主，反覆出現創傷情境的閃回與惡夢；病久不解，耗傷心膽之氣，心膽氣虛則見易驚善恐、聞聲即驚；肝失疏泄，氣鬱化火，可見煩躁易怒、情緒難以自控；病程遷延，氣血陰精暗耗，心脾兩虛或心腎不交，則見神情淡漠、恍惚不安、夜寐不寧、記憶反覆閃回而難以自制。臨床以心膽氣虛、肝鬱化火、心脾兩虛為常見證型。
records.western_pathology_zh: PTSD 的西醫病理機轉涉及杏仁核對威脅相關線索的過度活化、海馬迴體積縮小導致情境記憶與時間脈絡整合功能受損，使創傷記憶片段化並在不當情境下被觸發（閃回）；前額葉皮質對杏仁核的下行抑制功能減弱，恐懼消除（extinction）機制失效；下視丘—腦垂體—腎上腺軸調節異常，部分患者呈現基礎皮質醇偏低而正腎上腺素反應性過高的型態，形成過度警覺、驚跳反應增強等交感神經亢奮症狀。發病與創傷嚴重度、既往創傷史、社會支持及遺傳體質等因素相關。
records.etiology_en: Post-traumatic stress disorder falls within the TCM categories of "fright palpitations" (jing ji) and "visceral agitation" (zang zao). The pathogenesis begins with sudden fright disordering the qi, unmooring the heart spirit so that traumatic flashbacks and nightmares recur involuntarily. When unresolved over time, this depletes heart-gallbladder qi, producing easy startling and hypervigilance to sound. Impaired liver free-coursing with qi stagnation transforming into fire manifests as irritability and difficulty controlling emotion. With prolonged course, qi, blood, and essence are gradually consumed; heart-spleen deficiency or heart-kidney disharmony follows, presenting as emotional numbness, dissociation, disturbed sleep, and intrusive, uncontrollable re-experiencing of the trauma. Commonly seen clinical patterns include heart-gallbladder qi deficiency, liver depression transforming into fire, and heart-spleen deficiency.

records.western_pathology_en: In Western medicine, the pathophysiology of PTSD involves amygdala hyperactivation to threat-related cues and reduced hippocampal volume, which impairs contextual and temporal integration of memory so that traumatic memories become fragmented and are triggered inappropriately as flashbacks. Diminished top-down inhibition of the amygdala by the prefrontal cortex leads to failure of fear extinction. Dysregulation of the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis is also implicated; some patients show a pattern of lower baseline cortisol with heightened noradrenergic reactivity, producing hyperarousal and an exaggerated startle response. Onset is associated with trauma severity, prior trauma history, social support, and genetic predisposition.

records.name_zh: 注意力不足過動症（文件情境）
records.etiology_zh: 注意力不足過動症屬中醫兒科「健忘」、「躁動」範疇，病機多為先天稟賦不足，腎精未充，腦髓失養，故見注意力難以集中、學習遲鈍；後天脾虛則生化乏源，氣血不足以養心神，加之肝常有餘，肝陽偏亢、肝風內動，可見坐立不安、衝動易怒、動作難以自控；脾虛生濕，濕聚成痰，痰火上擾心神，則見情緒躁動、言行冒失。臨床以腎虛肝旺、心脾兩虛、痰火擾心為常見證型，治療重在補腎填精、健脾益氣、平肝潛陽、清心化痰。
records.western_pathology_zh: ADHD 的西醫病理機轉主要涉及前額葉—紋狀體神經迴路中多巴胺與正腎上腺素傳導不足，影響執行功能、抑制控制與工作記憶，導致注意力難以持續、衝動控制不佳與過動行為；影像學研究顯示部分患者大腦皮質成熟速度較同齡兒童延遲；遺傳率高，屬多基因交互作用之神經發展性疾患，亦與孕期環境因子（如早產、菸酒暴露）有關。症狀通常在學齡前後顯現，可持續至成年，常合併學習或情緒調節困難。
records.etiology_en: Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder falls within the TCM pediatric categories of "forgetfulness" (jian wang) and "restlessness" (zao dong). The pathogenesis is often rooted in insufficient congenital endowment, with unreplenished kidney essence failing to nourish the brain marrow, resulting in difficulty sustaining attention and slow learning. Acquired spleen deficiency limits the generation of qi and blood needed to nourish the heart spirit; combined with the child's constitutionally exuberant liver, liver yang hyperactivity and internal liver wind stirring can produce restlessness, impulsivity, irritability, and poor behavioral self-control. Spleen deficiency generating dampness that congeals into phlegm, with phlegm-fire disturbing the heart spirit, presents as emotional agitation and rash speech or actions. Commonly seen clinical patterns include kidney deficiency with liver hyperactivity, heart-spleen deficiency, and phlegm-fire harassing the heart; treatment emphasizes tonifying the kidney and replenishing essence, fortifying the spleen and boosting qi, calming the liver and subduing yang, and clearing the heart while resolving phlegm.

records.western_pathology_en: In Western medicine, the pathophysiology of ADHD primarily involves insufficient dopaminergic and noradrenergic transmission within prefrontal-striatal circuits, impairing executive function, inhibitory control, and working memory, which underlies sustained inattention, poor impulse control, and hyperactive behavior. Neuroimaging studies show that cortical maturation is delayed in some affected children relative to peers. Heritability is high, reflecting a neurodevelopmental disorder shaped by multigenic interaction, and is also associated with prenatal environmental factors such as prematurity and exposure to tobacco or alcohol. Symptoms typically emerge around school age and can persist into adulthood, often accompanied by learning or emotional regulation difficulties.

records.etiology_zh: 壓力與過勞屬中醫「虛勞」、「鬱證」範疇，病機多因勞倦過度、情志失調，日久耗傷心脾之氣，氣血化生不足，故見神疲乏力、心悸健忘、食慾不振；情志不遂、肝失疏泄，氣機鬱滯，久則化火傷陰，可見煩躁易怒、胸脅脹悶、失眠多夢；病程遷延不解，由心脾及腎，腎精暗耗，出現腰膝痠軟、精神萎靡、記憶減退等虛損之候。臨床以心脾兩虛、肝鬱化火、氣陰兩虛為常見證型，久病者常兼夾多證。
records.western_pathology_zh: 西醫將慢性壓力與過勞的病理機轉歸因於下視丘—腦垂體—腎上腺軸長期過度活化，初期皮質醇分泌偏高，長期則轉為調節反應遲鈍（皮質醇日夜節律變平），並伴交感神經系統持續亢奮，形成「累積負荷」（allostatic load）；長期壓力亦干擾睡眠結構、削弱免疫調節功能，並與情緒耗竭、去人性化（對工作與他人疏離冷漠）、成就感低落等職業倦怠核心症狀相關。持續處於高壓狀態者，罹患焦慮、憂鬱及心血管疾病之風險亦相對升高。
records.etiology_en: Stress and burnout fall within the TCM categories of "taxation fatigue" (xu lao) and "depression pattern" (yu zheng). The pathogenesis commonly arises from excessive overwork and unregulated emotion, which over time consumes heart and spleen qi and reduces the generation of qi and blood, presenting as fatigue, palpitations, poor memory, and reduced appetite. Unresolved emotional distress impairing the liver's free-coursing function causes qi stagnation that, if prolonged, transforms into fire and injures yin, manifesting as irritability, chest and hypochondriac distension, and disturbed sleep with excessive dreaming. When the condition persists, the pathology extends from the heart and spleen to the kidney, gradually depleting kidney essence and producing deficiency signs such as lower back and knee soreness, mental exhaustion, and memory decline. Commonly seen clinical patterns include heart-spleen deficiency, liver depression transforming into fire, and combined qi-yin deficiency; in long-standing cases, multiple patterns often coexist.

records.western_pathology_en: In Western medicine, the pathophysiology of chronic stress and burnout is attributed to prolonged overactivation of the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis — initially elevated cortisol secretion, later blunting into a flattened diurnal cortisol rhythm — accompanied by sustained sympathetic nervous system activation, producing cumulative "allostatic load." Chronic stress also disrupts sleep architecture and impairs immune regulation, and is linked to the core features of occupational burnout: emotional exhaustion, depersonalization (detachment from work and others), and reduced sense of personal accomplishment. Individuals under sustained high stress also carry a correspondingly elevated risk of anxiety, depression, and cardiovascular disease.

records.name_zh: 慢性疲勞症候群（文件情境）
records.etiology_zh: 西醫方面，本病病因尚未明確，目前認為與 Epstein-Barr 病毒或人類疱疹病毒第六型（HHV-6）感染有關，亦可能因免疫系統反應失常而引起神經系統發炎。中醫方面，本病多屬外感之後餘邪未清：餘邪留連少陽，或入陽明化熱，熱擾上焦（心熱、肺熱）、中焦（發熱、煩躁）或下焦（灼傷陰液）；亦可見脾為濕熱所困而脾氣虛弱、肺之水液下返於脾而肺氣虛、肝氣橫逆乘脾而肝鬱脾虛。病久耗傷氣血陰陽，則形成肝血虛、肺陰虛、胃陰虛、腎陰虛、腎陽虛、心血虛、心陰虛等虛損證候。
records.western_pathology_zh: 本病指一組以嚴重而持續之疲勞為特徵的症候群：疲勞不因休息（包括臥床休息）而緩解，並非由其他疾病直接引起，且病程持續超過六個月。西醫對其病理機制尚未完全闡明，目前認為可能與 Epstein-Barr 病毒或人類疱疹病毒第六型（HHV-6）感染有關，或因免疫系統反應失常而導致神經系統發炎。

records.etiology_en: In Western medicine the etiology is not clearly understood; it is believed to involve Epstein-Barr virus or human herpesvirus-6 (HHV-6) infection, and inflammation in the nervous system resulting from a faulty immune-system response. In Chinese medicine the condition is largely attributed to a residual pathogenic factor after an external invasion (residual EPI): the lingering pathogen may remain in the Shaoyang, or enter the Yangming and transform into heat disturbing the upper jiao (heart heat, lung heat), the middle jiao (fever, irritability), or the lower jiao (injuring yin). Other mechanisms include spleen damp-heat with spleen qi deficiency, lung fluid falling back to the spleen with lung qi deficiency, and liver qi overacting on the spleen producing liver qi stagnation with spleen qi deficiency. With time these deplete qi, blood, yin and yang, giving rise to deficiency patterns such as liver blood deficiency, lung yin deficiency, stomach yin deficiency, kidney yin deficiency, kidney yang deficiency, heart blood deficiency, and heart yin deficiency.
records.western_pathology_en: Chronic fatigue syndrome refers to a group of symptoms characterized by severe, continued tiredness that is not relieved by rest (including bed rest), is not directly caused by other medical conditions, and lasts more than six months. Its pathology is not clearly understood in Western medicine; it is believed to be due to Epstein-Barr virus or human herpesvirus-6 (HHV-6) infection, or to inflammation in the nervous system caused by a faulty immune-system response.

records.etiology_zh: 不寧腿症候群屬中醫「血痺」、「著痺」範疇，病機以肝血不足、筋脈失於濡養為主，血虛生風，虛風內動，故見夜臥則下肢酸脹麻痛、蟲行蟻走感，必欲移動或捶打方能稍緩；脾腎兩虛、氣血生化不足者，血不養筋之象尤甚，常兼見面色萎黃、倦怠乏力；病久夾瘀夾寒者，經絡阻滯不通，症狀入夜加重，得溫得動則減。臨床以肝血不足、脾腎兩虛、血虛夾瘀為常見證型。
records.western_pathology_zh: 西醫認為不寧腿症候群與中樞多巴胺系統功能失調有關，症狀多呈現明顯的日夜節律（傍晚至夜間加重），與多巴胺傳導在此時段相對不足有關；另一項重要機轉為腦部鐵蛋白儲存不足（即使周邊血清鐵正常），影響多巴胺合成所需之酪胺酸羥化酶活性。次發性不寧腿症候群常見於缺鐵性貧血、慢性腎臟病（尿毒症）、妊娠及周邊神經病變患者；家族遺傳傾向亦已於部分病例中被證實。
records.etiology_en: Restless legs syndrome falls within the TCM categories of "blood impediment" (xue bi) and "fixed impediment" (zhuo bi). The pathogenesis is primarily liver blood insufficiency failing to nourish the sinews and vessels; blood deficiency generates internal wind, so at night — when blood is even more depleted — the lower limbs develop an aching, distended, crawling sensation that compels movement or rubbing for temporary relief. In those with combined spleen-kidney deficiency and insufficient generation of qi and blood, the inability of blood to nourish the sinews is more pronounced, often accompanied by sallow complexion and fatigue. In long-standing cases complicated by blood stasis or cold, obstruction of the channels and collaterals worsens symptoms at night, which ease with warmth and movement. Commonly seen clinical patterns include liver blood insufficiency, combined spleen-kidney deficiency, and blood deficiency with stasis.

records.western_pathology_en: In Western medicine, restless legs syndrome is thought to involve dysfunction of the central dopaminergic system, with symptoms characteristically following a circadian pattern that worsens in the evening and at night, coinciding with relatively reduced dopaminergic transmission during this period. Another key mechanism is insufficient brain iron (ferritin) stores — even when peripheral serum iron is normal — which affects the activity of tyrosine hydroxylase required for dopamine synthesis. Secondary restless legs syndrome is commonly seen in iron-deficiency anemia, chronic kidney disease (uremia), pregnancy, and peripheral neuropathy; a familial genetic tendency has also been demonstrated in some cases.

records.name_zh: 晝夜節律睡眠障礙（文件情境）
records.etiology_zh:
睡眠障礙絕對是困擾中國人千年以上的一種症狀，所以遠從《黃帝內經》成書之時，就有許多類似名稱，例如：目不瞑、不得眠、不得臥、不寐、無眠、少睡、少寐...等等名詞。

從中醫探討失眠的基本模型是，因為古人沒有電燈，從晚上7點以後就燈光昏暗，因此他們大約在晚上9-11之間就入睡，早晨4點起床，這段期間無法入睡稱為「失眠」。

現代科學家發現，晚上9點後腦部的松果體開始分泌促進睡眠的褪黑激素，完全可以解釋古人的睡眠時間是正確的。

然而，現代人普遍在12點以後入睡，失眠通常發生在深夜1-4點之間，差不多已經到古人起床的時間，光就這點就已經是現代人失眠的原因。

現代人的睡眠時間根本不對，最核心改善失眠的方法，就是直接調整生理時鐘，或是輔助運用「褪黑激素」。如果你做得到，再怎麼怪異難治的失眠都會徹底消失，這確實是現代人的文明病，也不需要再繼續閱讀本文了！

如果就寢時間正常，卻依然失眠的話，可以從中醫證候，結合經絡現象來觀察，因為雲端中醫的會員中，有太多人失眠，所以相關的案例非常多，歸納出以下7種類型：

1. 外感傷寒後遺症：陰氣旺盛陽不入陰、脾胃虛寒

中醫《傷寒論》是千古以來治療「外感傷寒」的專書，裡面有多處提到「不得眠」的症狀，這可以說是感冒所遺留下的後遺症。

果不出其然，從2019年開始全球新冠疫情之後，全球上億人感冒，最常見的後遺症就是失眠。許多人形容「明明就已經很累很累，可是就是睡不著」，這其實可以運用陰陽理論來解釋。

「陰陽」是中醫學裡最核心的理論，可以說整套中醫學都是運用陰陽學說所建構出來的。《黃帝內經》亦提到：「夫邪氣之客人也，或令人目不瞑，不臥出者，何氣使然？…今厥氣客於五臟六腑，則衛氣獨衛其外，行於陽不得入於陰…」「衛氣不得入於陰，常留於陽。」

當代名醫張賜興中醫師曾說：「白天屬陽，夜晚屬陰，陰陽氣通就可安然入眠。」陽氣只要一入陰經，人就想睡覺。出離陰經的一瞬間，人就會醒來，體內陰陽如果不協調，「陽不入陰」就是造成現代人失眠的主因！

然而，許多人在施打新冠疫苗，或是感染新冠病毒之後，體內的經絡型態就會變成下面一樣，體內陽經能量嚴重不足，呈現「陽虛現象」，這就是典型造成失眠經絡型態。

體內陰盛陽衰時，很容易出現失眠現象

雲端中醫經絡檢測系統中有提供陰陽數值，從大量現代人經絡數據發現，陰陽比例有 75%是「陰大於陽」，也就是說現代人有高達75%的機率是陽氣不足(陽虛體質)，陰陽狀態不協調。

因為陰氣旺盛，陽氣不足，陽不入陰，自然會形成各種睡眠障礙！可以說多數現代人正在困擾的疾病或症狀，不少是因為體質陽虛(寒氣旺盛)所造成的。

上面這張經絡圖，是某會員Z小姐的妹妹，在2019年立冬之後出現睡眠障礙，她明明很累卻睡不著，睡不沈且很容易醒來，隔天起床之後精神不好，白天昏昏欲睡，這個現象讓她感到很困擾，整體感覺起來就是感到憂鬱且沮喪。

運用經絡檢測之後，明顯看出她的手部與腳部的陽經能量都相對不足。既然體內陽經的能量不足，陰經的能量過剩，古書上提到的「陽不入陰」現象自然呈現出來，簡單說就是陽虛所造成的。

另代一提的是，許多現代人由於常常食用寒性冰冷食物，也會經常出現這種陽虛型態，用白話說就是「脾胃虛寒」，這單純到只要服用溫熱中藥(附子理中湯)，同時配合溫熱物理療法(例如遠紅外線烤箱)，透過溫暖腹部及脾胃之後就會改善！

如果可以配合按摩「三陰交」、「神門」、「內關」、「陽陵泉」、「足三里」…等等穴位，效果更是好。

因為體內寒氣很重造成的失眠，其實與憂鬱症的成因類似，同樣發生在女性的機率較高，因此各位讀者也可以參考憂鬱症與經絡關係。

2. 上虛下實：陽虛現象的延伸

這種體內陽虛所造成的失眠，會出現這各種變化型，最常見的就是「寒性陽虛體質」的變化型，有一種看起來不是陽虛體質，本質上卻是它的變化型，那就是上虛下實經絡型態，有一定比例的失眠者就是出現這種經絡現象。

從下面「上虛下實」的組成可以清楚發現，這是由手三陽經虛證所組成，這就是典型陽虛的現象，從經絡的運行路線看來，可以說是整個腹部寒氣滿滿，持續一段時間之後，整個胸部也阻塞了，就會形成上虛下實經絡型態。

上虛下實經絡型態其實是由兩種型態所組成

在2022年5月時，有一位長期失眠的會員，在經過數次經絡檢測之後，發現自己呈現「上虛下實」的經絡型態，由於這種型態在夏天出現的機率很低，因為夏天時陽經能量是強旺的，所以幾乎可以推斷她一年四季就是這種經絡現象，未來有待持續觀察。

雲端中醫有不少文章，就是專門探討現代人胸部氣血經常瘀阻，甚至導致「上虛下實」經絡型態，這些都是可以透過溫熱物理療法，配合「揉按腹部」及按摩相關穴道改善(點選閱讀)。

2022年6月時，有一位連續失眠1-2年的會員回報，她就是出現這種經絡型態，在炎熱的6月天裡她測量10次，竟然有8次出現手三陰經虛證，由於她都是在清晨3-5點醒來後難以入睡，某位中醫師幫她開了「大青龍湯」，只吃了一包科中藥粉，竟然就有明顯改善。[@ad:1]

3. 長期熬夜出現鐵三角經絡型態

以上探討的是單純因為感冒後遺症所造成的失眠，這只是其中一種機率較高的原因。另一種原因也是常見的，那就是因為長期熬夜晚睡，之後所產生的一系列體內「陰虛火熱」的現象。

在雲端中醫多數會員的長期觀察後發現，原來失眠是一種惡性循環的過程。在發生失眠以前總不喜歡睡覺，當夜貓子晚上熬夜工作、看電影或娛樂跑趴，為了讓自己在晚上可以看起來精神奕奕，愛喝咖啡、酒精…等等這類可以讓自己興奮的飲料。

這些人多年下來每天一定要把自己搞的很累，一定要撐到最後一刻感到不行了才會入睡。如果幫這樣的人檢測經絡，大多數都會出現像下圖的經絡圖，這種經絡圖就像是一種「作繭」的程序，一旦穩定出現這種「鐵三角經絡型態」，真的就別想睡了，因此也可以說是「自縛」。

長期熬夜的人，自然會形成這種經絡型態

雲端中醫某位女性會員約47歲，她之所以開始研究經絡，主因就是長期失眠，當她幫自己檢測超過50次之後清楚確定，自己的經絡圖穩定呈現肝經實證、脾經與膀胱經虛證的狀態，她說：「她經常都是整個晚上眼睛無法閉上，非常痛苦！」

她告訴阿編說：「以前她根本不知道什麼叫做失眠，經常就是看youtube 看到深夜，早上6點多就起床，就這樣持續很多年…漸漸地…某一天開始就真的睡不著了！」

這種經絡現象也會大量出現在夏天，也因此在夏天很容易失眠。若去觀察那些其他原因造成這種經絡型態的人，也很難脫離睡眠障礙的困擾，因此這種經絡型態可以說是失眠的大本營。

基於此，多數人失眠的原因就是：剛開始不願意睡，漸漸的就是你的身體讓你睡不著！這是造成失眠的原因，也是結果。

遇到這種經絡型態時，最快速的改善方法，就是「深呼吸、放空腦袋、放鬆肌肉」。要改善「鐵三角經絡型態」，最快速的方法就是身心徹底放鬆，當一個人可以真正放鬆之後，這種經絡型態就會開始鬆動，絕大多數的人會開始感到整天想睡覺，立即脫離失眠困擾。

放鬆永遠是改善失眠最有效的方法

一些會員都發現，每次只要練習瑜珈深呼吸、數呼吸沒多久之後，心念雖然會開始專注且平靜，但是隨即會感到昏沉想睡覺，可見現代人多數白天處於緊張狀態，是因為無法放鬆而導致失眠。

某位失眠會員努力練習放鬆法持續三個月，竟然完全改變了造成失眠的「鐵三角經絡型態」，連他自己都覺得很不思議。

4. 鐵三角變化型：肝胃不和、肝膽鬱熱、熱擾胸膈

延續上一個案例，這位女性會員的失眠非常嚴重，從2021 年1月開始，已經整整四個月每天晚上都睡不著，這個狀況一直持續到2022年2月整整一年。真正屬於她的經絡型態，是以三條經絡為主的變化型，必須掌握4個重點：

嚴重失眠的經絡型態，要掌握四個重點

心經與心包經出現虛證，經常有胸痛、胸悶現象

三焦經與大腸經實證，代表體內累積龐大的火氣，熱到睡不著。

肝經實證、脾經與膀胱經虛證，也就是上面提到的作繭自縛經絡型態。

肝經與胃經實證，有肝胃不協調的現象，經常也會伴隨膽經實證的熱證。

除了她之外， 之前也有一些其他會員分享類似經絡現象，這種經絡型態的常見症狀是：很容易生氣、急躁不耐煩、夜間多夢、身體感到發熱難耐、常常感到口渴、嘴裡苦苦、酸酸的(胃酸)、肋痛、頭暈、耳鳴、頭脹、胸悶胸痛、肚子容易餓、肚子胃腸脹氣、消化不良、全身酸痛…等等。

這種經絡型態，若結合傳統中醫證候，有可能是「肝胃不和」、「膽熱」、「肝脾不調」、「心脈瘀阻」、「陰虛火旺」、「熱擾胸膈」…等等，這些都是造成失眠的主因。也因此有些會員就嘗試服用「加味逍遙散」或「四逆散」，這類的中藥，都會有某種程度的改善，印證古書上所描述的「胃不和則臥不安」。

有些會員也發現，有時候當晚上睡不著時，反而會出現身體發熱的症狀，例如：心煩、胸悶、噁心想吐、口苦、口酸。一些除胸中煩熱的科學中藥也很有效果，例如：竹葉石膏湯、梔子豉湯。[@formula:202]

這就印證傳統中醫認為大部分的失眠都是體內太熱所造成，《傷寒論》中提到熱病會造成失眠，由於生氣或壓力，肝氣疏泄之能力不足，鬱在體內久了化火。或喝酒、飲食不節，熱邪聚於肝膽，蘊積化火，火熱上炎，擾亂神明，心神不安所以失眠。

5. 思慮過多心脾兩虛、胸部瘀阻

上面提到寒熱的問題，接下來探討「思慮」問題。中醫常說「思傷脾」，經常思慮過多的人脾會不好，造成脾虛。

傳統中醫認為，當一個人脾氣虛弱時，氣血生化之源不足，血不養心，心血不足時容易出現心神不安，出現所謂的心脾兩虛。

常見症狀是：失眠、多夢易醒、面色蒼白、疲倦無力、氣短懶言、心悸、健忘，食慾不佳、大便溏瀉、舌淡苔薄、脈細而弱。

而今，運用經絡檢測可以清楚驗證這個現象，雲端中醫開發團隊就是一群整天用腦的人組成，其中某位軟體工程師每天用腦超過10個小時，當他累積一年半超過200次經絡數據之後，畫成一張圖，就是脾經虛證。

這種經絡型態如果再加上「久坐」且「思慮用腦過多」，就很容易出現類似於「心脾兩虛」的經絡現象。常用腦的工程師幾乎清一色都是屬於這種經絡型態，因此像下面這種的經絡圖可以輕易地從他們身上取得：

夏季經絡型態變化型，經常會出現心經與心包經虛證

以上就是其中一位工程師L先生的經絡圖，他只要工作用腦思慮過多時，就經常會出現多夢，晚上容易醒來，容易容易感到頭暈與倦怠，走樓梯會喘，有時候會心悸，大便溏瀉，最明顯的就是特別容易健忘。

他知道中醫最典型改善心脾兩虛的中藥就是「歸脾湯」或是「八珍湯」，像這種健脾益氣，養血安神的中藥，每次只要他開始用腦過多時，就一定會買開科學中藥來服用，好好幫自己補一下。

直到2022年時他回饋，每次吃完這些中藥補完之後，睡眠狀態就會明顯改善，可見「思傷脾」這個說法確實成立！

6. 心腎不交、心火旺盛

當代名醫陳潮宗曾經說：「失眠問題在於心」，因此中醫有許多診斷失眠證型都與心相關，例如：「心陰不足」、「心腎不交」、「心火亢盛」…等等，似乎都指出失眠與「心系臟腑」(心臟、心包、心經、心包經)有關係。

傳統中醫認為，當一個人體內心火旺盛時，心神不守，容易出現失眠多夢、胸中煩熱、心悸、面紅口苦、口渴口乾、口舌生瘡，舌尖紅，脈數有力。由於心火會移熱於小腸，所以小便短赤，疼痛滯澀。

這個心火旺盛，常常是因為體內的腎水不足所造成，腎陰不能上濟於心，心火獨亢於上，不能下交於腎，心腎水火不能相濟，因此又稱為「心腎不交」。

體內腎陰不足時，也會造成火旺就是基於同樣原理，症狀是：頭暈、耳鳴、潮熱盜汗、手心腳心煩熱、健忘多夢、腰膝痠軟、遺精、舌紅少苔、脈細數。

這種抽象的理論，其實可以透過經絡數據來加以證明，從大量現代人的經絡數據中發現，現代人一年四季心經實證，腎經虛證。因此有一定比例的人出現的失眠現象，可以說有極高的機率源自於這裡。

現代人的經絡型態，一年四季心經實證，腎經虛證

某會員S小姐就曾經分享，她偶爾就會出現睡眠障礙，她經常幫自己進行經絡檢測，自己的腎經總是出現虛證，而他仔細觀察心經，還真的常常出現實證！

她的睡眠障礙症狀，就是不易入睡、感到心煩、偶爾會出現心悸或胸悶胸痛、夜間多夢、有時候會因為胸中煩熱而醒來，經常感到口乾。

她記得過去有一次曾經找了一位中醫師治療，醫師開了「黃連阿膠湯」給她服用，確實有明顯改善睡眠。她記得當時服用這個藥的方法很特殊，是將中藥煮好放涼後，再將生蛋黃打入藥液中攪拌服下。由於她覺得這樣服藥不習慣，因此停止服藥，類似的症狀偶爾又會出現。

7. 改善上實下虛的失眠最難，其實也最簡單！

最後要提到的經絡型態是失眠的原因，也是結果，所以是最難改善的一種造成失眠的經絡型態，尤其出現在中老年人身上。

現代醫學發現，年紀愈大愈容易出現失眠的困擾！為什麼會這樣？其實運用經絡檢測可以提出再清楚不過的數值與圖像，如果說最難治的失眠是哪一種？答案就是「上實下虛」的經絡型態。

這種經絡氣血狀態永遠存在上半身，晚上睡覺時，腦子就算要關門打烊也關不掉，整個晚上經常是數羊數到精疲力竭了，才會投降睡著！事實上，這種經絡型態就是從上面每一種經絡型態所逐漸演變而來的。

經絡呈現上實下虛型態時，這種失眠很難被治癒

多數人的失眠，如果找不到原因時，多半是屬於這一種，而這一種失眠雖然最難治，其實也最好治。因為氣血過度集中在上半身，任何人只要有能力將氣血往下導引，瞬間就會睡著，所以其實也是最簡單的！

改善氣血往上集中的方法其實很多，有些會員也透過實驗發現，睡前慢步行禪，將集中在上半部的氣血往下導引是很有效的，這其實就是因為白天時全身的氣血都是集中在上半部，而卻不知道如何在睡前導引至下半部。

睡前要將整天快速反應的思考模式完全放慢，最簡單的方法就是練習「行禪」，觀察腳與地面接觸的感覺，這樣氣血往下導引的速度會很快。

一個人的思慮集中在上半部的最主要原因，就是睡前持續思考，氣血往上浮，睡前玩手機是主要元兇。

光線會影響人體的晝夜節律。美國醫學研究發現，每天晚上只要使用平板2小時，就會抑制褪黑激素分泌，影響睡眠品質，要花更多時間才能進入深睡。現代人哪一個不是在睡前玩手機呢？因為這樣睡不好也就理所當然了。

睡前看電腦手機，容易導致失眠

現在的電腦與手機系統都可以開啟夜間暗黑模式，建議所有不得不使用電腦的人都要進行設定。同時，與上一點一樣，現代人白天已經用腦思慮過多，導致氣血往上浮，晚上如果還是繼續用腦，對於改善睡眠品質是沒有幫助的！

現代研究發現，睡前3小時內如果做劇烈運動，會刺激生長激素的分泌，讓代謝旺盛，有的人的交感神經會過度活躍，大腦就很難進入睡眠狀態，進而導致失眠，這也是另一個原因。

綜合以上所有的經絡型態，可以清楚看到失眠的原因是很複雜的，只要找到自己的經絡型態，去改善它且持續觀察，失眠就會自然消失，其實是一點也不困難的！
records.western_pathology_zh:
失眠是一種相當常見症狀且困擾現代人的症狀，這是指不容易入睡，或是睡到一半醒來就無法再睡，無法深度睡眠，導致睡醒後仍沒有休息過的感覺。

依照西方數據報告顯示，有將近5至7千萬的美國民眾曾經出現睡眠障礙現象。根據「台灣睡眠醫學學會」統計，台灣每5人就有1人深受失眠之苦。根據健保資料庫統計，台灣失眠人數逐年攀升，女性遠多於男性，女性是男性的兩倍。

造成失眠的原因非常多，例如壓力(工作、感情、人際關係、人生重大事件…等等）、焦慮思緒過於活躍而無法入睡、環境因素（光線、噪音、睡眠環境改變…等）、疾病引發、睡前食用太多咖啡因的食物、晚上吃太多、睡眠習慣不好、枕頭過高、天氣太冷太熱、藥物副作用、輪班工作制度、婦女停經賀爾蒙變化…等等太多原因了！

失眠可能是短期的，也可能是長期的，一般會伴隨其他症狀：白天疲倦想睡、煩躁，憂鬱或焦慮、注意力不集中、無法專注工作、記憶變差、頭痛、胃腸不適，漸漸地到了睡覺時間就開始擔心。

長期失眠會引發更多的疾病，例如：憂鬱症、焦慮症、聽力障礙(耳鳴、耳聾）、肥胖、記憶力下降、皮膚疾病(皮膚乾燥,粉刺,黑斑等)、腸胃疾病、免疫力下降、心臟疾病、高血壓、糖尿病、各種癌症，可以說是典型的萬病之源。

許多疾病也會反過來造成失眠，例如：憂鬱症、焦慮障礙、鼻炎、纖維肌痛、關節炎、頭痛、胃痛、心絞痛、糖尿病、夜尿症...等等。

近代發現睡眠可能與褪黑激素(Melatonin）有關，因為在接近入睡時，大腦便會開始分泌褪黑激素，並在半夜達到高峰，在早晨醒來之前濃度便開始逐漸下降。

現代人生理時鐘紊亂是造成失眠的主因

現代人高頻率處於電燈、手機、電腦環境下，造成體內褪黑激素分泌紊亂，生理時鐘不固定，應該就是現代人受到失眠困擾的主因。

現代醫學治療失眠的藥物，主要運用「苯二氮平」之安眠藥物，除了鎮靜安眠外，還具有抗焦慮、肌肉鬆弛及抗痙攣的作用。此外也有運用非苯二氮平藥物、褪黑激素、抗憂鬱劑、抗組織胺、鬆弛劑等藥物改善。

失眠長期困擾著一定比例的人，有些人不想長期依賴安眠藥物，可以從中醫的角度來理解失眠，提供另一條新的思路。[@ad:1]
