records.western_pathology_en:
Insomnia is a very common symptom that troubles modern people. It refers to difficulty falling asleep, or waking mid-sleep and being unable to fall asleep again, or inability to achieve deep sleep, so that one still does not feel rested upon waking.

According to Western data reports, nearly 50 to 70 million Americans have experienced sleep disturbances. According to statistics from the Taiwan Society of Sleep Medicine, one in five people in Taiwan suffers from insomnia. National Health Insurance database statistics show that the number of people with insomnia in Taiwan is climbing year by year, with far more women than men — women outnumber men two to one.

The causes of insomnia are extremely numerous: stress (work, relationships, interpersonal issues, major life events, etc.); anxiety with an overactive mind preventing sleep; environmental factors (light, noise, changes in sleep environment, etc.); illness; consuming too much caffeine before bed; eating too much at night; poor sleep habits; a pillow that is too high; weather too cold or too hot; drug side effects; shift work; hormonal changes of menopause in women — and many more!

Insomnia may be short-term or long-term, and is generally accompanied by other symptoms: daytime fatigue and sleepiness, irritability, depression or anxiety, poor concentration, inability to focus on work, worsening memory, headaches, gastrointestinal discomfort — and gradually, worry begins as bedtime approaches.

Chronic insomnia triggers many further diseases, for example: depression, anxiety disorders, hearing problems (tinnitus, deafness), obesity, memory decline, skin diseases (dry skin, acne, dark spots, etc.), gastrointestinal diseases, lowered immunity, heart disease, hypertension, diabetes, and various cancers — it can be called a classic root of a myriad diseases.

Many diseases also conversely cause insomnia, for example: depression, anxiety disorders, rhinitis, fibromyalgia, arthritis, headaches, stomach pain, angina, diabetes, nocturia, and so on.

In recent times it has been found that sleep may be related to melatonin: as bedtime approaches, the brain begins to secrete melatonin, which peaks in the middle of the night, and its concentration gradually declines before morning waking.

Disordered circadian clocks are the chief cause of insomnia in modern people.

Modern people are frequently exposed to electric lighting, mobile phones, and computers, disordering the body's melatonin secretion and destabilizing the biological clock — this is likely the chief reason modern people are troubled by insomnia.

Modern medications for insomnia mainly use benzodiazepine hypnotics, which besides sedative-hypnotic effects also have anxiolytic, muscle-relaxant, and anticonvulsant actions. Non-benzodiazepine drugs, melatonin, antidepressants, antihistamines, and relaxants are also used for improvement.

Insomnia chronically troubles a certain proportion of people, and some do not wish to depend on sleeping medication long-term; insomnia can be understood from the perspective of Chinese medicine, offering another new line of thinking.[@ad:1]

records.etiology_en:
Sleep disorders have unquestionably troubled the Chinese for well over a millennium, so from the time the Huangdi Neijing (Yellow Emperor's Inner Classic) was compiled there have been many similar names, such as: "eyes that will not close," "unable to sleep," "unable to lie down," bu mei (sleeplessness), "no sleep," "little sleep," "scant slumber," and other terms.

The basic model for understanding insomnia in Chinese medicine is this: because the ancients had no electric lighting, light was dim after about 7 p.m., so they fell asleep roughly between 9 and 11 p.m. and rose at 4 a.m.; inability to sleep during this period was called "insomnia."

Modern scientists have found that after 9 p.m. the brain's pineal gland begins secreting sleep-promoting melatonin, which fully explains that the ancients' sleep schedule was correct.

However, modern people generally fall asleep after midnight, and insomnia typically occurs between 1 and 4 a.m. — nearly the hour when the ancients were getting up. This point alone is already a cause of modern insomnia.

Modern people's sleep timing is simply wrong. The most central way to improve insomnia is to directly adjust the biological clock, or to use melatonin as an aid. If you can accomplish this, even the strangest and most intractable insomnia will completely disappear. It is truly a disease of modern civilization — and if that solves it, there is no need to read further!

If bedtime is normal yet insomnia persists, one can observe TCM patterns combined with meridian phenomena. Because so many Cloud TCM members suffer insomnia, related cases are extremely numerous, and the following 7 types have been summarized:

1. Sequelae of external Cold Damage: exuberant Yin with Yang failing to enter Yin; Spleen-Stomach Deficiency-Cold

The Shanghan Lun (Treatise on Cold Damage) is the classic text of the ages for treating "external Cold Damage," and it mentions the symptom of "inability to sleep" in many places — this can be described as a sequela left behind by colds.

Sure enough, since the global COVID-19 pandemic began in 2019, hundreds of millions worldwide have fallen ill, and the most common sequela has been insomnia. Many describe it as "utterly exhausted, yet simply unable to sleep" — which can be explained by Yin-Yang theory.

"Yin-Yang" is the most central theory in Chinese medicine; the entire system of Chinese medicine can be said to be constructed upon Yin-Yang doctrine. The Huangdi Neijing also states: "When pathogenic Qi lodges in a person, it may make the eyes unable to close and prevent lying down to sleep — what Qi causes this? ... Now when rebellious Qi lodges in the five zang and six fu organs, the defensive (Wei) Qi guards only the exterior, moving in the Yang and unable to enter the Yin ..." and "When defensive Qi cannot enter the Yin, it remains constantly in the Yang."

The contemporary renowned physician Dr. Zhang Cixing once said: "Daytime belongs to Yang, night belongs to Yin; when Yin and Yang Qi flow through, one can sleep peacefully." The moment Yang Qi enters the Yin meridians, a person becomes sleepy; the instant it leaves the Yin meridians, the person wakes. If the body's Yin and Yang are not in harmony, "Yang failing to enter Yin" is the chief cause of modern insomnia!

However, in many people, after COVID-19 vaccination or infection with the COVID-19 virus, the body's meridian pattern becomes like the one below: the energy of the Yang meridians is severely insufficient, presenting a "Yang Deficiency phenomenon." This is the classic insomnia-producing meridian pattern.

When Yin is exuberant and Yang is debilitated in the body, insomnia readily appears.

The Cloud TCM meridian testing system provides Yin-Yang values. Large volumes of modern meridian data show that in 75% of cases the Yin-Yang ratio is "Yin greater than Yang" — that is, modern people have as high as a 75% probability of insufficient Yang Qi (Yang-Deficient constitution), with Yin and Yang out of harmony.

With Yin Qi exuberant and Yang Qi insufficient, Yang failing to enter Yin, various sleep disorders naturally form! It may be said that of the diseases and symptoms troubling most modern people, many are caused by a Yang-Deficient constitution (exuberant Cold Qi).

The meridian chart above is from the younger sister of member Ms. Z, who developed a sleep disorder after the Beginning of Winter in 2019. She was clearly exhausted yet could not sleep, slept shallowly and woke easily, felt unrefreshed the next morning, and was drowsy during the day. This troubled her greatly; overall she felt gloomy and dejected.

After meridian testing, it was evident that the Yang meridian energy of her hands and feet was relatively insufficient. With the body's Yang meridian energy insufficient and Yin meridian energy in surplus, the "Yang failing to enter Yin" phenomenon described in the ancient books naturally presented itself — put simply, it was caused by Yang Deficiency.

Worth mentioning additionally: many modern people, from frequently eating cold-natured and icy foods, also often show this Yang-Deficient pattern — in plain language, "Spleen-Stomach Deficiency-Cold." This can be as simple as taking warming Chinese herbs (Fuzi Lizhong Tang / Aconite Center-Rectifying Decoction) together with warming physical therapies (such as a far-infrared sauna); once the abdomen and the Spleen and Stomach are warmed, it improves!

Combining massage of acupoints such as Sanyinjiao (SP-6), Shenmen (HT-7), Neiguan (PC-6), Yanglingquan (GB-34), and Zusanli (ST-36) gives even better results.

Insomnia caused by heavy internal Cold in fact has a similar etiology to depression, and likewise occurs with higher probability in women; readers may also consult the discussion of depression and its meridian relationships.

2. Deficiency above, Excess below: an extension of the Yang-Deficiency phenomenon

Insomnia caused by this internal Yang Deficiency appears in various transformed types. The most common is the variant of the "Cold-type Yang-Deficient constitution." There is one that does not look like a Yang-Deficient constitution but is in essence its variant — the "Deficiency above, Excess below" meridian pattern; a certain proportion of insomniacs show precisely this meridian phenomenon.

From the composition of "Deficiency above, Excess below" shown below, it is clearly formed from Deficiency of the three Hand Yang meridians — the classic Yang-Deficiency phenomenon. Judging from the meridians' pathways, one can say the entire abdomen is full of Cold; after this persists for a time, the entire chest also becomes obstructed, forming the Deficiency-above-Excess-below meridian pattern.

The Deficiency-above-Excess-below meridian pattern is in fact composed of two patterns.

In May 2022, a member with chronic insomnia found, after several meridian tests, that she presented the "Deficiency above, Excess below" meridian pattern. Since the probability of this pattern appearing in summer is very low — Yang meridian energy is strong in summer — it can almost be inferred that she shows this meridian phenomenon in all four seasons, pending continued observation.

Cloud TCM has many articles specifically discussing how the Qi and Blood of modern people's chests are frequently stagnant and obstructed, even producing the "Deficiency above, Excess below" meridian pattern; all of this can be improved through warming physical therapies combined with kneading the abdomen and massaging the relevant acupoints (click to read).

In June 2022, a member who had suffered continuous insomnia for 1-2 years reported that she showed precisely this meridian pattern. In the hot days of June she tested herself 10 times, and 8 of them showed Deficiency of the three Hand Yin meridians. Because she always woke at 3-5 a.m. and could not fall back asleep, a TCM physician prescribed Da Qing Long Tang (Major Bluegreen Dragon Decoction); after taking just one packet of the scientific herbal granules, she improved markedly.[@ad:1]

3. Chronic late nights producing the Iron Triangle meridian pattern

The above discussed insomnia caused purely by cold/flu sequelae, which is only one relatively probable cause. Another cause is also common: the series of internal "Yin Deficiency with Fire-Heat" phenomena produced by chronically staying up late.

Long-term observation of most Cloud TCM members has revealed that insomnia is a vicious cycle. Before insomnia develops, such people never liked to sleep — night owls staying up to work, watch films, or party; and to look energetic at night they love coffee, alcohol, and other stimulating drinks.

For years, such people exhaust themselves daily, holding on until the very last moment before finally sleeping. Testing the meridians of such a person mostly produces a chart like the one below — a chart resembling a "cocoon-spinning" process. Once this "Iron Triangle meridian pattern" appears stably, sleep is truly out of reach; one could call it "self-binding."

People who chronically stay up late naturally form this meridian pattern.

One female Cloud TCM member, about 47, began studying meridians precisely because of chronic insomnia. After testing herself more than 50 times, she confirmed clearly that her meridian chart stably showed Liver meridian Excess with Deficiency of the Spleen and Bladder meridians. She said: "I often cannot close my eyes the whole night — it is agonizing!"

She told the editor: "I used to have no idea what insomnia even was. I constantly watched YouTube deep into the night and got up after 6 a.m. — this went on for many years... and gradually... one day I truly could not sleep anymore!"

This meridian phenomenon also appears extensively in summer, which is why insomnia comes easily in summer. Observing people in whom other causes produce this meridian pattern, they too can hardly escape sleep disorders; this meridian pattern can thus be called the home base of insomnia.

On this basis, the cause of most people's insomnia is: at first you refuse to sleep; gradually, it is your body that will not let you sleep! This is both the cause of insomnia and its result.

When encountering this meridian pattern, the fastest method of improvement is "deep breathing, emptying the mind, relaxing the muscles." To improve the "Iron Triangle meridian pattern," the fastest route is thorough physical and mental relaxation. Once a person can truly relax, this meridian pattern begins to loosen; the great majority of people then start feeling sleepy all day and immediately escape the torment of insomnia.

Relaxation is always the most effective way to improve insomnia.

Some members have found that shortly after practicing yogic deep breathing or breath counting, although the mind becomes focused and calm, they promptly feel drowsy and sleepy — showing that most modern people are tense during the day, and it is the inability to relax that causes insomnia.

One insomniac member practiced relaxation methods diligently for three months and completely transformed the "Iron Triangle meridian pattern" causing his insomnia — even he found it hard to believe.

4. Iron Triangle variants: Liver-Stomach disharmony, Liver-Gallbladder constrained Heat, Heat harassing the chest and diaphragm

Continuing the previous case: this female member's insomnia was very severe. From January 2021 she went a full four months unable to sleep every night, a situation that continued for an entire year until February 2022. Her true meridian pattern was a variant centered on three meridians, and four key points must be grasped:

The meridian pattern of severe insomnia — four key points to grasp:

The Heart and Pericardium meridians show Deficiency, with frequent chest pain and chest oppression.

The Triple Burner and Large Intestine meridians are in Excess, indicating enormous accumulated internal Fire — too hot to sleep.

Liver meridian Excess with Deficiency of the Spleen and Bladder meridians — the self-binding "cocoon" pattern mentioned above.

Liver and Stomach meridians in Excess — Liver-Stomach disharmony, frequently accompanied by the Heat pattern of Gallbladder meridian Excess.

Besides her, other members have shared similar meridian phenomena. The common symptoms of this meridian pattern are: proneness to anger, impatience and irritability, dream-disturbed nights, unbearable feelings of body heat, frequent thirst, bitter or sour taste in the mouth (stomach acid), rib pain, dizziness, tinnitus, head distension, chest oppression and pain, easy hunger, abdominal and gastrointestinal bloating, indigestion, generalized aching, and so on.

Combined with traditional TCM patterns, this meridian pattern may correspond to "Liver-Stomach disharmony," "Gallbladder Heat," "Liver-Spleen disharmony," "Heart vessel stasis obstruction," "Yin Deficiency with effulgent Fire," "Heat harassing the chest and diaphragm," and so on — all chief causes of insomnia. Accordingly, some members have tried taking Jia Wei Xiao Yao San (Augmented Free and Easy Wanderer Powder) or Si Ni San (Frigid Extremities Powder); such Chinese herbs bring some degree of improvement, corroborating the ancient dictum "when the Stomach is not in harmony, sleep is not peaceful."

Some members have also found that on nights they cannot sleep, symptoms of body heat may in fact appear, such as vexation, chest oppression, nausea, bitter taste, and sour taste. Scientific herbal formulas that clear vexing Heat from the chest are also very effective, for example Zhuye Shigao Tang (Lophatherum and Gypsum Decoction) and Zhizi Chi Tang (Gardenia and Fermented Soybean Decoction).[@formula:202]

This corroborates traditional Chinese medicine's view that most insomnia is caused by excessive internal Heat. The Shanghan Lun states that febrile disease causes insomnia: through anger or stress, the Liver's capacity for free coursing becomes insufficient, and prolonged internal constraint transforms into Fire; or through alcohol and dietary irregularity, the Heat pathogen gathers in the Liver and Gallbladder, accumulates and transforms into Fire, and the Fire-Heat flames upward, disturbing the Spirit-brightness — the Heart Spirit is unquiet, hence insomnia.

5. Excessive pensiveness with Heart-Spleen dual Deficiency; chest stasis and obstruction

Having discussed Cold and Heat above, we turn next to the problem of "pensiveness." Chinese medicine often says "pensiveness damages the Spleen": people who habitually overthink develop a weakened Spleen — Spleen Deficiency.

Traditional Chinese medicine holds that when a person's Spleen Qi is weak, the source of Qi and Blood generation is insufficient; the Blood fails to nourish the Heart, and with Heart Blood insufficient, restlessness of the Heart Spirit readily appears — the so-called Heart-Spleen dual Deficiency.

Common symptoms are: insomnia, excessive dreaming with easy waking, pale complexion, fatigue and weakness, shortness of breath with little desire to speak, palpitations, forgetfulness, poor appetite, loose stools, a pale tongue with thin coating, and a thin, weak pulse.

Today meridian testing can clearly verify this phenomenon. The Cloud TCM development team is itself a group of people who use their brains all day. One software engineer among them uses his brain more than 10 hours daily; when he accumulated more than 200 meridian readings over a year and a half and plotted them as a single chart, it showed Spleen meridian Deficiency.

If this meridian pattern is further combined with prolonged sitting and excessive mental work, a meridian phenomenon resembling "Heart-Spleen dual Deficiency" readily appears. Engineers who work intensively with their minds are almost uniformly of this meridian pattern, so charts like the one below can easily be obtained from them:

A summer variant of the meridian pattern, frequently showing Deficiency of the Heart and Pericardium meridians.

The above is the meridian chart of one of those engineers, Mr. L. Whenever his work involves excessive mental effort, he frequently dreams excessively, wakes easily at night, readily feels dizzy and fatigued, gets short of breath climbing stairs, sometimes has palpitations and loose stools — and most noticeably, becomes especially forgetful.

He knows that the classic TCM formulas for improving Heart-Spleen dual Deficiency are Gui Pi Tang (Spleen-Restoring Decoction) or Ba Zhen Tang (Eight Treasures Decoction) — herbs that fortify the Spleen, boost Qi, nourish the Blood, and calm the Spirit. Whenever he begins overusing his brain, he makes sure to buy the scientific herbal granules and give himself a proper tonification.

By 2022 he reported that each time he finished a course of these tonifying herbs, his sleep clearly improved — evidence that the saying "pensiveness damages the Spleen" indeed holds true!

6. Heart and Kidney failing to communicate; exuberant Heart Fire

The contemporary renowned physician Chen Chao-tsung once said: "The problem of insomnia lies in the Heart." Chinese medicine accordingly has many insomnia diagnostic patterns related to the Heart, such as "Heart Yin insufficiency," "Heart and Kidney failing to communicate," "Heart Fire hyperactivity," and so on — all seeming to indicate that insomnia is related to the "Heart system" of organs (Heart, Pericardium, Heart meridian, Pericardium meridian).

Traditional Chinese medicine holds that when Heart Fire is exuberant, the Heart Spirit is unguarded, and there readily appear insomnia with excessive dreaming, vexing heat in the chest, palpitations, flushed face and bitter taste, thirst and dry mouth, sores of the mouth and tongue, a red tongue tip, and a rapid, forceful pulse. Because Heart Fire shifts its Heat to the Small Intestine, urine is scanty and dark, with painful, rough voiding.

This exuberant Heart Fire is often caused by insufficiency of Kidney Water: Kidney Yin cannot ascend to aid the Heart, Heart Fire blazes alone above and cannot descend to join the Kidney, and Heart and Kidney — Water and Fire — cannot assist each other; hence it is also called "Heart and Kidney failing to communicate."

Insufficient Kidney Yin producing effulgent Fire rests on the same principle, with symptoms of dizziness, tinnitus, tidal fever and night sweats, vexing heat in the palms and soles, forgetfulness and excessive dreaming, soreness and weakness of the lower back and knees, seminal emission, a red tongue with scant coating, and a thin, rapid pulse.

This abstract theory can actually be demonstrated with meridian data: large volumes of modern meridian data show that modern people have Heart meridian Excess and Kidney meridian Deficiency in all four seasons. Thus, for a certain proportion of people, their insomnia can be said with very high probability to originate here.

The meridian pattern of modern people: Heart meridian Excess and Kidney meridian Deficiency all year round.

Member Ms. S once shared that she occasionally has sleep disturbances. She frequently tests her own meridians: her Kidney meridian always shows Deficiency, and on careful observation her Heart meridian really does often show Excess!

Her sleep-disorder symptoms are difficulty falling asleep, vexation, occasional palpitations or chest oppression and pain, dream-disturbed nights, sometimes waking from vexing heat in the chest, and frequent dry mouth.

She recalled that once she sought treatment from a TCM physician, who prescribed Huanglian Ejiao Tang (Coptis and Donkey-Hide Gelatin Decoction), and it did clearly improve her sleep. She remembered the method of taking this medicine was unusual: the decoction was cooked and cooled, then a raw egg yolk was beaten into the liquid and stirred before drinking. Because she found this way of taking medicine uncomfortable, she stopped, and similar symptoms occasionally return.

7. Improving Excess-above-Deficiency-below insomnia is the hardest — and actually the simplest!

The final meridian pattern to mention is both the cause of insomnia and its result, making it the most difficult insomnia-producing meridian pattern to improve, especially in the middle-aged and elderly.

Modern medicine has found that the older one gets, the more prone one is to insomnia. Why? Meridian testing can supply numbers and images that could not be clearer. If one asks which insomnia is hardest to treat, the answer is the "Excess above, Deficiency below" meridian pattern.

In this state the meridian Qi and Blood permanently reside in the upper body; at night, even when the brain wants to close up shop, it cannot shut down, and one often counts sheep to the point of exhaustion before finally surrendering to sleep. In fact, this meridian pattern gradually evolves from each of the patterns above.

When the meridians present the Excess-above-Deficiency-below pattern, this insomnia is very hard to cure.

Most insomnia with no identifiable cause belongs to this type. And though this insomnia is the hardest to treat, it is actually also the easiest — because the Qi and Blood are excessively concentrated in the upper body, anyone who can guide the Qi and Blood downward will fall asleep in an instant. So it is in fact also the simplest!

There are many methods to improve upward-concentrated Qi and Blood. Some members have found through experiment that slow walking meditation before bed, guiding the Qi and Blood concentrated in the upper body downward, is very effective — during the day the whole body's Qi and Blood concentrate in the upper body, and people simply do not know how to guide them downward before sleep.

To fully slow the rapid-response thinking mode of the day before bed, the simplest method is to practice "walking meditation," observing the sensation of the feet contacting the ground; this guides Qi and Blood downward very quickly.

The chief reason a person's mental activity concentrates in the upper body is continued thinking before bed, which makes Qi and Blood float upward — and playing with one's phone before bed is the main culprit.

Light affects the human circadian rhythm. American medical research has found that using a tablet for just 2 hours each night suppresses melatonin secretion, impairs sleep quality, and lengthens the time needed to enter deep sleep. Which modern person does not use a phone before bed? Poor sleep is then only to be expected.

Looking at computers and phones before bed readily leads to insomnia.

Today's computer and phone systems can all enable night/dark mode, and everyone who must use a computer is advised to set it. Likewise, as with the previous point, modern people already overthink during the day, causing Qi and Blood to float upward; continuing to use the brain at night does nothing to help sleep quality!

Modern research has found that vigorous exercise within 3 hours of bedtime stimulates growth hormone secretion and raises metabolism; in some people the sympathetic nervous system becomes overactive and the brain has difficulty entering the sleep state, leading to insomnia — another contributing cause.

Taking all the above meridian patterns together, it is clear that the causes of insomnia are complex. But simply find your own meridian pattern, improve it, and keep observing — the insomnia will disappear naturally. It is really not difficult at all!

records.etiology_zh: 戒菸輔助屬中醫「癮症」概念範疇，久吸菸草，燥熱之毒經口鼻直入於肺，耗傷肺氣，燥熱傷陰，日久肺腎陰虛，可見咳嗽痰少、口乾咽燥；驟然戒斷菸癮，因肝失疏泄，氣機不暢，加以心神失於菸毒刺激後之常態，可見煩躁不安、易怒、情緒波動、口欲亢進難耐；兼夾痰濁內生者，見胸悶、咳嗽痰多。針灸戒菸輔助，多從清肺潤燥、疏肝理氣、寧心安神著手，以緩解戒斷期之躁動與菸癮發作。
records.western_pathology_zh: 尼古丁作用於大腦尼古丁性乙醯膽鹼受體，促使中腦邊緣多巴胺獎賞路徑（伏隔核）釋放多巴胺，產生愉悅與強化效應；長期吸菸使受體數量上調並產生耐受性，一旦戒斷則受體活性不足，多巴胺傳導驟降，出現渴求菸癮、易怒、焦慮、注意力不集中、食慾增加與體重上升等戒斷症狀。尼古丁依賴同時涉及行為制約（吸菸相關情境線索觸發渴求）與生理依賴兩個層面，故戒菸治療常需藥物輔助與行為介入並行。
records.etiology_en: Smoking cessation support falls within the TCM concept of "addiction pattern." Prolonged tobacco use allows dry-heat toxin to enter the lung directly via the mouth and nose, consuming lung qi and injuring yin with dryness and heat; over time this produces lung-kidney yin deficiency, presenting as cough with scanty phlegm and dry mouth and throat. On abrupt cessation, impaired liver free-coursing obstructs the flow of qi, and the heart spirit — accustomed to the stimulant effect of tobacco toxin — becomes unsettled, producing irritability, anger, mood swings, and an intense, unrelenting oral craving. Where phlegm-turbidity has accumulated internally, chest oppression and productive cough are also seen. Acupuncture support for smoking cessation generally focuses on clearing the lung and moistening dryness, coursing the liver and regulating qi, and calming the heart spirit, to ease the restlessness and cravings of the withdrawal period.

records.western_pathology_en: Nicotine acts on nicotinic acetylcholine receptors in the brain, promoting dopamine release in the mesolimbic reward pathway (nucleus accumbens), which produces pleasure and reinforces continued use. Chronic smoking causes receptor upregulation and tolerance; upon cessation, receptor activity is insufficient and dopaminergic transmission drops sharply, producing withdrawal symptoms such as craving, irritability, anxiety, poor concentration, increased appetite, and weight gain. Nicotine dependence involves both behavioral conditioning — in which smoking-associated situational cues trigger cravings — and physiological dependence, so smoking cessation treatment often requires combined pharmacological and behavioral intervention.

records.name_zh: 身體症狀障礙（文件情境）
records.etiology_zh: 身體症狀障礙屬中醫「鬱證」、「梅核氣」範疇，病機以情志不遂、肝失疏泄為先，氣機鬱滯，循經竄擾多個臟腑部位，發為周身遊走性疼痛或異常感覺，部位不定、反覆難癒；氣鬱痰凝、結於咽喉者，可見咽中如有炙臠，咯之不出、嚥之不下之「梅核氣」；鬱久化火，可見煩躁、脅肋脹痛；心脾兩虛、氣血不足者，形神失養，症狀隨情緒波動而增減，多伴倦怠、食慾不振。臨床以肝鬱氣滯、氣鬱痰凝、心脾兩虛為常見證型。
records.western_pathology_zh: 身體症狀障礙的西醫病理機轉並非單一器質性病變所能解釋，涉及對身體感覺的過度警覺與災難化解讀（內感受處理異常），使正常生理波動被放大為顯著症狀；中樞神經系統對疼痛與不適訊號之調節閾值降低（中樞敏感化）亦是重要機轉之一；常與焦慮、憂鬱共病，且與早年生活壓力或創傷經驗有相關性；患者對健康之過度擔憂與反覆求醫行為，往往形成症狀關注與焦慮互為加重之惡性循環。
records.etiology_en: Somatic symptom disorder falls within the TCM categories of "depression pattern" (yu zheng) and "plum-pit qi" (mei he qi). The pathogenesis begins with unresolved emotional distress impairing the liver's free-coursing function; the resulting qi stagnation travels along the channels and disturbs multiple organ systems, producing migratory pain or abnormal sensations of uncertain location that recur despite treatment. Where qi stagnation and phlegm congeal in the throat, the classic "plum-pit qi" pattern appears — a sensation of something stuck in the throat that can neither be coughed up nor swallowed down. Prolonged stagnation transforming into fire produces irritability and rib-side distension and pain. In those with heart-spleen deficiency and insufficient qi and blood, body and spirit lack nourishment, and symptoms fluctuate with emotional state, often accompanied by fatigue and poor appetite. Commonly seen clinical patterns include liver depression with qi stagnation, qi stagnation with phlegm congelation, and heart-spleen deficiency.

records.western_pathology_en: The Western pathophysiology of somatic symptom disorder cannot be explained by a single organic lesion; it involves excessive vigilance toward and catastrophic interpretation of bodily sensations (abnormal interoceptive processing), which amplifies normal physiological fluctuations into prominent symptoms. A lowered central threshold for regulating pain and discomfort signals (central sensitization) is another key mechanism. The disorder frequently co-occurs with anxiety and depression and is associated with early-life stress or trauma. Excessive health-related worry and repeated care-seeking behavior often form a self-reinforcing cycle in which symptom focus and anxiety amplify one another.

records.etiology_zh: 記憶力減退屬中醫「健忘」範疇，病位主要在心、脾、腎。思慮過度、勞傷心脾者，氣血生化不足，不能上榮於腦，故見遇事善忘、精神不振、面色萎黃；年老或久病傷腎者，腎精虧虛，髓海失充，腦失所養，可見健忘伴腰膝痠軟、耳鳴眩暈；痰濁瘀血阻滯腦竅、清陽不升者，亦可見健忘、頭重昏蒙、舌質紫暗。臨床以心脾兩虛、腎精不足、痰瘀阻竅為常見證型，須與病理性癡呆鑑別。
records.western_pathology_zh: 記憶力減退在西醫的成因相當多元，須先排除病理性失智症。常見可逆性因素包括睡眠不足、憂鬱或焦慮導致之「假性失智」、甲狀腺功能低下、維生素B12缺乏及藥物副作用等；長期慢性壓力使皮質醇持續偏高，可對海馬迴造成不利影響，損及新記憶之形成與鞏固；隨年齡增長，處理速度與部分額葉功能自然減退，屬正常老化現象，但仍應與早期神經退化性病變（如失智症前驅期）審慎鑑別，必要時轉介神經專科評估。
records.etiology_en: Memory decline falls within the TCM category of "forgetfulness" (jian wang), located primarily in the heart, spleen, and kidney. When overthinking and fatigue injure the heart and spleen, insufficient generation of qi and blood fails to nourish the brain above, presenting as forgetfulness, low spirits, and a sallow complexion. In the elderly or those with kidney damage from prolonged illness, depleted kidney essence fails to fill the sea of marrow, leaving the brain unnourished, with forgetfulness accompanied by lower back and knee soreness, tinnitus, and dizziness. Where phlegm-turbidity and blood stasis obstruct the brain orifices and clear yang fails to ascend, forgetfulness with heavy-headedness, mental fogginess, and a dark purplish tongue may also be seen. Commonly seen clinical patterns include heart-spleen deficiency, kidney essence insufficiency, and phlegm-stasis obstructing the orifices; this should be distinguished from pathological dementia.

records.western_pathology_en: The causes of memory decline in Western medicine are diverse, and pathological dementia must first be ruled out. Common reversible factors include sleep deprivation; "pseudodementia" secondary to depression or anxiety; hypothyroidism; vitamin B12 deficiency; and medication side effects. Chronic stress with persistently elevated cortisol can adversely affect the hippocampus, impairing the formation and consolidation of new memories. With advancing age, processing speed and certain frontal lobe functions naturally decline as part of normal aging, but this should still be carefully distinguished from early neurodegenerative processes (such as a prodromal stage of dementia), with referral to a neurology specialist when indicated.

records.name_zh: 飲酒問題輔助（文件情境）
records.etiology_zh: 飲酒問題輔助屬中醫「酒毒」、「酒癖」範疇，酒性濕熱，久飲傷及脾胃，釀濕生熱，濕熱蘊結中焦，可見脘腹脹滿、口苦苔膩、大便不爽；酒毒傷肝，肝失疏泄，氣鬱化火，則見煩躁易怒、脅肋不舒、面赤目紅；久之傷及心神，心神不寧，可見失眠多夢、心悸不安；病程遷延，脾胃運化久損，氣血生化乏源，終致脾腎兩虛，倦怠乏力、形體消瘦。針灸輔助戒酒著重清熱化濕、疏肝解鬱、寧心安神。
records.western_pathology_zh: 酒精作用於中樞神經系統之 GABA-A 受體（增強其抑制作用）及 NMDA 麩胺酸受體（抑制其興奮作用），長期飲酒使腦部產生神經適應性改變，GABA 受體活性下調、麩胺酸受體上調，形成耐受性；一旦驟然停飲，中樞神經系統轉為過度興奮狀態，出現顫抖、焦慮、失眠、癲癇發作甚或譫妄（酒精戒斷症候群）之風險；中腦邊緣多巴胺獎賞路徑之活化則是成癮行為的核心機轉。長期過量飲酒亦可導致肝臟損傷、周邊神經病變及硫胺素（維生素B1）缺乏所致之魏尼克—柯沙可夫症候群等併發症。
records.etiology_en: Alcohol use problems fall within the TCM categories of "alcohol toxin" (jiu du) and "alcohol addiction" (jiu pi). Alcohol is dampness-heat in nature; prolonged drinking injures the spleen and stomach, brewing dampness and generating heat that accumulates in the middle burner, presenting as epigastric and abdominal distension, bitter taste with a greasy tongue coating, and unsatisfying bowel movements. Alcohol toxin injuring the liver impairs its free-coursing function, and qi stagnation transforms into fire, producing irritability, rib-side discomfort, and a flushed face with red eyes. Over time this disturbs the heart spirit, causing insomnia with excessive dreaming and palpitations with unease. As the condition persists, prolonged impairment of spleen-stomach transformation and transportation depletes the source of qi and blood, eventually leading to combined spleen-kidney deficiency, with fatigue and wasting. Acupuncture support for reducing alcohol use focuses on clearing heat and resolving dampness, coursing the liver and relieving depression, and calming the heart spirit.

records.western_pathology_en: Alcohol acts on GABA-A receptors in the central nervous system (enhancing their inhibitory effect) and NMDA glutamate receptors (suppressing their excitatory effect). Chronic drinking produces neuroadaptive changes — downregulation of GABA receptor activity and upregulation of glutamate receptors — resulting in tolerance. Upon abrupt cessation, the central nervous system swings into a state of overexcitation, with tremor, anxiety, insomnia, and a risk of seizures or even delirium (alcohol withdrawal syndrome). Activation of the mesolimbic dopamine reward pathway is the core mechanism underlying addictive behavior. Chronic excessive alcohol use can also cause liver damage, peripheral neuropathy, and Wernicke-Korsakoff syndrome resulting from thiamine (vitamin B1) deficiency.

records.etiology_zh: 飲食失調屬中醫「厭食」、「食亦」範疇，病機以肝鬱脾虛為主軸：情志不遂，肝失疏泄，橫逆犯脾，脾胃運化失常，可見食慾減退、脘悶不舒，或情緒性暴食交替出現；思慮傷脾，脾胃虛弱，生化乏源，久則氣血兩虛，形體消瘦、面色萎黃、月經失調；若鬱久化火，胃熱熾盛，則見多食易饑、嘈雜似饑；病程日久，心神失養，情緒不穩，常兼焦慮抑鬱之象。臨床以肝鬱脾虛、脾胃虛弱、胃熱鬱火為常見證型。
records.western_pathology_zh: 飲食失調（如厭食症、暴食症）的西醫病理機轉屬多因子交互作用：遺傳體質、完美主義人格特質與身體意象扭曲為重要促發因素；血清素系統調節食慾、飽足感與情緒之功能異常，可能參與症狀之維持；下視丘—腦垂體—性腺軸受長期營養不足與體重過低影響而受抑制，厭食症患者常見停經；暴食症則以反覆暴食後代償行為（如催吐、瀉劑濫用）為特徵，長期可導致電解質失衡（如低血鉀）之風險，須留意心律不整等併發症；社會文化對體態之壓力與共病之焦慮、強迫特質亦扮演重要角色。
records.etiology_en: Disordered eating falls within the TCM categories of "food aversion" (yan shi) and "stomach heat with excess consumption" (shi yi). The pathogenesis centers on liver depression with spleen deficiency: unresolved emotional distress impairs the liver's free-coursing function, and the liver invades the spleen, disturbing normal digestive transformation and transportation, presenting as reduced appetite and epigastric fullness, or alternating episodes of emotionally driven binge eating. Overthinking injuring the spleen leads to spleen-stomach weakness and an insufficient source for generating qi and blood; over time this produces combined qi-blood deficiency, with wasting, a sallow complexion, and menstrual irregularity. Where stagnation transforms into fire and stomach heat becomes intense, excessive hunger and a gnawing hunger-like sensation appear. With prolonged course, the heart spirit lacks nourishment and mood becomes unstable, often with accompanying anxiety and depression. Commonly seen clinical patterns include liver depression with spleen deficiency, spleen-stomach weakness, and stomach heat with depressive fire.

records.western_pathology_en: The Western pathophysiology of eating disorders (such as anorexia nervosa and bulimia nervosa) involves multifactorial interaction: genetic predisposition, perfectionistic personality traits, and body image distortion are important precipitating factors. Dysregulation of the serotonergic system, which modulates appetite, satiety, and mood, may contribute to symptom maintenance. The hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal axis becomes suppressed under prolonged undernutrition and low body weight, and amenorrhea is commonly seen in anorexia nervosa. Bulimia nervosa is characterized by recurrent binge eating followed by compensatory behaviors (such as self-induced vomiting or laxative misuse), which over time carries a risk of electrolyte imbalance (such as hypokalemia) and warrants attention to complications such as cardiac arrhythmia. Sociocultural pressure regarding body shape, along with comorbid anxiety and obsessive-compulsive traits, also plays a significant role.

records.etiology_zh: 感冒多因正氣虛弱、衛外不固,風邪夾寒、夾熱或夾暑濕乘虛侵犯肺衛,肺氣失宣,清竅不利而發病。風寒外束者惡寒重、發熱輕、鼻塞流清涕、無汗,苔薄白,脈浮緊;風熱犯表者發熱重、惡寒輕、咽痛口渴、鼻塞流濁涕,苔薄黃,脈浮數;暑濕型多見於長夏,兼身重、脘悶、便溏。素體肺氣不足、反覆感邪者易纏綿難癒。
records.western_pathology_zh: 普通感冒為病毒引起的急性上呼吸道黏膜發炎,鼻病毒(rhinovirus)最常見,其餘尚有冠狀病毒、呼吸道融合病毒、腺病毒等,經飛沫與接觸傳播。病毒侵犯鼻咽黏膜上皮,誘發局部發炎反應,出現鼻塞、流涕、咽痛、輕咳等症狀,多在7至10天內自限;免疫力低下、過度疲勞或幼兒與慢性病患者較易反覆感染,或併發細菌性鼻竇炎、中耳炎。
records.etiology_en: The common cold generally arises when defensive (wei) qi is weak and the exterior is not secure, allowing wind combined with cold, heat, or summer-damp to invade the lung-defense level, impairing lung qi dispersal and clouding the orifices. Wind-cold binding the exterior shows marked aversion to cold, mild fever, nasal congestion with clear discharge, no sweating, a thin white coating, and a floating tight pulse. Wind-heat invading the exterior shows marked fever, mild aversion to cold, sore throat, thirst, and turbid nasal discharge, with a thin yellow coating and a floating rapid pulse. A summer-damp pattern is more common in late summer, with body heaviness, epigastric fullness, and loose stools. Those with underlying lung-qi deficiency who repeatedly contract pathogens tend toward a protracted, recurrent course.

records.western_pathology_en: The common cold is an acute viral inflammation of the upper respiratory mucosa, most often caused by rhinovirus, with coronaviruses, respiratory syncytial virus, and adenoviruses also common; transmission is by droplet and contact spread. Viral infection of the nasopharyngeal epithelium triggers local inflammation producing nasal congestion, rhinorrhea, sore throat, and mild cough, typically self-limited within 7 to 10 days. Those who are immunocompromised, overexerted, very young, or living with chronic illness are more prone to recurrent infection or to secondary bacterial complications such as sinusitis or otitis media.

records.etiology_zh: 流行性感冒屬中醫「時行感冒」範疇,多因時令疫癘之氣(風熱夾毒或風寒夾疫)乘正氣不足、衛外失固之際侵襲肺衛,較一般感冒發病急、傳變快、症情重。臨床常見發熱高、惡寒甚、周身痠痛、頭痛劇烈、咽痛、乾咳少痰,苔黃或黃燥,脈浮數而有力;素體氣陰不足、老幼體弱者易內傳氣分,甚或傳變為肺熱壅盛、邪陷心包等重症。
records.western_pathology_zh: 流行性感冒由流感病毒(以A、B型為主)引起,經飛沫傳播,潛伏期短、傳染力強,好發於冬春季並可群聚流行。病毒感染呼吸道上皮後引發全身性發炎反應,典型表現為突發高熱、明顯肌肉痠痛、極度倦怠,症狀較普通感冒更為劇烈;年幼、年長或合併慢性心肺疾病者可併發病毒性或續發性細菌性肺炎等重症,需及早辨識與治療,必要時使用抗病毒藥物。
records.etiology_en: Influenza falls under the TCM category of "seasonal epidemic cold" (shi xing gan mao): a seasonal pestilential qi — wind-heat combined with toxin, or wind-cold combined with epidemic factors — invades the lung-defense level when righteous qi is weak and the exterior is unsecured, producing a more abrupt onset, faster progression, and more severe presentation than an ordinary cold. Typical signs are high fever, marked aversion to cold, generalized body aches, severe headache, sore throat, and a dry cough with scant sputum, with a yellow or dry-yellow coating and a forceful floating rapid pulse. Those with underlying qi-yin deficiency, the elderly, and children are more prone to internal transmission into the qi level, or even progression to lung-heat excess or pathogen invading the pericardium in severe cases.

records.western_pathology_en: Influenza is caused by influenza viruses (predominantly types A and B), spread by droplet transmission, with a short incubation period, high transmissibility, and typical seasonal outbreaks in winter and spring. Viral infection of the respiratory epithelium triggers a systemic inflammatory response, classically presenting as abrupt high fever, prominent myalgia, and profound fatigue — more severe than the common cold. Young children, the elderly, and those with chronic cardiopulmonary disease are at higher risk of complications such as viral or secondary bacterial pneumonia, and require early recognition and, where indicated, antiviral treatment.

records.etiology_en: Lung Qi Deficiency with insecurity of the defensive exterior, Spleen Qi Deficiency, Kidney Qi insufficiency, and contraction of Wind-Cold or abnormal (aberrant) Qi.

records.etiology_zh: 慢性鼻竇炎屬中醫「鼻淵」範疇,病位在肺、脾、膽。多因外感風熱失於清解,或膽經鬱熱循經上犯,燻蒸鼻竇,以致濁涕黃稠、鼻塞嗅減、頭脹頭痛;若脾胃濕熱內蘊、清陽不升,則涕多黏白、遇勞加重;病久肺脾氣虛、邪戀清竅,則涕清而黏、鼻塞反覆、遇風冷易發,纏綿難癒。
records.western_pathology_zh: 慢性鼻竇炎指鼻竇黏膜發炎持續超過12週,常由鼻竇開口複合體(ostiomeatal complex)阻塞、纖毛清除功能受損及細菌生物膜形成所致,亦與過敏性鼻炎、鼻中隔偏曲、鼻息肉等解剖或免疫因素相關。主要症狀為鼻塞、膿性鼻涕、顏面脹痛及嗅覺減退,病程反覆遷延,治療需兼顧鼻竇通氣引流與感染控制,部分病例合併鼻息肉需手術評估。
records.etiology_en: Chronic sinusitis falls under the TCM category of "nasal deep-source drainage" (bi yuan), centered on the lung, spleen, and gallbladder. It commonly arises when externally contracted wind-heat is not properly cleared, or when gallbladder-channel heat stagnation ascends along its pathway to steam the sinuses, producing thick yellow discharge, nasal congestion, diminished smell, and a distending headache. When spleen-stomach damp-heat accumulates internally and clear yang fails to ascend, the discharge is copious, sticky, and white, worsening with exertion. In long-standing cases with lung-spleen qi deficiency and lingering pathogen at the orifice, the discharge becomes clear but sticky, congestion recurs, and symptoms flare with wind and cold exposure, producing a protracted, relapsing course.

records.western_pathology_en: Chronic sinusitis is defined as sinus mucosal inflammation persisting beyond 12 weeks, commonly resulting from obstruction of the ostiomeatal complex, impaired mucociliary clearance, and bacterial biofilm formation, and is also associated with anatomic or immune factors such as allergic rhinitis, septal deviation, and nasal polyps. Principal symptoms are nasal congestion, purulent discharge, facial pressure/pain, and reduced sense of smell, with a relapsing, protracted course; management addresses both sinus drainage/ventilation and infection control, and cases with nasal polyps may require surgical evaluation.

records.etiology_zh: 哮喘多因宿痰伏肺,遇外感風寒、風熱,或飲食、情志、勞倦所誘,以致痰阻氣道、肺氣宣降失常而喘促痰鳴。發作期分寒喘(痰白清稀、遇冷即發,苔白脈緊,屬寒邪犯肺、肺氣不宣)與熱喘(痰黃黏稠、發熱口渴,苔黃脈滑數,屬痰熱壅肺);緩解期則以肺氣虛(自汗畏風、易感冒)、脾虛痰盛(食少便溏、痰多易咳)、腎不納氣(喘促短氣、動則尤甚、腰膝痠軟)等虛證為主,反覆發作日久,耗傷肺、脾、腎三臟。
records.western_pathology_zh: 氣喘(哮喘)是一種慢性氣道發炎性疾病,常以嗜酸性球或混合型發炎為主,導致氣道高反應性;接觸過敏原、感染、冷空氣、運動或刺激物時,支氣管平滑肌痙攣、黏膜水腫及痰液分泌增加,造成可逆性氣流阻塞,出現喘鳴、胸悶、咳嗽與呼吸困難。長期未妥善控制的發炎可導致氣道重塑、肺功能不可逆下降;吸入型類固醇為長期控制發炎的主要治療,急性發作則以支氣管擴張劑緩解症狀。

symptoms_zh: 呼吸急促，氣不接續之症

records.classical_references_zh:
《聖濟總錄．傷寒門》：「論曰傷寒喘，其證不一。有邪氣在表，表未解無汗而喘者；有邪氣在裡，汗出不惡寒，腹滿而喘者。有潮熱者。有心下有水而喘者。古人治之，亦各求其本。故在表者當汗，在裡者宜下，至於心下有水而喘，則又當利其小便也。

《症因脈治．喘症論》：「諸經皆令人喘，而多在肺胃二家。喘而咳逆嗽痰者，肺也；喘而嘔吐者，胃也」。

《症因脈治．外感喘》：「暑濕喘逆之症，煩悶口渴，喘息氣粗，多言身重，汗出身仍熟，此暑濕之喘症也」。

《症因脈治．內傷喘》：「食積喘逆之症，胸滿，胃痛腹痛，惡食飽悶，大便或結或溏，上氣喘逆，喘嘔噯氣，此食積喘逆症也」。

《景岳全書．喘促》：「關格之證為喘者，…其病必虛裡跳動而氣喘不已。此之喘狀多無咳嗽，但覺胸膈舂舂，似脹非脹，似短非短，微勞則喘甚，多言亦喘甚，甚至通身振振，慌張不寧，此必情欲傷陰，以致元氣無根，孤陽離劇候也」。

《醫學正傳．哮喘》：「大抵哮以聲響名，喘以氣息言。夫喘促喉中如水雞聲者，謂之哮；氣促而連屬不能以息者，謂之喘。」

《景岳全書．喘促》謂：「氣喘之病，最為危候，治失其要，鮮不誤人，欲辨之者，亦惟二證而已。所謂二證者，一曰實喘，一曰虛喘也」

《臨證指南醫案．喘》云：「在肺為實，在腎為虛。」
records.etiology_en: Asthma is generally rooted in latent phlegm lodged in the lung, triggered by external contraction of wind-cold or wind-heat, or by diet, emotional strain, or overexertion, so that phlegm obstructs the airway and lung qi loses its normal dispersing-descending function, producing wheezing with rattling phlegm. During attacks, a cold-type pattern shows thin white sputum triggered by cold exposure, a white coating, and a tight pulse (cold pathogen invading the lung, lung qi unable to disperse), while a heat-type pattern shows thick yellow sputum with fever and thirst, a yellow coating, and a slippery rapid pulse (phlegm-heat obstructing the lung). Between attacks, deficiency patterns predominate: lung-qi deficiency (spontaneous sweating, aversion to wind, frequent colds), spleen deficiency with phlegm excess (poor appetite, loose stools, copious phlegm), and kidney failing to grasp qi (labored breathing worse on exertion, sore weak low back and knees). Repeated attacks over time progressively deplete the lung, spleen, and kidney.

records.western_pathology_en: Asthma is a chronic inflammatory airway disease, typically driven by eosinophilic or mixed-pattern inflammation, that produces airway hyperresponsiveness. Exposure to allergens, infection, cold air, exercise, or irritants triggers bronchial smooth-muscle spasm, mucosal edema, and increased mucus secretion, causing reversible airflow obstruction with wheeze, chest tightness, cough, and dyspnea. Poorly controlled inflammation over time can lead to airway remodeling and irreversible decline in lung function; inhaled corticosteroids are the mainstay of long-term anti-inflammatory control, while bronchodilators are used to relieve acute exacerbations.

records.name_zh: 慢性阻塞性肺病（輔助文件情境）
records.etiology_zh: 慢性阻塞性肺病屬中醫「肺脹」範疇,多由久患咳嗽、哮喘、支飲等肺系疾病反覆遷延,痰濁潴留,復感外邪而誘發,致肺氣脹滿、不能斂降。病機演變常見肺氣虛→肺脾兩虛(痰濁壅肺、脾失健運)→肺腎兩虛(腎不納氣,動則喘甚)→心陽虛衰、血脈瘀阻(唇甲紫紺、下肢浮腫);後期常見痰濁、水飲、血瘀互結,虛實夾雜,標本同病。
records.western_pathology_zh: 慢性阻塞性肺病主要因長期吸入有害物質(以吸菸為最主要危險因子,其次為職業粉塵與空氣污染)引起氣道與肺實質慢性發炎,導致慢性支氣管炎(氣道黏液分泌增加、纖毛功能受損)與肺氣腫(肺泡壁破壞、彈性回縮力喪失)並存,造成持續性、進行性且不完全可逆的氣流受限。病程後期可因慢性缺氧併發肺動脈高壓與肺心病(右心衰竭),急性惡化常由呼吸道感染誘發。
records.classical_references_zh:
《丹溪心法．咳嗽》：「上半日多嗽者，此屬胃中有火，用貝母、石膏降胃火；午後嗽多者，屬陰虛，必用四物湯加炒柏、知母降火；黃昏嗽者是火氣浮於肺，不宜用涼藥，宜五味子、五倍子歛而降之；五更嗽多者，此胃中有食積，至此時，火氣流入肺，以知母、地骨皮降肺火。」

《景岳全書．咳嗽》：「咳嗽，凡遇秋冬即發者，此寒包熱也。但解其寒，其熱自散、宜六安煎、二陳湯、金水六君煎三方，察其虛實壯老隨宜用之，如果內熱甚者，不妨佐以黃芩、知母之類。」

《雜病源流犀燭．咳嗽哮喘源流》：「有聲無痰曰咳，非無痰，痰不易出也，病在肺、肺主聲，故聲先而痰後。有痰無聲曰嗽，非無聲，痰隨嗽出，聲不甚響也，病在脾，脾藏痰，故痰出而嗽止。」
records.etiology_en: COPD falls under the TCM category of "lung distension" (fei zhang), commonly resulting from long-standing, recurrent lung-system disorders such as cough, asthma, and fluid-retention dyspnea, in which phlegm-turbidity accumulates and repeated external pathogen invasion precipitates attacks, so that lung qi becomes distended and can no longer contract and descend. The pathomechanism typically progresses from lung-qi deficiency, to combined lung-spleen deficiency (phlegm-turbidity obstructing the lung with impaired spleen transportation), to combined lung-kidney deficiency (kidney failing to grasp qi, dyspnea worse on exertion), and eventually to heart-yang deficiency with blood-vessel stasis (cyanotic lips and nails, lower-limb edema). In advanced disease, phlegm-turbidity, fluid retention, and blood stasis commonly intermingle, presenting a mixed deficiency-excess pattern in which root and branch are both diseased.

records.western_pathology_en: COPD results primarily from chronic inhalation of noxious particles — cigarette smoke being the dominant risk factor, with occupational dust and air pollution also contributing — causing chronic inflammation of the airways and lung parenchyma. This produces coexisting chronic bronchitis (increased airway mucus secretion and impaired ciliary function) and emphysema (destruction of alveolar walls and loss of elastic recoil), together causing persistent, progressive, and largely irreversible airflow limitation. In advanced disease, chronic hypoxia can lead to pulmonary hypertension and cor pulmonale (right heart failure); acute exacerbations are commonly triggered by respiratory infection.

records.etiology_zh: 慢性咳嗽指咳嗽遷延超過八週,中醫辨證常見數型:外感咳嗽失治、風邪未盡,伏於肺絡(風邪戀肺),遇冷或刺激性氣味即發,咽癢陣咳,苔薄;痰濕內蘊者,脾失健運,痰阻肺絡而咳痰量多、胸悶,苔白膩;肝火犯肺者,情緒波動即嗆咳陣作、咳引脅痛,苔薄黃,脈弦;肺陰虧虛者,乾咳無痰或痰少而黏、咽乾少津,舌紅少苔,多見於病程日久、反覆傷陰者。諸型可單獨或夾雜出現,故慢性咳嗽辨證較急性咳嗽複雜。
records.western_pathology_zh: 慢性咳嗽定義為咳嗽持續超過8週,常見病因依序為上呼吸道咳嗽症候群(鼻涕倒流)、咳嗽變異型氣喘、胃食道逆流,以及服用ACE抑制劑類降血壓藥物,少數為慢性支氣管炎、支氣管擴張症或其他肺部病灶所致。共同機轉為咳嗽反射弧(氣道感覺神經末梢)因發炎、機械或化學刺激而持續處於敏感化狀態,診斷需系統性排除上述常見病因,並依線索安排胸部影像或肺功能檢查。

records.etiology_en: Chronic cough — cough persisting beyond eight weeks — is differentiated in TCM into several patterns. In lingering wind after an inadequately treated external contraction (wind lodged in the lung network), cough recurs paroxysmally with throat itch, triggered by cold or irritant odors, with a thin coating. In internal phlegm-damp accumulation, impaired spleen transportation lets phlegm obstruct the lung network, producing copious sputum and chest fullness with a white greasy coating. In liver fire invading the lung, emotional upset provokes choking paroxysmal cough with rib-side pain, a thin yellow coating, and a wiry pulse. In lung-yin deficiency, there is a dry cough with little or no sputum, dry throat with scant fluid, and a red tongue with little coating — most often seen in protracted cases with repeated yin injury. These patterns may appear singly or in combination, making chronic cough considerably harder to differentiate than acute cough.

records.western_pathology_en: Chronic cough is defined as cough persisting beyond 8 weeks. The most common causes, in roughly descending order, are upper airway cough syndrome (postnasal drip), cough-variant asthma, gastroesophageal reflux disease, and ACE-inhibitor antihypertensive medication, with chronic bronchitis, bronchiectasis, or other pulmonary lesions accounting for a smaller share. The shared mechanism is sensitization of the cough reflex arc (airway sensory afferents) from inflammation or mechanical/chemical irritation. Diagnosis requires systematically ruling out these common causes and, guided by clinical clues, obtaining chest imaging or pulmonary function testing as indicated.

records.etiology_zh: 感染後咳嗽多因外感風邪雖經治療、表證已解,而餘邪未盡,伏留肺絡,肺氣失於宣暢,故咳嗽遷延不癒,痰少或無痰,遇風、遇冷、遇異味則咳嗽加劇;若病程中熱邪傷陰,則兼見咽乾口燥、乾咳少痰。此證多屬邪去正未復之虛實夾雜候,治宜宣肺祛餘邪與潤肺止咳並用,不宜早投滋補斂澀之品,以免留邪不去。
records.western_pathology_zh: 感染後咳嗽(postinfectious cough)是指上呼吸道病毒感染後,急性症狀已緩解但咳嗽持續3至8週的常見現象,機轉為病毒感染導致氣道上皮受損、局部發炎與咳嗽感受器暫時性高敏感化,並非持續性感染所致。多數病例可於數週內自行緩解;若咳嗽超過8週,或伴隨發燒、體重減輕、咳血等警示症狀,則需重新評估是否為氣喘、鼻涕倒流或其他慢性咳嗽病因。

《景岳全書．咳嗽》：「咳嗽，凡遇秋冬即發者，此寒包熱也。但解其寒，其熱自散、宜六安煎、二陳湯、金水六君煎三方，察其虛實壯老隨宜用之，如果內熱甚者，不妨佐以黃芩、知母之類。」

records.etiology_en: Post-viral cough commonly occurs when, although the exterior pattern from an external wind contraction has resolved with treatment, a residual pathogen remains lodged in the lung network, so lung qi cannot disperse freely and the cough persists with little or no sputum, worsening on exposure to wind, cold, or pungent odors. Where heat has injured fluids during the illness, dry throat and mouth with a dry cough and scant sputum may accompany it. This is generally a mixed deficiency-excess pattern of "pathogen departed but righteous qi not yet restored," best treated by combining dispersal of the residual pathogen with moistening of the lung to stop cough, avoiding early use of rich tonifying or astringent formulas that could trap the lingering pathogen.

records.western_pathology_en: Postinfectious cough refers to the common pattern in which cough persists for 3 to 8 weeks after acute symptoms of an upper respiratory viral infection have resolved. The mechanism involves virus-induced airway epithelial injury, local inflammation, and transient hypersensitization of cough receptors, rather than ongoing active infection. Most cases resolve spontaneously within a few weeks; cough persisting beyond 8 weeks, or accompanied by warning signs such as fever, weight loss, or hemoptysis, warrants reevaluation for asthma, postnasal drip, or other causes of chronic cough.

records.name_zh: 急性支氣管炎（文件情境）
records.etiology_zh: 急性支氣管炎多屬中醫「咳嗽」範疇,因外感風寒或風熱之邪侵襲肺衛,肺失宣降,肺氣上逆而咳。風寒襲肺者咳嗽聲重、痰白清稀、鼻塞流清涕、惡寒發熱無汗,苔薄白,脈浮緊;風熱犯肺者咳嗽氣粗、痰黃黏稠、咽痛口渴、發熱惡風,苔薄黃,脈浮數。若邪戀不去、痰濕內生,可見咳嗽痰多、胸悶,病程遷延則轉為痰濕蘊肺之證。
records.western_pathology_zh: 急性支氣管炎為氣管與支氣管黏膜之急性發炎,約九成由病毒感染引起,常見於上呼吸道感染之後,少數為細菌感染或吸入刺激性物質所致。黏膜發炎導致纖毛清除功能受損、痰液分泌增加,臨床以咳嗽為主要表現,可伴咳痰、胸骨後不適,通常於1至3週內自行緩解;若咳嗽持續超過3週,或痰呈膿性、伴發熱不退,則需排除肺炎或其他病因。
records.etiology_en: Acute bronchitis generally falls under the TCM category of "cough," arising when externally contracted wind-cold or wind-heat invades the lung-defense level, impairing lung qi's dispersing-descending function and causing qi to rebel upward as cough. Wind-cold invading the lung produces a heavy-sounding cough with thin white sputum, nasal congestion with clear discharge, aversion to cold, fever without sweating, a thin white coating, and a floating tight pulse. Wind-heat invading the lung produces a coarse cough with thick yellow sputum, sore throat, thirst, fever with aversion to wind, a thin yellow coating, and a floating rapid pulse. If the pathogen lingers and internal phlegm-damp forms, copious sputum and chest fullness appear, and a protracted course shifts the pattern toward phlegm-damp accumulating in the lung.

records.western_pathology_en: Acute bronchitis is an acute inflammation of the tracheobronchial mucosa, roughly 90% viral in origin and commonly following an upper respiratory infection, with a minority of cases caused by bacterial infection or inhaled irritants. Mucosal inflammation impairs mucociliary clearance and increases mucus secretion, producing cough as the dominant symptom, often with sputum production and retrosternal discomfort; it typically resolves spontaneously within 1 to 3 weeks. Cough persisting beyond 3 weeks, or accompanied by purulent sputum and unresolving fever, warrants evaluation to exclude pneumonia or other causes.

records.name_zh: 阻塞性睡眠呼吸中止（文件情境）
records.etiology_zh: 阻塞性睡眠呼吸中止屬中醫「鼾症」範疇,多因形體肥胖、恣食肥甘,脾失健運,痰濕內生,壅塞氣道咽喉;或痰濁鬱久化熱,痰熱互結,咽喉不利,鼾聲雷動;病程日久,痰瘀互結,阻滯氣道脈絡,更兼夜間反覆缺氧耗氣傷陰,可見晨起頭脹頭痛、神疲嗜睡、健忘、心悸等心脾兩虛或痰瘀阻絡之象。
records.western_pathology_zh: 阻塞性睡眠呼吸中止是睡眠中咽喉部軟組織反覆塌陷,造成上呼吸道部分或完全阻塞,常見危險因子包括肥胖、扁桃腺肥大、下顎後縮及頸部脂肪堆積。反覆阻塞導致間歇性缺氧與睡眠片段化,病人常有大聲鼾聲、睡眠中呼吸暫停、白天嗜睡與晨起頭痛,長期未治療與高血壓、心律不整、代謝症候群及心血管疾病風險增加相關,診斷需依睡眠多項生理檢查(polysomnography)確認。
records.etiology_en: Obstructive sleep apnea falls under the TCM category of "snoring disorder" (han zheng). It commonly arises from obesity and overindulgence in rich, greasy food, which impairs spleen transportation and generates internal phlegm-damp that obstructs the airway and throat; when this phlegm-turbidity stagnates and transforms into heat, phlegm-heat binds together, further obstructing the throat and producing loud, thunderous snoring. In protracted cases, phlegm and blood stasis intermingle to block the airway network, and repeated nocturnal hypoxia consumes qi and injures yin, producing morning headache and head distension, fatigue with daytime sleepiness, poor memory, and palpitations — signs of heart-spleen deficiency or phlegm-stasis obstructing the network.

records.western_pathology_en: Obstructive sleep apnea results from repeated collapse of the soft tissues of the pharynx during sleep, causing partial or complete upper-airway obstruction. Common risk factors include obesity, tonsillar hypertrophy, retrognathia, and cervical fat deposition. Repeated obstruction causes intermittent hypoxia and sleep fragmentation; patients typically present with loud snoring, witnessed apneas during sleep, daytime sleepiness, and morning headache. Untreated disease is associated with increased risk of hypertension, arrhythmia, metabolic syndrome, and cardiovascular disease; diagnosis is confirmed by polysomnography.

records.etiology_zh: 正氣不足，絡脈空虛，風寒或風熱之邪乘虛侵襲面部經絡，氣血阻滯。
records.western_pathology_zh: 莖乳孔內莖乳突神經非特異性炎症導致的面神經麻痺，引起面部表情肌癱瘓。
records.classical_references_zh:
《靈樞．經脈》篇：「胃足陽明之脈，…是主血所生病者，…曰喎…」

《靈樞．經筋》篇：「足陽明之筋，…其病…，卒口僻，…」

《諸病源候論．風病諸侯》：「風邪入於足陽明、手陽明之經，遇寒則筋急引頰，故使口喎僻，言語不正，而目不能平視。診其脈，浮而遲者可治。」

《景岳全書．非風》：「凡非風口眼喎斜，有寒熱之辨。在經曰："足陽明之筋引缺盆及頰，卒口僻，急者目不合，熱則筋縱，目不開。頰筋有寒則急，引頰移口。有熱則筋弛縱，緩不勝收，故僻。'此經以病之寒熱，言筋之緩急也。然而血氣無虧，則雖熱未必緩，雖寒未必急，亦總由血氣之衰可知也。」

《醫林改錯．口眼歪斜辨》：「或曰：半身不遂，既然無風，如何口眼歪斜?余曰：古人立歪斜之名，總是臨症不細心審察之故。口眼歪斜，並非歪斜。因受病之半臉無氣，無氣則半臉縮小。一眼無氣力，不能圓睜，小眼角下抽，口半邊無氣力不能開，咀角上抽，上下相湊，乍看似歪斜，其實並非左右之歪斜。…」「又曰：口眼歪斜，盡屬半臉無氣乎？余曰：前論指兼半身不遂而言。若壯盛人，無半身不遂，忽然口眼歪斜，乃受風邪阻滯經絡之症。經絡為風邪阻滯，氣必不上達。氣不上達頭面，亦能病口眼歪斜。用通絡散風之劑，一藥而癒，又非治半身不遂方之所能為也。」

records.etiology_en: Insufficiency of Upright (Zheng) Qi with emptiness of the collateral vessels, allowing Wind-Cold or Wind-Heat pathogens to exploit the deficiency and invade the facial meridians and collaterals, obstructing Qi and Blood.

records.etiology_zh: 中醫病因有四:一、肝陽亢盛、腎陰虧虛;二、痰濕內蘊;三、勞倦過度、精神緊張;四、生活方式因素。其發病機轉以五端為要:風、火、痰、瘀、虛,其中「虛」包括血虛、陰虛與津液虧耗。西醫方面,參與本病發生的危險因素包括:高血壓、糖尿病、動脈粥樣硬化、心臟病、口服避孕藥、飲食因素(高鹽、高脂、飲酒)、精神壓力、肥胖、非法藥物、吸菸、年齡大於55歲,以及中風家族史。
records.western_pathology_zh: 中風(Zhong Feng,義為「感受風邪」)相當於西醫的腦血管意外(Cerebrovascular Accident, CVA):腦部動脈阻塞或破裂,造成半身不遂(偏癱)。臨床分為兩大類:缺血性中風,其機轉包括血栓形成、栓塞、全身性低灌流、靜脈血栓、隱源性(原因不明)以及動脈硬化與動脈粥樣硬化;出血性中風,包括顱內出血與腦內出血。

records.etiology_en: In TCM, four etiological factors are identified: (1) liver yang excess with kidney yin deficiency; (2) phlegm and dampness accumulation; (3) overstrain and stress; and (4) lifestyle factors. The mechanism of disease centers on five key factors: wind, fire, phlegm, stasis, and deficiency — the last encompassing deficiency of blood, yin, and body fluid. From the Western medical perspective, factors and conditions that may play a role in its development include hypertension, diabetes, atherosclerosis, heart disease, birth control pills, diet (salt, fat, alcohol), stress, obesity, illegal drugs, smoking, age over 55, and family history of stroke.
records.western_pathology_en: Wind Stroke (Zhong Feng, "catching wind") corresponds to Cerebrovascular Accident (CVA) in Western medicine, in which the arteries in the brain become blocked or rupture, resulting in hemiplegia. Two major categories are described: ischemic stroke — arising from thrombosis, embolism, systemic hypoperfusion, venous thrombosis, cryptogenic causes, and arteriosclerosis/atherosclerosis — and hemorrhagic stroke, comprising intracranial hemorrhage and intracerebral hemorrhage.

records.etiology_zh: 周邊神經病變在中醫多歸屬「痺證」與「痿證」範疇，依麻木、疼痛為主或以萎軟無力為主而異。痺證者，多因風寒濕三氣雜至，或久病氣血虧虛，肌膚經絡失於溫養，以致血行不暢、脈絡瘀阻，發為肢端麻木、刺痛；痿證者，多因久病耗傷，肺熱津傷不能布散精微，或脾胃虛弱，運化無權，氣血生化不足，不能榮養四肢肌肉、經筋，或肝腎虧虛，精血不能滋養筋脈，皆可致肢體萎軟、感覺遲鈍、肌力減退。飲食不節、嗜食肥甘釀生痰濕，痰瘀互結，阻滯脈絡，亦為常見病理環節。臨床常見氣血兩虛、痰瘀阻絡、肝腎虧虛、脾虛濕困等證型。
records.western_pathology_zh: 周邊神經病變是指周邊感覺、運動或自主神經纖維受損所致的一組疾病，成因多元，包括糖尿病及其他代謝性疾病、化學治療藥物或其他神經毒性物質、自體免疫疾病、維生素缺乏（如維生素 B12）、遺傳性神經病變、感染（如帶狀皰疹、萊姆病）、酒精濫用及局部神經壓迫等。病理機轉主要涉及軸突變性及／或髓鞘脫失，導致神經傳導速度減慢或訊號中斷。臨床上常表現為對稱性、由遠端向近端發展的感覺異常（麻木、刺痛、灼熱感）、疼痛及肌力減退，呈現典型的「手套襪套型」分布，嚴重者可伴隨自主神經功能障礙（如姿勢性低血壓、排汗異常）。
records.etiology_en: In Chinese medicine, peripheral neuropathy is generally categorized under Bi syndrome (painful obstruction) or Wei syndrome (flaccidity/wasting), depending on whether numbness/pain or weakness/atrophy predominates. In Bi syndrome, invasion by wind, cold and damp, or long-term qi and blood deficiency, leaves the skin, flesh and channels without warmth and nourishment, so blood movement becomes sluggish and the collaterals become obstructed, producing numbness and stabbing pain of the extremities. In Wei syndrome, prolonged illness consuming the body, Lung heat scorching fluids so that essence and qi cannot be distributed, or Spleen-Stomach weakness with failure of transformation and transportation reducing qi-blood production, leaves the four limbs' muscles and sinews unnourished; alternatively Liver-Kidney deficiency leaves essence and blood unable to nourish the sinews and vessels — all of these can produce limb flaccidity, reduced sensation and diminished muscle strength. Poor diet with excessive rich, greasy food generating phlegm-damp, with phlegm and stasis binding together to obstruct the collaterals, is another common pathological link. Clinically the commonly seen patterns are qi-blood deficiency, phlegm-stasis obstructing the collaterals, Liver-Kidney deficiency, and Spleen deficiency with damp encumbrance.

records.western_pathology_en: Peripheral neuropathy denotes a group of disorders caused by damage to peripheral sensory, motor, or autonomic nerve fibers. Causes are diverse, including diabetes and other metabolic disorders, chemotherapeutic agents or other neurotoxic substances, autoimmune disease, vitamin deficiency (e.g., vitamin B12), hereditary neuropathies, infection (e.g., herpes zoster, Lyme disease), alcohol misuse, and local nerve compression. The underlying pathology chiefly involves axonal degeneration and/or demyelination, slowing nerve conduction velocity or interrupting signal transmission. Clinically this typically presents as symmetric, distal-to-proximal sensory disturbance (numbness, tingling, burning) and pain with reduced muscle strength, following a characteristic 'stocking-glove' distribution; more severe cases may include autonomic dysfunction such as orthostatic hypotension or abnormal sweating.

records.etiology_zh: 糖尿病周邊神經病變屬中醫「消渴」病久所致的兼證，多見於消渴病程日久，燥熱傷陰耗氣，氣陰兩虛，血行無力，脈絡失於濡養而致瘀阻不通，發為肢體麻木、疼痛、感覺減退，屬「血痺」「消渴痺」範疇。病久陰損及陽，可見陰陽兩虛，寒凝血瘀，肢冷疼痛加劇；若脾失健運、水濕內停，痰濁與瘀血互結，阻滯經絡，亦致肢端麻木不仁、步履如踩棉感。臨床常分為氣陰兩虛兼脈絡瘀阻、陰陽兩虛兼寒凝血瘀、痰瘀阻絡等證型論治。
records.western_pathology_zh: 糖尿病周邊神經病變是長期血糖控制不良最常見的併發症之一，好發於病程較長、血糖控制不佳的病患。其病理機轉主要與慢性高血糖引起的微血管病變（滋養神經的血管受損、缺血缺氧）、多元醇路徑活化（山梨醇及果糖堆積造成神經細胞滲透壓損傷）、氧化壓力增加及糖化終產物（AGEs）累積等多重機轉有關，最終導致周邊神經軸突變性及髓鞘脫失。臨床上典型表現為對稱性、由遠端向近端進展的感覺運動性多發神經病變，呈「手套襪套型」分布，早期以麻木、刺痛或灼熱感為主，後期可出現肌力減退及自主神經病變（如姿勢性低血壓、胃輕癱、排汗異常）。
records.etiology_en: Diabetic peripheral neuropathy in Chinese medicine is regarded as a complication arising from long-standing Wasting-Thirst (Xiaoke/diabetes) disease. Prolonged dryness-heat consumes yin and depletes qi, producing combined qi-yin deficiency; blood then moves without force, and the collaterals lose nourishment and become obstructed, giving rise to numbness, pain, and reduced sensation of the limbs — categorized under 'Blood Bi' or 'Xiaoke Bi.' As the disease progresses, yin damage extends to yang, producing combined yin-yang deficiency with cold coagulating the blood, worsening cold pain of the limbs. Where Spleen transportive function fails and water-damp accumulates, phlegm turbidity binding with blood stasis obstructing the channels can also produce numbness of the extremities and a sensation of walking on cotton. Clinically the condition is differentiated into qi-yin deficiency with collateral stasis, yin-yang deficiency with cold-coagulated stasis, and phlegm-stasis obstructing the collaterals.

records.western_pathology_en: Diabetic peripheral neuropathy is one of the most common complications of long-standing poor glycemic control, occurring more often with longer disease duration and poorer glucose control. Its pathophysiology chiefly involves chronic hyperglycemia-induced microvascular damage to the vasa nervorum (causing nerve ischemia and hypoxia), activation of the polyol pathway (accumulation of sorbitol and fructose causing osmotic injury to nerve cells), increased oxidative stress, and accumulation of advanced glycation end-products (AGEs) — mechanisms that together lead to axonal degeneration and demyelination of peripheral nerves. Clinically it typically presents as a symmetric, distal-to-proximal sensorimotor polyneuropathy in a 'stocking-glove' distribution, with numbness, tingling, or a burning sensation predominating early and reduced muscle strength or autonomic neuropathy (orthostatic hypotension, gastroparesis, abnormal sweating) appearing later.

records.summary_zh: 三叉神經痛表現為突發且劇烈的臉部疼痛，常被描述為尖銳、射擊樣或電擊樣疼痛，多影響單側，可持續數秒至約兩分鐘。洗臉、進食、刷牙、輕觸或風吹等刺激可能誘發疼痛。此為學習與文件對照摘要，不取代臨床診斷。
records.summary_en: Trigeminal neuralgia causes sudden, severe facial pain often described as sharp, shooting, or electric-shock-like. It usually affects one side and may last from a few seconds to about two minutes. Washing, eating, brushing the teeth, light touch, or wind may trigger attacks. Study and documentation context only; not a diagnostic substitute.

records.etiology_zh: 帶狀皰疹後神經痛屬中醫「蛇串瘡」病後餘毒未清所致，多因肝經濕熱未盡，或年老體弱、正氣未復，餘毒與氣血瘀滯膠結，阻滯經絡而疼痛纏綿不已。臨床以氣滯血瘀證最為多見，症見皮損雖已消退，患處仍疼痛如針刺刀割，痛處固定不移；亦有脾虛濕蘊、餘濕未清者，疼痛伴脘悶納呆、肢體困重；年老體弱、氣血兩虛者，則見疼痛纏綿，兼神疲乏力、面色少華，多因正虛無力驅邪外出，餘毒滯留脈絡而致。
records.western_pathology_zh: 帶狀皰疹後神經痛是指帶狀皰疹（水痘帶狀皰疹病毒再活化）皮疹癒合後，疼痛仍持續存在（通常定義為皮疹發作後持續超過三個月）的一種慢性神經痛症候群。其病理機轉主要為病毒再活化過程中對周邊神經及背根神經節造成直接損傷，導致周邊及中樞神經敏感化（周邊致敏與中樞致敏），部分神經纖維去傳入後產生異常自發放電及痛覺閾值下降。年齡愈大、急性期皮疹及疼痛程度愈嚴重、免疫功能低下者，發生此併發症的風險愈高。臨床表現為患處持續性灼痛、電擊樣痛或異常性疼痛（輕觸即痛），對生活品質影響甚鉅，治療較為困難。
records.etiology_en: Postherpetic neuralgia in Chinese medicine arises from residual toxin remaining after 'Snake-Coil Rash' (herpes zoster) disease, usually because Liver channel damp-heat has not been fully cleared, or because in the elderly or the constitutionally weak the correct qi has not recovered, so residual toxin binds with stagnant qi and blood to obstruct the channels, producing lingering, unresolved pain. Clinically the most common pattern is qi stagnation with blood stasis, in which, although the skin lesions have resolved, the affected area still has stabbing, knife-like pain that is fixed in location. Another pattern is Spleen deficiency with lingering damp, in which pain is accompanied by epigastric fullness, poor appetite, and heaviness of the limbs. In the elderly or constitutionally weak, combined qi-blood deficiency produces lingering pain together with fatigue and a lusterless complexion, generally because insufficient correct qi cannot expel the pathogen, leaving residual toxin lodged in the collaterals.

records.western_pathology_en: Postherpetic neuralgia refers to a chronic neuropathic pain syndrome in which pain persists after the skin lesions of herpes zoster (reactivation of varicella-zoster virus) have healed, generally defined as pain lasting more than three months after rash onset. Its pathophysiology chiefly involves direct damage to peripheral nerves and dorsal root ganglia during viral reactivation, producing both peripheral and central sensitization; deafferentation of some nerve fibers leads to abnormal spontaneous firing and a lowered pain threshold. Risk of this complication increases with older age, greater severity of the acute rash and pain, and immunosuppression. Clinically it presents as persistent burning pain, electric-shock-like pain, or allodynia (pain from light touch) in the affected area, substantially impairing quality of life and often proving difficult to treat.

records.name_zh: 帕金森氏症（輔助文件情境）
records.etiology_zh: 帕金森氏症在中醫歸屬「顫證」（顫振）範疇，其病位在筋脈，與肝、腎、脾關係最為密切。多因年老體衰，肝腎陰虧，精血不能榮養筋脈，陰虛不能制陽，虛風內動，發為肢體震顫、動作遲緩；或情志失調，肝氣鬱結，久鬱化火，耗傷陰血，肝陽偏亢，化風而動；或飲食不節、勞倦傷脾，脾失健運，痰濕內生，痰鬱化熱，痰熱動風，亦可擾動筋脈；病程日久，氣血運行不暢，兼夾瘀血阻絡，筋脈失於濡養，震顫愈加難已。臨床常見肝腎陰虛、氣血兩虛、痰熱動風、瘀血阻絡等證型，其中「內風」為貫穿全程的核心病機，與外感風邪之「中風」病機有別而理法相通。
records.western_pathology_zh: 帕金森氏症是一種進行性神經退化性疾病，其核心病理特徵為中腦黑質緻密部多巴胺神經元進行性喪失，導致紋狀體多巴胺分泌不足，造成基底核運動迴路失衡。病理上可見殘存神經元內出現路易氏體（Lewy body，由 α-突觸核蛋白異常聚集而成）。典型臨床四大主徵為靜止性震顫、動作遲緩、肌強直與姿勢不穩，常合併非運動症狀，如嗅覺減退、便秘、睡眠障礙及憂鬱等，部分可先於運動症狀多年出現。確切病因尚未完全明瞭，一般認為與年齡老化、遺傳易感性及環境因素交互作用有關。
records.etiology_en: Parkinson's disease is categorized in Chinese medicine under 'tremor disorder' (Chan Zheng), located in the sinews and vessels and most closely related to the Liver, Kidney and Spleen. It commonly arises from age-related decline with Liver-Kidney yin deficiency, in which essence and blood fail to nourish the sinews and vessels; yin deficiency fails to restrain yang, and internal wind stirs, producing limb tremor and slowed movement. Alternatively, emotional disturbance causing Liver qi constraint that transforms into fire over time consumes yin-blood, so Liver yang becomes hyperactive and transforms into wind. Poor diet or overexertion damaging the Spleen impairs its transportive function, generating internal phlegm-damp that stagnates into heat, and phlegm-heat stirring wind can likewise disturb the sinews and vessels. As the disease progresses, impaired qi-blood movement combines with blood stasis obstructing the collaterals, leaving the sinews and vessels unnourished and the tremor increasingly intractable. Commonly seen clinical patterns are Liver-Kidney yin deficiency, qi-blood deficiency, phlegm-heat stirring wind, and blood stasis obstructing the collaterals; 'internal wind' is the core pathomechanism running through the entire course of disease, related to but conceptually distinct from the wind mechanism of externally-contracted Wind Stroke (Zhong Feng).

records.western_pathology_en: Parkinson's disease is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder whose core pathological feature is progressive loss of dopaminergic neurons in the substantia nigra pars compacta of the midbrain, leading to insufficient striatal dopamine and consequent imbalance in the basal ganglia motor circuitry. Pathologically, surviving neurons show Lewy bodies (intracellular inclusions formed by abnormal aggregation of alpha-synuclein). The four cardinal clinical features are resting tremor, bradykinesia, rigidity, and postural instability, often accompanied by non-motor symptoms such as reduced sense of smell, constipation, sleep disturbance, and depression, some of which can precede motor symptoms by years. The exact cause remains incompletely understood but is generally thought to involve an interaction of aging, genetic susceptibility, and environmental factors.

records.name_zh: 多發性硬化症（輔助文件情境）
records.etiology_zh: 西醫方面，本病確切病因未明，最常見的看法認為與病毒感染、基因缺陷或環境因素有關。遺傳因素：多發性硬化症患者一級親屬的發病率為3–5%，異卵雙胞胎為3–5%，同卵雙胞胎則高達25%。飲食因素方面，飽和脂肪與乳製品為重要相關成分。中醫方面，本病歸屬「痿證」範疇，病因包括：（一）外邪侵襲——濕邪入侵最為常見，另有伴高熱的強烈風熱型；（二）飲食失調——過食生濕之品及發物；（三）房勞過度——耗傷腎精；（四）驚恐與劇烈情志刺激——以心、脾兩臟受損最重。
records.western_pathology_zh: 多發性硬化症是一種侵犯中樞神經系統的自身免疫性疾病，1868年由Jean-Martin Charcot首先描述。本病女性多於男性，最常於20至40歲之間確診，但任何年齡皆可發病；美國約有40萬名患者，全球約100萬名。病理上，炎症導致髓鞘消失，使沿神經傳導的電衝動變慢，且神經本身亦受到損害。1996年美國國家多發性硬化症協會將臨床病程標準化為四型：（一）復發–緩解型（RR）——以不可預測的復發繼以數月至數年的緩解期為特徵，發作所致的功能缺損可恢復或留有後遺症；（二）續發進行型——RR型患者半數以上會轉為進行性，發作愈重愈密，終至融合為無緩解的持續發作；（三）原發進行型（10–25%）——神經功能持續穩定下降，無階梯狀病程；（四）進行復發型（5–10%）——伴劇烈發作而無平穩的穩定期，患者很快須以輪椅代步。

records.etiology_en: In Western medicine the exact cause is unknown; the most common view implicates viral infection, a gene defect, or environmental factors. Genetic factors: the incidence in first-degree relatives of MS patients is 3–5%, in dizygotic twins 3–5%, and in monozygotic (identical) twins 25%. Dietary factors: saturated fat and dairy are a major component. In Chinese medicine, MS falls into the category of wei (atrophy) syndrome; its causes include (1) invasion of external pathogens — damp invasion being the most common, plus a strong wind-heat type with high fever; (2) diet — damp-producing foods and excessive consumption of fa wu; (3) excessive sexual activity, which depletes the kidney; and (4) shock and severe emotions, which strike the heart and spleen hardest.
records.western_pathology_en: Multiple sclerosis is an autoimmune disease that affects the central nervous system, first described in 1868 by Jean-Martin Charcot. It affects women more than men and is most commonly diagnosed between ages 20 and 40, though it can occur at any age; about 400,000 people in the U.S. and about one million patients worldwide have MS. Pathologically, inflammation causes the myelin to disappear, so the electrical impulses that travel along the nerves become slower; in addition, the nerves themselves are damaged. In 1996 the United States National Multiple Sclerosis Society standardized four clinical courses: (1) relapsing-remitting (RR) — unpredictable relapses followed by months to years of remission, with deficits that may resolve or leave sequelae; (2) secondary progressive — more than half of RR patients convert to a progressive course, the attacks worsening and clustering until they merge into one attack with no relapse; (3) primary progressive (10–25%) — neurological function declines steadily, without stepwise course; and (4) progressive relapsing (5–10%) — intense attacks with no steady period of stability, with rapid progression to wheelchair dependence.

records.name_zh: 原發性顫抖症（文件情境）
records.etiology_zh: 原發性顫抖症同屬中醫「顫證」範疇，然其震顫多見於動作或維持姿勢時（動作性震顫），與帕金森氏症以靜止性震顫為主者有別。病機多因稟賦不足，肝腎精血素虛，筋脈失於濡養，虛風內動，故常見家族傾向；亦可因情志緊張、勞倦耗氣，氣血兩虛，筋脈失養而顫動加劇；部分患者因肝陽偏旺、心肝火熱上擾，遇情緒激動、飲用咖啡或酒精戒斷時震顫明顯加重，而少量飲酒後反可暫時減輕，此與肝陽偏亢、氣血逆亂之機轉相應。臨床常見肝腎虧虛、氣血兩虛、肝陽上擾三型。
records.western_pathology_zh: 原發性顫抖症是成人最常見的動作障礙疾病之一，其特徵為姿勢性及動作性震顫，多見於雙手，亦可累及頭部、聲音或下肢，通常呈對稱性，於維持特定姿勢或執行精細動作（如寫字、持杯）時明顯，靜止時則減輕或消失，藉此與帕金森氏症之靜止性震顫作區別。約半數病例具家族史，呈體染色體顯性遺傳模式，惟致病基因尚未完全確認。目前認為其病理機轉與小腦—丘腦—皮質運動迴路（尤其是橄欖小腦路徑）功能失調有關，而非黑質多巴胺神經元退化。震顫症狀常因情緒緊張、疲勞或咖啡因攝取而加劇，少量酒精則可暫時緩解，惟長期使用酒精緩解症狀並非建議之治療方式。
records.etiology_en: Essential tremor likewise falls under the 'tremor disorder' category in Chinese medicine, but the tremor typically occurs with action or sustained posture (action tremor), distinguishing it from Parkinson's disease, in which resting tremor predominates. Its pathomechanism commonly involves constitutional insufficiency, with inherently deficient Liver-Kidney essence and blood leaving the sinews and vessels unnourished and internal wind stirring — which is why a family tendency is often observed. It may also arise from emotional tension or overexertion depleting qi, producing combined qi-blood deficiency that leaves the sinews and vessels unnourished and worsens the tremor. In some patients, Liver yang hyperactivity or Heart-Liver fire-heat disturbing upward causes the tremor to worsen markedly with emotional excitement, coffee intake, or alcohol withdrawal, while a small amount of alcohol can temporarily reduce it — corresponding to the mechanism of Liver yang hyperactivity with disordered qi-blood movement. Clinically the three commonly seen patterns are Liver-Kidney deficiency, qi-blood deficiency, and Liver yang disturbing upward.

records.western_pathology_en: Essential tremor is one of the most common movement disorders in adults, characterized by postural and action tremor most often affecting the hands, and sometimes the head, voice, or legs; it is usually symmetric, becomes prominent when maintaining a posture or performing fine motor tasks (such as writing or holding a cup), and diminishes or disappears at rest — distinguishing it from the resting tremor of Parkinson's disease. About half of cases have a family history, following an autosomal dominant pattern, although the causative gene(s) have not been fully identified. Current understanding attributes the underlying pathophysiology to dysfunction of the cerebello-thalamo-cortical motor circuit (particularly the olivocerebellar pathway), rather than degeneration of nigral dopaminergic neurons as in Parkinson's disease. Tremor is often worsened by emotional stress, fatigue, or caffeine intake, and can be temporarily reduced by a small amount of alcohol, although using alcohol to relieve symptoms long-term is not a recommended approach.

records.etiology_zh: 梅尼爾氏症屬中醫「眩暈」範疇，病機以「痰濕中阻」型最為切合其反覆發作、動則加劇、如坐舟車、伴胸悶噁心之特徵——多因飲食不節、脾失健運，水濕內停，聚而成痰，痰濁上蒙清竅，清陽不升而致眩暈欲仆。然臨床亦可見他型：肝陽上亢者，眩暈遇怒遇勞加重，兼頭痛、口苦、耳鳴、失眠；瘀血阻竅者，眩暈久治不癒，兼頭痛固定、面唇色暗；氣血兩虛者，眩暈勞累即發，兼面色蒼白、心悸、乏力；腎精不足者，眩暈伴腰膝痠軟、耳鳴健忘，多見於病程遷延、反覆發作日久者。臨床當依發作誘因、伴隨症狀及舌脈綜合辨證。
records.western_pathology_zh: 梅尼爾氏症是一種原因未明的內耳疾病，其病理特徵為「內淋巴水腫」，即膜性迷路內淋巴液異常蓄積、壓力增高，進而影響耳蝸與前庭系統的正常功能。臨床上以反覆發作性眩暈（每次持續數十分鐘至數小時）、波動性感音神經性聽力下降（早期常侷限於低頻）、耳鳴及耳脹滿感四大症狀為特徵，發作時常伴噁心、嘔吐。確切病因尚未完全闡明，可能與內淋巴囊功能異常、自體免疫反應、病毒感染、血管因素或內耳解剖變異等多重機轉有關。診斷需排除其他可引起類似症狀之疾病（如前庭性偏頭痛、聽神經瘤等）。
records.etiology_en: Ménière's disease is categorized in Chinese medicine under 'dizziness and vertigo' (Xuan Yun). The pattern of 'phlegm-damp obstructing the middle' fits its characteristic presentation particularly well — recurrent episodes, aggravation with movement, a sensation of being on a boat or in a moving vehicle, and accompanying chest oppression and nausea — commonly arising from poor diet impairing Spleen transportive function, so that water-damp accumulates and condenses into phlegm, and turbid phlegm rises to cloud the clear orifices, with clear yang failing to ascend, producing vertigo severe enough to threaten falling. Other patterns are also seen clinically: Liver yang uprising, in which vertigo worsens with anger or exertion and is accompanied by headache, a bitter taste, tinnitus, and insomnia; blood stasis obstructing the orifices, in which the vertigo is long-standing and unresponsive to treatment, with a fixed headache and dark complexion/lips; qi-blood deficiency, in which vertigo is triggered by fatigue and accompanied by a pale complexion, palpitations, and lassitude; and kidney essence insufficiency, in which vertigo is accompanied by lower back and knee soreness, tinnitus, and forgetfulness, more often seen where the disease course has been prolonged with repeated recurrence. Pattern differentiation clinically should integrate the triggering factors, accompanying symptoms, and tongue/pulse findings.
