records.western_pathology_en: Ménière's disease is an inner ear disorder of unknown cause whose pathological hallmark is endolymphatic hydrops — abnormal accumulation of endolymph within the membranous labyrinth with elevated pressure, which in turn disrupts normal cochlear and vestibular function. Clinically it is characterized by four cardinal features: recurrent episodic vertigo (each episode lasting tens of minutes to several hours), fluctuating sensorineural hearing loss (typically low-frequency in early stages), tinnitus, and aural fullness, with episodes often accompanied by nausea and vomiting. The exact cause remains incompletely understood but may involve endolymphatic sac dysfunction, autoimmune reactions, viral infection, vascular factors, or anatomic variation of the inner ear, among other mechanisms. Diagnosis requires excluding other conditions that can produce similar symptoms, such as vestibular migraine or acoustic neuroma.

records.name_zh: 前庭性偏頭痛（文件情境）
records.etiology_zh:
偏頭痛也是困擾中國人千年以上的症狀，因此古代典籍上的類似名稱很多。這種頭痛往往此較頑固，不易速癒，治療上可以與一般性「頭痛」的一起探討。

若手中拿一個銅人，可以清楚看出頭部主要是受到膀胱經影響。而影響側邊頭部的經絡，主要就是「膽經」。然而，一些經絡如三焦經、小腸經、大腸經與胃經也都會影響。

膽經遍佈整個側邊頭部

古書《蘭室秘藏》中提到：「頭半邊痛者，先取手少陽陽明，後取足少陽陽明，此偏頭痛也。」這句話的意思是頭痛與膽經、三焦經、大腸經與胃經息息相關。

在雲端中醫會員從經絡檢測長期觀察之後發現，偏頭痛果然與這4條經絡密切相關，分述如下：

一、少陽經(膽經、三焦經)異常

現代人膽經一年四季都是虛證，機率穩定高達70%以上，女性高於男性。而三焦經一年四季都是實證，機率也是穩定高達60-70%以上。因此可以說現代人的少陽經永遠處於不平衡、不協調的狀態。

現代人少陽經(膽經與三焦經)長年不平衡

如果一個人的膽經長期保持嚴重虛證，三焦經嚴重實證的話，那真的難逃偏頭痛的命運。2021年12月時，某位女性會員就分享，她的偏頭痛病史高達15年以上，幾年前開始進行經絡檢測，發現自己的三焦經能量很高，膽經卻常常很低。

每次偏頭痛發作時，還會嚴重暈眩、怕冷、脖子痛、腰痛或腰部冷冷的、整天疲勞想睡，出現憂鬱感、耳鳴，體內感到極度燥熱很想生氣罵人、手臂酸痛、眼睛有點模糊、腳抽筋。尤其是冬天發作的機率更高。這些都是典型膽經與三焦經異常的症狀。

二、陽明經(胃經、大腸經)異常

同樣的狀況，也發生在陽明經上。現代人胃經一年四季都是虛證，機率穩定高達50-60%，而大腸經一年四季都是實證，在夏天機率高達70%以上。因此可以說現代人的陽明經永遠處於不平衡、不協調的狀態。

現代人陽明經(胃經與大腸經)長年不平衡

2021年11月時，某位男性會員就分享，進入冬天之後他開始出現面部肌肉疼痛，嘴巴張開時會疼痛，漸漸地出現偏頭痛。他發現自己的胃經與大腸經都出現虛證，陽明經能量明顯不足。

當陽明異常時，會出現嗅覺障礙、面部肌肉異常、肩頸酸痛、手肘上下手臂酸痛、眼睛異常、出現脾胃消化道各種症狀(便秘、腹瀉、食慾不佳、持續飢餓...等等)、暈眩、言語錯亂...等等，這些都是典型陽明經症狀。

三、少陽與陽明經絡變化型

以上只是將少陽與陽明經分開討論，事實上在一張經絡圖中，他們都是合併顯現的。膽經與胃經的連動性很高，也就是說膽經虛證時，胃經也會同步虛證，而三焦經與大腸經也一樣，所以就會出現以下這兩種可能性。

少陽經與陽明經常見的經絡型態

以上兩種經絡型態的可能性，在冬天的時候最容易出現，天氣愈冷時愈明顯，這時候出現偏頭痛等一系列症狀的機率就很高了！

四、肝陽上亢狀態

傳統中醫認為「肝陽上亢」時會出現偏頭痛，症狀是頭脹痛、眩暈、眼睛乾澀、耳鳴、心煩易怒、睡眠障礙、肋痛、口乾舌燥、面紅、舌紅少苔，脈弦或細數。這是心情鬱悶，肝氣鬱結在體內久了化火所造成。

肝陽上亢的經絡型態，很容易出現偏頭痛

這種經絡現象，有一些會員確實觀察出來了，就是典型的鐵三角經絡現象，加上少陽與陽明經實證(如上圖)。這是真的會出現偏頭痛，較高機率出現在夏季，同時出現肝陽上亢的一系列症狀，大家都可以自行驗證。

不論哪一種經絡型態，只要長期體內經絡阻塞，造成體內氣滯血瘀的話，都有可能出現偏頭痛，因為人體最容易出現氣血瘀滯的經絡就是膀胱經與膽經，而這兩條經絡都通過頭部。

從上述可知，外在的寒氣最容易造成偏頭痛，所以冬季最容易出現偏頭痛。可以從「艾灸」、「熱吹風機」或「遠紅外線照射」照射頭部與經絡相關部位，或是半身熱浴、拍打膽經與胃經，溫暖肚臍是改善偏頭痛最快且最簡單的方法。

改善偏頭痛最簡單的方法
records.western_pathology_zh: 前庭性偏頭痛是偏頭痛的一種亞型，臨床表現以反覆發作性眩暈或頭暈為主，可伴隨或不伴隨頭痛，是造成反覆眩暈最常見病因之一。其病理機轉被認為與偏頭痛共通的三叉神經血管系統活化及皮質擴散性抑制（cortical spreading depression）有關，這些神經性發炎反應可延伸影響腦幹及丘腦中負責整合前庭訊號的神經核團，造成前庭路徑異常敏感化與感覺訊息處理失調，進而誘發眩暈發作。診斷需符合偏頭痛病史，並出現反覆前庭症狀發作，同時排除其他可導致眩暈之疾病（如梅尼爾氏症、良性陣發性姿勢性眩暈等）。目前對其確切分子機轉仍在研究中，一般認為與遺傳易感性及神經傳導物質（如降鈣素基因相關胜肽 CGRP）調節異常有關。

records.classical_references_zh:
《蘭室秘藏．頭痛門》：「頭半邊痛者，先取手少陽陽明，後取足少陽陽明，此偏頭痛也。」

《名醫類案．首風》：「偏頭痛，五七年，大溲燥結，雙目赤腫，眩暈。…診之急數而有力，風熱之甚也。此頭角痛，是三焦相火之經，乃陽燥金勝也。」

《臨證指南醫案．頭風》：「右偏頭痛，鼻竅流涕，仍不通爽，咽喉疳腐，寤醒肢冷汗出，外邪頭風，已留數日，其邪混處，精華氣血咸為蒙閉，豈是發散清寒可解！頭巔藥餌，務宜清揚，當刺風池、風府，投藥仍以通法。」
records.etiology_en:
Migraine, too, is a symptom that has troubled the Chinese for well over a millennium, so the ancient classics contain many similar names for it. This type of headache tends to be rather stubborn and not quickly cured; therapeutically it can be discussed together with ordinary "headache."

Holding a bronze acupuncture figure in hand, one can clearly see that the head is chiefly influenced by the Bladder meridian, while the meridian influencing the side of the head is principally the Gallbladder meridian. However, several other meridians — the Triple Burner, Small Intestine, Large Intestine, and Stomach meridians — also exert influence.

The Gallbladder meridian spreads across the entire side of the head.

The ancient text Lanshi Micang (Secret Treasury of the Orchid Chamber) states: "For pain in half the head, first take the Hand Shaoyang and Yangming, then take the Foot Shaoyang and Yangming — this is hemilateral headache (migraine)." This means headache is intimately connected with the Gallbladder, Triple Burner, Large Intestine, and Stomach meridians.

Long-term observation through meridian testing by Cloud TCM members has confirmed that migraine is indeed closely related to these 4 meridians, described in turn below:

1. Shaoyang meridian (Gallbladder and Triple Burner) abnormality

In modern people the Gallbladder meridian is Deficient in all four seasons, with a stable probability above 70%, higher in women than in men. The Triple Burner meridian is in Excess in all four seasons, with a stable probability of 60-70% or higher. It can therefore be said that the Shaoyang meridians of modern people are perpetually in an unbalanced, uncoordinated state.

Modern people's Shaoyang meridians (Gallbladder and Triple Burner) are chronically unbalanced.

If a person's Gallbladder meridian remains in severe Deficiency long-term while the Triple Burner meridian is in severe Excess, they truly can hardly escape the fate of migraine. In December 2021, a female member shared that her history of migraine exceeded 15 years; having begun meridian testing several years earlier, she found her Triple Burner meridian energy very high while her Gallbladder meridian was often very low.

Each migraine attack was accompanied by severe vertigo, aversion to cold, neck pain, low back pain or a cold sensation in the lower back, all-day fatigue and sleepiness, feelings of depression, tinnitus, a feeling of extreme internal dry-heat with an urge to snap at people in anger, aching arms, slightly blurred vision, and leg cramps — especially with a higher probability of attacks in winter. These are all classic symptoms of Gallbladder and Triple Burner meridian abnormality.

2. Yangming meridian (Stomach and Large Intestine) abnormality

The same situation occurs with the Yangming meridians. In modern people the Stomach meridian is Deficient in all four seasons with a stable probability of 50-60%, while the Large Intestine meridian is in Excess year-round, with a probability above 70% in summer. It can therefore be said that the Yangming meridians of modern people are perpetually in an unbalanced, uncoordinated state.

Modern people's Yangming meridians (Stomach and Large Intestine) are chronically unbalanced.

In November 2021, a male member shared that after winter began he developed facial muscle pain, pain on opening his mouth, and gradually a migraine. He found that both his Stomach and Large Intestine meridians showed Deficiency, with clearly insufficient Yangming energy.

When Yangming is abnormal, there can be olfactory disturbances, facial muscle abnormalities, shoulder and neck soreness, aching of the elbow and upper and lower arm, eye abnormalities, various Spleen-Stomach digestive-tract symptoms (constipation, diarrhea, poor appetite, persistent hunger, etc.), vertigo, disordered speech, and so on — all classic Yangming meridian symptoms.

3. Shaoyang and Yangming meridian variants

The above discusses the Shaoyang and Yangming meridians separately; in fact, on a single meridian chart they appear together. The Gallbladder and Stomach meridians are highly linked — when the Gallbladder meridian is Deficient, the Stomach meridian is Deficient in tandem — and the same holds for the Triple Burner and Large Intestine meridians, giving rise to the following two possibilities.

Common meridian patterns of the Shaoyang and Yangming meridians.

These two possible meridian patterns appear most readily in winter, becoming more pronounced the colder the weather gets — at which point the probability of migraine and its associated series of symptoms is very high!

4. The Liver-Yang-rising state

Traditional Chinese medicine holds that migraine appears with "Liver Yang rising" (ascendant hyperactivity of Liver Yang), with symptoms of distending headache, vertigo, dry eyes, tinnitus, vexation and irritability, sleep disturbance, rib-side pain, dry mouth and tongue, flushed face, a red tongue with scant coating, and a wiry or thin-rapid pulse. This is caused by emotional depression — Liver Qi constrained within the body for a long time transforming into Fire.

The Liver-Yang-rising meridian pattern readily produces migraine.

Some members have indeed observed this meridian phenomenon: the classic Iron Triangle meridian pattern plus Excess of the Shaoyang and Yangming meridians (as in the figure above). This genuinely does produce migraine, with a higher probability of appearing in summer, together with the series of Liver-Yang-rising symptoms — everyone can verify this for themselves.

Whatever the meridian pattern, long-term meridian obstruction in the body producing internal Qi stagnation and Blood stasis can give rise to migraine, because the meridians in which the human body most readily develops Qi and Blood stasis are the Bladder and Gallbladder meridians — and both of these meridians pass through the head.

From the above it is clear that external Cold most readily causes migraine, which is why migraine occurs most easily in winter. One can apply moxibustion, a hot hair dryer, or far-infrared irradiation to the head and the relevant meridian regions, or take a hot half-body bath, pat along the Gallbladder and Stomach meridians, and warm the navel — warming the abdomen is the fastest and simplest way to improve migraine.

The simplest method for improving migraine.

records.western_pathology_en: Vestibular migraine is a subtype of migraine characterized clinically by recurrent episodic vertigo or dizziness, with or without accompanying headache, and is one of the most common causes of recurrent vertigo. Its pathophysiology is thought to share the trigeminovascular activation and cortical spreading depression seen in migraine generally; this neurogenic inflammatory process is believed to extend to brainstem and thalamic nuclei responsible for integrating vestibular signals, producing abnormal sensitization of vestibular pathways and disordered sensory processing that can trigger vertigo episodes. Diagnosis requires a history of migraine together with recurrent vestibular symptom episodes, with other causes of vertigo (such as Ménière's disease or benign paroxysmal positional vertigo) excluded. The precise molecular mechanisms remain under study but are generally thought to involve genetic susceptibility and dysregulation of neurotransmitters such as calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP).

records.etiology_zh:
痤瘡絕對是困擾中國人千年以上的症狀，遠在《黃帝內經》中，就會對痤瘡的形成有詳細的論述。《黃帝內經.素問》中提到：「汗出見濕，乃生痤疿」、「勞汗當風，寒薄為皶，鬱乃痤」。

到了隋代，《諸病源候論》稱為「面疱」。清代《醫宗金鑒》則直稱為「肺風粉刺」，《外科大成》又稱為「酒刺」，現在俗稱為「粉刺」。

後代中醫對青春痘的看法，主要可以歸納為以下5種主要可能性：

一、肺熱容易產生皮膚疾病

在中醫理論認為「肺主皮毛」，肺經出了問題之後，自然會出現許多皮膚疾病，痤瘡就是最典型的案例。主要症狀就是面部瘙癢，冒起粉刺且伴有紅腫疼痛感，也會出現口乾舌燥，舌質紅、舌苔黃，同時小便容易尿少，顏色深黃，大便容易乾燥。

肺經異常會出現痤瘡，還有一個原因是因為大腸經，因為肺經與大腸經互為表裡關係，這兩條經絡連動性很高。

所以肺經有病時，大腸經會有病，在雲端中醫公開的現代人的經絡數據裡，肺經與大腸經連動性高，每年5-6月之後同步轉成實證，如果實證過度嚴重就容易出現肺熱相關的皮膚疾病。

肺經與大腸經連動性高，從5-6月之後就轉為實證直到年底

二、胃熱(陽明熱)嚴重時將會出現面皰

由於胃經屬於陽明經，另一個陽明經是大腸經，這兩個經最後都是通往面部，因此與青春痘密切相關。從上面的肺經分析，也可以看到大腸經的影子，可見大腸經與面皰一定脫不了關係！

面皰經常出現在胃經與大腸經路線上

胃經有火氣，通常是因為吃出來的，例如大量吃炸的食物，或是晚上吃宵夜，長期累積在肚子裡造成脾胃積熱。因為胃熱所造成的青春痘，會出現毛囊性丘疹，能擠出白粉色油狀物質，有時會出現黑頭粉刺。

從上圖可以看出胃經、大腸經異常時，這種痘子經常長在嘴巴、鼻子周圍，因為這是受到陽明經的影響，有時候會出現在背部與前胸，這都是與位於經絡的路線上。透過瀉大腸的火氣可以改善陽明經的火熱，因此有一派養生人士非常重視「排宿便養生法」。

由於是胃熱造成，所以很容易肚子餓、口臭、口乾舌燥，很想喝冰水、大便堅硬乾燥難以排出、舌質紅，舌苔厚膩…等症狀。

這個現象可以透過經絡檢測來印證，在夏天的時候，經常可以看到下面這張圖，這就是典型體內火熱的圖，當這種經絡圖出現的時候，經常會在臉上冒出幾顆痘子。

春夏期間經常出現面皰的經絡現象

三、晚上熬夜產生肝火，隔天自動冒出痘痘

因為肝火旺造成的青春痘，其實最多人有過這種經驗，現代人多數肝經保持在實證狀態，因此只要多熬夜幾天，肝經實證就更嚴重，擦槍走火之後就會產生肝火，進而出現各式各樣的疾病，痤瘡就是典型案例。

為什麼肝火會造成青春痘，其實有一句話大家都聽過，所謂「肝膽相照」，肝經與膽經具有表裡關係，如果一個人經常晚上超過11點不睡覺，那就是在膽經與肝經的運行時間沒有休息，自然產生肝膽之火。

膽經行走路線包含頭部與面部，尤其是整個頭部，因此有些人的痘痘不只會長在臉上，還會在頭皮長痘痘。

某會員J先生長期熬夜，他發現自己沒有辦法留長頭髮，因為頭部長了很多痘子，只要頭髮太長就會很癢很難受。他覺得很奇怪，為什麼痘子不是長在臉上，而是長在頭皮？

膽經火氣讓頭皮也會長痘痘

透過經絡檢測超過50次之後確認，他的肝經90%以上是實證，膽經85%以上都是虛證，長期肝經、膽經不平衡，每次如果再加上熬夜之後，就很容易出現各種肝火症狀(詳細閱讀肝火症狀)，長痘子還只是其中之一個小症狀罷了。

由於中醫將常將肝臟與腎臟一起討論，因為肝火旺很久之後，也會出現「腎陰虛」，因此有一派中醫師認為腎陰虛也是造成青春痘的一種原因。必須透過滋水補腎來滅火！[@ad:1]

四、血熱、毒熱及血瘀，讓你全身冒痘痘

有一派中醫專門從血熱下手，這派認為青春痘是因為長久體內氣血運行不佳，或因為不良情緒鬱結體內太久了，造成體內氣滯血瘀。

血瘀久了、鬱積久了就會化熟，這種熱久了之後會化成毒，所以讓青春痘長出膿皰，周圍常有紅暈且腫痛、面色潮紅，有時候會發熱，青春痘變得非常難以治癒。

中醫認為如果是這種類型的青春痘，就必須透過涼血、解毒、活血化瘀才有可能從根本去拔除痘痘。事實上這種因為血瘀所造成的各種「怪異痘痘」算是很常見，但是現代醫學很難以理解。

雲端中醫某會員S小姐的一位女性朋友約40歲，背後不明原因發癢長達5-6年，期間到各大醫院檢查也找不出什麼原因，透過經絡檢測呈現膀胱經呈現嚴重虛證。

全身氣血瘀阻，痘痘會反應在膀胱經上

結果這位S小姐當時想：「那我就來幫她刮痧拔罐好了！」結果處理完之後，背後竟然明顯冒出大約30-50個黑色痘子，這其實也可以說是嚴重的瘀痧。

當場彼此都瞠目結舌，從來沒看過這種現象！結果幾天後這位女性朋友說：「我的背後發癢竟然改善了80%」，讓S小姐感到喜出望外！

S小姐在接下來的一個月內，又陸續幫她刮痧拔罐3次，最後一次的時候背後完全沒有黑色痘子的痕跡，背後發癢的現象完全消失，她的朋友當時準備了一個大紅包給她，彼此都非常高興。

這位女性朋友說：「感謝你幫我解除這個困擾多年且渾身不對勁的症狀，現在我真的感到非常舒服！」

在中醫看來，只要人體氣血不通，瘀血毒素就無所不在，呈現在臉上就是面皰，更有可能出現在全身各種部位，這其實就是「刮痧拍打治百病」的根本原理，古今運用這招闖天下的名醫神醫還真的不在少數！

五、不要以為陽虛寒性體質，就不會長痘痘

看了上面的分析，不是熱、就是火，就是血毒，可見中醫認為臉上長痘子，幾乎都是體內太熱所造成，完全符合青春痘看起來就是「紅腫熱痛」的樣貌。然而，如果治療青春痘這麼簡單，怎麼會有人為此困擾了一輩子呢？

這裡舉個一個真實案例，某會員M先生的一位朋友家境富裕，長期受青春痘困擾，從國中就開始長青春痘，一直治到現在都已經入社會了，臉上痘子還是冒不停，整個臉就像月球表面，已經持續戰痘了幾十年！

在戰痘期間，他至少試過5-6位中醫，6-7種西醫門診，各種奇門怪派都試過，最後還是治不好。

M先生從2019年中加入會員之後，對經絡檢測就非常積極。過去他總是認為青春痘就是體內火熱所造成，但是他幫這位朋友檢測至少10次以上，完全看不出明顯火熱訊息。

許多長期面皰不癒者，其實是屬於陽虛寒性體質

他的經絡圖，永遠穩定呈現三焦經、大腸經虛證，他說：「若依照雲端中醫的討論喝冰水的文章來看，這是肚子寒氣太重所造成的」這個讓他非常困惑？

他問朋友說：「要不要作個實驗，如果你是體內太熱造成青春痘，那服用附子理中湯之後一定嚴重，因為這是很熱的中藥！而你似乎很適合這個中藥？」

朋友說：「醫療界可以用的方法，我哪一個沒試過？多一次失敗對我也沒有任何差別！」結果服用附子理中湯5天之後，痘子不但沒有更嚴重，反而開始減緩冒出來。

朋友說：「奇怪，我反而覺得精神變好了？沒有出現什麼火氣現象」

M先生說，運用「附子理中湯」這種極熱的中藥來改善青春痘，經常在一些中醫書籍上看到，要不是經絡數據顯示這麼明確，我還真不敢這樣建議呢！

如果這個方向是正確的話，代表過去十幾年M先生的治療方向應該都是錯誤的。而後M先生又研究了很多中醫書籍，確認可以從改善寒性體質來消除青春痘，像這樣的人為數還真不少！

既然痘子有以上幾種體質，那要該如何加以改變呢？其實方法很簡單，歸納出以下簡單幾個重點：

少吃增加體內火熱的食物：少吃太甜、太油、太辣或熱性的食物，例如：咖啡(咖啡其實蠻熱的)、巧克力、可可、炸雞、炸薯條、奶油、燻烤類、油炸類等，以防止增加體內火熱，造成更嚴重的青春痘。

多吃富纖維素食物：大腸經與面部疾病息息相關，保持排便正常可以預防長痘子，例如多吃胡蘿蔔、各種綠色青菜、金針菇、筍子等，可以幫助腸道乳動。平時也可喝優酪乳，以幫助排便順暢。

食用清涼解毒中藥茶或食物：如果確認不是因為腹中寒氣太盛所造成的青春痘，可食用具有退肝火功效的藥茶及食物，藥茶例如：決明子茶、菊花茶、金銀花茶。食物如：檸檬、綠豆、冬瓜、小黃瓜、冬瓜、西瓜、胡蘿蔔、蕃茄、空心菜、菠菜、竹筍…等。

不要喝酒：喝酒可以增加體內濕氣與熱氣，對於改善青春痘不會有任何幫助。

老話一句，就是要早睡：盡可能在晚上11點以前入睡，晚上11點至凌晨3點，是肝膽經的運行時間，此時睡覺可調節肝膽運作功能。

早上起床飲用一杯溫水：早起喝一杯溫水早上喝溫水是「養正氣」的秘訣，還可以清宿便、消除口臭，調節全身免疫系統。

適當服用中藥：只要確認是火熱造成的面皰，服用中藥效果非常快，這種清熱涼血、除濕解毒的中藥，可以在痘子冒出來的第一時間就要消滅它，例如：「枇杷清肺飲」、「調胃承氣湯」、「清上防風湯」、「黃連解毒湯」、「普濟消毒飲」、「加味逍遙散」、「黃芩清肺湯」、「六味地黃丸」…等等，中藥的解決方案非常豐富，請自行研究或詢問中醫師。

「痤瘡」是一個常見的皮膚疾病，又稱為青春痘、面皰、粉刺、暗瘡或毛囊炎，是所有愛美的人最討厭的皮膚疾病。

現代醫學認為，痤瘡是毛囊發炎的疾病，一般最常見的痘痘，稱為「尋常性痤瘡」，「粉刺」是「非發炎性痤瘡」。

痤瘡一般都以粉刺、丘疹、膿皰、紅色硬凸狀結節、囊腫的形式出現，之後留下疤痕。痤瘡給人的傷害更多是在心理上，如讓人喪失自信，沮喪甚至有自殺的傾向。

現代醫學發現，痤瘡最常見於青少年和年輕人(12-25歲)，有高達85%的年輕人有不同程度痤瘡的困擾，大部分的人在年紀增長後會逐漸改善。有的人在40或50歲左右時還會生粉刺。

現代醫學對痤瘡的理解，主要是過量的皮脂分泌形成粉刺，毛囊開口的異常角化，造成毛囊阻塞，痤瘡桿菌的過度滋生，或是毛囊與附近皮膚組織的發炎反應。

其他造成痤瘡的原因，主要是荷爾蒙失常，「壓力」及「睡眠不足」容易造成荷爾蒙平衡被打亂，進而影響毛孔角質、皮脂分泌，就容易長痘痘。女性月經期間或是動情期也會出現荷爾蒙變化，所以也會長痘痘。

還有飲食不當(高熱量、高糖份食物、含有激素的乳製品)也會讓皮膚變差，容易長痘痘。使用不當保養品或化妝品，或錯誤的護膚方式，更容易長痘痘。

悶熱流汗、環境髒污、藥物副作用也會造成痤瘡。便祕會造成腸內環境改變，讓有害物質在體內累積，長期便秘也會長痘痘。

臉部和下巴是粉刺出現的集中地，胸部、背部、肩膀乃至上臂有時也逃不過粉刺的魔掌，但這些地方通常是毛囊角化症而不是通常意義上的粉刺痤瘡。

有些人的長期痤瘡是運用另類療法治癒的，中醫是另類療法的大宗，因此如果長期不癒的痤瘡也可以考慮運用中醫療法。

records.western_pathology_en:
Acne is a common skin disease, also known as pimples, facial blemishes, comedones, blackheads, or folliculitis — the skin disease most detested by anyone who cares about their appearance.

Modern medicine regards acne as a disease of follicular inflammation. The most common type of pimple is called 'acne vulgaris,' while comedones are 'non-inflammatory acne.'

Acne generally appears in the form of comedones, papules, pustules, hard raised red nodules, and cysts, subsequently leaving scars. The harm acne inflicts is largely psychological — loss of self-confidence, dejection, and even suicidal tendencies.

Modern medicine has found that acne is most common in adolescents and young adults (ages 12-25); up to 85% of young people are troubled by acne to varying degrees, and in most people it gradually improves with age. Some people still develop comedones around age 40 or 50.

Modern medicine's understanding of acne centers on excessive sebum secretion forming comedones; abnormal keratinization at the follicular opening causing follicular obstruction; overgrowth of Cutibacterium acnes (the acne bacillus); and inflammatory reactions of the follicle and neighboring skin tissue.

Other causes of acne are chiefly hormonal disturbance: 'stress' and 'insufficient sleep' readily disrupt hormonal balance, which in turn affects pore keratinization and sebum secretion, making breakouts likely. Women also undergo hormonal changes during menstruation or the fertile phase of the cycle, and thus break out at those times as well.

Improper diet (high-calorie and high-sugar foods, dairy products containing hormones) likewise worsens the skin and promotes pimples. Using unsuitable skincare products or cosmetics, or incorrect skincare methods, makes breakouts even more likely.

Sweating in hot, stuffy conditions, dirty environments, and drug side effects can also cause acne. Constipation alters the intestinal environment, allowing harmful substances to accumulate in the body; long-term constipation also leads to pimples.

The face and chin are where comedones concentrate; the chest, back, shoulders, and even the upper arms sometimes cannot escape them either, although lesions in these areas are usually keratosis pilaris rather than comedonal acne in the usual sense.

Some people's long-standing acne has been cured through alternative therapies, of which Chinese medicine is a major branch; therefore, for acne that has long failed to heal, Chinese medical treatment may also be considered.

records.etiology_en:
Acne has unquestionably troubled the Chinese for over a thousand years. As far back as the Huangdi Neijing (Yellow Emperor's Inner Classic), the formation of acne was discussed in detail. The Suwen (Plain Questions) of the Neijing states: 'When sweating meets dampness, acne and miliaria arise,' and 'When sweat from exertion meets wind, and cold thins it, facial blemishes form; when it stagnates, acne results.'

By the Sui dynasty, the Zhubing Yuanhou Lun (Treatise on the Origins and Manifestations of Diseases) called it 'facial pao (face blisters).' The Qing-dynasty Yizong Jinjian (Golden Mirror of Medicine) called it outright 'Lung-Wind acne (fei feng fen ci),' and the Waike Dacheng (Great Compendium of External Medicine) also called it 'wine pimples (jiu ci)'; today it is commonly called 'fen ci' (comedones).

Later generations of Chinese medicine's views on acne can be summarized into the following five main possibilities:

1. Lung Heat readily produces skin diseases

Chinese medical theory holds that 'the Lung governs the skin and body hair.' Once the Lung channel is disordered, many skin diseases naturally appear, and acne is the most typical example. The main symptoms are facial itching, eruption of comedones accompanied by redness, swelling, and pain, along with dry mouth and parched tongue, a red tongue body with a yellow coating, scanty deep-yellow urine, and a tendency to dry stools.

Another reason acne appears when the Lung channel is abnormal lies with the Large Intestine channel: the Lung and Large Intestine channels form an exterior-interior pair, and these two channels are highly linked.

So when the Lung channel is diseased, the Large Intestine channel becomes diseased as well. In the modern-population meridian data published by Cloud TCM, the Lung and Large Intestine channels show high linkage, turning to Excess in synchrony after May-June each year; when the Excess becomes too severe, Lung-Heat-related skin diseases readily appear.

The Lung and Large Intestine channels are highly linked, turning to Excess from May-June until the end of the year

2. Severe Stomach Heat (Yangming Heat) produces facial acne

The Stomach channel belongs to the Yangming; the other Yangming channel is the Large Intestine channel, and both ultimately run to the face — hence their close relationship with acne. The Lung-channel analysis above also shows the shadow of the Large Intestine channel; clearly the Large Intestine channel is inseparable from facial acne!

Facial acne often appears along the pathways of the Stomach and Large Intestine channels

Fire in the Stomach channel usually comes from what one eats — for example, large amounts of fried food, or late-night snacks — accumulating in the belly over time to create accumulated Heat in the Spleen and Stomach. Acne caused by Stomach Heat presents as follicular papules from which a whitish-pink oily substance can be squeezed, sometimes with blackheads.

From the figure above one can see that when the Stomach and Large Intestine channels are abnormal, these pimples often grow around the mouth and nose, because these areas are influenced by the Yangming channels; they sometimes appear on the back and chest as well, all of which lie on the channel pathways. Draining Fire from the Large Intestine can improve the Fire-Heat of the Yangming channels, which is why one school of health cultivators places great emphasis on 'clearing retained stool as a health method.'

Because it arises from Stomach Heat, symptoms readily include frequent hunger, bad breath, dry mouth and parched tongue, a strong craving for ice water, hard dry stools that are difficult to pass, a red tongue body, a thick greasy coating, and so on.

This phenomenon can be verified through meridian testing. In summer one frequently sees the chart below — the typical picture of internal Fire-Heat; when this kind of meridian chart appears, a few pimples often erupt on the face.

The meridian phenomenon in which facial acne frequently appears during spring and summer

3. Staying up late at night generates Liver Fire, and pimples pop out automatically the next day

Acne from exuberant Liver Fire is in fact the type most people have experienced. Most modern people keep the Liver channel in an Excess state, so a few extra late nights make the Liver-channel Excess more severe; once it flares out of control, Liver Fire is produced, giving rise to all manner of diseases, of which acne is a typical example.

Why does Liver Fire cause acne? There is a saying everyone has heard — 'the Liver and Gallbladder reflect one another (gan dan xiang zhao).' The Liver and Gallbladder channels stand in an exterior-interior relationship. If a person regularly stays up past 11 p.m., they are failing to rest during the circulation hours of the Gallbladder and Liver channels, and Liver-Gallbladder Fire naturally arises.

The Gallbladder channel's pathway includes the head and face — especially the entire head — so some people's pimples grow not only on the face but also on the scalp.

A certain member, Mr. J, stayed up late over a long period and found he could not grow his hair long, because many pimples grew on his head; whenever his hair got too long it became unbearably itchy. He found it strange — why did the pimples grow not on his face but on his scalp?

Gallbladder-channel Fire makes pimples grow even on the scalp

After more than 50 meridian tests it was confirmed that his Liver channel showed Excess over 90% of the time and his Gallbladder channel showed Deficiency over 85% of the time. With long-term Liver-Gallbladder channel imbalance, each additional late night readily produced various Liver Fire symptoms (see the detailed reading on Liver Fire symptoms) — growing pimples being merely one small symptom among them.

Because Chinese medicine often discusses the Liver together with the Kidney — long-standing exuberant Liver Fire eventually also produces 'Kidney Yin Deficiency' — one school of Chinese medicine practitioners holds that Kidney Yin Deficiency is likewise a cause of acne, and the Fire must be extinguished by enriching Water and tonifying the Kidney! [@ad:1]

4. Blood Heat, toxic Heat, and Blood stasis make pimples erupt all over the body

One school of Chinese medicine approaches acne specifically through Blood Heat. This school holds that acne arises because the body's Qi and Blood have long circulated poorly, or because negative emotions have been constrained within the body too long, producing Qi stagnation and Blood stasis.

When Blood stasis and constraint persist, they transform into Heat, and prolonged Heat transforms into toxin, so the acne develops pustules, often with red halos, swelling, and pain around them, a flushed complexion, and at times fever — and the acne becomes extremely difficult to cure.

Chinese medicine holds that for this type of acne, only cooling the Blood, resolving toxin, and invigorating the Blood to transform stasis can uproot the pimples at their source. In fact, the various 'strange pimples' caused by Blood stasis are quite common, though modern medicine finds them hard to comprehend.

A female friend, about 40 years old, of Cloud TCM member Ms. S had unexplained itching on her back lasting 5-6 years; examinations at all the major hospitals found no cause. Meridian testing showed severe Deficiency of the Bladder channel.

When Qi and Blood are obstructed throughout the body, pimples manifest along the Bladder channel

Ms. S thought at the time: 'Then let me do gua sha scraping and cupping for her!' After the treatment, roughly 30-50 dark pimples visibly erupted on her back — which could indeed be called severe stagnant sha.

Both were dumbfounded on the spot, never having seen such a phenomenon! A few days later the friend said: 'The itching on my back has actually improved by 80%,' to Ms. S's delighted surprise!

Over the following month, Ms. S performed gua sha and cupping for her another 3 times; by the final session there was no trace of dark pimples on her back and the itching had completely disappeared. Her friend prepared a large red envelope for her, and both were overjoyed.

The friend said: 'Thank you for relieving me of this symptom that troubled me for years and made my whole body feel wrong — now I truly feel wonderful!'

In the Chinese medical view, wherever the body's Qi and Blood fail to flow freely, stasis and toxins are everywhere; manifesting on the face they become acne, and they may just as well appear on any part of the body. This is in fact the fundamental principle behind 'gua sha and slapping therapy curing a hundred diseases,' and the famous physicians, ancient and modern, who have made their way in the world with this technique are truly not few!

5. Do not assume that a Yang-Deficient, Cold-natured constitution cannot grow pimples

Looking at the analyses above — if not Heat then Fire, or else Blood toxin — it seems Chinese medicine holds that facial pimples are almost always caused by excessive internal Heat, fully matching acne's appearance of 'redness, swelling, heat, and pain.' Yet if treating acne were that simple, how could anyone be troubled by it for a lifetime?

Here is a real case. A friend of member Mr. M came from a wealthy family and was troubled by acne long-term, starting in junior high school; treated continuously right up to his entry into the workforce, his face still broke out endlessly, the whole face like the surface of the moon — a battle against acne lasting decades!

During that battle he tried at least 5-6 Chinese medicine practitioners and 6-7 Western medical clinics, along with every strange and unorthodox school, and in the end still was not cured.

After joining as a member in mid-2019, Mr. M became very active with meridian testing. He had always assumed acne was caused by internal Fire-Heat, but after testing this friend at least 10 times, he could see no obvious signs of Fire-Heat at all.

Many people with long-unhealed facial acne actually have a Yang-Deficient, Cold-natured constitution

His friend's meridian charts forever and stably showed Deficiency of the Triple Burner (Sanjiao) and Large Intestine channels. He said: 'Judging by Cloud TCM's discussion in the article on drinking ice water, this is caused by excessive Cold in the abdomen' — which puzzled him greatly.

He asked his friend: 'Shall we run an experiment? If your acne comes from excessive internal Heat, then taking Fuzi Lizhong Tang (Aconite Center-Rectifying Decoction) would certainly make it worse, since it is a very hot herbal formula — and yet you seem well suited to this formula?'

The friend said: 'Which method available to the medical world have I not tried? One more failure makes no difference to me!' After taking Fuzi Lizhong Tang for 5 days, the pimples not only did not worsen but began to erupt more slowly.

The friend said: 'Strange — I actually feel my spirits have improved, and no Fire signs have appeared.'

Mr. M said that using an extremely hot formula like Fuzi Lizhong Tang to improve acne is often seen in Chinese medical books; had the meridian data not been so unambiguous, he truly would not have dared make such a suggestion!

If this direction is correct, it means the treatment direction of the previous decade or more had all been wrong. Mr. M then studied many more Chinese medical books and confirmed that acne can be eliminated by improving a Cold constitution — and people like this are truly not few!

Since pimples arise from the several constitutional types above, how should they be changed? The method is actually simple, summarized in the following key points:

Eat fewer foods that increase internal Fire-Heat: eat less of what is overly sweet, oily, spicy, or hot in nature — for example coffee (coffee is actually quite heating), chocolate, cocoa, fried chicken, french fries, butter and cream, smoked and grilled foods, and deep-fried foods — to avoid adding internal Fire-Heat and causing more severe acne.

Drinking yogurt drinks regularly also helps keep bowel movements smooth.

Consume cooling, toxin-resolving herbal teas or foods: once it is confirmed the acne is not caused by excessive Cold in the abdomen, one may take herbal teas and foods that drain Liver Fire — teas such as cassia seed (juemingzi) tea, chrysanthemum tea, and honeysuckle (jinyinhua) tea; foods such as lemon, mung bean, winter melon, cucumber, watermelon, carrot, tomato, water spinach, spinach, bamboo shoots, and so on.

Do not drink alcohol: alcohol increases internal Dampness and Heat and will be of no help whatsoever in improving acne.

The same old advice — go to bed early: fall asleep before 11 p.m. whenever possible; 11 p.m. to 3 a.m. is the circulation time of the Liver and Gallbladder channels, and sleeping then regulates Liver-Gallbladder function.

Drink a cup of warm water upon rising in the morning: drinking warm water in the morning is a secret of 'nourishing upright Qi'; it can also clear retained stool, eliminate bad breath, and regulate the whole body's immune system.

Take Chinese herbal medicine appropriately: once it is confirmed that the facial acne is caused by Fire-Heat, herbal medicine works very quickly. These Heat-clearing, Blood-cooling, Dampness-eliminating, toxin-resolving herbs can wipe out a pimple the moment it emerges — for example Pipa Qingfei Yin (Loquat Lung-Clearing Drink), Tiaowei Chengqi Tang (Stomach-Regulating Qi-Guiding Decoction), Qingshang Fangfeng Tang (Upper-Body-Clearing Saposhnikovia Decoction), Huanglian Jiedu Tang (Coptis Toxin-Resolving Decoction), Puji Xiaodu Yin (Universal Relief Toxin-Dispersing Drink), Jiawei Xiaoyao San (Augmented Free Wanderer Powder), Huangqin Qingfei Tang (Scutellaria Lung-Clearing Decoction), Liuwei Dihuang Wan (Six-Ingredient Rehmannia Pill), and so on. The herbal solutions are very rich — please research them yourself or consult a Chinese medicine practitioner.

records.etiology_zh:
古代中醫沒有「牛皮癬」這個名詞，但是不代表古代沒有這個疾病，在古代稱之為「白疕」，是指皮膚上起白色厚屑，伴有搔癢的一種頑固性皮膚病。

古代的醫書如《諸病源候論》、《醫宗金鑒》等都有探討過，例如《外科證治全書》記載「皮膚燥癢起如疹疥而色白，搔之屑起，漸至肢體枯燥，折裂、血出痛楚。」

傳統中醫認為，這種病主要是由於「血虛」導致身體出現「風」和「燥」現象，肌膚因此得不到足夠的滋養而出現疾病。

病情在起初是受到外在寒氣、或濕熱之邪氣侵襲肌膚，導致經絡氣血流動不暢，阻塞在皮膚表面而造成病變。

中醫認為牛皮癬在最初是寒氣、濕熱入侵體內所造成

如果病情拖長，原有的寒氣、火熱、濕熱等因素會轉化，寒邪轉為熱，濕邪轉為燥，進而導致病症加劇。

最終再加上氣血受損，會使得血液變得更加不足且皮膚更加乾燥，肌膚的狀態進一步惡化，所以牛皮癬很難治療。

傳統中醫辨證，提出「血熱」、「血燥」、「血瘀」、「濕熱」、「外感風寒」...等等證候的可能性。

也因為其複雜性，所以每個人的狀況都不一樣，所以也沒有一種固定的中藥方劑，可以直接治療牛皮癬。

以上中醫的描述，很多人還是沒辦法理解，因為中醫描述的內容實在都太抽象了。

要理解牛皮癬這種疾病到底是什麼原因造成的？最簡單的方法就是直接在牛皮癬病患的身上，幫他們進行經絡檢測，直接觀察是什麼樣的經絡現象就可以破解背後原因。

某位雲端中醫會員在數年前就已經分享過皮膚病的觀察心得，她曾經在中國大陸研讀中醫，特別喜歡研究皮膚病。

她記得幾年前有一段期間，他經常會去找病患檢測經絡，他發現這些牛皮癬患者有高機率出現有兩條經絡虛證：脾經與膀胱經，讓她感到非常好奇！

牛皮癬(銀屑病)與鐵三角經絡型態密切相關

而後從一些會員的長期觀察回報之後發現，有較高的機率，牛皮癬患者都是出現所謂的「鐵三角」經絡型態，很值得現代醫學進行研究。

這裡舉個經典案例，某會員在2023年10月期間，分享他的朋友的牛皮癬案例，他的朋友在第一、第三腳趾、腳踝、下肢外側(膽經的路線)，還有手肘都有牛皮癬，這樣已經持續很多年了，讓他感到很困擾。

男性出現牛皮癬的經絡型態

這位會員很吃驚地發現，朋友身上牛皮癬的位置，確實都在這些異常經絡之上。尤其是膽經嚴重實證，他的大腿膽經路線上的牛皮癬特別嚴重。

其他如肝經、脾經的位置，在大腳趾上確實也都出現了牛皮癬。手肘部位也有出現明顯的牛皮癬，可以說是與肝經對應(大腸經)。

而事實上這種經絡型態，經常都會出現三焦經、大腸經實證，雖然這張經絡圖上沒有出現異常，也可以假設隨時都可能出現。

他這張經絡圖雖然是胃經正常，但是他的胃經「解溪穴」的位置，乾癬特別嚴重。不過後來這位會員又幫他檢測了幾次，胃經確實較常會出現實證。

由於這種經絡型態，多數人出現在春夏季節，有些人到了秋冬季節也不會消失，剛好符合現代醫學的觀察：春季發病，冬季加重，夏季緩解。

至於為什麼會冬季加重？可能有以下的原因：

冬天出汗減少：冬季的寒冷和乾燥天氣會導致乾癬患者出汗減少，這使得毛孔更易堵塞，一些有害物質無法及時有效地被清除。

冬季皮膚乾燥：冬季開窗通風的時間減少，使得室內空氣無法保持流通且過於乾燥。

免疫力下降：冬季也是上呼吸道感染的高發期，這類感染亦可能觸發乾癬的病情加劇。

有一些會員在冬季的時候，確實就爆發乾癬，但是卻沒有出現鐵三角經絡型態，而是出現「手三陽經虛證」，這就是腹部寒濕陽虛的典型現象(見下圖)

女性在冬季牛皮癬發病，呈現手三陽經虛證

從她的經絡現象，也可以看到膽經嚴重實證，似乎膽經與乾癬之間有一定程度的關聯。

總體而言，乾癬還是以鐵三角經絡型態較多，不少會員也觀察其他的免疫系統疾病，同樣都是出現鐵三角經絡型態。

尤其是罹患這種疾病的人，因為皮膚異常感到自卑，通常心情都不會很好，而心情鬱悶這也會加重鐵三角經絡型態的穩固。

可見鐵三角經絡體質的人，如果沒有注意養生，很容易引發免疫系統相關的疾病(例如：糖尿病、發炎性腸病、硬皮病、類風濕性關節炎、紅斑性狼瘡…等)。

有更多的關節炎患者，他們也是出現鐵三角經絡型態，這就足以解釋為什麼牛皮癬患者很容易出現關節炎。

古代中書籍也經常提到這樣的論點，例如《幼幼集成》提到「癮疹多屬於脾，以其隱隱在皮膚之間，發而多癢」，古代人經常是從脾臟去治療小兒的皮膚病。

夏季預防及改善皮膚病，到冬季就不會發病

所以嚴格說起來，牛皮癬算是一種「夏病」，發病在「冬季」，所以如果夏天好好養生預防疾病的話，冬天就不會發病。

依照不少會員的觀察，夏季確實很容易出現各種皮膚病，黃帝內經上說：「風者，百病之長也。」這是真實不虛的。

如果是初期的皮膚病，可以運用「麻黃桂枝各半湯」可以在皮膚病出來的剛開始就把它斬斷，就不會延伸出未來的各種疾病。

如果是長期慢性體質所造成的牛皮癬，一些會員回報運用「養肝丸」或「加味逍遙散」＋「銀翹散」，改善效果還蠻不錯的。

牛皮癬屬於是免疫的疾病，而每個人的免疫系統被破壞的原因是不一樣的。不論是哪一種原因，只要改善自己的體質，免疫力就會回到正常的狀態，相關的疾病自然都會改善。
records.western_pathology_zh:
乾癬(Psoriasis)是一種免疫系統失衡的慢性皮膚病，又稱為「牛皮癬」或「銀屑病」。

主要特色是在身上出現一塊一塊異常的皮膚，這些塊狀皮膚通常會發紅斑、發癢、以及脫屑，這並不是一種傳染性疾病。

由於免疫系統失衡，乾癬患者容易同時罹患關節炎、淋巴癌、心血管疾病、克隆氏症以及憂鬱症的機會都較高。

現代醫學發現，牛皮癬有明顯的季節性，患常於春季發病，冬季加重，夏季緩解，所以高緯度寒冷地區出現的機率高於低緯度地區。

直至今日乾癬尚無法完全治癒，只能運用藥物控制症狀，例如類固醇軟膏、膽鈣化醇軟膏...等等，有些治療藥物價非常昂貴。

所以，如果有替代的方案， 相信受到這種疾病困擾的人一定會努力去追尋，也可以考慮中醫相關的治療理論。

records.western_pathology_en:
Psoriasis is a chronic skin disease of immune-system imbalance, also known in Chinese as 'niupixuan (cattle-hide lichen)' or 'silver-scale disease.'

Its main feature is the appearance of patches of abnormal skin on the body; these patches usually show erythema, itching, and scaling. It is not a contagious disease.

Because of the immune-system imbalance, psoriasis patients have a higher likelihood of concurrently developing arthritis, lymphoma, cardiovascular disease, Crohn's disease, and depression.

Modern medicine has found that psoriasis is markedly seasonal: patients often experience onset in spring, aggravation in winter, and remission in summer, so the probability of occurrence in cold high-latitude regions is higher than in low-latitude regions.

To this day psoriasis cannot be completely cured; medications can only control the symptoms — for example corticosteroid ointments, cholecalciferol (vitamin D analogue) ointments, and so on — and some treatment drugs are extremely expensive.

Therefore, if an alternative option exists, those troubled by this disease will surely strive to pursue it, and the related treatment theories of Chinese medicine may also be considered.

records.etiology_en:
Ancient Chinese medicine had no term 'niupixuan (psoriasis),' but that does not mean the disease did not exist in antiquity. In ancient times it was called 'bai bi' — a stubborn skin disease in which thick white scales arise on the skin, accompanied by itching.

Ancient medical texts such as the Zhubing Yuanhou Lun (Treatise on the Origins and Manifestations of Diseases) and the Yizong Jinjian (Golden Mirror of Medicine) all discussed it; for example, the Waike Zhengzhi Quanshu (Complete Book of Patterns and Treatments in External Medicine) records: 'The skin is dry and itchy, erupting like papules or scabies but white in color; scratching raises scales; gradually the limbs and body become withered and dry, cracking and splitting, with bleeding and pain.'

Traditional Chinese medicine holds that this disease arises mainly from 'Blood Deficiency' giving rise to phenomena of 'Wind' and 'Dryness' in the body, so that the skin, failing to receive adequate nourishment, becomes diseased.

At its outset the condition results from external Cold, or Damp-Heat pathogenic Qi, invading the skin, causing the flow of Qi and Blood in the channels to become inhibited and blocked at the skin surface, producing the lesions.

Chinese medicine holds that psoriasis is initially caused by Cold or Damp-Heat invading the body

If the illness drags on, the original factors of Cold, Fire-Heat, and Damp-Heat transform — the Cold pathogen turns to Heat, the Damp pathogen turns to Dryness — thereby aggravating the condition.

Finally, with Qi and Blood damaged on top of this, the Blood becomes even more insufficient and the skin even drier, and the skin's condition deteriorates further — which is why psoriasis is so hard to treat.

Traditional Chinese pattern identification proposes the possibilities of 'Blood Heat,' 'Blood Dryness,' 'Blood stasis,' 'Damp-Heat,' 'external contraction of Wind-Cold,' and other patterns.

Because of this complexity, each person's situation is different, so there is also no single fixed herbal formula that can directly treat psoriasis.

Many people still cannot make sense of the Chinese medical descriptions above, because what Chinese medicine describes is simply too abstract.

To understand what actually causes the disease of psoriasis, the simplest method is to perform meridian testing directly on psoriasis patients and observe what meridian phenomena appear, thereby cracking the underlying cause.

A certain Cloud TCM member shared her observations on skin diseases several years ago; she had studied Chinese medicine in mainland China and particularly loved researching skin diseases.

She recalled that during a period some years ago she would often go out to test patients' meridians, and she found that these psoriasis patients had a high probability of showing Deficiency in two channels — the Spleen channel and the Bladder channel — which made her very curious!

Psoriasis is closely related to the 'Iron Triangle' meridian pattern

Later, from some members' long-term observation reports, it was found that with fairly high probability, psoriasis patients present the so-called 'Iron Triangle' meridian pattern — well worth research by modern medicine.

Here is a classic case. During October 2023 a member shared his friend's psoriasis case: the friend had psoriasis on the first and third toes, the ankle, the lateral aspect of the lower limb (the Gallbladder channel pathway), and the elbows, and this had persisted for many years, troubling him greatly.

The meridian pattern of a man with psoriasis

This member was astonished to find that the locations of the psoriasis on his friend's body indeed all lay on those abnormal channels — especially the severely Excess Gallbladder channel: the psoriasis along the Gallbladder channel pathway on his thigh was particularly severe.

At other locations such as the Liver and Spleen channels, psoriasis indeed also appeared on the big toe. Obvious psoriasis also appeared at the elbows, which can be said to correspond to the Liver channel (Large Intestine channel).

In fact this meridian pattern frequently shows Excess of the Triple Burner and Large Intestine channels; although no abnormality appeared on this particular chart, one may assume it could appear at any time.

Although this chart showed his Stomach channel as normal, the psoriasis at the location of the Stomach channel's Jiexi point (ST41) was especially severe. On later occasions when the member tested him again several times, the Stomach channel did indeed more often show Excess.

Since this meridian pattern appears in most people during spring and summer, and in some people does not disappear even in autumn and winter, it happens to match modern medicine's observation: onset in spring, aggravation in winter, remission in summer.

As for why it worsens in winter, the following reasons are possible:

Reduced sweating in winter: the cold, dry weather of winter reduces psoriasis patients' sweating, which makes the pores more easily blocked, so that some harmful substances cannot be promptly and effectively cleared.

Dry winter skin: in winter, windows are opened for ventilation less often, so indoor air cannot stay circulating and becomes excessively dry.

Lowered immunity: winter is also the peak season for upper respiratory tract infections, and such infections may likewise trigger aggravation of psoriasis.

Some members have indeed had psoriasis flare in winter yet without showing the Iron Triangle meridian pattern, instead showing 'Deficiency of the three Yang channels of the hand' — the typical presentation of abdominal Cold-Damp with Yang Deficiency (see figure below).

A woman whose psoriasis flared in winter, presenting Deficiency of the three hand-Yang channels

From her meridian phenomena one can also see severe Excess of the Gallbladder channel; there seems to be a certain degree of association between the Gallbladder channel and psoriasis.

Overall, psoriasis still most often shows the Iron Triangle meridian pattern, and many members observing other immune-system diseases have found that they likewise present the Iron Triangle pattern.

In particular, people with this disease often feel inferior because of their abnormal skin and are usually in low spirits, and this emotional gloom further consolidates the Iron Triangle meridian pattern.

Clearly, people with an Iron Triangle meridian constitution who do not attend to health cultivation easily develop immune-system-related diseases (for example: diabetes, inflammatory bowel disease, scleroderma, rheumatoid arthritis, lupus erythematosus, and so on).

Even more arthritis patients likewise present the Iron Triangle meridian pattern — which suffices to explain why psoriasis patients so easily develop arthritis.

Ancient Chinese texts often made this point as well; for example, the Youyou Jicheng (Complete Compendium on Childhood Diseases) states: 'Hidden rashes mostly belong to the Spleen, for they lie hidden within the skin, and when they erupt they itch greatly' — the ancients often treated children's skin diseases from the Spleen.

Prevent and improve skin disease in summer, and it will not flare in winter

Strictly speaking, then, psoriasis counts as a 'summer disease' that flares in 'winter,' so if one cultivates health well in summer and prevents disease, it will not flare in winter.

According to the observations of many members, various skin diseases do indeed appear easily in summer. The Huangdi Neijing says: 'Wind is the chief of the hundred diseases' — this is genuinely true.

For early-stage skin disease, 'Mahuang Guizhi Gebantang (Ephedra and Cinnamon Twig Half-and-Half Decoction)' can cut it off right at the very start when the skin disease first emerges, so that the various diseases of the future will not develop from it.

For psoriasis caused by a long-term chronic constitution, some members report that using 'Yang Gan Wan (Liver-Nourishing Pill),' or 'Jiawei Xiaoyao San (Augmented Free Wanderer Powder)' plus 'Yinqiao San (Honeysuckle and Forsythia Powder),' gives quite good improvement.

Psoriasis is an immune disease, and the reason each person's immune system is damaged is different. Whatever the cause, as long as one improves one's own constitution, immunity returns to its normal state, and the related diseases all naturally improve.

records.etiology_zh:
古代沒有「帶狀疱疹」這個名詞，但是卻有不少類似疾病，可見古代就有帶狀疱疹。

中醫沒有免疫力這種名詞，只有所謂的「正氣」，當體內臟腑經絡不平衡，免疫力就會開始低下，帶狀疱疹就會在這種狀況下出現。

傳統中醫認為帶狀皰疹是因為外感毒邪，造成肝火、膽火熾盛，阻滯經絡，凝結于肌膚所造成。

1.火熱形成的帶狀疱疹

從現代人的經絡數據中發現，絕多數人長期肝經實證、膽經虛證，長期在這樣的狀態下久了就會出現經絡氣血阻塞，出現肝經與膽經上的疼痛，這是帶狀疱疹的常見原因。

現代人經常肝經實證、膽經虛證，長期表裡經絡不平衡

依照一些雲端中醫會員觀察，發現人體只要非常疲勞時，很容易出現鐵三角經絡型態(肝經實證、脾經與膀胱經虛證)，因此這也可以說是免疫力開始下降的經絡型態。

這時候容易出現中醫所說的「肝火上炎」證候，經常出現口苦、口乾、煩躁易怒，大便乾或小便黃的現象。

這種現象也會與中醫所說的「少陽病」重疊，所以會造成肝經、膽經與三焦經的異常，這通常是肝經鬱熱所造成。

如果就「寒熱指數」而言，只要持續保持在「上下皆熱」的狀態之下，就有機會出現帶狀皰疹。

由於「鐵三角經絡體質」的人，長期出現鐵三角經絡型態，同時少陽經(三焦經、膽經)與陽明經(大腸經、胃經)實證，到了一定的時間點體內化熱，就會出現帶狀疱疹。

疲勞或天氣濕熱時，就會出現鐵三角經絡型態

尤其是現代人長期三焦經實證，代表體內火氣旺盛。足以解釋為什麼有些人的帶狀疱疹會出現在耳朵附近，這就是體內「毒熱熾盛」的一個現象。所以夏天很容易出現帶狀疱疹。

這種體內的鬱熱，也有可能是長期飲食不節制，體內醞釀濕熱久了，造成脾虛濕熱嚴重，濕阻氣機，蘊滯肌膚，而出現皮膚皰疹、水皰。

由於鐵三角經絡型態與情緒密切相關，一個人如果情緒突然間崩潰了(親友死亡、失業、離婚、破產...等等)或壓力過大，也有機會出現鐵三角經絡型態，進而出現帶狀疱疹。

不只是帶狀疱疹，中醫治療許多皮膚病都可以從去除體內濕熱下手。大家可以去看看脾經的路線，也會通過胸部、肋間部，這也是帶狀疱疹常見部位。

2.陰寒形成的帶狀疱疹

傳統中醫針對帶狀疱疹的治療，主要都是從肝膽火熱、脾胃濕熱蘊毒來思考，難道寒邪不會出現帶狀疱疹嗎？

現代醫學發現，冬季及初春很容易出現帶狀疱疹，尤其是天氣忽冷忽熱的春季，造成免疫力低下也容易出現帶狀疱疹。

然而，冬季常見的經絡型態，其實是與夏季期間是完全相反的，可見體內「過寒」或「過熱」時，都會造成免疫力低下，而引發帶狀皰疹。

進入秋冬之後，經絡紊亂造成免疫力低下

以秋季為例，原本夏季的鐵三角，在氣溫下降之後，膽經、胃經與腎經能量也會開始下降，這時候人體的免疫力會快速下降。

以春季為例，很容易延續冬天常見的「陽虛」經絡型態。以2023年4月為例，都已經進入春季末期即將進入夏季了，台灣地區依然出現寒流，感覺完全就像冬天一樣。

有一位會員就回報他的帶狀疱疹復發，而他的體能數值只有17，這麼低的體能數值通常代表體內氣血循環不佳，而下半身所有經絡都是虛證，帶動上半身經絡實證(見下圖)。

天氣溫度下降出現帶狀皰疹案例

尤其是三焦經火熱嚴重，這其實根源於天氣寒冷引發的下半身經絡能量不足，出現「上實下虛」經絡現象。

這種「上實下虛」的經絡型態，很容易出現代中老年身上，這位會員約60歲，也符合這個年齡。現代醫學發現老年人容易出現帶狀皰疹，背後的經絡模型應該就是這種經絡現象。

如果就「寒熱指數」而言，只要長期保持在「上熱下寒」或是「上下皆寒」的狀態之下，就有機會出現帶狀皰疹。

總而言之，如果一個人體內長期保持過度火熱，或是過度陰寒，都會造成免疫力低下，進而誘發皰疹病毒活躍，出現帶狀皰疹。

如果這種經絡體質沒有加以改善，後續會延伸出更多的疾病，並不會真正的痊癒，所以改善經絡體質才是最根本的方法。

直至2023年為止，從數據中發現「鐵三角經絡體質」最容易引發帶狀皰疹，其次就是「上實下虛」的經絡型態。

夏季或情緒壓力最容易讓「鐵三角經絡型態」趨於嚴重，冬季最容易讓「上實下虛」經絡型態趨於嚴重，因此這就是這兩個季節誘發帶狀皰疹的經絡模型。
records.western_pathology_zh:
帶狀疱疹是一個常見疾病，以台灣地區為例，每3個人就有1人，在其一生可能罹患至少一次的帶狀疱疹。

任何年紀的人都可能發生帶狀疱疹，這是因為每個人在感染水痘帶狀疱疹病毒康復之後，病毒並沒有從此消失，而是終身潛伏在人體的神經節裡面。

這些病毒會因為年齡增長、罹患疾病或免疫力降低時而被活化，年紀大的人機率更高，造成身體的疼痛、皮膚表面出現紅疹及水泡。

因此，這就像是人體內的不定時炸彈，一旦免疫力開始低下，就容易活化病毒使其增生，而引發帶狀疱疹。

年紀大，或是罹患慢性疾病(糖尿病、腎臟病、氣喘、癌症...等等)免疫力低下族群，發生帶狀疱疹機率是一般人的1.24-9倍。

這種因為免疫力低下，疱疹病毒被活化的疾病不只一種，近年來研究發現「憂鬱症」也可能是這樣形成的。

帶狀疱疹發病時，身上會產生皮膚疼痛、刺癢、痠麻、灼熱的現象，表皮會長出紅斑、水疱，通常在2-4週內就會痊癒。

最常出現的位置是胸部、頸部，眼睛、耳朵周圍、臉上三叉神經分佈區域，也會出現在背部、腰間。

在疲勞免疫力低下時，帶狀疱疹病毒開始活化

由於這是免疫力低下所呈現出來的疾病，治療的方法也只是減輕緩解疼痛感覺、外用麻醉貼布、低能量雷射、或神經阻斷術，多數的時候不需要治療，數天至數周內就會自己康復！

2023年時有一位會員分享，他過去曾經在國外罹患帶狀皰疹，當時西方的醫生連一顆藥也沒有開給他，只要求在家休息睡覺而已。之後他整天睡覺，過了一個星期後就康復了。

像這種源自於體內免疫力低下所出現的疾病，最適合運用中醫理論，因此只要經絡氣血平衡，就可以加速痊癒。
records.classical_references_zh:
《醫宗金鑒外科心法要訣．腰部》，「纆腰火丹蛇串名，乾濕紅黃似珠形，肝心脾肺風熱濕，纏腰已遍不能生」。

《證治準繩.瘍醫》謂：「或問繞腰生瘡，累累如珠，何如曰：是名火帶瘡，亦名纏腰火丹，由心腎不交、肝火內熾流入膀胱，纏於帶脈，故如束帶。」

《醫宗金鑒.纏腰火丹》曰：「此證俗名蛇串瘡．有乾濕不同，紅黃之異，皆如累累珠形。乾者色紅赤，形如雲片，上起風粟，作癢發熱……濕者色黃白，水皰大小不等，作爛流水，較乾者多疼。」

《諸病源候論》：「僧帶瘡者纏腰生，狀如僧帶，因此為名」

《外科啟玄‧明瘡瘍 汗下和大要三法論》:「瘡之邪自外而入。脈必浮 數而實，在表故當汗之。邪從汗出。毒自消散」「蜘蛛瘡，此瘡生於皮膚間，與水窠相似，淡紅且痛，五七個成攢，亦能蔭開。」
records.western_pathology_en:
Herpes zoster (shingles) is a common disease; taking Taiwan as an example, one in every three people may suffer at least one episode of herpes zoster in their lifetime.

Herpes zoster can occur at any age, because after each person recovers from varicella-zoster virus infection, the virus does not thereupon disappear; it remains latent for life within the body's nerve ganglia.

These viruses can be reactivated with advancing age, illness, or lowered immunity — the probability is higher in the elderly — causing bodily pain and the appearance of red rashes and blisters on the skin surface.

It is thus like a time bomb inside the human body: once immunity begins to decline, the virus is readily activated and proliferates, triggering herpes zoster.

The elderly, and immunocompromised groups with chronic diseases (diabetes, kidney disease, asthma, cancer, and so on), have 1.24 to 9 times the general population's probability of developing herpes zoster.

Diseases in which herpes viruses are activated by lowered immunity are not limited to this one; in recent years research has found that 'depression' may also form in this way.

At onset, herpes zoster produces skin pain, prickling itch, aching numbness, and burning sensations; erythema and vesicles emerge on the skin, usually healing within 2-4 weeks.

The most common locations are the chest and neck, around the eyes and ears, and the facial distribution area of the trigeminal nerve; it also appears on the back and around the waist.

Under fatigue and lowered immunity, the herpes zoster virus begins to reactivate

Since this is a disease that manifests lowered immunity, the treatment methods are only to ease and relieve the sensation of pain — topical anesthetic patches, low-level laser, or nerve block; most of the time no treatment is needed, and it heals by itself within days to weeks!

In 2023 a member shared that he had previously contracted herpes zoster abroad; at the time the Western doctor did not prescribe him a single pill, only asking him to rest and sleep at home. He then slept all day, and after a week he had recovered.

Diseases like this, arising from lowered internal immunity, are the most suitable for applying Chinese medical theory; as long as the meridians' Qi and Blood are balanced, healing can be accelerated.

records.etiology_en:
There was no term 'herpes zoster' in antiquity, but there were quite a few similar diseases — clearly herpes zoster existed in ancient times.

Chinese medicine has no such term as immunity — only the so-called 'upright Qi (zheng qi).' When the body's Zang-Fu organs and meridians are out of balance, immunity begins to decline, and herpes zoster appears under such conditions.

Traditional Chinese medicine holds that herpes zoster is caused by external contraction of toxic pathogens producing blazing Liver Fire and Gallbladder Fire, which obstruct the channels and congeal in the skin.

1. Herpes zoster formed by Fire-Heat

From the meridian data of modern people it is found that the great majority show long-term Liver-channel Excess and Gallbladder-channel Deficiency; remaining long in this state leads to obstruction of meridian Qi and Blood, with pain along the Liver and Gallbladder channels — this is a common cause of herpes zoster.

Modern people commonly show Liver-channel Excess and Gallbladder-channel Deficiency — long-term imbalance of an exterior-interior channel pair

According to the observations of some Cloud TCM members, whenever the body is extremely fatigued, the Iron Triangle meridian pattern (Liver-channel Excess with Spleen- and Bladder-channel Deficiency) readily appears; it can thus also be called the meridian pattern of immunity beginning to decline.

At such times the pattern Chinese medicine calls 'Liver Fire flaming upward' readily appears, with frequent bitter taste in the mouth, dry mouth, agitation and irritability, dry stools, or dark-yellow urine.

This phenomenon also overlaps with what Chinese medicine calls 'Shaoyang disease,' so it produces abnormalities of the Liver, Gallbladder, and Triple Burner channels — usually caused by constrained Heat in the Liver channel.

In terms of the 'cold-heat index,' simply remaining continuously in a state of 'heat both above and below' creates the opportunity for herpes zoster to appear.

People with the 'Iron Triangle meridian constitution' show the Iron Triangle pattern long-term with simultaneous Excess of the Shaoyang channels (Triple Burner, Gallbladder) and the Yangming channels (Large Intestine, Stomach); when at a certain point in time Heat forms internally, herpes zoster appears.

The Iron Triangle meridian pattern appears with fatigue or hot-humid weather

In particular, modern people's long-term Triple Burner-channel Excess indicates exuberant internal Fire. This suffices to explain why some people's herpes zoster appears near the ears — a phenomenon of 'blazing toxic Heat' within the body. Hence herpes zoster readily appears in summer.

This internal constrained Heat may also come from long-term dietary indulgence: Damp-Heat brews in the body over time, producing severe Spleen Deficiency with Damp-Heat; Dampness obstructs the Qi dynamic and accumulates stagnantly in the skin, producing skin herpes and vesicles.

Since the Iron Triangle meridian pattern is closely related to emotions, if a person's emotions suddenly collapse (death of family or friends, unemployment, divorce, bankruptcy, and so on) or stress becomes excessive, the Iron Triangle pattern may also appear, and with it herpes zoster.

Not only for herpes zoster — in treating many skin diseases Chinese medicine can start from removing internal Damp-Heat. Everyone may look at the Spleen channel's pathway: it also passes through the chest and intercostal region, which are likewise common sites of herpes zoster.

2. Herpes zoster formed by Yin Cold

Traditional Chinese treatment of herpes zoster proceeds mainly from Liver-Gallbladder Fire-Heat and Spleen-Stomach Damp-Heat brewing toxin — but can the Cold pathogen not produce herpes zoster?

Modern medicine finds that herpes zoster readily appears in winter and early spring — especially in spring, when the weather swings abruptly between cold and hot, and the resulting lowered immunity also favors the appearance of herpes zoster.

Yet the meridian patterns common in winter are in fact the complete opposite of those during summer; clearly, both 'excessive Cold' and 'excessive Heat' within the body lower immunity and trigger herpes zoster.

After entering autumn and winter, meridian disorder causes immunity to decline

Taking autumn as an example: as the temperature falls, the energies of the Gallbladder, Stomach, and Kidney channels of the original summer Iron Triangle also begin to decline, and at this time the body's immunity drops rapidly.

Taking spring as an example: it very easily continues the 'Yang Deficiency' meridian pattern common in winter. Take April 2023: although it was already late spring about to enter summer, a cold front still appeared in Taiwan, and it felt exactly like winter.

One member reported that his herpes zoster had recurred, and his physical-energy index was only 17. Such a low energy index usually indicates poor circulation of Qi and Blood within the body; all the channels of his lower body were Deficient, driving Excess of the upper-body channels (see figure below).

A case of herpes zoster appearing as the weather temperature dropped

In particular, the Fire-Heat of the Triple Burner channel was severe — this is in fact rooted in the insufficiency of lower-body channel energy brought on by the cold weather, presenting the 'Excess above, Deficiency below' meridian phenomenon.

This 'Excess above, Deficiency below' meridian pattern very easily appears in the middle-aged and elderly; this member was about 60 years old, matching that age. Modern medicine finds that the elderly readily develop herpes zoster, and the meridian model behind it should be this meridian phenomenon.

In terms of the 'cold-heat index,' remaining long-term in a state of 'heat above, cold below' or 'cold both above and below' creates the opportunity for herpes zoster to appear.

In sum, if a person's body long remains excessively Fire-Hot, or excessively Yin-Cold, immunity declines, thereby inducing activation of the herpes virus and the appearance of herpes zoster.

If this meridian constitution is not improved, more diseases will develop later on, and true recovery will not occur — so improving the meridian constitution is the most fundamental method.

As of 2023, the data show that the 'Iron Triangle meridian constitution' most readily triggers herpes zoster, followed by the 'Excess above, Deficiency below' meridian pattern.

Summer or emotional stress most readily drives the 'Iron Triangle meridian pattern' toward severity, and winter most readily drives the 'Excess above, Deficiency below' pattern toward severity; these, then, are the meridian models by which these two seasons induce herpes zoster.

records.etiology_zh: 斑禿中醫稱「油風」,多因情志不遂、肝氣鬱結,或思慮勞倦、耗傷心脾,以致氣血生化不足,髮失所養而驟然脫落(「髮為血之餘」);亦有因肝腎精血虧虛,精不化血,血不養髮而漸見斑禿、鬢髮稀疏者;病程日久或反覆發作,可兼夾血瘀,新髮難生,局部頭皮血絡瘀阻不通。
records.western_pathology_zh: 斑禿為器官特異性自體免疫疾病,免疫系統攻擊處於生長期(anagen)的毛囊,毛囊周圍免疫豁免機制崩解,CD8陽性T細胞浸潤毛囊使其提前進入退化期,導致邊界清楚的圓形或橢圓形非疤痕性落髮斑塊。病程可自行緩解或反覆發作,少數進展為全頭禿(alopecia totalis)或全身脫毛(alopecia universalis),與甲狀腺疾病、白斑症等其他自體免疫疾病有共病傾向。
records.etiology_en: Alopecia areata is termed "wind of oily scalp" (you feng) in TCM. It commonly arises from unresolved emotional constraint causing liver qi stagnation, or from excessive rumination and overexertion depleting the heart and spleen, so that qi and blood production becomes insufficient and the hair — "the surplus of blood" — loses its nourishment and falls out abruptly. It may also arise from liver-kidney essence-blood deficiency, in which essence fails to transform into blood and blood cannot nourish the hair, producing gradual patchy hair loss and thinning at the temples. In protracted or recurrent cases, blood stasis often intermingles, obstructing the local scalp blood network and impeding regrowth of new hair.

records.western_pathology_en: Alopecia areata is an organ-specific autoimmune disease in which the immune system attacks hair follicles in the anagen (growth) phase. Collapse of the follicle's immune-privileged microenvironment allows CD8-positive T cells to infiltrate the follicle and prematurely drive it into a regressive phase, producing well-demarcated, round or oval patches of non-scarring hair loss. The course may remit spontaneously or recur; a minority of cases progress to alopecia totalis (complete scalp hair loss) or alopecia universalis (total body hair loss), and the condition shows comorbid association with other autoimmune diseases such as thyroid disease and vitiligo.

records.name_zh: 酒糟性皮膚炎（文件情境）
records.etiology_zh: 酒渣鼻多因肺胃積熱,復感風邪,熱毒上蒸於面,致鼻頭及兩頰紅赤灼熱;或嗜食辛辣厚味、酒漿,助濕生熱,脾胃濕熱上蒸於面;病程日久,氣血瘀滯,絡脈瘀阻,則見鼻部丘疹膿皰反覆不消,甚則鼻贅增生、鼻頭肥大變形。
records.western_pathology_zh: 酒糟性皮膚炎(玫瑰痤瘡)是一種慢性發炎性皮膚病,好發於顏面中央,機轉涉及先天免疫調節異常(抗菌胜肽cathelicidin表現與活化異常)、血管神經調節失衡導致陣發性潮紅與微血管擴張,以及蠕形蟎(Demodex)數量增加所誘發的局部發炎反應。臨床可見持續性紅斑、微血管擴張、丘疹膿皰,少數患者病程後期因結締組織增生出現鼻贅;日曬、飲酒、辛辣飲食及溫度劇變為常見誘發因子。
records.etiology_en: Rosacea commonly arises from accumulated lung-stomach heat compounded by externally contracted wind, so that heat-toxin steams upward to the face, producing redness and burning heat over the nose and cheeks. It may also arise from excessive consumption of spicy, greasy food and alcohol, which fosters damp-heat in the spleen-stomach that steams upward to the face. In protracted cases, qi and blood stagnate and the network vessels become obstructed, producing recurrent papules and pustules on the nose, and in advanced disease, rhinophyma with thickened, deformed nasal tissue.

records.western_pathology_en: Rosacea is a chronic inflammatory skin disease that predominantly affects the central face. Its mechanisms involve dysregulated innate immunity (abnormal expression and activation of the antimicrobial peptide cathelicidin), vascular and neurovascular dysregulation producing episodic flushing and telangiectasia, and a local inflammatory response driven by increased Demodex mite density. Clinically it presents with persistent erythema, telangiectasia, and papulopustules; a minority of patients develop rhinophyma from connective-tissue proliferation in advanced disease. Common triggers include sun exposure, alcohol, spicy food, and rapid temperature change.

records.etiology_zh: 慢性搔癢中醫多從「風」論治:血虛生風者,肌膚失於濡養,癢無定處、夜間尤甚,伴皮膚乾燥脫屑,多見於年老體弱、病久血虛之人;風濕熱蘊膚者,癢處潮紅或滲液,遇熱加重,苔黃膩;亦有血瘀生風者,病程日久,搔抓後皮膚肥厚粗糙、色素沉著,癢處固定不移。三型可單獨或相兼為患。
records.western_pathology_zh: 慢性搔癢指持續超過6週的搔癢感,病因廣泛,包括皮膚疾病(異位性皮膚炎、乾癬、皮膚乾燥症)、全身性疾病(慢性腎病、肝膽疾病、甲狀腺功能異常、血液疾病)、神經性(帶狀疱疹後神經痛、神經壓迫)及心因性等。其機轉涉及皮膚C神經纖維經組織胺或非組織胺路徑(如IL-31等細胞激素介導)傳導癢覺訊號至中樞,故治療需先釐清潛在病因,而非單純止癢。
records.etiology_en: Chronic pruritus is generally treated in TCM from the perspective of "wind." In blood-deficiency wind, the skin loses nourishment, producing itching without a fixed location that worsens at night, accompanied by dry, flaking skin — most often seen in the elderly, the frail, and those with long-standing blood deficiency. In wind-damp-heat accumulating in the skin, the itchy area is flushed or weeping and worsens with heat, with a yellow greasy coating. There is also blood-stasis wind, in which a protracted course and repeated scratching thicken and roughen the skin with pigmentation, and itching localizes to a fixed area. These three patterns may occur singly or in combination.

records.western_pathology_en: Chronic pruritus refers to itching persisting beyond 6 weeks, with a broad range of causes including dermatologic disease (atopic dermatitis, psoriasis, xerosis), systemic disease (chronic kidney disease, hepatobiliary disease, thyroid dysfunction, hematologic disorders), neuropathic causes (postherpetic neuralgia, nerve entrapment), and psychogenic factors. Its mechanism involves cutaneous C-fiber afferents transmitting itch signals to the central nervous system via histaminergic or non-histaminergic pathways, including cytokine mediators such as IL-31; management therefore requires identifying the underlying cause rather than symptomatic itch relief alone.

records.etiology_en: Yin Deficiency as the root and Dryness-Heat as the branch, with depletion of Yin fluids of the Lung, Stomach, and Kidney across the three Burners (Sanjiao).

records.etiology_zh: 代謝症候群在中醫並無單一對應病名，其臨床表現（腹型肥胖、血糖偏高、血脂異常、血壓偏高之聚集狀態）多與「痰濕」「濕熱」病理相關，屬中醫「肥胖」「消渴」前期及「眩暈」「胸痺」等病之共同土壤。多因飲食不節，過食肥甘厚味，損傷脾胃，運化失健，水穀精微不歸正化，反聚為痰濕，壅滯中焦；痰濕久蘊化熱，痰熱互結，阻遏氣機；情志失調，肝失疏泄，橫逆犯脾，亦助痰濕內生；病久痰濕與氣血相干，兼夾氣滯血瘀，脈絡不暢。臨床常見脾虛痰濕、痰濕化熱、肝鬱脾虛兼痰濕、氣滯血瘀等證型，總屬本虛標實，以脾虛為本，痰濕（或痰熱）、氣滯、血瘀為標。
records.western_pathology_zh: 代謝症候群是指腹型肥胖、高血糖（或胰島素阻抗）、高血壓及致動脈粥樣硬化性血脂異常（三酸甘油酯過高、高密度脂蛋白膽固醇過低）等一組相互關聯之心血管代謝危險因子聚集出現的臨床狀態，符合其中三項以上即可診斷。其核心病理機轉為胰島素阻抗與內臟脂肪過度堆積：內臟脂肪組織分泌過多促發炎脂肪激素（adipokines）與游離脂肪酸，一方面加劇胰島素訊息傳導障礙，一方面促成血管內皮功能失調與慢性低度發炎狀態，並使脂肪異位堆積於肝臟、骨骼肌等組織。具此狀態者，日後發展為第二型糖尿病及心血管疾病的風險明顯增加。
records.etiology_en: There is no single traditional disease name in Chinese medicine that corresponds directly to metabolic syndrome; its clinical picture — the clustering of central obesity, elevated blood glucose, dyslipidemia, and elevated blood pressure — is generally linked to the pathologies of 'phlegm-damp' and 'damp-heat,' and is regarded as common ground preceding conditions such as 'obesity,' the early stage of 'Wasting-Thirst' (Xiaoke/diabetes), 'dizziness,' and 'chest Bi.' It commonly arises from poor dietary habits, with excessive intake of rich, greasy food damaging the Spleen and Stomach and impairing their transportive and transforming function, so that the essence of food and drink is not properly transformed and instead accumulates as phlegm-damp, congesting the middle burner. Prolonged phlegm-damp accumulation transforms into heat, with phlegm and heat binding together to obstruct qi movement; emotional disturbance impairing the Liver's free-coursing function, with the Liver invading the Spleen horizontally, further promotes internal generation of phlegm-damp. As the condition persists, phlegm-damp interacts with qi and blood, adding qi stagnation and blood stasis with poor flow through the vessels. Commonly seen clinical patterns are Spleen deficiency with phlegm-damp, phlegm-damp transforming into heat, Liver constraint with Spleen deficiency and phlegm-damp, and qi stagnation with blood stasis — overall a pattern of root deficiency with branch excess, Spleen deficiency being the root, and phlegm-damp (or phlegm-heat), qi stagnation, and blood stasis being the branch manifestations.

records.western_pathology_en: Metabolic syndrome refers to the clinical state produced by the clustering of interrelated cardiometabolic risk factors — central (abdominal) obesity, hyperglycemia (or insulin resistance), hypertension, and atherogenic dyslipidemia (elevated triglycerides with low HDL cholesterol) — diagnosed when three or more of these components are present. Its core pathophysiology is insulin resistance together with excess visceral fat accumulation: visceral adipose tissue secretes excess pro-inflammatory adipokines and free fatty acids, which both worsen impairment of insulin signaling and promote endothelial dysfunction and a state of chronic low-grade inflammation, while also driving ectopic fat deposition in tissues such as the liver and skeletal muscle. Individuals with this constellation carry a markedly increased future risk of developing type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular disease.

records.name_zh: 甲狀腺功能低下（文件情境）
records.etiology_zh:
在古代，沒有像現代那樣使用「甲狀腺亢進」或「低下」這樣的詞彙，但有類似的疾病，比如「癭瘤」。甲狀腺功能低下症的症狀，偏向於中醫所說的「虛勞」、「虛損」的範疇。

甲狀腺功能異常，區分為亢進與低下，這可以說就是陰陽一體兩面，亢進屬陽，低下屬陰，而現代醫學的症狀觀察，剛好也符合陰陽理論。

甲狀腺異常符合陰陽的概念

傳統中醫認為「甲狀腺功能亢進」主要是陽證、熱證為主(註1)，因為甲亢最常見的症狀是：體重莫名下降、食慾增加但體重減輕、心跳變快、手抖、怕熱、排便次數增加、體耐力降低、手腳無力、脾氣暴躁、失眠多夢、月經不規則。

甲狀腺功能低下減退，主要是虛証、寒証為主(註2)，因為甲狀腺低下主要症狀是：心率減慢、畏寒、言語緩慢，聲音低沉。毛髮稀疏、皮膚乾燥、粗糙變厚，眉毛脫落。精神錯亂、抑鬱、痴呆、體重增加。

要釐清甲狀腺亢進與低下，就是背後是什麼原因，最簡單的方法就是直接幫甲狀腺疾病的人進行經絡檢測，就清楚比較其中的差異性。

從雲端中醫的許多文章中都可以理解一個原則：體質偏熱的人，主要是「鐵三角經絡體質」，體質偏寒的人，主要是「寒性陽虛經絡體質」。

所以，理論上甲狀腺亢進應該是「鐵三角經絡體質」，甲狀腺低下應該是「寒性陽虛經絡體質」。而這只是推斷，事實上也許大家想的並不一樣。

下面這個經絡案例，是2023年12月期間某會員所分享的，他的一位女性朋友罹患甲狀腺亢進、手腳冰冷、容易失眠，已經被診斷是子宮頸癌第0期。

女性出現甲狀腺亢進案例

從圖上可以清楚看到，這是典型的陽虛經絡現象，而且她也會手腳冰冷，這並不是熱性體質的現象。

而下面這兩個甲狀腺低下的案例，也是在過去幾年來由會員所分享的真實案例，從下圖可以清楚看出都是鐵三角經絡型態為主的熱性體質現象。

兩個甲狀腺低下案例

左邊這張圖是一位女性，長期膝關節無力、下肢水腫、經常頻尿、尿道炎，月經量過少且不規則。

右邊那張圖肝經、三焦經嚴重實證，呈現的就是肝火很旺的狀態。

以上提到的案例，都是屬於相反的案例。而系統中也有一些典型的鐵三角經絡體質，熱性體質出現甲亢的案例。也有一些屬於「寒性陽虛經絡體質」，出現甲狀腺機能減退的案例。

可見甲狀腺的異常，不論是亢進或低下，同一種經絡體質都是有可能出現完全相反的結果。

真正的原因，應該當一個人體內「極寒」或「極熱」的時候，會導致免疫系統的異常，這才是造成甲狀腺異常的根本原因。(進階閱讀)

2024年4月期間就有會員回報，她之前是甲狀腺亢進，後來又好像出現低下的症狀，後來她持續運用中藥進行養生之後，症狀確實就明顯改善了。

調整身體的寒熱陰陽，就會變得舒暢

無論甲狀腺亢進或低下，背後究竟應該是哪一種經絡型態或體質，這是醫學界需要統計的事，這對改善自己的健康狀態沒有關係。

而每個甲狀腺亢進或低下的人，只要經常幫自己進行經絡檢測，清楚理解自己是屬於哪一種體質？透過養生去改善自己的經絡體質，不論是亢進或低下都會自然改善。

除了從經絡看到自己的體質之外，也可以依照自己的症狀去對傳統中醫的證候，自然可以找到適合的中藥改善體質。

更重要的是，不論古今都確認這種疾病源自於情緒、生活習慣，這才是根治疾病的核心方法。

註1:傳統中醫辨證甲亢，主要是「肝鬱火旺」、「肝鬱脾虛型」、「胃熱亢盛型」、「氣陰兩虛」、「肝腎陰虛型」。

註2:傳統中醫辨證甲減，主要是腎陽虛、脾腎陽虛，病因多由先天稟賦不足、後天失養，或者積勞內傷、外感失治、誤治，久病失調。
records.western_pathology_zh:
甲狀腺機能低下，是指甲狀腺無法釋放足夠的甲狀腺激素，從而導致身體的基礎代謝率降低。

通常由多種原因引起，在女性和60歲以上的老年人中較為常見，女性患病的風險是男性的4倍。

甲狀腺功能低下的常見症狀包括：感覺容易疲倦愛睡覺、體溫偏低、心跳太慢、血壓偏低、關節疼痛、便秘、食慾下降、排汗減少、注意力無法集中、記憶力變差、皮膚乾燥、毛髮稀疏、月經過多、肌肉痠痛、虛弱、體重增加。

現代醫學治療甲狀腺機能低下症，不管原因如何，最主要的治療方法是補充甲狀腺素。

許多患者覺得這是一個令人困擾的疾病，有些人原本甲狀腺「亢進」又變成「低下」？如果可以從中醫或經絡的角度來探討理解這個疾病，或許可以提供一條新的思路。

records.western_pathology_en:
Hypothyroidism refers to the thyroid gland's inability to release sufficient thyroid hormone, thereby lowering the body's basal metabolic rate.

It usually arises from multiple causes and is more common in women and in the elderly over 60; women's risk of the disease is 4 times that of men.

Common symptoms of hypothyroidism include: feeling easily tired and sleepy, low body temperature, an overly slow heartbeat, low blood pressure, joint pain, constipation, decreased appetite, reduced sweating, inability to concentrate, worsening memory, dry skin, sparse hair, heavy menstruation, muscle aches, weakness, and weight gain.

In modern medicine's treatment of hypothyroidism, whatever the cause, the principal treatment method is supplementation with thyroid hormone.

Many patients feel this is a vexing disease — some people go from thyroid 'hyperfunction' to 'hypofunction.' If this disease can be explored and understood from the perspective of Chinese medicine or the meridians, it may perhaps offer a new line of thinking.

records.etiology_en:
In antiquity, terms like the modern 'hyperthyroidism' or 'hypothyroidism' were not used, but there were similar diseases, such as 'ying liu (goiter tumor).' The symptoms of hypothyroidism lean toward what Chinese medicine calls the categories of 'xu lao (Deficiency taxation)' and 'xu sun (Deficiency detriment).'

Thyroid dysfunction is divided into hyperfunction and hypofunction — one could say these are the two faces of one Yin-Yang whole: hyperfunction belongs to Yang, hypofunction belongs to Yin, and modern medicine's symptom observations happen to accord with Yin-Yang theory as well.

Thyroid abnormality accords with the concept of Yin and Yang

Traditional Chinese medicine holds that 'hyperthyroidism' is mainly a Yang pattern and Heat pattern (Note 1), because hyperthyroidism's most common symptoms are: unexplained weight loss, increased appetite yet falling weight, a faster heartbeat, hand tremor, heat intolerance, increased frequency of bowel movements, reduced physical endurance, weakness of the limbs, an explosive temper, insomnia with excessive dreaming, and irregular menstruation.

Hypothyroidism is mainly a Deficiency pattern and Cold pattern (Note 2), because hypothyroidism's main symptoms are: slowed heart rate, aversion to cold, slow speech, and a low, deep voice; sparse hair, dry, rough, thickened skin, loss of the eyebrows; mental confusion, depression, dementia, and weight gain.

To clarify what actually lies behind thyroid hyperfunction and hypofunction, the simplest method is to perform meridian testing directly on people with thyroid disease and clearly compare the differences between them.

From many Cloud TCM articles one can grasp a principle: people with Heat-leaning constitutions mainly have the 'Iron Triangle meridian constitution,' while people with Cold-leaning constitutions mainly have the 'Cold-natured Yang-Deficient meridian constitution.'

So, in theory, hyperthyroidism should correspond to the 'Iron Triangle meridian constitution,' and hypothyroidism to the 'Cold-natured Yang-Deficient meridian constitution.' But this is only inference; in fact things may not be as everyone imagines.

The meridian case below was shared by a member during December 2023: a female friend of his suffered hyperthyroidism, cold hands and feet, and ready insomnia, and had been diagnosed with stage 0 cervical cancer.

A case of hyperthyroidism in a woman

From the chart one can clearly see this is a typical Yang-Deficient meridian phenomenon, and she also had cold hands and feet — this is not the phenomenon of a Heat-natured constitution.

The two hypothyroidism cases below are likewise real cases shared by members over the past several years; from the figures below one can clearly see that both are Heat-constitution phenomena dominated by the Iron Triangle meridian pattern.

Two hypothyroidism cases

The chart on the left is a woman with long-term weakness of the knee joints, lower-limb edema, frequent urination and urethritis, and scanty, irregular menstruation.

The chart on the right shows severe Excess of the Liver and Triple Burner channels — presenting precisely the state of exuberant Liver Fire.

The cases mentioned above are all contrary cases. The system also contains some typical Iron Triangle meridian constitution — Heat constitution — cases presenting hyperthyroidism, as well as some 'Cold-natured Yang-Deficient meridian constitution' cases presenting hypothyroidism.

Clearly, in thyroid abnormality — whether hyperfunction or hypofunction — the same meridian constitution can produce completely opposite results.

The true reason should be that when the interior of a person's body is 'extremely Cold' or 'extremely Hot,' it causes abnormality of the immune system — this is the fundamental cause of thyroid abnormality. (Further reading)

During April 2024 a member reported that she previously had hyperthyroidism and later seemed to develop symptoms of hypofunction; after she continued health cultivation with Chinese herbs, her symptoms did indeed clearly improve.

Adjust the body's cold-heat and Yin-Yang, and one becomes comfortable and at ease

Whichever meridian pattern or constitution actually lies behind thyroid hyperfunction or hypofunction is a matter for the medical field to tabulate statistically; it has no bearing on improving one's own state of health.

And every person with thyroid hyperfunction or hypofunction, as long as they frequently perform meridian testing on themselves and clearly understand which constitution they belong to, and improve their meridian constitution through health cultivation, will see natural improvement whether the condition is hyperfunction or hypofunction.

Besides seeing one's own constitution from the meridians, one can also match one's own symptoms against traditional Chinese medicine's patterns, and naturally find suitable Chinese herbs to improve the constitution.

More important still, both ancient and modern observers confirm that this disease has its source in emotions and lifestyle habits — this is the core method of curing the disease at its root.

Note 1: Traditional Chinese pattern identification of hyperthyroidism mainly comprises 'Liver constraint with exuberant Fire,' 'Liver constraint with Spleen Deficiency,' 'exuberant Stomach Heat,' 'Deficiency of both Qi and Yin,' and 'Liver-Kidney Yin Deficiency.'

Note 2: Traditional Chinese pattern identification of hypothyroidism is mainly Kidney Yang Deficiency and Spleen-Kidney Yang Deficiency; the causes are mostly insufficient innate endowment or inadequate postnatal nourishment, or accumulated overwork with internal damage, external contractions left untreated or mistreated, and prolonged illness with poor regulation.

records.name_zh: 甲狀腺功能亢進（文件情境）
records.etiology_zh:
甲狀腺機能亢進絕對是困擾中國人千年以上的症狀，在古代被稱為「癭病」，癭是甲狀腺疾病的總稱。古書說：「癭，嬰也，在頸嬰喉也。」嬰有纏繞之意，是指頸前結核兩側腫大的一類疾病。

癭病包含了現代醫學所說的幾種疾病，包含單純性甲狀腺腫大、甲狀腺腺瘤、甲狀腺囊腫、甲狀腺癌、甲狀腺炎等，傳統中醫將癭病則分為氣癭、肉癭、石癭及癭癰四種。

古人觀察發現，這種疾病大多數是受到「情志」異常所造成，由於精神情緒壓力導致肝氣鬱結，肝經氣血異常反應在脖子附近，通常屬於氣虛、陰虛火旺的證候。

傳統中醫最大的問題，就是講了一堆抽象理論，古文艱澀難懂就算了，就算有人翻譯完整，也很難理解抽象的道理。而今，可以運用經絡檢測，直接就去觀察甲狀腺亢進患者的經絡型態，不就最直接了當，簡單易懂嗎？

既然甲亢是一種體質狀態，理論上在甲亢出現的幾年前，甚至十幾年前，就可以觀察出可能性，這才是預防醫學的價值所在。這裡就紀錄一位持續觀察4年，從完全沒有甲抗，到確診甲抗，到改善甲亢的完整過程。

某女性會員從2018年開始(當時41歲)，就經常幫自己進行經絡檢測，在起初的時候她爾偶就會出現手抖，每次都只要吃點醣類即可改善，因此她以為自己血糖有問題。當時，她就偶爾會看到自己出現所謂的「鐵三角」經絡型態，但是不穩定出現。

2018年甲狀現亢進確診前4年，出現鐵三角經絡型態

這個狀況一直持續到了2020年之後，她因為家庭、工作壓力雙重因素，經常心情鬱悶不開心，2020-2021年中，這段期間她在進行經絡檢測時，發現這種鐵三角經絡型態已經開始穩定呈現，幾乎不會變化了。同時，她發現自己身體很容易發熱難耐，她以為這是更年期的現象。

從2021年底開始，她開始嚴重失眠，幾乎每天都無法入睡，從這時候開始不論檢測多少次經絡，都穩定呈現下圖這樣的經絡型態。她開始出現手抖、喉嚨經常痛、頸部腫大，心跳很快且經常、整天身體嚴重發熱、很容易生氣暴躁，有時候感到恐慌、體重明顯減輕、整天覺得疲倦...等等。

確診甲狀腺亢進經絡型態

因為這種現象，到了醫院掛急診3次，最後驗血確認是甲狀腺亢進，醫生開了「抗甲狀腺藥物」給她服用。那一陣子，她的經絡圖穩定呈現如上圖的型態，比起以前多了更多的紅色經絡。

她發現，至少在過去一年來，不論春夏秋冬都已經穩定呈現鐵三角經絡型態，已經確定成為一種「鐵三角經絡體質」，不論怎麼檢測都不會改變，唯一就是在某些日子睡眠品質比較好的那幾天，會少一些紅色經絡。

由於她服用「抗甲狀腺藥物」之後出現皮膚搔癢現象，醫生說這是最常見的副作用，同時也會出現關節痛，所以她不想繼續治療，醫生勸她千萬不要停藥，但是她就是不想依賴化學藥物，因此她開始尋找中醫療法。

事實上，從他的經絡現象可以明確看出，完全符合傳統中醫對於甲亢的論斷。傳統中醫認為，與甲亢相關的臟腑分析如下：

心：心悸、氣短、嚴重者出現心衰，焦慮、易怒、失眠

脾胃：大便次數增多，便稀，消谷善飢，體重減少

肺：乏力、皮膚潮熱、怕熱

腎：女子月經減少或是閉經，男子生殖力減弱

肝：甲亢重症出現肝功能的損傷

總體來看，整個疾病的重點在於「厥陰」和「少陽」，是由於「肝氣鬱滯」導致生風化火，最後造成精氣虧損，陰虛火旺。因此，甲亢的總體治療原則就是舒達肝鬱，收斂陽氣。經常運用「小柴胡湯」、「   白虎加人參湯」、「生脈飲」、「加味逍遙散」之類方劑。

從經絡型態的角度看來，這就是「鐵三角經絡型態」的最嚴重變化型。從下圖可以清楚看出，心經與心包經嚴重虛證而造成心悸、氣短。脾經虛證、膽經、胃經實證出現脾胃障礙。肺經、大腸與三焦經同時實證，體內火熱。肝經實證、腎經與膀胱經虛證造成肝腎不調。

鐵三角經絡型態發展到最嚴重的變化型

以上這些中藥她幾乎都有服用過，效果卻不明顯，甲亢症狀大部分都沒有消失。所有的朋友都跟她說這樣很危險，以知名作家楊渡的女兒，也是時尚雜誌《ELLE》的總編輯楊茵絜為例，就是因為甲狀腺風暴引發心臟衰竭而死亡。

最後她心想，既然這是自體免疫的疾病，只要改善自己的免疫力即可自癒，而胸腺就是人體免疫力的核心。因此她狠下心來花費新台幣數百萬，進行「胸腺素療法」，整個療程大約3個月。

然而，她在第二個星期之後，就開始回到最原始的單純鐵三角經絡型態，有時候甚至幾乎消失。   多數甲亢症狀明顯消失，驗血檢查指數完全正常，而完全沒有服用任何「抗甲狀腺藥物」，不論幫她診治的中醫師、西醫師都感到非常訝異。

雲端中醫在很多文章內都已經明確指出，任何人一旦穩定呈現「鐵三角經絡體質」，要改變是非常困難的，因此一定要特別重視這種經絡型態，不要讓它穩定呈現成為一種體質現象。

當一種經絡型態穩定呈現多年之後的結果，有很高的機率出現各種器質性病變，在沒病的時候都改變不了的經絡體質，在已經生病的時候要改變的困難性更高。然而，絕大多數人就是等到這時候才會考慮運用中醫，時間點完全不對。

在此刻，運用西醫可以讓你不死，運用中醫可以緩解部分症狀，而難以改變這種經絡體質，所以最終你會發現甲亢非常難以根治。除非用運更高科技的生化療法，不然就是從「心」下手，徹底從情緒的根源改善。再次強調，這個論點絕對不是要你相信，而是去印證！

也因此，雲端中醫立場不會謾罵西醫，更不會說中醫萬能可治百病。因為從大量經絡數據清楚印證，再怎麼高明的中醫師，也很難以解決這種鐵三角經絡體質，因為真正關鍵在病人的心，這不是物理藥物可以根本解決的。嚴重發病時如果沒有現代醫學的輔助，是很容易危及生命的。

此案例不是要提出中醫可以如何成功治療甲亢，而是要提出如何預防甲亢？在進入炎熱夏天之後，至少有50%以上的人會出現鐵三角經絡型態，而在進入冬天的時候會自動消失。而極端的人會在最炎熱夏天出現最嚴重的變化型，這就可以解釋楊茵絜，為什麼在2022年炎熱的6月發病的時間點。

如果可以在任何時候都針對鐵三角經絡型態加以改善，不但以可以預防甲亢，更可以預防各種自體免疫疾病、慢性病與癌症，這是非常值得關注的養生議題，在此提出期待未來醫療界能夠重視這種經絡現象。

PS. 對於「胸腺素療法」有興趣者，可以直接與我們聯繫 support@cloudtcm.com
records.western_pathology_zh:
甲狀腺機能亢進(簡稱甲亢)是一種甲狀腺荷爾蒙過多所導致的疾病，是一種「自體免疫」的疾病。當體內免疫系統異常時，身體會製造出抗體，去刺激甲狀腺製造過多的甲狀腺素。甲亢就是甲狀腺分泌過多所致，反之則為低下症。

甲狀腺位於於頸部喉結下方，外型像是蝴蝶狀的腺體，是影響最廣的內分泌腺，身體每個器官的新陳代謝都受到甲狀腺的影響，包括心臟、肌肉、眼睛、骨骼、皮膚、情緒等等，因此甲狀腺亢進的原因與症狀非常複雜。

女性比起男性有較高的機率得到甲亢，是男性的5倍。甲亢常見的症狀，包含：心跳變快、心悸、手抖、怕熱、睡眠障礙、容易生氣暴躁、呼吸氣短、大便次數增加或腹瀉、體重減輕、食慾大增、覺得疲倦、脖子腫大、眼睛突出、女性月經不調...等等。

通常甲抗病患不會一次出現以上全部的症狀，例如有人剛開始只是感到疲倦，或是偶爾會手抖，通常是慢慢出現而漸漸加重，最後形成甲亢。

現代醫學發現造成甲抗的原因很多，包含基因、遺傳、環境、吸菸和壓力等等相關。治療甲亢的方法，一般就是服用「抗甲狀腺藥物」，抑制甲狀腺荷爾蒙合成。或是運用「放射碘」治療，慢慢破壞甲狀腺細胞。或是「開刀」切除甲狀腺。

不論哪一種治療方法都有副作用，甚至必須終身服藥，因此甲抗患者通常都會問：「如何根治這種疾病？」

現代醫學認為甲亢是一種體質，只能運用藥物來控制。既然是一種體質，只要運用經絡檢測長期觀察，一定會穩定呈現一種固定的型態。所以在甲亢出現的幾年前就已經可以觀察出來，因此可以藉由養生來預防，只要改變經絡體質，就可以達到所謂的「根治」境界。
records.western_pathology_en:
Hyperthyroidism (abbreviated as 'jiakang' in Chinese) is a disease caused by an excess of thyroid hormone; it is an 'autoimmune' disease. When the body's immune system is abnormal, the body produces antibodies that stimulate the thyroid to manufacture excessive thyroid hormone. Hyperthyroidism results from thyroid oversecretion; the converse is hypothyroidism.

The thyroid lies in the neck below the Adam's apple, a gland shaped like a butterfly; it is the endocrine gland with the broadest influence — the metabolism of every organ in the body is affected by the thyroid, including the heart, muscles, eyes, bones, skin, mood, and so on — so the causes and symptoms of hyperthyroidism are very complex.

Women have a higher probability than men of developing hyperthyroidism — 5 times that of men. Common symptoms of hyperthyroidism include: a faster heartbeat, palpitations, hand tremor, heat intolerance, sleep disturbance, ready anger and irritability, shortness of breath, increased frequency of bowel movements or diarrhea, weight loss, greatly increased appetite, feeling fatigued, neck swelling, protruding eyes, menstrual irregularity in women, and so on.

Usually a hyperthyroid patient does not show all the above symptoms at once; for example, some at first merely feel fatigued, or occasionally have hand tremor — the symptoms usually appear slowly and worsen gradually, finally forming hyperthyroidism.

Modern medicine finds many causes of hyperthyroidism, related to genes, heredity, environment, smoking, stress, and more. The methods of treating hyperthyroidism are generally taking 'antithyroid drugs' to inhibit thyroid hormone synthesis; or applying 'radioactive iodine' therapy to gradually destroy thyroid cells; or 'surgery' to excise the thyroid.

Every treatment method has side effects, and some even require lifelong medication, so hyperthyroid patients usually ask: 'How can this disease be cured at the root?'

Modern medicine regards hyperthyroidism as a constitution that can only be controlled with drugs. Since it is a constitution, long-term observation using meridian testing will certainly show a stable, fixed pattern. It can thus already be observed several years before hyperthyroidism appears, and can therefore be prevented through health cultivation; simply by changing the meridian constitution, one can reach the so-called realm of 'root cure.'
