records.etiology_en:
Hyperthyroidism has unquestionably troubled the Chinese for over a thousand years. In antiquity it was called 'ying disease (goiter)'; ying is the general term for thyroid diseases. An ancient text says: 'Ying means to encircle — it wraps the throat at the neck.' Ying carries the sense of entwining, referring to the class of diseases with nodular swelling on both sides of the front of the neck.

Ying disease encompasses several diseases named by modern medicine, including simple goiter, thyroid adenoma, thyroid cyst, thyroid cancer, and thyroiditis. Traditional Chinese medicine divides ying disease into four kinds: Qi ying, flesh ying, stone ying, and ying abscess.

The ancients observed that this disease mostly results from abnormality of the 'emotions (qingzhi)': mental and emotional stress leads to Liver Qi constraint, and the abnormal Qi and Blood of the Liver channel manifests in the vicinity of the neck — usually belonging to patterns of Qi Deficiency, or Yin Deficiency with exuberant Fire.

The greatest problem of traditional Chinese medicine is that it expounds a pile of abstract theory; the classical language is obscure enough as it is, and even with a complete translation the abstract principles remain hard to grasp. Today, one can use meridian testing to observe directly the meridian patterns of hyperthyroid patients — is that not the most direct and easily understood approach?

Since hyperthyroidism is a constitutional state, in theory the possibility can be observed several years — even more than a decade — before hyperthyroidism appears; herein lies the value of preventive medicine. Recorded here is one person's complete course of 4 years of continuous observation, from no hyperthyroidism at all, to diagnosed hyperthyroidism, to improved hyperthyroidism.

A certain female member had, from 2018 onward (then aged 41), frequently performed meridian testing on herself. In the beginning she would occasionally develop hand tremor, each time improved simply by eating a little carbohydrate, so she assumed she had a blood-sugar problem. At that time she would occasionally see the so-called 'Iron Triangle' meridian pattern in herself, but it did not appear stably.

In 2018, 4 years before the hyperthyroidism diagnosis, the Iron Triangle meridian pattern appeared

This situation continued until after 2020, when, under the dual factors of family and work pressure, she was frequently depressed and unhappy. From 2020 to mid-2021, during her meridian tests she found that this Iron Triangle meridian pattern had begun to present stably, almost without variation. At the same time she found her body very prone to unbearable heat, which she took to be a menopausal phenomenon.

From late 2021 she began to suffer severe insomnia, almost unable to fall asleep every night. From this point on, no matter how many times she tested her meridians, they stably presented the meridian pattern shown in the figure below. She began to develop hand tremor, frequent sore throat, neck swelling, a very fast and frequent heartbeat, severe body heat all day long, great proneness to anger and irritability, occasional panic, obvious weight loss, feeling fatigued all day, and so on.

The meridian pattern at the diagnosis of hyperthyroidism

Because of these phenomena she went to the hospital emergency department 3 times; finally blood tests confirmed hyperthyroidism, and the doctor prescribed an 'antithyroid drug' for her. During that period, her meridian charts stably presented the pattern shown above, with more red (Excess) channels than before.

She found that for at least the past year, through spring, summer, autumn, and winter alike, the Iron Triangle meridian pattern had presented stably — it had definitively become an 'Iron Triangle meridian constitution' that would not change no matter how she tested; the sole exception was that on certain days when her sleep quality was better, there would be a few fewer red channels.

Because she developed itchy skin after taking the 'antithyroid drug' — the doctor said this is the most common side effect — and joint pain also appeared, she did not want to continue the treatment. The doctor urged her on no account to stop the medication, but she simply did not want to depend on chemical drugs, so she began to seek Chinese medical therapy.

In fact, from her meridian phenomena it can be clearly seen that they accord completely with traditional Chinese medicine's assessment of hyperthyroidism. Traditional Chinese medicine's analysis of the Zang-Fu organs related to hyperthyroidism is as follows:

Heart: palpitations, shortness of breath, in severe cases heart failure; anxiety, irritability, insomnia

Spleen and Stomach: increased frequency of bowel movements, loose stools, rapid digestion with frequent hunger, weight loss

Lung: weakness, hot flushed skin, heat intolerance

Kidney: reduced menstruation or amenorrhea in women, weakened reproductive capacity in men

Liver: severe hyperthyroidism shows damage to liver function

Viewed overall, the crux of the whole disease lies in 'Jueyin' and 'Shaoyang': 'Liver Qi constraint and stagnation' engenders Wind and transforms into Fire, finally causing depletion of essence-Qi and Yin Deficiency with exuberant Fire. Therefore the overall treatment principle for hyperthyroidism is to soothe and free the constrained Liver and restrain the Yang Qi, frequently using formulas of the type of Xiao Chaihu Tang (Minor Bupleurum Decoction), Baihu Jia Renshen Tang (White Tiger Decoction plus Ginseng), Shengmai Yin (Pulse-Engendering Drink), and Jiawei Xiaoyao San (Augmented Free Wanderer Powder).

From the perspective of meridian patterns, this is the most severe variant form of the 'Iron Triangle meridian pattern.' From the figure below one can clearly see: severe Deficiency of the Heart and Pericardium channels producing palpitations and shortness of breath; Spleen-channel Deficiency with Gallbladder- and Stomach-channel Excess producing Spleen-Stomach disorder; simultaneous Excess of the Lung, Large Intestine, and Triple Burner channels — Fire-Heat within the body; and Liver-channel Excess with Kidney- and Bladder-channel Deficiency producing Liver-Kidney disharmony.

The Iron Triangle meridian pattern developed to its most severe variant form

She had taken nearly all of the above Chinese herbal formulas, yet the effect was not obvious, and most of the hyperthyroid symptoms did not disappear. All her friends told her this was very dangerous — taking as an example the daughter of the well-known writer Yang Du: Yang Yin-chieh, editor-in-chief of the fashion magazine ELLE, who died of heart failure triggered by thyroid storm.

Finally she thought: since this is an autoimmune disease, improving her own immunity should allow self-healing — and the thymus is the core of human immunity. So she steeled herself to spend several million New Taiwan dollars on 'thymosin therapy,' a full course of about 3 months.

Yet after the second week, she began to return to the original simple Iron Triangle meridian pattern, which at times almost disappeared. Most hyperthyroid symptoms clearly vanished, and blood test indices were completely normal — entirely without taking any 'antithyroid drug' — astonishing both the Chinese medicine practitioners and the Western physicians treating her.

Cloud TCM has clearly pointed out in many articles that once anyone stably presents the 'Iron Triangle meridian constitution,' changing it is extremely difficult; one must therefore pay particular attention to this meridian pattern and not let it present stably and become a constitutional phenomenon.

When a meridian pattern has presented stably for many years, the result is a high probability of various organic pathologies. A meridian constitution that could not be changed even while one was well is even harder to change once one is already ill. Yet the great majority of people only consider using Chinese medicine at that point — the timing is completely wrong.

At that moment, using Western medicine can keep you from dying, and using Chinese medicine can ease some symptoms yet can hardly change this meridian constitution — so in the end you will find hyperthyroidism extremely difficult to cure at the root. Short of employing higher-technology biochemical therapies, the alternative is to start from the 'heart-mind' and thoroughly improve things from the emotional root. To emphasize once more: this point is absolutely not for you to believe, but to verify!

For this reason, Cloud TCM's position is never to revile Western medicine, nor to claim that Chinese medicine is omnipotent and can cure all diseases. Massive meridian data clearly confirm that even the most brilliant Chinese medicine practitioner can hardly resolve this Iron Triangle meridian constitution, because the true key lies in the patient's heart-mind, which physical medicines cannot fundamentally resolve. In a severe episode, without the support of modern medicine, life is easily endangered.

This case is not presented to claim how Chinese medicine can successfully treat hyperthyroidism, but to raise the question of how to prevent hyperthyroidism. After the hot summer arrives, at least 50% or more of people show the Iron Triangle meridian pattern, which disappears automatically upon entering winter. Extreme individuals show the most severe variant form in the hottest summer — which can explain the timing of why Yang Yin-chieh fell ill in the hot June of 2022.

If one can improve the Iron Triangle meridian pattern whenever it appears, one can prevent not only hyperthyroidism but also various autoimmune diseases, chronic diseases, and cancer. This is a health-cultivation topic highly worthy of attention, raised here in the hope that the medical community will in future take this meridian phenomenon seriously.

records.etiology_zh: 橋本氏甲狀腺炎依其臨床表現，屬中醫「癭病」與「虛勞」範疇。初期或見頸前腫大者，多因情志不遂，肝失疏泄，氣機鬱滯，津液不歸正化，凝聚成痰，痰氣互結於頸前而成癭；病久痰氣鬱結，兼夾血行不暢，痰瘀互結，腫塊質地漸硬。隨病程進展，脾腎陽氣漸損，脾陽不振則運化失司，腎陽不足則溫煦失職，症見畏寒肢冷、神疲乏力、面浮肢腫、大便溏薄，屬脾腎陽虛之候；亦有病久陰血暗耗，肝腎陰虛，虛熱內擾者。臨床當依甲狀腺功能狀態及全身症狀，分虛實而治，病程日久者多以脾腎陽虛為主要病機。
records.western_pathology_zh: 橋本氏甲狀腺炎是最常見的自體免疫性甲狀腺疾病，也是已開發國家甲狀腺功能低下最常見的病因。其病理機轉為體內產生抗甲狀腺過氧化酶抗體（anti-TPO）及抗甲狀腺球蛋白抗體（anti-Tg）等自體抗體，並伴隨淋巴細胞浸潤甲狀腺組織，造成慢性發炎反應，逐漸破壞甲狀腺濾泡結構與功能，多數病患最終發展為甲狀腺功能低下。臨床上常見甲狀腺腫大（質地可呈結節狀或瀰漫性腫大）、疲倦、怕冷、體重增加、皮膚乾燥、便秘、月經紊亂等甲狀腺功能低下相關症狀，好發於女性，且常與其他自體免疫疾病並存。診斷主要依據甲狀腺自體抗體檢測及甲狀腺功能檢查。
records.etiology_en: According to its clinical presentation, Hashimoto thyroiditis is categorized in Chinese medicine under 'goiter disease' (Ying Bing) and 'vacuity taxation' (Xu Lao). In its early stage, where anterior neck swelling is present, it commonly arises from emotional frustration impairing the Liver's free-coursing function, causing qi stagnation; body fluids are then not properly transformed and instead congeal into phlegm, with phlegm and qi binding together in the anterior neck to form the goiter. As the condition persists, phlegm-qi constraint combines with sluggish blood movement, phlegm and stasis binding together and the mass gradually hardening. As the disease progresses, Spleen and Kidney yang qi are gradually damaged — Spleen yang failure impairs transportation and transformation, while Kidney yang insufficiency impairs its warming function — producing aversion to cold with cold limbs, fatigue, facial and limb puffiness, and loose stool, characteristic of Spleen-Kidney yang deficiency. In some patients with a long disease course, covert consumption of yin-blood produces Liver-Kidney yin deficiency with internal disturbance from deficiency heat. Clinically, treatment should be differentiated according to thyroid function status and systemic symptoms; in patients with a long disease course, Spleen-Kidney yang deficiency is generally the predominant pathomechanism.

records.western_pathology_en: Hashimoto thyroiditis is the most common autoimmune thyroid disorder and the leading cause of hypothyroidism in developed countries. Its pathophysiology involves the production of autoantibodies — anti-thyroid peroxidase (anti-TPO) and anti-thyroglobulin (anti-Tg) antibodies — together with lymphocytic infiltration of thyroid tissue, producing a chronic inflammatory process that progressively destroys the structure and function of thyroid follicles; most patients eventually develop hypothyroidism. Clinically it commonly presents with goiter (which may be nodular or diffusely enlarged), fatigue, cold intolerance, weight gain, dry skin, constipation, and menstrual irregularity — symptoms related to hypothyroidism. It occurs more often in women and frequently coexists with other autoimmune conditions. Diagnosis is based mainly on testing for thyroid autoantibodies together with thyroid function tests.

records.etiology_zh: 肥胖在中醫多因飲食不節，嗜食肥甘厚味、甘肥生冷，日久損傷脾胃，運化失健，水濕內停，聚而成痰，痰濕壅滯肌膚腠理，發為形體肥胖；亦有先天稟賦不足，脾氣虛弱，氣虛不能布散水穀精微，反聚為痰濕；情志失調，肝失疏泄，氣機鬱滯，橫逆犯脾，助濕生痰，或因鬱久化熱，胃熱熾盛，消穀善飢而又痰濕內蘊；久坐少動、勞逸失度亦使氣機不暢，痰濕停聚。病程日久，痰濕阻滯氣血運行，兼夾血瘀，痰瘀互結；亦可損及脾腎陽氣，脾腎陽虛，氣化失司，水濕愈加難化。臨床常見胃熱濕阻、脾虛濕盛、肝鬱氣滯、脾腎陽虛、痰瘀互結等證型。
records.western_pathology_zh: 肥胖的病理生理核心為長期熱量攝取超過消耗，形成持續的正能量平衡，其成因涉及遺傳易感性、下視丘食慾調控系統（瘦素 leptin 及飢餓素 ghrelin 訊息傳導）失調、久坐少動的生活型態，以及環境與行為等多重因素交互作用。體重過度增加以脂肪組織擴增為主，尤以內臟脂肪堆積影響最大；肥大化的脂肪細胞分泌過多促發炎脂肪激素與游離脂肪酸，導致慢性低度發炎、胰島素阻抗及血管內皮功能失調，進而增加第二型糖尿病、高血壓、血脂異常、心血管疾病及部分癌症之風險。臨床上以身體質量指數（BMI）及腰圍作為評估肥胖程度及相關代謝風險之常用指標。
records.etiology_en: Obesity in Chinese medicine commonly arises from poor dietary habits — excessive intake of rich, greasy, sweet, and raw/cold foods — which over time damages the Spleen and Stomach, impairing their transportive and transforming function so that water-damp accumulates internally and condenses into phlegm; phlegm-damp then congests the flesh and interstices, producing an overweight body form. It may also arise from constitutional Spleen qi weakness, in which insufficient qi cannot distribute the essence of food and drink, which instead accumulates as phlegm-damp. Emotional disturbance impairing the Liver's free-coursing function causes qi stagnation, with the Liver invading the Spleen horizontally and promoting damp and phlegm generation; alternatively, prolonged constraint transforming into heat produces intense Stomach heat with rapid digestion and persistent hunger together with internal phlegm-damp accumulation. A sedentary lifestyle and imbalance between activity and rest likewise impair qi movement and allow phlegm-damp to accumulate. As the condition persists, phlegm-damp obstructs qi-blood movement, adding blood stasis so that phlegm and stasis bind together; it may also damage Spleen-Kidney yang qi, and Spleen-Kidney yang deficiency with impaired qi transformation makes water-damp increasingly difficult to resolve. Commonly seen clinical patterns are Stomach heat with damp obstruction, Spleen deficiency with damp exuberance, Liver constraint with qi stagnation, Spleen-Kidney yang deficiency, and phlegm-stasis binding together.

records.western_pathology_en: The core pathophysiology of obesity is chronic caloric intake exceeding energy expenditure, producing a sustained positive energy balance; its causes involve an interplay of genetic predisposition, dysregulation of the hypothalamic appetite-regulation system (leptin and ghrelin signaling), a sedentary lifestyle, and environmental and behavioral factors. Excess weight gain occurs mainly through expansion of adipose tissue, with visceral fat accumulation having the greatest impact; hypertrophied adipocytes secrete excess pro-inflammatory adipokines and free fatty acids, producing chronic low-grade inflammation, insulin resistance, and endothelial dysfunction, which in turn increase the risk of type 2 diabetes, hypertension, dyslipidemia, cardiovascular disease, and certain cancers. Body mass index (BMI) and waist circumference are commonly used clinical measures for assessing the degree of obesity and associated metabolic risk.

records.etiology_zh: 血脂異常在中醫並無獨立病名，多歸屬「痰濁」「血瘀」病理範疇，與飲食、脾胃運化及肝之疏泄關係密切。多因飲食不節，嗜食肥甘厚味，損傷脾胃，運化失司，水穀精微不能正常輸布，反聚濕生痰，痰濁滯留血脈之中；情志失調，肝失疏泄，氣機不暢，血行遲滯，久而成瘀，痰濁與瘀血互結，阻於脈道，日久亦可蒙蔽清竅或閉阻心脈。年老體衰、脾腎兩虛者，運化與氣化俱弱，痰濕更易內生而難化。臨床常見痰濁內蘊、脾虛痰濕、肝鬱氣滯血瘀、痰瘀互結等證型，總以痰濁、血瘀為標，脾（腎）虛為本。
records.western_pathology_zh: 血脂異常是指血液中脂質濃度異常，主要包括低密度脂蛋白膽固醇（LDL-C）及／或三酸甘油酯過高，及／或高密度脂蛋白膽固醇（HDL-C）過低。其成因為遺傳因素（如家族性高膽固醇血症等脂蛋白代謝基因異常）與後天因素（飲食中飽和脂肪與精緻糖攝取過多、缺乏運動、肥胖、糖尿病、甲狀腺功能低下、飲酒過量等）交互作用所致。病理上，過多的低密度脂蛋白顆粒容易滲入並沉積於血管內皮下層，經氧化修飾後引發局部發炎反應，促使巨噬細胞吞噬形成泡沫細胞，逐步形成動脈粥樣硬化斑塊，為冠心病、腦中風等心腦血管疾病之重要危險因子。
records.etiology_en: There is no independent disease name for dyslipidemia in Chinese medicine; it is generally categorized under the pathologies of 'phlegm turbidity' and 'blood stasis,' closely related to diet, Spleen-Stomach transportive function, and the Liver's free-coursing function. It commonly arises from poor dietary habits — excessive intake of rich, greasy food — damaging the Spleen and Stomach and impairing transportation and transformation, so that the essence of food and drink cannot be properly distributed and instead accumulates as damp and condenses into phlegm, with turbid phlegm lodging within the blood vessels. Emotional disturbance impairing the Liver's free-coursing function causes qi stagnation, with blood movement becoming sluggish and, over time, forming stasis; phlegm turbidity and blood stasis then bind together to obstruct the vessels, which over time may also cloud the clear orifices or block the vessels of the Heart. In the elderly or those with combined Spleen-Kidney deficiency, both transportive and transformative function are weak, making phlegm-damp more likely to form internally and more difficult to resolve. Commonly seen clinical patterns are internal accumulation of phlegm turbidity, Spleen deficiency with phlegm-damp, Liver constraint with qi stagnation and blood stasis, and phlegm-stasis binding together — overall, phlegm turbidity and blood stasis are the branch manifestation, with Spleen (or Kidney) deficiency as the root.

records.western_pathology_en: Dyslipidemia refers to abnormal blood lipid concentrations, mainly elevated low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) and/or triglycerides, and/or low high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (HDL-C). Its causes involve an interaction between genetic factors (such as mutations affecting lipoprotein metabolism, as in familial hypercholesterolemia) and acquired factors (excessive dietary saturated fat and refined sugar, lack of exercise, obesity, diabetes, hypothyroidism, excessive alcohol intake, and others). Pathologically, excess LDL particles readily infiltrate and deposit in the subendothelial layer of blood vessels; after oxidative modification they trigger a local inflammatory response, prompting macrophages to engulf them and form foam cells, which progressively build into atherosclerotic plaque — an important risk factor for coronary heart disease, stroke, and other cardio-cerebrovascular diseases.

records.etiology_zh: 骨質疏鬆屬中醫「骨痿」「骨痺」範疇，其病位在骨，與腎關係最為密切，兼涉肝、脾。腎主骨生髓，腎精充盈則骨髓得養、骨骼強健；若先天稟賦不足，或年老體衰，或久病傷腎，腎精漸虧，骨髓失於充養，則骨枯而髓減，骨質脆弱易於折損，此為本病之根本病機。婦女經、孕、產、乳皆易耗傷精血，尤以絕經前後天癸漸竭、腎精更虛，故本病好發於停經後婦女及老年人。肝腎同源，肝血不足亦可累及骨骼失養；脾為後天之本、氣血生化之源，脾虛則氣血生化不足，骨骼失於後天滋養，亦促使骨質疏鬆加重。臨床常見腎陽虛、腎陰虛、脾腎兩虛、肝腎不足兼血瘀等證型。
records.western_pathology_zh: 骨質疏鬆是一種以骨質密度降低及骨微結構破壞為特徵的骨骼疾病，其病理核心為蝕骨細胞（osteoclast）主導之骨吸收作用與造骨細胞（osteoblast）主導之骨形成作用兩者失衡，導致骨吸收速率超過骨形成速率。停經後婦女因雌激素急遽下降，蝕骨細胞活性明顯增加，骨質流失加速，為停經後骨質疏鬆之主要機轉；隨年齡增長，造骨細胞功能亦逐漸衰退，加重骨質流失。其他危險因子包括鈣質及維生素D攝取不足、缺乏負重運動、長期使用糖皮質激素、吸菸、過量飲酒及家族史等。骨質疏鬆本身通常無明顯症狀，多於發生脆弱性骨折（常見部位為脊椎、髖部及腕部）後方才被發現，對高齡族群之生活品質及死亡率影響甚大。
records.etiology_en: Osteoporosis is categorized in Chinese medicine under 'bone wilting' (Gu Wei) or 'bone Bi,' located in the bone and most closely related to the Kidney, with involvement of the Liver and Spleen. The Kidney governs the bones and generates marrow; when Kidney essence is abundant, the marrow is nourished and the bones remain strong. Where there is constitutional insufficiency, age-related decline, or Kidney damage from prolonged illness, Kidney essence gradually becomes deficient, the marrow loses its nourishment, the bone withers and marrow diminishes, and the bone becomes fragile and prone to fracture — this is the fundamental pathomechanism of the disease. In women, menstruation, pregnancy, childbirth, and lactation all readily consume essence and blood, and especially around menopause, as Tiangui gradually becomes exhausted, Kidney essence becomes further deficient — which is why this condition is most common in postmenopausal women and the elderly. Because Liver and Kidney share a common source, Liver blood insufficiency can also leave the bones unnourished; the Spleen is the root of postnatal qi-blood production, so Spleen deficiency reduces qi-blood generation, depriving the bones of postnatal nourishment and further aggravating osteoporosis. Commonly seen clinical patterns are Kidney yang deficiency, Kidney yin deficiency, combined Spleen-Kidney deficiency, and Liver-Kidney insufficiency with blood stasis.

records.western_pathology_en: Osteoporosis is a skeletal disorder characterized by reduced bone mineral density and deterioration of bone microarchitecture. Its core pathology is an imbalance between osteoclast-mediated bone resorption and osteoblast-mediated bone formation, such that the rate of bone resorption exceeds the rate of bone formation. In postmenopausal women, the sharp decline in estrogen markedly increases osteoclast activity and accelerates bone loss, which is the principal mechanism of postmenopausal osteoporosis; with advancing age, osteoblast function also gradually declines, further worsening bone loss. Other risk factors include inadequate calcium and vitamin D intake, lack of weight-bearing exercise, long-term glucocorticoid use, smoking, excessive alcohol intake, and family history. Osteoporosis itself is usually asymptomatic and is often only discovered after a fragility fracture occurs (commonly at the spine, hip, or wrist), which substantially affects quality of life and mortality in older populations.

records.name_zh: 下視丘-腦下垂體-腎上腺軸失調（文件情境）
records.etiology_zh: 此類以長期疲勞、畏寒、睡眠障礙、應激耐受力下降為主訴之狀態，中醫多從「虛勞」「腎虛」「心脾兩虛」等病機論治，而非對應單一病名。多因長期精神壓力、勞倦過度，耗傷心脾之氣，心脾兩虛則神疲乏力、健忘失眠、面色少華；勞倦日久，由脾及腎，腎陽漸虛，命門火衰，溫煦失職，症見畏寒肢冷、腰膝痠軟、精神不振；亦有因思慮過度、暗耗腎陰，致心腎不交，症見心煩失眠、五心煩熱兼疲乏。此類狀態多屬本虛為主，病程遷延，治療當以調補心脾腎、平衡陰陽為原則，並須與確診之腎上腺皮質功能不足（如愛迪生氏病）等器質性疾病相區別，後者屬西醫急重症範疇，不可混淆。
records.western_pathology_zh: 「腎上腺疲勳」（adrenal fatigue）並非西醫內分泌學會正式承認之診斷名稱，目前並無可靠證據支持慢性壓力會導致腎上腺本身功能衰竭。正常生理狀態下，下視丘—腦下垂體—腎上腺軸（HPA axis）透過下視丘分泌促腎上腺皮質素釋放激素（CRH），刺激腦下垂體釋放促腎上腺皮質激素（ACTH），再刺激腎上腺皮質分泌皮質醇，並依晝夜節律調節分泌量。長期或慢性壓力狀態可能造成此軸線之調節失常，如皮質醇日夜波動幅度變平、壓力反應調節能力下降等現象，這與慢性壓力、睡眠不足及情緒耗竭（burnout）相關研究之發現有部分重疊；然而這與真正的腎上腺皮質功能不足（如原發性愛迪生氏病，因腎上腺皮質本身病變導致皮質醇分泌絕對不足，屬可檢驗確診且可能危及生命之疾病）機轉完全不同，兩者不可混為一談。因此，出現長期疲勞、畏寒、應激耐受力下降等症狀者，仍應由西醫排除甲狀腺功能異常、貧血、憂鬱症及真正之腎上腺疾病等器質性病因。
records.etiology_en: The state characterized by chronic fatigue, cold intolerance, sleep disturbance, and reduced tolerance to stress is generally treated in Chinese medicine according to the pathomechanisms of 'vacuity taxation' (Xu Lao), 'Kidney deficiency,' or 'combined Heart-Spleen deficiency,' rather than corresponding to a single named disease. It commonly arises from prolonged mental stress and overexertion consuming Heart-Spleen qi; combined Heart-Spleen deficiency produces fatigue, forgetfulness, insomnia, and a lusterless complexion. With prolonged overexertion, the deficiency extends from the Spleen to the Kidney, Kidney yang gradually becomes deficient, and the mingmen fire wanes, impairing its warming function, producing aversion to cold with cold limbs, lower back and knee soreness, and low spirits. Some cases arise from excessive worry covertly consuming Kidney yin, leading to Heart-Kidney disharmony, with vexation, insomnia, and a feverish sensation in the palms, soles and chest together with fatigue. This state is generally rooted mainly in deficiency, with a protracted course; treatment should follow the principle of regulating and tonifying the Heart, Spleen and Kidney and balancing yin and yang — and this pattern must be clearly distinguished from a confirmed diagnosis of adrenal cortical insufficiency (such as Addison's disease), which is a distinct, potentially life-threatening organic condition in Western medicine and must never be conflated with it.

records.western_pathology_en: 'Adrenal fatigue' is not a diagnosis formally recognized by endocrine societies, and there is currently no reliable evidence that chronic stress causes the adrenal glands themselves to fail. Under normal physiology, the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis operates through hypothalamic release of corticotropin-releasing hormone (CRH), which stimulates pituitary release of adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH), which in turn stimulates cortisol secretion from the adrenal cortex, with output regulated according to a diurnal rhythm. Prolonged or chronic stress may alter the regulation of this axis — for example, a flattened diurnal cortisol curve or reduced capacity to regulate the stress response — findings that overlap partially with research on chronic stress, sleep deprivation, and burnout. However, this is mechanistically distinct from true adrenal cortical insufficiency (such as primary Addison's disease, in which disease of the adrenal cortex itself causes an absolute deficiency of cortisol secretion — a testable, confirmable, and potentially life-threatening condition), and the two should never be conflated. Individuals presenting with chronic fatigue, cold intolerance, or reduced stress tolerance should still be evaluated by a physician to exclude organic causes such as thyroid dysfunction, anemia, depression, and genuine adrenal disease.

records.etiology_zh: 特發性水腫屬中醫「水腫」範疇，其病機關鍵在肺、脾、腎三臟氣化功能失調，導致水液代謝失常，泛溢肌膚。脾主運化水濕，若脾氣虛弱，運化無權，水濕內停，泛溢肌膚，發為肢體浮腫，尤以下肢及久坐久立後為甚，兼見神疲乏力、納呆便溏；腎主水，司開闔，若腎陽不足，氣化無權，水液不得溫化排泄，亦致水濕泛溢，兼見腰膝痠軟、畏寒肢冷；肝主疏泄，調暢氣機及水道，若肝鬱氣滯，氣機不暢，亦可影響水液輸布而致水腫，兼見胸脅脹悶、情緒相關性浮腫加重（如經前浮腫）。外感風邪初起，肺失宣降，通調水道失職，亦可致頭面眼瞼水腫。臨床以脾虛濕困、腎陽不足、肝鬱氣滯三型多見，且常見月經週期或體位變化相關之波動性水腫。
records.western_pathology_zh: 特發性水腫是指反覆發生的體液滯留（多見於女性），經完整評估後仍找不到心臟、腎臟、肝臟或靜脈系統等明確器質性病因者，屬排除性診斷。其可能機轉包括：微血管通透性異常增加，使血漿成分容易滲漏至組織間隙；與姿勢相關的體液分布異常，久站或久坐後液體易積聚於下肢組織間隙（姿勢性因素）；腎素—血管收縮素—醛固酮系統（RAAS）調節異常，導致鈉與水滯留；部分病例可能與雌激素、黃體素等荷爾蒙波動相關，故症狀常隨月經週期波動。診斷過程須先排除心臟衰竭、腎病症候群、肝硬化、深層靜脈栓塞及淋巴水腫等可辨識病因後，方能歸類為特發性水腫。
records.etiology_en: Idiopathic edema is categorized in Chinese medicine under 'water swelling' (Shui Zhong), with the key pathomechanism being dysregulation of the qi-transforming function of the Lung, Spleen, and Kidney, leading to disordered water metabolism and its overflow into the flesh. The Spleen governs the transportation and transformation of water-damp; if Spleen qi is weak and this function is impaired, water-damp accumulates internally and overflows into the flesh, producing limb swelling — especially in the lower limbs and after prolonged sitting or standing — together with fatigue, poor appetite, and loose stool. The Kidney governs water and controls its opening and closing; if Kidney yang is insufficient and qi transformation is impaired, water fluid cannot be warmed and excreted properly, likewise causing water-damp to overflow, together with lower back and knee soreness and aversion to cold with cold limbs. The Liver governs free-coursing and regulates the movement of qi and the water pathways; Liver constraint with qi stagnation can also disturb the distribution of water fluid and produce edema, together with chest and rib-side distension and edema that worsens with emotional fluctuation (such as premenstrual swelling). At the initial stage of external wind invasion, impaired Lung dispersing and descending function can disturb regulation of the water pathways, causing swelling of the face and eyelids. Clinically the three commonly seen patterns are Spleen deficiency with damp encumbrance, Kidney yang insufficiency, and Liver constraint with qi stagnation, with fluctuating edema often related to the menstrual cycle or changes in body position.

records.western_pathology_en: Idiopathic edema refers to recurrent fluid retention (seen mainly in women) for which, after a thorough evaluation, no identifiable cardiac, renal, hepatic, or venous cause can be found — it is a diagnosis of exclusion. Possible mechanisms include abnormally increased capillary permeability, allowing plasma components to leak more readily into the interstitial space; posture-related abnormalities in fluid distribution, with fluid tending to accumulate in the lower-limb interstitial space after prolonged standing or sitting (an orthostatic component); dysregulation of the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system (RAAS), leading to sodium and water retention; and, in some cases, an association with fluctuations in hormones such as estrogen and progesterone, so that symptoms often vary with the menstrual cycle. The diagnostic process must first exclude identifiable causes such as heart failure, nephrotic syndrome, cirrhosis, deep vein thrombosis, and lymphedema before a case can be classified as idiopathic edema.

records.etiology_zh:
在古代沒有「血壓機」，沒有低血壓的定義，所以根本不可能有「低血壓」這種疾病。

然而，可以從低血壓的症狀來推斷，低血壓究竟是哪一種原因所造成的。

由於低血壓常見的症狀是頭暈眼花、視線模糊、疲勞、心悸、手腳冰冷、失眠、呼吸快且淺、耳鳴等。

所以通常會辨證低血壓是心氣虛、脾陽虛、腎虛...等等所造成，相當於中醫「眩暈」、「 虛勞」、 「 暈厥」等範疇。

無論是什麼原因所造成的，低血壓最終的結果就是「氣血兩虛」，體內經絡氣血因為種種原因，鼓動能量不足且無力，導致心臟與頭部的氣血不足，導致血壓下降。

體內氣血不足的人，容易出現低血壓

所以傳統中醫治療低血壓，經常以「補氣血、補虛扶正」為主，常用方劑是補中益氣湯、當歸補血湯等。

然而，一個人氣血兩虛只是結果，原因是什麼造成的呢？如果沒有找到原因，盲目補氣、補血只是治標不治本的一種療法。

要了解一個人低血壓，最簡單的方法就是直接找低血壓的人進行經絡檢測，就可以知道是什麼樣的經絡型態與原因所造成的。

某會員在2023年12月就提出分享，他說他從來也沒有低血壓，也不會蹲下去站起來之後頭暈，低血壓跟他一點關係都沒有。

但是在2023年進入冬季之後，有一天他蹲下去地下撿東西，站起來之後暈到受不了，而且感到有點喘。

後來那兩天，他反覆測試了幾次，確實就是蹲下去之後，站起來就感到很不舒服，幾乎就是站不穩，一定要扶著桌子。家人要求他量血壓，確實是數值偏低。

當天，他也幫自己進行經絡檢測，出現非常低的「體能數值」。由於他已經幫自己檢測超過3年，他清楚知道自己是屬於「寒性陽虛經絡體質」，體質明顯偏寒。

姿勢性低血壓經絡型態

若依照「良導絡」經絡檢測的原理，體能數值這麼低，就是經氣血不足的明顯訊號。所以上面的這張經絡圖，就是氣血不足的象徵。

然而，這位會員提到：「每年我到冬天，都是出現這種低體能數值，但是從來沒有出現姿勢性低血壓？為什麼今年會出現呢？」

他反覆的思考，終於找原因。原來是那兩天工作壓力很大，他連續幾天晚上都沒有睡好，很明顯就是睡眠不足。

所以他要求自己連續3天，每天晚上一定要睡飽，必須提早入睡而且很晚起床，果然測試蹲下站起來之後，就沒有嚴重頭暈了。

從大量現代人的經絡數據，結合一些會員長期的觀察回饋發現，「寒性陽虛經絡體質」體質的人較容易出現低血壓現象，有以下個重要原因：

低體數能數值：體內很寒的人，在進入冬季之後，幾乎都是低體能數值，這是體內氣血不足的明顯訊號。

肝經虛證：絕大多數的人肝經都是實證，但是寒性體質的人在冬季的時候肝經虛證，這很有可能會出現肝血不足的現象。

經絡陽虛：所有通往頭部的經絡，幾乎都是陽經。體內很寒的人通往頭部的經絡氣血是明顯不足的，所以就會出現頭暈、疲勞。

脾胃虛弱：寒性體質的人，體內膽經、胃經、大小腸經、三焦經能量虛弱，所以脾胃虛弱，自然會出現疲勞且低血壓現象。

既然知道經絡的原因，改善的方法就很簡單了。在冬季一定要不斷提升體能數值，不要熬夜讓肝經出現虛證，服用提升脾胃陽氣的中藥，同時持續溫熱與經絡拍打陽經，就可以預防或改善低血壓。

從上面這個真實案例，也可以清楚看到膽經與胃經虛症，而能量最強的小腸經，竟然也出現虛證，這就是典型的陽虛現象。

從其他會員的回報也發現，除了寒性體質的人，長期脾經虛證的人，由於體內脾胃氣血虛弱，也有機會出現低血壓的現象。

總之，如果一個人體內陽經(三焦經、小腸經、大腸經、膽經、胃經、膀胱經)，或是脾經、肝經長期出現氣血不足的狀態，那就很有機會出現低血壓，請各位讀者親自驗證。
records.western_pathology_zh:
低血壓是指血壓低於正常範圍，定義是：收縮壓低於90mmHg，而舒張壓低於60mmHg。

由於一般人不會經常量血壓，而且低血壓也沒有立即性的危險性，所以經常被忽略，不認為這個疾病有什麼嚴重性。

低血壓的常見症狀包括：頭暈(嚴重甚至會暈倒)、眼花與視線模糊、不明原因的疲勞、無力、注意力不集中、心悸、心跳加速、噁心嘔吐、手腳冰冷或身體寒冷、呼吸快且淺。

有些人蹲下去站起來，就會感到嚴重暈眩

低血壓的常見原因包括：

姿勢性低血壓：當姿勢改變時，例如從坐或蹲姿變成站姿，血壓會突然下降，導致大腦血液供應不足，進而出現上述症狀。

靜脈回流不良：少運動的人，長期下肢血循不良，血液淤積在靜脈內，回流到心臟的血液變少而造成低血壓。

貧血：紅血球數量不足，容易衍生出低血壓的問題。

餐後低血壓：好發於年長者，因為吃飽飯後血液進入消化系統而使血壓降低。

藥物副作用：一些藥物，例如降血壓藥、利尿劑、鎮定劑、治療勃起功能障礙藥物等，可能會導致低血壓。

懷孕：孕婦因為體重上升及血流量增加，會使心臟負擔變多，會出現低血壓的症狀，產後就會恢復正常。

其他疾病：一些疾病如甲狀腺疾病、糖尿病、心臟病、腎臟病等，也可能會導致低血壓。

最常見的現象，就是姿勢性低血壓，許多人蹲下去站起來之後頭暈，就是姿勢性低血壓所造成。

當一個人從坐或蹲姿變成站姿時，血壓會突然下降，導致大腦血液供應不足，進而出現頭暈、眼花、視線模糊、耳鳴、耳朵脹痛、噁心、嘔吐、甚至昏厥等症狀。

現代醫學對低血壓的研究是非常清楚的，從經絡的角度來看，也可以對低血壓提出另一條新思路，可以預防低血壓的現象。

records.western_pathology_en:
Hypotension refers to blood pressure below the normal range, defined as: systolic pressure below 90 mmHg and diastolic pressure below 60 mmHg.

Since most people do not measure their blood pressure regularly, and hypotension carries no immediate danger, it is often overlooked, and this condition is not considered to have any seriousness.

Common symptoms of hypotension include: dizziness (in severe cases even fainting), blurred and dimmed vision, unexplained fatigue, weakness, poor concentration, palpitations, a racing heartbeat, nausea and vomiting, cold hands and feet or bodily coldness, and rapid, shallow breathing.

Some people feel severe vertigo when they stand up from squatting

Common causes of hypotension include:

Postural (orthostatic) hypotension: when posture changes — for example from sitting or squatting to standing — blood pressure drops suddenly, the blood supply to the brain becomes insufficient, and the symptoms above then appear.

Poor venous return: in people who exercise little, long-term poor blood circulation in the lower limbs lets blood pool within the veins; the blood returning to the heart decreases, causing hypotension.

Anemia: an insufficient number of red blood cells readily gives rise to the problem of hypotension.

Postprandial hypotension: common in the elderly — after a full meal, blood enters the digestive system and blood pressure falls.

Drug side effects: some drugs — for example antihypertensive drugs, diuretics, sedatives, and drugs for erectile dysfunction — may cause hypotension.

Pregnancy: pregnant women, with rising weight and increased blood volume, bear a greater cardiac load and may show symptoms of hypotension, which return to normal after delivery.

Other diseases: some diseases such as thyroid disease, diabetes, heart disease, and kidney disease may also cause hypotension.

The most common phenomenon is postural hypotension: the dizziness many people feel after squatting down and standing up is caused by postural hypotension.

When a person goes from a sitting or squatting posture to standing, blood pressure drops suddenly, the blood supply to the brain becomes insufficient, and symptoms such as dizziness, dimmed vision, blurred vision, tinnitus, ear fullness and pain, nausea, vomiting, and even syncope may appear.

Modern medicine's research on hypotension is very clear; from the perspective of the meridians, another new line of thinking on hypotension can also be offered, which can prevent hypotensive phenomena.

records.etiology_en:
In antiquity there were no 'blood pressure machines' and no definition of low blood pressure, so a disease called 'hypotension' could not possibly have existed.

However, one can infer from the symptoms of hypotension what kind of cause actually produces it.

Since the common symptoms of hypotension are dizziness and dimmed vision, blurred vision, fatigue, palpitations, cold hands and feet, insomnia, rapid shallow breathing, tinnitus, and the like,

hypotension is usually identified as caused by Heart Qi Deficiency, Spleen Yang Deficiency, Kidney Deficiency, and so on — corresponding to the Chinese medical categories of 'vertigo (xuan yun),' 'Deficiency taxation (xu lao),' and 'syncope (yun jue).'

Whatever the cause, the final outcome of hypotension is 'Deficiency of both Qi and Blood': for various reasons, the body's meridian Qi and Blood lack propulsive energy and strength, the Qi and Blood reaching the heart and head become insufficient, and blood pressure falls.

People with insufficient Qi and Blood in the body readily develop hypotension

Therefore, traditional Chinese treatment of hypotension usually centers on 'tonifying Qi and Blood, supplementing Deficiency and supporting the upright'; commonly used formulas are Buzhong Yiqi Tang (Center-Tonifying Qi-Boosting Decoction), Danggui Buxue Tang (Chinese Angelica Blood-Tonifying Decoction), and the like.

Yet a person's dual Deficiency of Qi and Blood is only the result — what is the cause? Without finding the cause, blindly tonifying Qi and Blood is a therapy that treats only the branch, not the root.

To understand a person's hypotension, the simplest method is to perform meridian testing directly on people with hypotension; one can then know what kind of meridian pattern and cause produce it.

A certain member shared in December 2023: he said he had never had hypotension, never got dizzy standing up from a squat — hypotension had nothing whatever to do with him.

But after winter arrived in 2023, one day he squatted down to pick something up off the floor, and upon standing was dizzy beyond endurance, and felt somewhat short of breath.

Over the following two days he tested repeatedly several times: indeed, after squatting down, on standing up he felt very unwell, almost unable to stand steady, and had to hold onto the table. His family asked him to measure his blood pressure, and the readings were indeed on the low side.

That same day he also performed meridian testing on himself, showing an extremely low 'physical-energy index.' Having already tested himself for over 3 years, he knew clearly that he belonged to the 'Cold-natured Yang-Deficient meridian constitution,' with a constitution clearly leaning Cold.

The meridian pattern of postural hypotension

According to the principle of 'Ryodoraku' meridian testing, such a low physical-energy index is precisely a clear signal of insufficient meridian Qi and Blood. So the meridian chart above is the very image of insufficient Qi and Blood.

However, this member remarked: 'Every year when winter comes, I show this kind of low energy index, but I have never had postural hypotension — why did it appear this year?'

He thought it over repeatedly and finally found the reason. It turned out that in those two days his work pressure had been heavy and he had not slept well for several nights running — quite clearly, sleep deprivation.

So he required of himself that for 3 consecutive days he must sleep his fill each night — going to bed early and rising very late — and sure enough, when he tested squatting down and standing up, there was no longer severe dizziness.

From the meridian data of large numbers of modern people, combined with the long-term observations and feedback of some members, it is found that people of the 'Cold-natured Yang-Deficient meridian constitution' are more prone to hypotensive phenomena, for the following important reasons:

Low physical-energy index: people whose interior is very Cold almost always show a low energy index after winter arrives — a clear signal of insufficient Qi and Blood in the body.

Liver-channel Deficiency: the great majority of people show Liver-channel Excess, but people of Cold constitution show Liver-channel Deficiency in winter, which very possibly indicates the phenomenon of insufficient Liver Blood.

Yang-channel Deficiency: nearly all the channels running to the head are Yang channels. In people whose interior is very Cold, the Qi and Blood of the channels running to the head are clearly insufficient, so dizziness and fatigue appear.

Weak Spleen and Stomach: in people of Cold constitution, the energies of the Gallbladder, Stomach, Large and Small Intestine, and Triple Burner channels are weak, so the Spleen and Stomach are weak, and fatigue and hypotensive phenomena naturally appear.

Once the meridian causes are known, the method of improvement is very simple: in winter one must keep raising the physical-energy index; do not stay up late, lest the Liver channel show Deficiency; take Chinese herbs that raise the Yang Qi of the Spleen and Stomach; and at the same time continue warming and meridian-slapping of the Yang channels — this can prevent or improve hypotension.

From the real case above, one can also clearly see Deficiency of the Gallbladder and Stomach channels, and even the Small Intestine channel — normally the strongest in energy — showed Deficiency: this is the typical Yang-Deficiency phenomenon.

From other members' reports it is also found that, besides people of Cold constitution, those with long-term Spleen-channel Deficiency — whose Spleen-Stomach Qi and Blood are weak — also have a chance of developing hypotensive phenomena.

In short, if a person's Yang channels (Triple Burner, Small Intestine, Large Intestine, Gallbladder, Stomach, and Bladder channels), or the Spleen or Liver channels, long remain in a state of insufficient Qi and Blood, there is a real chance of hypotension appearing — readers are invited to verify this for themselves.

records.etiology_zh: 中醫將本病病因分為實、虛兩端。實證多因情志失調（精神失常）、痰濕積聚內停、病邪侵犯心臟，或久病遷延而致；虛證則多由勞倦過度與久病耗傷所成。
records.western_pathology_zh:
「心律不整」有很多類似名稱，這是指心臟電傳導系統異常，所引起的各種症狀。在正常狀況下，人體的心跳為每分鐘60至100下，若心臟電流傳導系統被各種可能因素所擾亂，導致心跳太快、太慢、不規律等狀況，就稱為「心律不整」。

在科技日新月異之下，現代每一個人都可以透過智慧手錶，或下載手機APP，在一分鐘之內就可以診斷出是否心律不整，有興趣的人可以點選下載[愛心鏡RhythmCam](IOS/Android)。

自從新冠疫情爆發以來，心律不整一直是大家關注的議題，因為青壯年人如果發生猝死，最有可能的原因是「心律不整」。大約有1%~2%的人會出現心律不整，65歲以上的的機率 增至5%~10%。

運用手機APP檢查是否心律不

大約有80%的心律不整都是屬於良性的，多數人沒有察覺，然而有20%屬於惡性，屬於一種心臟疾病，容易產生血栓，這一類人的中風機率是一般人的5倍。

許多心律不整表現是無症狀的，如果有症狀會出現「心悸」，突然感覺心臟的跳動和撞擊。嚴重的心律不整，會出現：胸悶、胸痛、呼吸困難、冒冷汗、血壓低、頭暈、暈厥(感覺快暈倒)、恐慌症...等等。

造成心律不整的原因很多，例如：遺傳、吸菸飲酒過度、喝咖啡、壓力大、電解質不平衡、藥物濫用或副作用、糖尿病、心臟病、睡眠呼吸中止症、高血壓、甲狀腺機能低下或亢進、冠狀動脈心臟病...等等。

大部分的心律不整，可以透過正常作息就可以改善。現代醫學採用抗心律不整藥物(例如：鈉、鉀、鈣離子拮抗劑、乙型交感神經抑制劑)，或是「心導管電燒療法」，有些人會安裝入心律調整器。

中醫對心律不整的看法是從經絡氣血、寒熱這些抽象概念去分析的，現代醫學幾乎不能理解中醫在講什麼？如果一個人在經過現代醫學總總治療之後，效果依然不佳，或是直接想要選擇另類療法，那就可以參考中醫的治療理論。

records.western_pathology_en:
'Cardiac arrhythmia' goes by many similar names; it refers to the various symptoms caused by abnormality of the heart's electrical conduction system. Under normal conditions, the human heartbeat is 60 to 100 beats per minute; if the heart's electrical conduction system is disturbed by any of various possible factors, causing the heartbeat to become too fast, too slow, or irregular, this is called 'arrhythmia.'

With technology advancing by the day, everyone today can determine within one minute whether they have an arrhythmia through a smartwatch or a downloaded phone app; those interested may tap to download [RhythmCam] (iOS/Android).

Since the outbreak of the COVID-19 pandemic, arrhythmia has been a topic of general concern, because when sudden death occurs in young and middle-aged adults, the most likely cause is 'arrhythmia.' About 1-2% of people experience arrhythmia, and the probability rises to 5-10% in those over 65.

Using a phone app to check for arrhythmia

About 80% of arrhythmias are benign, and most people are unaware of them; however, 20% are malignant — a form of heart disease prone to producing thrombi — and the stroke probability of such people is 5 times that of the general population.

Many arrhythmias present without symptoms; when symptoms occur, 'palpitations' appear — a sudden awareness of the heart's beating and pounding. Severe arrhythmias produce: chest tightness, chest pain, difficulty breathing, cold sweats, low blood pressure, dizziness, syncope (feeling about to faint), panic disorder, and so on.

The causes of arrhythmia are many, for example: heredity, excessive smoking and drinking, drinking coffee, heavy stress, electrolyte imbalance, drug abuse or side effects, diabetes, heart disease, sleep apnea, hypertension, thyroid hypofunction or hyperfunction, coronary artery heart disease, and so on.

Most arrhythmias can be improved simply through a regular daily routine. Modern medicine employs antiarrhythmic drugs (for example: sodium, potassium, and calcium ion antagonists, beta-adrenergic blockers), or 'catheter ablation therapy'; some people have a pacemaker implanted.

Chinese medicine's view of arrhythmia proceeds by analysis from abstract concepts such as meridian Qi and Blood and cold-heat, which modern medicine can scarcely comprehend. If, after the various treatments of modern medicine, a person's results remain poor — or one directly wishes to choose an alternative therapy — one may then consult Chinese medicine's treatment theories.

records.name_zh: 心臟衰竭（輔助文件情境）
records.etiology_zh:
中醫並沒有心律不整這種疾病，但是中醫在兩千年前就已經密切觀察這種現象。《黃帝內經》提到：「脈絕不至曰死，乍疏乍數日死。」《傷寒論》也提到「傷寒脈結代，心動悸，主之。」這種「結代脈」，指的就是心律不整。

中醫的脈象中，有6種就是描述心律不整：

促脈：脈來急數有力而呈不規則間歇;

結脈：脈來遲緩而有不規則間歇的脈象;

代脈：脈來緩慢而有規則的間歇，且間歇時間較長的脈象；

數脈或疾脈：脈來急速，每分鐘超過100;

遲脈：脈行遲緩，每分鐘40至50次。

怪脈：屋漏脈(脈搏極遲慢，濺起無力）、遊蝦脈（時而躍然而去，須臾又來）...等等。

古人沒有鈉離子拮抗劑，也沒有電燒技術，更沒有心律調整器，那他們為什麼又可以治療這種症狀呢？這是因為中醫認為心律不整的原因，與現代醫學的立場完全不一樣，主要分類為以下幾種類型：

一、太陽少陰病、心腎陽虛

漢朝《傷寒論》中提到「傷寒脈結代、心動悸，炙甘草湯主之」，所謂「脈結代」的脈象，就是一種心律不整的脈象，同時還伴隨心悸，自覺心跳不安。

這個條文中，以「傷寒」二個字為首，說明其病因是「感受風寒」而起，且表邪尚未解除，又見脈結代，心動悸之證，這是因為少陰裡虛，心失所養所造成。

由於「太陽與少陰互為表裡」，所以太陽病很容易直接切入少陰病！而少陰以「心腎」為主，如果一個人平時心血虛弱、氣血不足，則太陽病之邪解不了，反而進入少陰，損傷心之氣血，就會出現心律不整且心悸。

因此，這種心律不整，也可以說是一種感冒遺留下來的後遺症，可見妥善處理好傷寒感冒，是預防疾病很重關鍵的程序！

二、心脾兩虛、心陽虛、心氣血虛

站在中醫的立場來看，現代人思慮過多，這很容易勞傷心脾，耗傷心血，又會影響脾胃。脾主運化血液，心又主行血，因此心脾兩虛的時候，最容易出現心律不整。

主要症狀是：心悸、健忘、睡眠障礙、夜間多夢、面色萎黃、食慾不佳、容易疲倦、腹脹、大便溏瀉、氣短、皮下出血、婦女月經不調，月經色淡量多、崩漏、月經少或經閉、舌質淡嫩苔白、脈細弱。

除此心脾兩虛之外，類似的證候還有心氣虛、心陽虛、心血虛時，也都會出現心律不整。從大量現代人的經絡數據發現，心經與心包經同步異常的頻率很高。

心經與心包經同步異常機率高

三、脾腎兩虛、水氣上擾凌心

依照中醫理論，脾臟與腎臟運化體內的水液，脾腎陽氣不足時，由於運化水液功能低下，不能布散體內津液，導致水液停聚而稱之為「痰飲」。

痰飲上犯，水氣在體內亂竄，甚至往上衝，就會出現心悸或心律不整。症狀是：胸悶、眩暈、氣喘、短氣、小便短少、咳嗽、咳痰，舌苔水滑，脈沉弦。

腎臟陽氣不足時，因為下半身的寒水亂竄，會出現嚴重頭暈、小便不利、四肢浮腫、肩背酸痛、腹痛腹瀉，這個時候也會出現心律不整，這也可以歸類為傷寒的少陰病。

這類疾病，可以說都是一種「水氣病」，這種經絡型態很容易在秋冬季節出現，而現代醫學也發現秋冬季節容易出現心律不整的現象。

秋冬季節常見的經絡型態

四、肝氣鬱結、肝火擾心

台灣奇美醫院中醫部創立「心律不整特別門診」，將心律不整區分為五種證候。其中一種就是肝氣鬱結、肝火擾心，這是現代人很容易出現的一種證候。

從大量現代人的經絡數據也可以印證這個事實，現代人至少有50%常出現的「鐵三角經絡型態」，就是以肝經實證為主軸所變化出來的一系列經絡型態，其中有一種就非常容易出現心律不整(見下圖)。

鐵三角經絡型態變化型，容易出現心律不整

從圖上可以清楚看出，這種經絡型態異常經絡很多，其中「心經」與「心包經」明顯虛證，體內三焦、大腸、肝經、膽經、胃經實證，可視為肝火、膽火、陽明火氣旺盛。脾經虛證，也可視為是心脾兩虛的現象。

五、氣滯血瘀、經絡不通

中醫診斷很喜歡運用「氣滯血瘀」這四個字，因為只要體內經絡氣血運作不佳時，就一定出現氣滯血瘀。從上面的經絡圖形看來，體內的經絡幾乎都是異常，可以說是全身性的氣血循環不佳。

凡是過度疲勞、年老的人、大病久病之後的人，都很容易出現這種證候，當這些通往胸部的經絡(例如：心經、心包經、肝經、膽經、脾經、胃經、腎經...等等)都阻塞時，人體前半部的氣血可以說都是瘀阻的。

因此，有些人就發現按摩腹部可以從根本來改善心律不整，這是因為腹部的經絡疏通了之後，整個胸部的氣血也會順暢。[@post:58]
records.western_pathology_zh:
「心律不整」有很多類似名稱，這是指心臟電傳導系統異常，所引起的各種症狀。在正常狀況下，人體的心跳為每分鐘60至100下，若心臟電流傳導系統被各種可能因素所擾亂，導致心跳太快、太慢、不規律等狀況，就稱為「心律不整」。

在科技日新月異之下，現代每一個人都可以透過智慧手錶，或下載手機APP，在一鐘之內就可以診斷出是否心律不整，有興趣的人可以點選下載[愛心鏡RhythmCam](IOS/Android)。

自從新冠疫情爆發以來，心律不整一直是大家關注的議題，因為青壯年人如果發生猝死，最有可能的原因是「心律不整」。大約有1%~2%的人會出現心律不整，65歲以上的的機率 增至5%~10%。

運用手機APP檢查是否心律不整

大約有80%的心律不整都是屬於良性的，多數人沒有察覺，然而有20%屬於惡性，屬於一種心臟疾病，容易產生血栓，這一類人的中風機率是一般人的5倍。

許多心律不整表現是無症狀的，如果有症狀會出現「心悸」，突然感覺心臟的跳動和撞擊。嚴重的心律不整，會出現：胸悶、胸痛、呼吸困難、冒冷汗、血壓低、頭暈、暈厥(感覺快暈倒)、恐慌症...等等。

造成心律不整的原因很多，例如：遺傳、吸菸飲酒過度、喝咖啡、壓力大、電解質不平衡、藥物濫用或副作用、糖尿病、心臟病、睡眠呼吸中止症、高血壓、甲狀腺機能低下或亢進、冠狀動脈心臟病...等等。

大部分的心律不整，可以透過正常作息就可以改善。現代醫學採用抗心律不整藥物(例如：鈉、鉀、鈣離子拮抗劑、乙型交感神經抑制劑)，或是「心導管電燒療法」，有些人會安裝入心律調整器。

中醫對心律不整的看法是從經絡氣血、寒熱這些抽象概念去分析的，現代醫學幾乎不能理解中醫在講什麼？如果一個人在經過現代醫學總總治療之後，效果依然不佳，或是直接想要選擇另類療法，那就可以參考中醫的治療理論。

records.name_zh: 反覆泌尿道感染（文件情境）
records.etiology_zh:
排尿困難是指小便不通，尿液點滴難出，這絕對是困擾中國人上千年的症狀，在古代稱為《黃帝內經》稱「癃」或「不得小便」、「癃閉」...等等，類似的名詞非常多。

依照傳統中醫的觀察，小便不通可以分類為以下證候，這同時也可以運用經絡檢測來加以比對驗證，分述如下：

一、外感傷寒(太陽病)

「小便不通」與「小便不利」概念類似，中醫的《傷寒論》可以說整本書有一大半都在處理感冒及其後遺症現象，而其中大量探討「小便不利」的症狀，涉及的條文有37條。

小便不利指的是「尿少或無尿」，「小便不通」是指膀胱中有尿液，但是排出困難，這兩種症狀經常會交替出現。

《傷寒論》將外感傷寒區分為六個階段(太陽病、少陽病、陽明病、太陰病、少陰病與厥陰病)，從熱證到寒證都會出現小便不利。

所謂的太陽病，大部分指的就是「膀胱經」，膀胱不就是管控排尿的主要器官嗎？因此在外感傷寒之後，很容易出現膀胱相關症狀，排尿障礙就是其中一個。

當外在的寒邪之氣進入體內之後，膀胱氣化失職，水液停留在下焦時，就容易出現口渴、口乾一直想要喝水，「尿不出來」或是「頻尿」兩種可能性，最常出現的就是「五苓散」證、「小青龍湯」證。

體內水液同時也與脾臟有關聯，因為「脾主運化」。從大量現代人的經絡數據中發現，膀胱經與脾經的連動性極高，因此當膀胱經異常時，會出現體內水氣運化障礙，就是這麼理所當然了。

膀胱經與脾經連動性高，牽動體內水氣運作

某會員A先生觀察自己身上的經絡長達10年以上，確認自己只要每次有點感冒的感覺就會開始頻尿，然而在夏天的時候，有時候會尿不出來，甚至感覺尿痛，幾乎每次只要立刻服用治療太陽病的「五苓散」就會快速改善，屢試不爽。

對某些人而言，一年四季出現膀胱經與脾經虛證已經成為一種體質現象，因此有些人很容易出現膀胱炎。2022年7月時就有一位男性會員分享，他被診斷出前列腺肥大，經常尿不出來，而他就是典型的「鐵三角經絡體質」。[@ad:1]

二、外感傷寒(少陽病)、肝氣鬱結

當外來寒邪進入少陽病之後，影響到膽經與三焦經，三焦不通時，體內的水氣運化就會出現障礙，因此也容易出現小便不利。同時出現暈眩、口苦、口乾、食慾不佳的現象，最常出現的就是「小柴胡湯」證，或是合併太陽病的「柴胡桂枝湯」證。

現代人由於壓力過大，情緒鬱悶，容易肝氣鬱結。不論是《傷寒論》或是後代中醫都有提出，體內肝氣鬱結時，很容易出現小便不通的現象。

由於情志失調，肝失調達，疏泄不利而出現小便不通、心情鬱悶、多煩善怒、肋痛、失眠、多夢、口苦胃酸、舌紅苔薄黃，脈弦。

從經絡的角度來看，肝經通往整個陰部，因此肝經異常時容易出現泌尿道、陰部的相關疾病。從現代人高機率出現肝經實證的狀況看來，長期坐在辦公室的現代人，容易出現膀胱疾病就是這麼理所當然了！

現代人肝氣鬱結，容易出現肝經實證之鐵三角經絡型態

同時肝經實證的時候，膀胱經與脾經經常出現虛證，呈現所謂的鐵三角型態，因此傳統中醫所說的「肝氣鬱結」造成的小便不通，用圖象化來理解就是這種經絡型態。

三、外感傷寒(陽明病)、下焦濕熱

造成小便困難最常見的狀態，其實是體內過於濕熱，有火氣所造成的，這常常是外感寒邪化熱(陽明病階段)，或是夏天處於濕熱的環境下所造成。常出現尿痛、尿頻、尿急、小便灼熱感、大便秘結，舌質紅、苔黃膩，脈沉數或濡數。嚴重的時候還會出現黃疸。

現代醫學也發現，夏季是膀胱炎高頻率出現的季節。古書《諸病源候論》提到：「小便不通，由膀胱與腎俱有熱故也」，體內濕熱阻滯牓胱，移熱於膀胱，濕熱互結，膀胱氣化失調，導致小便不通。這時候就要運用清熱利尿、瀉火、瀉大便的方法。

從大量現代人的經絡數據中完全可以印證這個事實，從腎經與膀胱經的能量趨勢看來，這2條經絡一起出現虛證的機率，在夏天到達了最高點。

夏季時，腎經與膀胱經虛證機率達到極點

某會女性會員C小姐過去經常開車，找不到廁所時就憋尿，久了就經常膀胱炎，可以說每隔幾個月就出現一次，她的經絡型態就是經常出現腎經與膀胱經虛證，持續觀察了好幾年都保持一樣的經絡型態，就算已經治癒了，也依然是屬於「鐵三角經絡體質」。

因此，要改變一種經絡體質是非常困難的，必須要持之以恆養生，努力提升腎經與膀胱經的能量，才有可能根本改善慢性膀胱炎的體質。

事實上，所謂的陽明病與下焦濕熱，依然沒有逃脫鐵三角經絡型態的範疇。到了夏季的時候，有一定比例的人會出現胃經實證，呈現下圖這種經絡型態，這是很容易出現膀胱炎的。

夏季容易出現型態，其實就是陽明濕熱膀胱炎的模型

在2022年6-7月間，至少有3-5位會員回報出現膀胱炎現象，幾乎都是出現這種經絡型態，這是因為夏季至少有50%的人會出現鐵三角經絡型態，而這種變化型就是常見的一種。[@ad:1]

四、外感傷寒(太陰少陰病)、下焦濕寒及腎氣不足

以上都是在講夏季的鐵三角，進入秋冬之後有沒有機會出現小便不通的機會呢？也是有的，這就是傳統中醫所說的腎氣不足小便不通。

當外感寒邪進入體內進入三陰階段之後，體內就開始變得很寒，進入所謂的少陰病，這個少陰指的就是「腎臟」，腎陽、腎氣不足時，就會出現小便排出無力，尿意頻頻又排尿困難，腰膝痠痛，手腳冰冷的症狀。

現代醫學同時也發現，冬天也是容易出現排尿障礙的季節。這時候只要溫暖腎陽，小便不利的現象就會消失。由於中老年人很容易出現腎陽虛，因此這個年紀的人如果出現小便困難，通常就是這個原因所造成的。

腎陽虛造成的小便不利，在冬天機率很高

從大量現代人的經絡數據中完全可以印證這個事實，從腎經與膽經胃經陽虛的能量趨勢看來，這3條經絡一起出現虛證的機率，在冬天到達了最高點。同時在冬季也有不少會員回報出現小便不通的現象，尤其是45歲以上機率更高。

現代人腎經高機率出現虛證，夏天與鐵三角經絡型態結合，冬天與陽虛經絡型態結合，因此只要是腎氣虛弱的人一年四季都有可能出現小便不通，這是必須要特別注意的。

尤其是男性前列腺肥大，幾乎都是夏季的鐵三角經絡型態，加上冬季的腎陽經經絡型態所構成，這通常要到中年以上才會穩定出現。現代醫學也發現50-60歲有50％機率出現前列腺肥大，完全不謀而合。

因此，善於養生者，一定要提升腎經能量，這樣就可以根本改善慢性長期困擾人的膀胱炎。

五、脾胃虛弱(中氣不足)、下腹部瘀血

傳統中醫還提到所謂的「中氣不足」會造成小便不通，這其實與上面的所有背後原因都是一樣的，由於鐵三角經絡型態脾經長期虛證，因此脾胃運化能力不佳。

上面提到肝氣鬱結的人，通常都會出現脾胃障礙，長期脾胃虛弱的人，也會出現排尿困難，伴隨各種脾胃症狀(食慾不佳、肚子脹氣、大便稀溏...等等)。

除了是季節性的影響，平日生活習慣(壓力、熬夜晚睡)也會造成鐵三角經絡型態，必須要改變生活習慣才會根本改善。

2022年8月初時有一位會員H先生就回報，由於該年夏天非常熱，全球處於熱浪狀態，他幾乎每天都晚上1點才睡。漸漸地發現自己的脾胃功能變差，食慾不佳，白天沒有精神，後腦杓常常暈暈的，經常還會出現背痛，分享經絡圖如下：

2022年經常熬夜造成脾胃虛弱，中氣不足案例

有些人長期喝冰水或寒涼食物，造成腹部經絡阻塞，外是車禍外傷造成下腹部瘀血，也會出現排尿困難，這時候可以運用「經絡療法」，或是運用活血化瘀中藥，將下腹部的瘀血化開，即可改善長期慢性的排尿障礙。

古代中醫也有運用導尿術治療小便不通，由於這是現代醫學的強項，嚴重到需要導尿時，是一定要到醫院去就診的，中醫的角色是用來平時保養及預防疾病才具有意義。
records.western_pathology_zh:
「排尿困難」是指在排尿過程出現困難，尿不出來的現象，有時可能會伴隨疼痛，小便無力需要用力、排尿啟動緩慢、小便延遲、排尿不乾淨(殘尿感)、尿滯留(尿不完)...等等。

小便困難通常是泌尿道感染發炎所引起，但也可能是其他疾病的症狀，例如：中樞神經病變、脊髓外傷、膀胱病變、腫瘤或結石、帶狀泡疹、尿道狹窄、前列腺肥大、過動性膀胱、子宮脫垂、骨盆底肌肉不能放鬆、膀胱頸功能失調、免疫神經疾病...等等。

現代許多女性上班族，因為工作需求而必須久坐、憋尿，讓肌肉長期處於緊繃狀態，逐漸無法放鬆，導致排尿困難。同時，女性膀胱出口阻塞的機率最高達到25%。

年紀大的男性容易出現排尿障礙，約有50%以上是攝護腺肥大引起。長期排尿困難，最終容易造成膀胱、腎臟功能受損及尿毒症，所以一定要儘早治療。

現代醫學治療排尿困難的方法，經常運用藥物，或用手加壓腹部輔助排尿，或運用導尿管或手術治療。醫生會建議進行膀胱訓練，骨盆底肌肉強化訓練(例如：凱格爾運動(Kegel)或提臀運動)。

如果一個人長期出現排尿障礙，又找不出明確的原因或治療效果不佳的時候，就很適合運用中醫的理論來探討，尤其是短暫出現的排尿困難，有可能只是經絡氣血的障礙所造成。
herb_formulas: 桂枝去桂加茯苓白朮湯
records.classical_references_zh:
《丹溪心法.小便不通》：「小便不通，有氣虛、血虛、有痰、風閉、實熱。氣虛用參、耆、升麻等，先服後吐，或參、耆藥中探吐之。血虛四物湯先服後吐，或芎歸湯中探吐亦可。痰多二陳湯先服後吐。已上皆用探吐。若瘀氣閉塞，二陳湯加木通、香附探吐之，以提其氣，氣升則水自降下，蓋氣承載其水也。有實熱者當利之，砂糖湯調牽牛末二三分，或山梔之類。有熱、有濕、有氣結於下，宜清宜燥宜升。」

《辨證錄.小便不通門》：「人有小便不通，點滴不能出，急悶欲死，心煩意躁，口渴索飲，飲而愈急，人以為小腸之熱極也，誰知是心火之亢極乎。夫心與小腸為表裡，小腸熱極而癃閉，乃熱在心而癃閉也。蓋小腸之能開合者，全責之心腎之氣相通也。今心火亢熱，則清氣不交於小腸，惟烈火之相迫，小腸有陽無陰，何能傳化乎？小腸既不能傳化，膀胱何能代小腸以傳化邪？況心腎之氣既不入小腸，亦何能入於膀胱，以傳化夫水哉。治法瀉心中之火，兼利其膀胱，即心腎氣通，小便亦通矣。」

《備急千金要方.膀胱腑》中記載導尿法： 「胞囊者，腎膀胱候也，儲津液并尿。若臟中熱病者，胞澀，小便不通，…為胞屈僻，津液不通。以蔥葉除尖頭，內陰莖孔中深三寸，微用口吹之，胞脹，津液大通，便愈。」

records.etiology_zh:
頻尿困擾著幾乎過去千年來多數的中國人，因此中醫典籍上探討頻尿的內容很多，古人稱之為小便數、癃、溲數、小便稠數...等等。

就中醫的觀點來看，可以從「三焦」的概念來理解頻尿，《黃帝內經.素問》提到:「三焦者，決瀆之官，水道出焉」指出三焦是人體水液運行的主要通道，與小便存在密切聯繫。

由於「三焦」有區分上中下，所以上中下焦有問題時，都會影響到尿液的異常。

「上焦」包含心臟、肺臟，古人認為肺臟有問題的時候，會造成頻尿。「中焦」包含肝膽脾胃，古人主要認為，脾主運化水液，所以脾虛的人容易頻尿。

「下焦」包含腎臟膀胱，這是最直接影響到泌尿系統的部分。《黃帝內經》提到「水泉不止者，是膀胱不藏也」，提出頻尿與「膀胱」腑息息相關，所以下焦有問題的人容易頻尿。

綜合以上，頻尿是體內臟腑調節水液與分佈的功能不佳，中醫認為人體水液調節最直接關的臟腑就是：肺臟、脾臟、腎臟與膀胱。

基於此，來理解頻尿的相關證候就相對容易了，分述如下：

1.外感傷寒影響肺臟、脾臟

中醫《傷寒論》是千古以來治療「外感傷寒」的專書，裡面有多處提到「小便不利」的症狀。

如果從三焦的角度來看，感冒傷寒時一定會影響到肺臟與脾胃，所以影響到上焦、中焦，造成小便障礙。

外感傷寒會影響到肺臟與脾胃消化系統

首先要提到的就是治療太陽病小便不利的「五苓散」，這可以說是千古神方，不論治療無尿或頻尿的效果都很好，具有雙向調節的作用！

古今醫家都認為這屬於「太陽蓄水證」，是膀胱氣化不利所造成，但是近代學者研究後發現(註1)，根據五苓散藥物組成，應該是傷寒影響肺臟與脾臟，造成的三焦不通暢，這是調節人體水液代謝系統的基礎方。

這個推論是完全合理的，雲端中醫有不少會員都是長期脾經虛證症。經常有會員回報，只要外面嚴重下雨時，就會開始頻尿，因為體內的濕氣提升讓脾臟產生運化障礙。

當然更重要的是，他們有一部分的人馬上服用「五苓散」，確實真的很快就改善了這種頻尿現象。

2.脾虛(脾氣虛、脾陽虛)造成水氣病

連續上面提到的脾虛，這不一定是感冒造成的，現代人經常熬夜、用腦過多或是常喝冰水也都會造成脾虛。

古人認為，脾虛的人就會出現頻尿，從大量現代人的經絡數據中發現，現代人高機率「脾經虛證」，也可以證明現代人很容易脾虛。

由於「脾主運化」，當體內脾臟運化水氣的能力不足之後，就會出現「水飲內停」，進而造成頻尿。

脾虛會造成水氣病，出現頻尿症狀

簡單說，頻尿就是「水氣病」(水氣運化障礙)的其中一個症狀，其他症狀還包含：眩暈、心悸、咳嗽氣喘、胸悶氣短、口渴、四肢水腫、食慾減退、舌淡苔白膩或白滑、脈弦滑...等等。

這種脾虛的頻尿，與中醫常說的「肝氣鬱結」、「中氣不足」、「脾胃虛寒」的證候都是類似的，因為這些證候都會包含脾虛，只是運用改善的中藥不一樣。

有些人一喝冰水，一吃吃西瓜就頻尿，這也是因為寒涼食物讓「脾胃虛寒」所造成的結果。總之，脾虛的人就容易頻尿。

每年在進入秋冬季節之後「水氣病」就容易發作，所以這就足以解釋為什麼秋冬之後很容易頻尿。

此外，夏季經常出現的「鐵三角經絡型態」就是脾經虛證。某會員在2024年7月就曾經回報，他連在炎熱的夏季都會頻尿，從他的經絡圖可以清楚看到脾經虛證。

男性鐵三角經絡型態，經常頻尿

除了頻尿之外，他也經常便秘，而且出現皮膚病，伴隨水氣障礙經常出現的口渴現象，這都是很典型的案例。

《傷寒論》就曾經提到：「欲得飲水者，少少與飲之，令胃氣和則愈」。原來，小小口喝水其實是可以用來治病的！

有一些會員也發現，自己感到經常口渴，但是一喝水就會馬上想要尿尿，就好像完全沒有吸收一樣，這就是脾腎氣血虛弱的典型症狀。這種狀況的人不適合大口喝水，小小口喝一樣可以解渴，減少頻尿狀況。

3.肺虛(肺氣虛、脾肺氣虛)

如果從五行來看，脾虛基本上就會肺虛，因為脾胃屬土，肺屬金，脾胃虛弱，土就無法生金，自然就會肺虛，因此通常治療肺氣虛的中藥，裡面都有脾胃藥。

從經絡角度來看，脾氣不升，就無法散精氣與肺部。所以一個人肺臟如果不好的話，也容易頻尿。

肺臟有病的人也會頻尿

而通常一個人肺臟不好，在最初都是外感傷寒沒有處理好，所以又回到最上面提到的外感傷寒。

一個人肺臟虛弱時，除了頻尿之外，還會有其他症狀，例如：氣短、打噴嚏、鼻子癢、流鼻涕、嗅覺喪失、大便秘結、心悸、多痰白痰、怕吹到風、胸悶、咳嗽氣喘、舌淡苔白、脈虛弱。

這可以解釋，為什麼「麻黃加朮湯」這種治療肺部的中藥，也可以改善頻尿。

4.膀胱虛寒、濕熱

討論到現在，基本上都是在探討肺臟與脾臟的問題，頻尿本身就與膀胱有關係。古人發現，不論是「膀胱虛寒」或是「膀胱濕熱」的時候都會造成頻尿。

腎膀胱不論是虛寒，或者是濕熱都會出現頻尿

「膀胱虛寒」的頻尿，會出現色清長像水，伴隨精神疲乏、腰膝酸軟、怕冷畏寒、下肢浮腫、舌淡苔白、脈象沈細。

「膀胱濕熱」的頻尿與尿道炎是類似的，尤其是夏天最容易出現這種頻尿，這是受到夏季又濕又熱的天氣所造成的。症狀是：尿急、尿痛、尿道灼熱感、小便短黃、小腹脹滿、口乾口渴、大便秘結、舌紅苔黃膩，脈滑數。

腎與膀胱互為表裡，頻尿雖然病在膀胱，但其病源在於腎，這是因為腎氣不足而氣化失常的結果，造成膀胱的問題。

所以膀胱的問題還是要跟腎臟一起解決，古人認為腎虛(腎氣虛、腎陰虛、腎陽虛)時就會頻尿，伴隨暈眩、耳鳴、睡眠障礙、腰膝痠軟、大便硬、手腳冰冷、容易疲勞...等等。

從大量現在人的經絡數據也可以印證腎經虛證與頻尿的關係，現代人最常出現的一種經絡現象，就是膽經＋腎經虛證。

某會員在2024年4月的時候就回報，她經常耳鳴且頻尿，而且晚上有睡眠障礙，從圖上就可以清楚看到這種經絡現象。

腎經虛證的人很容易頻尿

運用中藥改善腎膀胱虛寒的現象，提升腎氣就可以改善頻尿，最常運用的就是「八味地黃丸」，運用了千年效果還是很穩定。

名醫「張步桃」在《張步桃藥方妙解》一書中提到：「頻尿到冬天一個晚上要起來七、八次，腎氣丸(八味地黃丸)當然也能夠發揮效用！」

註1:程鍇,etal."《傷寒論》五苓散證的再辨析."中醫藥導報27.11(2021)。
records.western_pathology_zh:
現代醫學對頻尿的定義為：喝水量正常時，一天小便超過8次，晚上起床上排尿超過1-2次就算是頻尿。

造成頻尿的原因非常多，最常見的是喝太多水或利尿飲料(咖啡、茶)、情緒壓力(緊張、不安)、腎臟疾病或膀胱炎(尿路感染)，這最容易造成頻尿。

由於膀胱會隨著年紀增長，彈性慢慢減低，讓儲存尿液的量變少而導致頻尿，所以年紀愈大愈頻尿。

頻尿是讓人感到很困擾的症狀

男性在50歲以上，容易出現前列腺肥大，女性如果有子宮肌瘤過大、懷孕期間或子宮脫垂同樣造成頻尿。

一些藥物的副作用更會造成頻尿，例如：鈣通道阻滯劑、利尿劑、鋰、SSRI(治療抑鬱症)、抗生素...等等。

頻尿的原因超級複雜的，如果不是以上疾病所引起的頻尿，就很適合運用中醫理論，提供另一條新思路。

symptoms_zh: 呼吸急促，氣不接續之症

records.classical_references_zh:
《素問/靈蘭秘典論》云：「膀胱者，州都之官，津液藏焉，氣化則能出矣。」

《傷寒論/辨陽明病脈證并治》：「太陽病，若吐若下若發汗後，微煩，小便數，大便因鞕，與小承氣湯和之癒。」

《張氏醫通/小便不禁》：「是以老年人多頻數者，是膀胱血少，陽火偏旺也，治法宜滋腎水真陰，補膀胱津液為主，而佐以收澀之劑，六味丸加麥冬、五味之類，不可用溫藥也。」

《血證論/便閉》：「又小便數而不禁，大便反閉者，名為脾約。謂脾津下泄，無以潤腸故也。仲景用脾約丸治之。丹溪謂宜清肺燥，肺清則小水有利，而脾得灌溉，宜用清燥救肺湯治之。」

《胎產新書》：「產後氣血虛脫，溝瀆決裂，瀦蓄不固，水泉不止，故數而不禁耳。」
records.western_pathology_en:
Modern medicine defines urinary frequency as follows: with normal fluid intake, urinating more than 8 times a day, or rising to urinate more than 1-2 times at night, counts as urinary frequency.

The causes of urinary frequency are very numerous. The most common are drinking too much water or too many diuretic beverages (coffee, tea), emotional stress (nervousness, anxiety), kidney disease, or cystitis (urinary tract infection) — the causes that most readily produce frequency.

Because the bladder gradually loses elasticity with advancing age, its urine storage capacity decreases and frequency results; hence the older one gets, the more frequent urination becomes.

Urinary frequency is a highly distressing symptom.

Men over 50 are prone to prostatic hyperplasia; in women, an overly large uterine fibroid, pregnancy, or uterine prolapse likewise causes frequency.

The side effects of certain medications can also cause urinary frequency, for example: calcium channel blockers, diuretics, lithium, SSRIs (used to treat depression), antibiotics, and so on.

The causes of urinary frequency are extremely complex. When frequency is not caused by the diseases above, it is very well suited to the application of Chinese medical theory, which provides a new alternative line of thinking.

records.etiology_en:
Urinary frequency has troubled most Chinese people for the past thousand years and more, so classical Chinese medical texts contain a great deal of discussion of it; the ancients called it xiao bian shuo (frequent urination), long (dribbling urinary block), sou shuo (frequent voiding), xiao bian chou shuo (thick, frequent urine), and other such terms.

From the Chinese medical viewpoint, urinary frequency can be understood through the concept of the Triple Burner (San Jiao). The Yellow Emperor's Inner Classic (Su Wen) states: 'The Triple Burner is the official of the sluices; the waterways issue from it,' indicating that the Triple Burner is the principal channel for the movement of body fluids and is closely connected with urination.

Since the Triple Burner is divided into Upper, Middle, and Lower Burners, problems in any of the three can produce urinary abnormalities.

The Upper Burner contains the Heart and Lung; the ancients held that Lung disorders can cause urinary frequency. The Middle Burner contains the Liver, Gallbladder, Spleen, and Stomach; the ancients mainly held that, since the Spleen governs the transformation and transportation of fluids, people with Spleen Deficiency are prone to frequency.

The Lower Burner contains the Kidney and Bladder — the part that most directly affects the urinary system. The Inner Classic states: 'When the water-spring does not cease, the Bladder is failing to store,' proposing that urinary frequency is intimately related to the Bladder fu-organ; hence people with Lower Burner problems are prone to frequency.

Taken together, urinary frequency reflects poor regulation and distribution of fluids by the zang-fu organs. Chinese medicine holds that the organs most directly involved in the body's fluid regulation are the Lung, Spleen, Kidney, and Bladder.

On this basis, the patterns associated with urinary frequency become relatively easy to understand, set out as follows:

1. Externally contracted Cold Damage affecting the Lung and Spleen

The Treatise on Cold Damage (Shang Han Lun) is the definitive text of the ages on treating externally contracted Cold Damage, and it mentions the symptom of 'inhibited urination' in many places.

Viewed from the Triple Burner, a common cold or Cold Damage necessarily affects the Lung and the Spleen-Stomach, thus involving the Upper and Middle Burners and producing urinary disturbance.

Externally contracted Cold Damage affects the Lung and the Spleen-Stomach digestive system.

The first formula to mention is Wu Ling San (Five-Ingredient Powder with Poria), which treats inhibited urination in Taiyang disease. It can be called a divine formula of the ages: it works very well for both absent urination and frequency, exerting a bidirectional regulatory effect!

Physicians ancient and modern have regarded this as the 'Taiyang water-amassment pattern,' caused by impaired Bladder Qi transformation, but modern scholars have found on studying it (Note 1) that, judging from the composition of Wu Ling San, it should rather be Cold Damage affecting the Lung and Spleen and causing obstruction of the Triple Burner; it is the foundational formula for regulating the body's fluid-metabolism system.

This inference is entirely reasonable. Quite a few Cloud TCM members have long-standing Spleen channel Deficiency patterns. Members frequently report that whenever there is heavy rain outside, they begin to experience urinary frequency, because the rise of Dampness in the body impairs the Spleen's transformation function.

More importantly, some of them took Wu Ling San at once, and this urinary frequency truly did improve very quickly.

2. Spleen Deficiency (Spleen Qi Deficiency, Spleen Yang Deficiency) causing Water-Qi disease

Continuing from the Spleen Deficiency mentioned above: it is not necessarily caused by a cold. Modern habits of staying up late, overusing the brain, and frequently drinking iced water also produce Spleen Deficiency.

The ancients held that Spleen-Deficient people develop urinary frequency. Large volumes of meridian data from modern people show a high probability of 'Spleen channel Deficiency patterns,' which also demonstrates that modern people very easily become Spleen Deficient.

Because 'the Spleen governs transformation and transportation,' once the Spleen's capacity to transform and move water becomes insufficient, 'internal retention of water-rheum' appears and in turn causes urinary frequency.

Spleen Deficiency causes Water-Qi disease, with urinary frequency as one symptom.

Simply put, urinary frequency is one symptom of 'Water-Qi disease' (a disorder of water transformation and movement); other symptoms include dizziness, palpitations, cough and wheezing, chest oppression and shortness of breath, thirst, edema of the four limbs, reduced appetite, a pale tongue with a white greasy or white slippery coating, a wiry-slippery pulse, and so on.

This Spleen-Deficiency type of frequency is similar to the patterns Chinese medicine commonly calls 'Liver Qi stagnation,' 'Middle Qi insufficiency,' and 'Spleen-Stomach Deficiency-Cold,' because all of these patterns include Spleen Deficiency; only the herbs used to improve them differ.

Some people develop frequency the moment they drink iced water or eat watermelon; this too results from cold-natured foods producing 'Spleen-Stomach Deficiency-Cold.' In short, Spleen-Deficient people are prone to urinary frequency.

Each year after autumn and winter set in, 'Water-Qi disease' flares easily, which suffices to explain why urinary frequency so readily appears after autumn and winter.

Moreover, the 'Iron Triangle meridian pattern' that frequently appears in summer is precisely a Spleen channel Deficiency pattern. One member reported in July 2024 that he had urinary frequency even in the hot summer, and his meridian chart clearly showed Spleen channel Deficiency.

A male Iron Triangle meridian pattern, with frequent urinary frequency.

Besides frequency, he was also often constipated, had developed skin disease, and had the thirst that frequently accompanies water-metabolism disturbance — all very typical of such cases.

The Treatise on Cold Damage says: 'If he wishes to drink water, give it to him little by little, so that the Stomach Qi is harmonized and he recovers.' It turns out that drinking water in small sips can actually be used to treat disease!

Some members have also found that they feel thirsty all the time, yet want to urinate immediately after drinking, as if the water were not absorbed at all — a typical symptom of Spleen-Kidney Qi and Blood weakness. People in this situation should not gulp water in large mouthfuls; small sips quench thirst just as well while reducing the frequency.

3. Lung Deficiency (Lung Qi Deficiency, Spleen-Lung Qi Deficiency)

Viewed through the Five Phases, Spleen Deficiency essentially entails Lung Deficiency: the Spleen-Stomach belongs to Earth and the Lung to Metal; when the Spleen-Stomach is weak, Earth cannot generate Metal, and Lung Deficiency naturally follows. Hence formulas that treat Lung Qi Deficiency ordinarily contain Spleen-Stomach herbs.

From the meridian perspective, when Spleen Qi fails to ascend, it cannot disperse essence-Qi to the Lung. So a person whose Lung is unwell is also prone to urinary frequency.

People with Lung disease also develop urinary frequency.

And usually, when a person's Lung is unwell, it began with externally contracted Cold Damage that was not properly resolved — which brings us back to the external contraction discussed at the very top.

When a person's Lung is weak, besides frequency there are other symptoms as well, for example: shortness of breath, sneezing, itchy nose, nasal discharge, loss of smell, constipation, palpitations, copious white phlegm, aversion to drafts, chest oppression, cough and wheezing, a pale tongue with white coating, and a weak pulse.

This explains why Ma Huang Jia Zhu Tang (Ephedra Decoction plus Atractylodes), a Chinese formula that treats the Lung, can also improve urinary frequency.

4. Bladder Deficiency-Cold and Damp-Heat

The discussion so far has essentially concerned the Lung and Spleen, but urinary frequency is of course related to the Bladder itself. The ancients found that both 'Bladder Deficiency-Cold' and 'Bladder Damp-Heat' cause urinary frequency.

Whether the Kidney-Bladder is Deficient-Cold or Damp-Hot, urinary frequency appears.

In 'Bladder Deficiency-Cold' frequency, the urine is clear, copious, and watery, accompanied by mental fatigue, soreness and weakness of the lumbar region and knees, aversion to cold and chilliness, edema of the lower limbs, a pale tongue with white coating, and a deep, thin pulse.

'Bladder Damp-Heat' frequency resembles urethritis and appears most readily in summer, produced by the hot and humid summer weather. The symptoms are: urinary urgency, painful urination, a burning sensation in the urethra, scanty dark-yellow urine, lower-abdominal distension and fullness, dry mouth and thirst, constipation, a red tongue with a yellow greasy coating, and a slippery, rapid pulse.

The Kidney and Bladder stand in an interior-exterior relationship. Although frequency manifests as disease of the Bladder, its source lies in the Kidney: it is the result of insufficient Kidney Qi with disordered Qi transformation, which produces the Bladder problem.

Bladder problems must therefore be resolved together with the Kidney. The ancients held that Kidney Deficiency (Kidney Qi Deficiency, Kidney Yin Deficiency, Kidney Yang Deficiency) produces frequency, accompanied by dizziness, tinnitus, sleep disturbance, soreness and weakness of the lumbar region and knees, hard stools, cold hands and feet, easy fatigue, and so on.

Large volumes of meridian data from modern people also corroborate the relationship between Kidney channel Deficiency and frequency; one of the meridian phenomena most commonly seen in modern people is Gallbladder channel plus Kidney channel Deficiency.

One member reported in April 2024 that she often had tinnitus and urinary frequency, with sleep disturbance at night; this meridian phenomenon could be seen clearly on her chart.

People with Kidney channel Deficiency are very prone to urinary frequency.

Using Chinese herbs to improve Kidney-Bladder Deficiency-Cold and raise Kidney Qi can improve frequency. The most commonly used formula is Ba Wei Di Huang Wan (Eight-Ingredient Rehmannia Pill), whose effect has remained stable through a thousand years of use.

The renowned physician Zhang Bu-Tao wrote in his book Ingenious Explanations of Zhang Bu-Tao's Prescriptions: 'For frequency so severe that in winter one must get up seven or eight times in a night, Shen Qi Wan (Ba Wei Di Huang Wan) can of course take effect!'

Note 1: Cheng Kai, et al. 'A Re-analysis of the Wu Ling San Pattern in the Treatise on Cold Damage.' Guiding Journal of Traditional Chinese Medicine and Pharmacy 27.11 (2021).

records.name_zh: 良性攝護腺肥大（文件情境）
records.etiology_zh: 西醫病因病機：二氫睪固酮（DHT）刺激攝護腺內的生長因子，引起腺體增生（hyperplasia），腺體體積隨之增大；症狀多於五十歲以後開始出現。中醫方面，本病按虛實辨證：實證包括下焦濕熱、肝氣鬱結與下焦血瘀；虛證包括腎陰虛、腎陽虛、脾氣虛（下陷）與脾陽虛。
records.western_pathology_zh: 攝護腺為一核桃大小的腺體，位於膀胱與陰莖之間，其分泌的腺液可滋養並保護精子。良性攝護腺增生（BPH，又稱良性攝護腺肥大）即攝護腺腺體增大；其病理機轉為 DHT 刺激攝護腺內的生長因子，導致腺體增生、體積增大。病情嚴重時可導致膀胱無力、尿液逆流引起膀胱或腎臟感染、尿流完全阻塞，甚至腎衰竭。
herb_formulas: 當歸四逆加吳茱萸生薑湯
records.classical_references_zh:
《證治要訣·白濁》曰：​」白濁甚……此精濁窒塞竅道而結。​」​

《證治匯補·下竅門·便濁·附精濁》云：​「精濁者，因敗精流
於尿竅，滯而難出。​」

​《王旭高臨證醫案·遺精淋濁門·淋濁》雲：​「水竅精竅，異路同門，二竅不併開，水竅開，則溼熱常泄，相火常寧，精竅常閉。​」

《類證治裁·淋濁·論治》言：​「有過服金石，入房太甚，敗精瘀結而成淋者。​」

清代葉天士在《臨證指南醫案·淋濁》中的一則案例後評論道：​「若房勞強忍，精血之傷，乃有形敗濁阻於隧道，故每溺而痛。徒進清溼熱、利小便無用者，以溺與精同門異路耳。​」上述文獻都強調了瘀阻在慢性前列腺炎發病中的重要性。

《臨證指南醫案·鬱》曰：​「因情志不遂，則鬱而成病矣……皆因鬱則氣滯，氣滯久必化熱，熱鬱則津液耗而不疏，升降之機失度，初傷氣分，久延血分，延及鬱勞成沉痾。​」

《景嶽全書·虛勞門》曰：​「淫慾邪思又與憂思不同，而損唯在腎。蓋心耽慾念，腎必應之，凡君火動於上，則相火應於下……故其在腎，則爲遺淋帶濁。​」

records.etiology_en: Western etiology and pathogenesis: the presence of dihydrotestosterone (DHT) stimulates growth factors in the prostate, leading to hyperplasia with a resulting increase in glandular size; symptoms usually start after the age of 50. In Chinese medicine the condition is differentiated into excess patterns — damp-heat in the lower jiao, Liver qi stagnation, and blood stasis in the lower jiao — and deficiency patterns — Kidney yin deficiency, Kidney yang deficiency, Spleen qi deficiency/sinking, and Spleen yang deficiency.
records.western_pathology_en: The prostate is a walnut-sized gland located between the bladder and the penis; it secretes fluid that nourishes and protects sperm. Benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH), also known as benign prostatic hypertrophy, is an enlarged prostate gland: DHT stimulates growth factors in the prostate, leading to hyperplasia with the resulting increase in size. At their worst, severe cases can lead to a weak bladder, backflow of urine causing bladder or kidney infections, complete blockage of urine flow, and kidney failure.

records.name_zh: 慢性攝護腺炎／慢性骨盆疼痛
records.etiology_zh:
古代中醫雖然沒有前列腺增生的這個疾病，但是古人曾經記載不少類似的症狀與疾病，例如「白濁」、「精濁」、「癃閉」...等等。

現代醫學發現，前列腺增生容易出現在50歲後，遠在《黃帝內經》就提到，隨著年齡增長，男性腎氣逐漸衰退，就會出現腎氣虛弱的現象。

原文是這樣描述「丈夫五八，腎氣衰，髮墮齒槁；七八，肝氣衰，筋不能動，天癸竭，精少，腎藏衰，形體皆極。」

白話意思是，當男人到了40歲左右，腎氣開始衰退，會出現掉頭髮和牙齒失去光澤的情況。

到了五十六歲左右，肝氣也開始減弱，筋骨不再靈活，體內的精氣減少，腎臟功能下降，整個身體的狀態都會達到一個極限。

古人發現40歲以後男人的腎氣就開始虛弱

傳統中醫普遍認為，此病的病位主要在中醫的腎臟、膀胱及精室，疾病初起以實證居多，日久以虛證居多，病因病機錯綜複雜，基本是濕熱、腎陽虛、肝氣鬱結、氣滯血瘀所造成。

關於男性的前列腺疾病，現代中醫師研究的更為透徹。當代中醫研究名家曲黎敏，在《曲黎敏講黃帝內經》書中明確提到，男性會得到前列腺疾病，一般有三個原因：

忍精不瀉：只要是男人，只要欲念一動，前列腺就會帶著精子出來一小部分，但是使勁憋著不洩精，就容易得前列腺肥大。有些男性認為只要忍精不洩就不會傷害身體，但他不知道的是，欲念一動，精就動，就好比「拉出的屎坐不回去」​，把已經動了的精生生憋回去，已然是敗精，久之則化膿，成炎症，再遇鬱悶寒邪就容易成癌。

久坐不運動

老了，陽氣虛，不能化精，氣瘀、精瘀，就會得病。

以上三種以大白話解釋的原因，事實上就把現代男性會得到前列腺疾病的原因都清楚分析了。尤其是第一點，經常就是現代男性罹患前列腺疾病的主要原因。

所以嚴格說起來，前列腺疾病的背後一定伴隨情緒的相關困擾，一個男人會人忍精不瀉，多半有複雜的心理因素所造成。

忍精不瀉有機會造成攝護腺肥大

大國大陸李海松教授針對男科疾病有非常深入的研究，在《李海松男科指掌》書中提到，「從慢性前列腺炎病因來看，除少數病例有感染性因素以外，絕大多數發病是由不良的生活方式所致。」

「常見的如夫妻分居、忍精不洩、長期酗酒、嗜食辛辣、久坐濕冷之處或長途騎車擠壓、寒冷刺激等，均可導致前列腺導管舒縮功能障礙，前列腺液排出不暢，血液運行障礙，代謝廢物瘀積引起炎症。」

簡而言之，前列腺疾病通常源於下腹部、泌尿系統及陰部附近的經絡長期不暢，造成氣滯和血瘀。

這符合中醫理論中「久痛入絡」、「不通則痛」、「瘀滯則腫」和「瘀滯則凝」的概念。

由於多種原因，患者的絡脈氣滯不通，常見於少腹、睪丸、陰囊、恥骨及肛周等部位出現脹痛或刺痛。

邪氣在絡脈中滯留，導致血液流通不暢形成瘀滯，而津液凝滯則表現為痰。隨著時間的推移，氣滯、血瘀和痰濁逐漸凝聚形成積聚，使前列腺局部出現硬結、腫大，並導致精液液化不完全。

改善的方法很明確，就是運用經絡療法或中藥疏通經絡，去除體內的寒氣、濕氣，或是火熱，依照個別現象來對症下藥。

如果從經絡來理解前列腺的疾病，最簡單的方法就是找一個有前列腺增生的人來進行經絡檢測，就可以知道背後原因。

現代醫學發現前列腺疾病主要發生在中老年人男性身上，從大量現代人經絡數據中發現，通常這種年齡的人，最常出現「綜合經絡型態」，或是「上實下虛」。

下面這位會員就是典型的攝護腺肥大案例，這就是典型的「上實下虛」經絡型態，他是一位肥胖的男性，平常很頻尿卻排尿困難(常常要等很久)，這讓他非常困擾。

男性出現綜合經絡型態之上實下虛，有機會出現前列腺疾病

這種經絡型態的特點，就是體內寒氣重，下半身經絡(肝經、脾經、腎經、膀胱經、膽經與胃經)全部不暢通，通往下腹部泌尿系統及陰部附近的經絡當然也不通，久了一定生病，時間越久也就是年紀越大則越嚴重。

年輕人較不容易出現這種經絡型態，最有可能的原因，就是久坐、不運動。年輕人如果出現這種經絡型態，只要起來運動就會快速改善。

基於此，幾乎可以推斷，一個人如果從年輕就不運動，整天坐著不起身。到中年以後就很有可能出現這種經絡型態，產生前列腺疾病的基本模型。

如果這種人還整天不運動，經常坐著、躺著看色情網站，經常自慰又忍精不射的話，幾乎就可以確認他難逃各種前列腺疾病的困擾。

久坐不運動，容易出現下腹部經絡阻塞

從大量現代人的經絡數據也發現，「上虛下實」及「上實下虛」都代表肚子經絡有阻塞，所以有一定比例的前列腺增生會員，體內確實出現「上虛下實」的經絡型態。

所以不論「上實下虛」或「上虛下實」都要預防這個疾病，小部分比例的鐵三角經絡體質的人，也出現前列腺增生。

用最簡單的概念來理解前列腺增生，就是下腹部的經絡不通，所以從小到大都要疏通經絡，就可以精確預防前列腺疾病。

最主要的經絡有肝經、腎經、脾經。當膽經與胃經虛證時，也會造成前列腺的疾病，至於體內寒氣很重有密切的關係，所以必須溫陽。

除了平時要經常按摩、經絡拍打疏通經絡，配合服用中藥調整寒熱之外，身為男性一定要知道，只要慾念一動，前列腺液就會流出，忍精不瀉完全是錯誤的。

從根本解決的方法就是透過修煉昇華慾望，做不到就就只能正常瀉精，千萬不能忍精不瀉，造成複雜難治的疾病。
records.western_pathology_zh:
良性前列腺增生症，又稱「前列腺肥大」或「攝護腺肥大」，是男性隨著年齡增長而常見的疾病。

通常在35歲後開始出現增生，50-60歲的男性50%產生問題，到了80-90歲則有90%的男性有攝護腺肥大的症狀。

早期最常見的症狀包括夜間和日間頻尿、排尿困難、小便無法立即排出。有時會出現滴尿現象，尿量少且排尿無力，排尿時間延長，並常感覺排尿不盡，甚至需要用手壓腹部以協助排尿。

由於排尿不暢，患者易併發細菌性膀胱炎、膀胱結石、前列腺炎及尿路感染，嚴重時可能導致腎功能不全。

一般而言，多數人罹患這種疾病會主動選擇現代醫學治療，如果中醫及經絡的角度來觀察理解，依然是可以預防，甚至改善這種疾病。

《證治要訣·白濁》曰：​」白濁甚……此精濁窒塞竅道而結。​」​

《證治匯補·下竅門·便濁·附精濁》云：​「精濁者，因敗精流
於尿竅，滯而難出。​」

​《王旭高臨證醫案·遺精淋濁門·淋濁》雲：​「水竅精竅，異路同門，二竅不併開，水竅開，則溼熱常泄，相火常寧，精竅常閉。​」

《類證治裁·淋濁·論治》言：​「有過服金石，入房太甚，敗精瘀結而成淋者。​」

清代葉天士在《臨證指南醫案·淋濁》中的一則案例後評論道：​「若房勞強忍，精血之傷，乃有形敗濁阻於隧道，故每溺而痛。徒進清溼熱、利小便無用者，以溺與精同門異路耳。​」上述文獻都強調了瘀阻在慢性前列腺炎發病中的重要性。

《臨證指南醫案·鬱》曰：​「因情志不遂，則鬱而成病矣……皆因鬱則氣滯，氣滯久必化熱，熱鬱則津液耗而不疏，升降之機失度，初傷氣分，久延血分，延及鬱勞成沉痾。​」

《景嶽全書·虛勞門》曰：​「淫慾邪思又與憂思不同，而損唯在腎。蓋心耽慾念，腎必應之，凡君火動於上，則相火應於下……故其在腎，則爲遺淋帶濁。​」

records.etiology_zh: 西醫病因分為心因性與疾病性兩類：心因性者多與性興奮、性吸引有關，約佔10–20%，此型預後較佳；疾病性常見致病因素包括高血壓、動脈粥樣硬化、糖尿病、吸菸與飲食因素、前列腺切除術、骨盆腔手術、陰莖、骨盆、脊髓及腦部之外傷、骨盆腔放射治療、激素缺乏或過多、神經系統疾病及藥物副作用。中醫稱本病為陽痿（又名陰痿、筋痿），僅發生於年齡未逾天癸「八八」之男性。其病因計有十一項：一、先天稟賦不足；二、命門火衰；三、心脾兩虛；四、情志所傷（肝氣鬱結、恐傷腎）；五、濕熱下注下焦；六、陰液虧虛；七、陰陽兩虛；八、痰濕阻滯；九、局部阻滯；十、寒滯肝脈；十一、氣滯血瘀。
records.western_pathology_zh: 勃起功能障礙（ED）為「陽痿」之現代醫學名稱，屬男性性功能障礙，特徵為在性活動中持續無法產生或維持足以完成滿意性行為之陰莖勃起。西醫將其病因病理分為兩類：心因性因素多與性興奮、性吸引相關，約佔10–20%，預後較佳；疾病性因素方面，高血壓、糖尿病以及吸菸、飲食等因素導致動脈粥樣硬化，膽固醇沉積於血管內；其他病因尚包括前列腺切除術、骨盆腔手術、陰莖、骨盆、脊髓與腦部之損傷、骨盆腔放射治療、激素缺乏或過多、神經系統疾病及藥物副作用。

records.etiology_en: In Western medicine the causes fall into two categories: psychogenic causes, usually associated with sexual arousal or sexual attraction, accounting for about 10–20% of cases and carrying a better prognosis; and disease causes, commonly hypertension, atherosclerosis, diabetes mellitus, smoking and dietary factors, surgical removal of the prostate gland, pelvic operations, injuries to the penis, pelvis, spinal cord or brain, radiation therapy to the pelvis, lack or excess of hormones, neurological disorders, and side-effects of medications. In Chinese medicine the condition is called Yang Wei and occurs only in males not beyond the "8x8" age of Tian Gui. Eleven causes are recognized: (1) poor congenital constitution; (2) Ming Men fire deficiency; (3) Heart and Spleen deficiency; (4) emotional injury (Liver qi stagnation; fear injuring the Kidney); (5) damp-heat invading the lower jiao; (6) yin-fluid deficiency; (7) combined yin and yang deficiency; (8) phlegm-damp blockage; (9) local blockage; (10) cold invading the Liver meridian; (11) qi stagnation with blood stasis.
records.western_pathology_en: Erectile dysfunction (ED), the medical term for impotence, is a male sexual dysfunction characterized by the persistent inability to develop or maintain a penile erection satisfactory for sexual performance. Western medicine divides its etiology and pathology into two groups: psychogenic causes, usually associated with sexual arousal or sexual attraction, making up about 10–20% of cases with a better prognosis; and disease causes, in which hypertension, diabetes mellitus, smoking, and diet lead to atherosclerosis with cholesterol deposits in the blood vessels, and other factors include surgical removal of the prostate gland, operations in the pelvis, injuries to the penis, pelvis, spinal cord and brain, radiation therapy to the pelvis, lack or excess of hormones, neurological disorders, and side-effects from medications.

records.etiology_zh:
夜間頻尿/多尿確實是困擾中國人千年以上的症狀，早在西元600年時，古籍《諸病源候論》就清楚記載：「小便利多者，由膀胱虛寒，胞滑故也。腎為臟，膀胱腎之腑也，其為表裡俱主水。腎氣下通於陰，府既虛寒，不能溫其臟，故小便白而多，其至夜尿偏甚者，則內陰氣生是也。」

這句話的意思，就是小便頻繁是因為「膀胱虛寒」所造成。膀胱是腎的附屬器官，兩者是表裡關係，都主水。

腎氣下行到陰部，膀胱既然虛寒，就不能溫暖腎臟，所以小便白而多。如果夜尿特別多，那是因為內部「陰寒之氣」旺盛。

所以，古人認為膀胱虛寒是指膀胱的陽氣不足，就會導致小便不易控制，因此小便頻繁。夜尿特別多，是因為夜間陽氣更弱，膀胱更容易受寒。

古人認為腎臟膀胱陰寒是造成頻尿原因

以下是一些小便頻繁的常見症狀：

小便次數明顯增多，白天或晚上都會頻繁上廁所。

小便量較少，尿液清澈透明。

小便不易控制，容易尿失禁。

小腹發涼，腰酸背痛。

基於此，幾乎後代中醫師在診斷夜間頻尿都是沿用這個概念。所謂腎主水，司開闔，膀胱主藏尿液，故夜間多尿與中醫的腎臟、膀胱密不可分。

而白天是「陽」，夜間為「陰」，夜間陰盛陽衰，因此，夜間多尿就是陽氣虛弱所致。

簡單一句話解釋：不論是白天或是夜間頻尿/多尿，都是腎、膀胱的陽氣不足所造成的。

2023年11月就有一位會員分享，他說進入秋冬之後，他很明顯晚上夜尿的頻率增高，以前晚上只有一次，現在竟然有兩次，而且每次尿量都很大，而且尿液清澈透明，但是他睡前並沒有喝太多水。

由於他已經幫自己經絡檢測3年了，確認自己屬於「寒性陽虛經絡體質」，每年到冬天都是這樣。

他說：「其實不是只有冬天，就算是夏天，只要待在溫度太低的冷氣房，他都會馬上變得很頻尿，尤其是下午之後更明顯。」

所謂的「寒性陽虛經絡體質」，就是經常會出現膽經、胃經與腎經虛證，或是膽經＋腎經虛證，就像下圖一樣，這就是很容易頻尿/夜尿的經絡型態。

陽虛體質最常見的經絡型態

從上圖可以輕易看出，天氣冷的時候，也就是溫度降低的時候，這種經絡型態出現的機率會提高，完全印證了古代的中醫理論。

所以，就算沒有幫自己進行經絡檢測，這種經絡現象也在多數人身上會出現，所以冬天出現頻尿/夜尿的機率比夏季還要高。

除了這種陽虛經絡型態之外，另外一種常見的「鐵三角」也有可能造成頻尿/夜尿。

某會員長期觀察自己的經絡，確認自己是屬於「鐵三角」經絡體質，她就是經常每天晚上頻尿/夜尿，所以經常會影響到睡眠。

有大量比例的鐵三角經絡型態的人，很容易出現「腎經虛證」的現象，這種經絡型態就是脾經虛證、腎經與膀胱經虛證，當然就是腎氣/膀胱氣血不足了，嚴重性不亞於陽虛經絡現象。

鐵三角經絡型態也會出現腎經虛證

所以，古代中醫師才會發現「肝鬱血虛」、「脾虛濕盛」、「肝腎不足」、「心脾兩虛」、「脾腎兩虛」...等等，也會造成頻尿/夜尿，運用經絡數據完全可以印證。

基於此，改善夜尿的治療方法就開始複雜起來，就不是只有治療「腎虛」或「寒氣」這麼簡單了！

有一定比例的人，經絡體質偏向於「綜合經絡體質」，也就是體內有一些鐵三角，也有一些寒氣，所以一定都是腎經虛證，更難逃頻尿的困擾。

通常夜尿的人，還會同時出現的其他症狀，例如：暈眩、憂鬱疲倦、耳鳴、重聽、腰酸背痛、滑精、早瀉、膝蓋痛、腹瀉、四肢冰冷、食慾不佳...等等。

不論哪一種原因造成的腎虛，只要正確養生，把腎經能量提升，夜尿的症狀就會改善。體內寒氣重的人，只要去除體內的寒氣，提升體內的陽氣，讓身體暖暖的，頻尿/夜尿就會改善。

用腦過多，或是過度疲累，壓力過大的人，就要從放鬆身心靈下手，配合服用一些調和肝脾腎的中藥，就可以根本改善頻尿/夜尿。

只要找到屬於自己的原因，加以順勢養生改善異常經絡，長年困擾的頻尿/夜尿就會改善，每個人都可以親身驗證。
records.western_pathology_zh:
「夜尿症」是一種讓人在夜間不得不醒來小便的病症，多數人在夜間醒來一次小便是很常見的，但是超過2次以上就不是正常現象，這會嚴重影響夜間睡眠。

夜尿主要有「夜間頻尿」及「夜間多尿」兩種狀況，夜間頻尿是指尿的頻率，夜間多尿是指尿量的多少，當夜間尿量大時，就不是正常狀態。

不論男女，夜間頻尿發生機率與年齡正相關，20至40歲發生率約20%，60至80歲約60%，80歲以上約80%，年紀愈大愈容易出現這種現象。

造成夜間多尿的原因很多，氣溫經常是主因，當冬天氣溫下降時，由於人體較少流汗，水分無法經由汗腺排出，加上低溫刺激交感神經，尿道括約肌收縮，自然會比較頻尿。

天氣冷的時候很容易頻尿及多尿

此外，荷爾蒙失調、膀胱收縮力降低經常是主因。由於睡覺時，身體會分泌「抗利尿激素」，這會讓尿量減少、尿液濃縮，如果夜間尿量還非常多，通常是因為抗利尿劑素分泌不足的關係。

男性如果攝護腺肥大，會造成膀胱容積減少增加夜尿。女性會因泌尿道感染發炎，造成尿急、夜尿等症狀。有些人是整天頻尿或多尿，這有可能是相關疾病，例如：糖尿病、尿崩症或多渴症所引起。

有些人的夜間頻尿是假的，事實上是「睡眠障礙」，在床上翻來覆去時，對膀胱裡尿液會特別敏感，即使尿量只有一點點，還必須把尿液排空才能安心入睡。因此，夜尿會造成睡眠障礙，睡眠障礙也會夜尿。

改善夜尿最直接的方法就是改變生活習慣，例如：睡前4小時內儘量少喝水或茶、咖啡、酒精、水果...等等，養成睡前先將尿液排空的習慣。睡前靜坐放鬆，改善改善睡眠狀態、多運動排汗、減肥、睡覺時要晚暖..等等。

現代醫學運用藥物來治療夜尿，常用的如：利尿劑、抗憂鬱症藥物、女性荷爾蒙、血管收縮素、組織銨...等，對於膀胱功能喪失、攝護腺肥大阻塞、膀胱腫瘤、結石、尿道狹窄則運用手術改善。

如果一個人並沒有相關疾病，只是不明原因的夜間頻尿，其實可以參考中醫的概念，依然可以明顯改善夜間頻尿或多尿。

records.western_pathology_en:
'Nocturia' is a condition that compels a person to wake at night to urinate. Waking once during the night to urinate is common for most people, but more than 2 times is not a normal phenomenon and severely disrupts nighttime sleep.

Nocturia mainly comprises two situations, 'nocturnal urinary frequency' and 'nocturnal polyuria': nocturnal frequency refers to how often one urinates, while nocturnal polyuria refers to the volume of urine; a large nighttime urine volume is not a normal state.

In both men and women, the incidence of nocturnal frequency correlates positively with age: the incidence is about 20% at ages 20 to 40, about 60% at 60 to 80, and about 80% over age 80 — the older one is, the more readily this phenomenon appears.

There are many causes of nocturnal polyuria, and ambient temperature is often the main one. When temperatures fall in winter, the body sweats less and water cannot be expelled through the sweat glands; in addition, low temperature stimulates the sympathetic nervous system and the urethral sphincter contracts, so urination naturally becomes more frequent.

Urinary frequency and polyuria readily occur in cold weather.

Furthermore, hormonal imbalance and reduced bladder contractility are often primary causes. During sleep the body secretes 'antidiuretic hormone,' which reduces urine volume and concentrates the urine; if nighttime urine volume remains very large, it is usually because antidiuretic hormone secretion is insufficient.

In men, prostatic hyperplasia reduces bladder capacity and increases nocturia. In women, urinary tract infection and inflammation cause urgency, nocturia, and related symptoms. Some people have frequency or polyuria throughout the day, which may be caused by an underlying disease, for example: diabetes mellitus, diabetes insipidus, or polydipsia.

In some people the nocturnal frequency is spurious and is in fact a 'sleep disorder': while tossing and turning in bed, they become especially sensitive to the urine in the bladder, and even a tiny amount must be voided before they can fall asleep at ease. Thus nocturia causes sleep disturbance, and sleep disturbance in turn causes nocturia.

The most direct way to improve nocturia is to change lifestyle habits, for example: within 4 hours of bedtime, minimize water, tea, coffee, alcohol, fruit, and the like, and develop the habit of emptying the bladder before sleep. Sit quietly and relax before bed to improve sleep, exercise more to sweat, lose weight, keep warm while sleeping, and so on.

Modern medicine treats nocturia with medications, commonly including: diuretics, antidepressants, female hormones, vasopressin, antihistamines, and others; for loss of bladder function, obstructing prostatic hyperplasia, bladder tumors, stones, or urethral stricture, surgery is used.

If a person has no related disease and simply has nocturnal frequency of unknown cause, the concepts of Chinese medicine are well worth consulting and can still markedly improve nocturnal frequency or polyuria.
