records.western_pathology_en: Post-COVID syndrome (long COVID) refers to symptoms persisting more than three months after acute infection that cannot be explained by an alternative diagnosis. Proposed pathophysiological mechanisms include persistent low-grade inflammation and immune dysregulation; microvascular endothelial dysfunction affecting tissue perfusion; autonomic nervous system dysfunction (such as postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome); some evidence suggesting viral protein or RNA persistence or reactivation within tissues; mitochondrial dysfunction affecting energy metabolism; and autoimmune-like phenomena. Common presentations include prolonged fatigue, post-exertional malaise, dyspnea, cognitive impairment ("brain fog"), loss of smell, and reduced exercise tolerance, with symptom severity and duration varying between individuals.

records.name_zh: 慢性過敏體質（文件情境）
records.etiology_zh:
蕁麻疹絕對是困擾中國人千年以上的症狀，只是在古代有其他的名詞，例如「風疹塊」、「風疹」、「癮疹」、「鬼飯疙瘩」、「風疙瘩」...這些奇怪名詞。

因為中醫認為此病與「風邪」有關，對於蕁麻疹的證候觀察的非常詳細，歸納為「風寒型」、「風熱型」、「濕熱型」、「血熱型」、「血虛風燥型」、「脾胃虛弱型」、「氣滯血瘀型」...等等。

基於上面的分析，可以看出造成蕁麻疹的原因非常的多。問題就在於，為什麼有些人很容易得到蕁麻疹？有些人卻沒有？這背後可能是一種體質現象。

從關現代醫學觀察到的一些現象，其實也可以推論出背後原因，每年在冬季12月份之後氣溫驟降，就會出現「寒冷性蕁麻疹」。

寒冷的季節容易出現蕁麻疹

這類蕁麻疹屬於物理性慢性蕁麻疹，患者對「低溫」特別敏感。僅需短暫接觸雪、冰水、冷空氣，或因室內外溫差迅速變化，就可能引發風疹塊。

現在醫學的這個觀察，也可以運用經絡數據來加以印證。雲端中醫的系統中有不少蕁麻疹的真實案例，如果去觀察他們的「經絡型態」會發現，有一定比例人就是出現陽虛的經絡型態，而且機率偏高。

從下圖就可以清楚看到，這些都是陽虛的經絡型態，還有冬季常見的「上虛下實」經絡型態。

可以推斷，所謂的「過敏」，很可能就是體質偏寒，在天氣冷時的一種皮膚體表反應，如果體質沒有這麼寒，就不會誘發蕁麻疹。

寒性陽虛經絡型態，容易出現蕁麻疹

所以，如果有一個人長期觀察自己的經絡數據，確認自己是屬於「寒性經絡體質」，或是「上虛下實」經絡體質，在每年冬季12月到隔年初春這段期間，就有較高的機率會出現蕁麻疹，每個人都可以自行驗證。

這種蕁麻疹，就是所謂的「風寒」蕁麻疹，依照不少會員長期的回報發現，運用傷寒論中的「桂枝麻黃各半湯」或「葛根湯」，效果非常好。

有時候甚至服用科學中藥，幾個小時之後就開始退疹了，隔天之後就幾乎會消失了，可見中醫講的風寒蕁麻疹是真的。

有一些媽媽，遇到小孩子出現蕁麻疹，也是在「肺經」、「大腸經」、背後的「膀胱經」、「膽經」附近，用熱吹風機吹一吹，也可以快速改善這種風寒性的蕁麻疹，改善的速度也是非常的快。

然而，不是每一個人的蕁麻疹都是風寒造成的，現在醫學也發現免疫系統造成的蕁麻疹，通常通常都是慢性的。

通常看到免疫系統造成的疾病，雲端中醫的從經絡數據與體質角度來看，這很有可能是「鐵三角經絡型態化熱」所造成的。

理論推斷如此，實際上也一樣，有一定比例的慢性蕁麻疹會員，他們的經絡體質就是鐵三角經絡體質。

下面這4個蕁麻疹的真實案例，就是典型的鐵三角經絡型態，而且有些都已經轉變成化熱之極致現象。

以下這些真實案例，有些發生在炎熱的夏季，有時有些也發生在寒冷的冬季。

鐵三角經絡型態，也有機會容易出現蕁麻疹

由於鐵三角經絡型態不太可能出現在寒冷的冬季，所以這些都是屬於「鐵三角經絡體質」的族群，這種體質在免疫力慢性失調，就可能隨時出現蕁麻疹。

而事實上鐵三角經絡體質的人，出現了各種種免疫性疾病很多，例如紅斑性狼瘡、牛皮癬、類風濕關節炎，通常都是這種經絡體質。

所以只要是原因不明，慢性的蕁麻疹，都可以自行驗證一下，看看自己是不是屬於這種鐵三角經絡體質，反過來只要改善這種經絡體質，就可以改善慢性蕁麻疹。

當代名醫倪海廈臨床案例，在其學生林大棟的著作《佛州漢唐跟診日誌》中記載「皮五針」，分別是合谷穴、曲池穴、三陰交穴、築賓穴、血海穴。

皮五針是很重要的一組穴位，其不只對銀屑病，對於各種皮膚病也很有效，尤其是對於蕁麻疹有很好的效果。在發病初期的時候，甚至可以在留針二十分鐘後一起針就令蕁麻疹迅速消退。

大家去看這些穴道，就是位於大腸經、脾經穴道為主，而這個就是鐵三角經絡型態，最常出現的異常經絡。

從以上的經絡數據分析，如果一個人體內寒氣不重，或者是沒有因為疲勞壓力，長期累積而造成的鐵三角經絡體質，一輩子是可以遠離蕁麻疹的。

運用中藥改善蕁麻疹效果很好

某會員就在2024年12月期間回報，他以前很容易蕁麻疹，經常要到醫院去打針退疹。

後來，他確認自己的體質是「寒性陽虛經絡體質」之後。每次感冒就是運用《傷寒論》的中藥來治療，從此之後再也沒有再發生蕁麻疹。

總之，容易出現蕁麻疹應該是一種體質現象，只要改善體質，妥善處理好感冒傷寒，罹患蕁麻疹不但容易痊癒，之後也不容易復發。
records.western_pathology_zh:
蕁麻疹是一種很常見的皮膚病，可以算是一種皮膚過敏。特徵是皮膚上出現紅色或蒼白的隆起性疹塊，伴隨劇烈搔癢感。

急性的蕁麻疹通常會自然消退自癒，但可能反覆出現於不同部位。在多數的時候發生原因不明，現代醫學常會歸類於過敏現象。

例如：病毒感染、昆蟲叮咬，溫度變化(太冷太熱)、吹風、曬太陽、情緒壓力、花粉、蕁麻等植物性刺激，吃海鮮(魚蝦蟹)之後出現。

注射血清、青黴素等藥物，灰塵、毛髮及皮屑或黴菌等刺激之後造成。慢性特發性蕁麻疹，多數屬於免疫系統異常所造成。

現代醫學治療急性蕁麻疹常使用「抗組織胺」或是「類固醇」。嚴重或難治性的慢性蕁麻疹，甚至要運用免疫抑制劑或生物製劑。

像這種那麼奇怪的疾病，又也可以考慮從中醫的角度來理解，尤其是特定的「經絡體質」較容易出現蕁麻疹。

records.western_pathology_en:
Urticaria (hives) is a very common skin disease and can be considered a form of skin allergy. It is characterized by raised red or pale wheals on the skin, accompanied by an intense itching sensation.

Acute urticaria usually subsides and heals naturally, but it may appear repeatedly at different sites. Most of the time the cause of onset is unknown, and modern medicine commonly classifies it as an allergic phenomenon.

For example: it may appear after viral infection, insect bites, temperature changes (too cold or too hot), wind exposure, sun exposure, emotional stress, pollen, irritation from plants such as nettles, or after eating seafood (fish, shrimp, crab).

It may also be caused by injections of serum, penicillin, and other drugs, or by irritation from dust, hair and dander, molds, and the like. Chronic idiopathic urticaria is mostly caused by abnormalities of the immune system.

Modern medicine commonly treats acute urticaria with 'antihistamines' or 'corticosteroids.' Severe or refractory chronic urticaria may even require immunosuppressants or biologic agents.

For such a strange disease, one may also consider understanding it from the perspective of Chinese medicine — in particular, certain 'meridian constitutions' are more prone to developing urticaria.

records.etiology_en:
Urticaria has assuredly troubled the Chinese for more than a thousand years — only in antiquity it went by other names, for example 'wind-rash wheals' (feng zhen kuai), 'wind rash' (feng zhen), 'hidden rash' (yin zhen), 'ghost-rice bumps' (gui fan ge da), 'wind bumps' (feng ge da)... all these strange terms.

Because Chinese medicine considers this disease related to the 'Wind pathogen,' its observation of the patterns of urticaria is extremely detailed, summarized as the 'Wind-Cold type,' 'Wind-Heat type,' 'Damp-Heat type,' 'Blood-Heat type,' 'Blood Deficiency with Wind-Dryness type,' 'Spleen-Stomach weakness type,' 'Qi stagnation with Blood stasis type,' and so on.

From the analysis above, it can be seen that the causes of urticaria are very numerous. The question is: why do some people get urticaria so easily, while others do not? Behind this may lie a constitutional phenomenon.

From certain phenomena observed by modern medicine, the underlying cause can in fact also be inferred: every year after December, when the temperature plunges in winter, 'cold urticaria' appears.

Urticaria readily appears in the cold season.

This type of urticaria belongs to physical chronic urticaria; patients are especially sensitive to 'low temperature.' Merely brief contact with snow, ice water, or cold air, or a rapid change in the temperature difference between indoors and outdoors, can trigger wheals.

This observation of modern medicine can also be corroborated using meridian data. The Cloud TCM system contains quite a few real cases of urticaria; if one observes their 'meridian patterns,' one finds that a certain proportion of people present precisely the Yang-Deficient meridian pattern, and at an elevated rate.

From the figure below one can clearly see that these are all Yang-Deficient meridian patterns, along with the 'Deficient-above, Excess-below' meridian pattern common in winter.

It can be inferred that so-called 'allergy' may very well be a skin-surface reaction, in cold weather, of a constitution tending toward Cold; if the constitution were not so Cold, the urticaria would not be triggered.

The Cold-type Yang-Deficient meridian pattern readily presents urticaria.

So if a person observes their own meridian data long-term and confirms that they belong to the 'Cold-type meridian constitution' or the 'Deficient-above, Excess-below' meridian constitution, then during the period from December each year to the early spring of the following year, they have a relatively high probability of developing urticaria — everyone can verify this for themselves.

This type of urticaria is the so-called 'Wind-Cold' urticaria. According to the long-term reports of many members, using the Treatise on Cold Damage formulas Gui Zhi Ma Huang Ge Ban Tang (Half Cinnamon Twig and Half Ephedra Decoction) or Ge Gen Tang (Kudzu Decoction) works extremely well.

Sometimes, even taking concentrated scientific herbal granules, the rash begins to recede within a few hours, and by the next day it has almost disappeared — showing that the Wind-Cold urticaria spoken of in Chinese medicine is real.

Some mothers, when their child breaks out in urticaria, blow a hot hair-dryer over the areas of the 'Lung channel,' the 'Large Intestine channel,' and the 'Bladder channel' and 'Gallbladder channel' on the back; this too can rapidly improve this Wind-Cold type of urticaria, and the speed of improvement is likewise very fast.

However, not everyone's urticaria is caused by Wind-Cold. Modern medicine has also found urticaria caused by the immune system, which is usually chronic.

Whenever Cloud TCM sees diseases produced by the immune system, from the standpoint of meridian data and constitution, they are very likely produced by the 'Iron Triangle meridian pattern transformed into Heat.'

So the theory infers — and so it is in practice: a certain proportion of members with chronic urticaria have precisely the Iron Triangle meridian constitution.

The 4 real urticaria cases below are typical Iron Triangle meridian patterns, and some have already converted into the extreme transformed-Heat phenomenon.

Among these real cases, some occurred in the hot summer, and some occurred in the cold winter.

The Iron Triangle meridian pattern also has a chance of readily presenting urticaria.

Since the Iron Triangle meridian pattern is unlikely to appear in the cold winter, these all belong to the group with the 'Iron Triangle meridian constitution'; with this constitution, under chronic dysregulation of immunity, urticaria may appear at any time.

And in fact, people of the Iron Triangle meridian constitution develop a great many immune diseases of all kinds — for example systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, and rheumatoid arthritis usually occur in this meridian constitution.

So for any chronic urticaria of unknown cause, one can verify for oneself whether one belongs to this Iron Triangle meridian constitution; and conversely, simply improving this meridian constitution can improve the chronic urticaria.

The clinical cases of the renowned contemporary physician Ni Hai-Xia, recorded in his student Lin Da-Dong's book Diary of Clinical Observation at Han Tang, Florida, describe the 'Five Skin Needles': Hegu (LI-4), Quchi (LI-11), Sanyinjiao (SP-6), Zhubin (KI-9), and Xuehai (SP-10).

The Five Skin Needles are a very important group of acupoints, effective not only for psoriasis but for all kinds of skin diseases, and especially good for urticaria. In the initial stage of onset, the urticaria can even recede rapidly upon withdrawal of the needles after twenty minutes of retention.

If you look at these acupoints, they are located mainly on the Large Intestine and Spleen channels — and these are precisely the abnormal meridians that most commonly appear in the Iron Triangle meridian pattern.

From the meridian-data analysis above: if a person's internal Cold is not heavy, and they have not developed the Iron Triangle meridian constitution through the long accumulation of fatigue and stress, they can stay far from urticaria for a lifetime.

Using Chinese herbs to improve urticaria works very well.

One member reported in December 2024 that he used to develop urticaria very easily and often had to go to the hospital for injections to make the rash recede.

Later, after confirming that his constitution was the 'Cold-type Yang-Deficient meridian constitution,' he treated every cold with the Chinese herbs of the Treatise on Cold Damage — and from then on urticaria never occurred again.

In short, susceptibility to urticaria should be understood as a constitutional phenomenon: simply improve the constitution and handle colds and Cold Damage properly, and urticaria not only heals readily but also does not easily recur afterward.

records.etiology_zh:
要治療神經衰弱最簡單的方法，就是放慢步調，遠離電腦、手機，讓腦子徹底休息。由於古代中國人沒有現代科技，所以要罹患這種疾病的機率應該很低。

要理解神經衰弱的真正原因是什麼，最簡單直接的方法就是去找一個神經衰弱的人，長期檢測他/她的經絡，就可以知道是什麼經絡異常所造成的。

由於過去幾年來回報受到神經衰弱困擾的會員實在是非常多，所以透過歸納這些經絡型態，就可以找出一些背後的主要原因，主要有以下幾種：

1.肝氣鬱結、心脾兩虛、心血虛

傳統中醫認為「心主血脈」，如果一個人思慮過度時，就會耗傷心血，導致心血不足。會出現心悸、失眠、多夢、容易驚嚇、健忘、頭暈...等症狀。

當心臟的精神功能失調時，可能會表現為心神不寧、精神恍惚、悲傷想哭、無法控制自己的情緒、心中煩亂、睡眠不安、連連打哈欠，嚴重時甚至會出現語言異常。

古人把這種症狀稱為「臟躁證」，這與現代所說的神經衰弱症有些相似，運用「甘麥大棗湯」加以改善。

古人認為「思傷脾」，過度思考不僅會損傷心臟的血液，還會影響到脾臟和胃的功能，這是身體生成氣血的重要部分，功能都受損時，會導致精神無法穩定。

古人認為「思傷脾」，思考過度傷害脾胃

中醫也認為「肝主一身之氣」，掌管人體內所有氣之流動，肝氣一定要舒展暢達，如果「鬱滯」時，七情(喜、怒、憂、思、悲、恐、驚)就無法調節順暢，所以肝氣鬱結時也會神經衰弱。

如果這個肝氣鬱結在體內累積一段時間之後，就會出現「化火」現象，這時候神經衰弱就會更嚴重。

綜合以上的所有描述，完全可以運用經絡檢測來印證這件事情。從大量神經衰弱的經絡型態中可以看出，有較高的機率是出現「鐵三角經絡型態的極致現象」。(開啟閱讀深入理解)

這種經絡型態，脾虛胃強、肝胃不和、肝脾不調、心脾兩虛，同時心經、心包經虛證。少陽經、陽明經實證，所以體內很火熱。

有一定比例的人，一年四季都呈現這種經絡型態，這是常容易出現神經衰弱的一種經絡模型。

鐵三角經絡型態的極致現象

尤其是這種經絡型態，幾乎是一年四季都是膀胱經虛證、腎經虛證。「膀胱經」與「督脈」牽動中樞神經系統，腎臟與腦部關係密切，因為能量過度消耗，很可能就是造成神經衰弱的主因。

膀胱經與督脈氣血不足時，容易出現神經衰弱症

2024年有一位會員就分享，他說「思傷脾」這件事完全可以理解，因為他只要有一陣子特別用腦寫程式，就會出現胃脹氣、消化不良，最後確實會出現神經衰弱的感覺。而他的經絡現象，確實就是出現鐵三角經絡型態。

通常出現這種經絡型態的人，過去都是到處看病，怎麼看都看不好，這就是典型自律神經失調、神經衰弱的現象。

2.心腎不交、腎精不足

心腎不交時也會造成神經衰弱，這是中醫特有的概念，根據五行理論，心屬火、腎屬水。

在正常情況下，水與火相融，心與腎應相互配合。當這兩者無法順利交融，便會導致心腎不交的狀態。

中醫學中有「腎藏精」的觀點，中醫的腎與現代醫學的腦部有著密切的關聯。腎精不足會影響身體的激素平衡，進而可能引起各種腦部相關疾病。

某會員患有神經衰弱持續至少10年以上，他從2020年開始觀察經絡，發現自己的經絡數據是非常穩定的，為什麼呢？因為他經常可以看到自己心經實證，脾經與腎經虛證的現象。

男性長期神經衰弱，常見的經絡型態

他說自己的每天常見症狀，與神經衰弱的症狀99%吻合。可見中醫說的心腎不交、腎精不足有可能造成神經衰弱，這應該是真的。透過觀察經絡，也可以印證這個現象。

從大量現代人的經絡數據發現，脾經與腎經虛證是常態，基於此現代人有很高的機率會出現神經衰弱。

傳統中醫認為，「腎陰虛化火」的人，也有機會出現神經衰弱症。上面提到的鐵三角經絡型態極致現象，有一定比例的人腎經就是實證，或許可以用來解釋什麼叫做腎陰虛化火。

3.上虛下實、任督不通

神經衰弱的經絡型態還有很多種類型，自從疫情之後最常見的類型就是「上虛下實」，這種經絡型態的特點，可以說是整個胸部與腹部的經絡氣血都是阻塞的。

如果從經絡的角度來看，也可以說是任督二脈不通，上下無法交通，所以也有可能出現神經衰弱。

上虛下實、上實下虛的人，容易任督二脈不通

4.上實下虛、寒氣深重

由於綜合經絡型態是最常見的經絡型態，所以有一定比例的人出現神經衰弱，也是這種「鐵三角」加上「陽虛」經絡型態所造成的現象。

這種經絡型態膽經、胃經與膀胱經能量都是很虛弱的，這會導致通往頭部的氣血不足，所以很容易出現腦神經衰弱的現象。嚴重時就會出現「上實下虛」，導致任督二脈不通。

既然神經衰弱是用腦過多所造成的，最好的治療方法就是不要用腦，經常放空腦袋，運用經絡穴道拍打是一個很好的改善方式。

無論哪一種經絡型態，只要知道自己的異常經絡，經常運用經絡拍打或按摩，去疏通這些異常經絡，就可以緩解腦神經衰弱的現象。

如果可以配合冥想、瑜伽呼吸法，這是改善神經衰弱的最根本方法。名醫陳慕純醫師，就是長期指導病患練習內核心呼吸法，用來治療失眠卻不依賴安眠藥。

運用中藥改善神經衰弱的原理，主要是調整體內的脾胃系統， 讓所謂的「腦腸軸」暢通(開啟閱讀)，自然也可以改善神經衰弱的現象， 可見中醫的脾胃是與腦部密切相關的。
records.western_pathology_zh:
人腦是一個很神秘的器官，其實是相當耐操的！大腦皮質的神經細胞，就像那些可以連續工作超時的不倒翁，只要給它們足夠的睡眠和休息，它們就能迅速恢復元氣，再次投入戰鬥。

不過，在現代社會的龐大壓力下，神經衰弱症已經成為不少人的隱形敵人，當腦神經被長時間過度使用，好比開了個不停的馬拉松，終有一刻會超越耐受極限。

現代人資訊焦慮，普遍用腦過多

當一個人遭遇腦神經衰弱時，他的生活就好比被施了一個怪異的咒語。忘記東西變得司空見慣，就像個擁有短暫記憶的金魚。

整天無精打采，仿佛所有生活動力都被抽走了。不論做什麼都提不起勁，最終只想找個安靜的角落坐下或躺著。

反應變慢，對周遭的人事物漠不關心，這讓旁人可能會誤以為是憂鬱症。情緒波動大，可能因為一點小事就陷入深深的鬱悶，或是突然爆發出怒氣。

睡眠再也不是一件輕鬆事，常常被一點小聲音驚醒，然後輾轉反側難以再次入眠。

這種狀態常被歸類為「精神官能症」、「自律神經失調」或「身心症」。但是到醫院檢查，常會得到一個讓人哭笑不得的答案：「你沒有病！」讓人更感到無助。

這時候，中醫提供了另一種角度來看待和治療神經衰弱，提供另一條全新的思路！

records.western_pathology_en:
The human brain is a very mysterious organ — and in fact it is remarkably hard-wearing! The nerve cells of the cerebral cortex are like tumbler dolls that can work overtime continuously: as long as they are given sufficient sleep and rest, they can rapidly recover their vigor and throw themselves into the fray once more.

However, under the enormous pressures of modern society, neurasthenia has become the hidden enemy of many people. When the cranial nerves are overused for long periods — like a marathon run without pause — there comes a moment when the limit of tolerance is exceeded.

Modern people suffer information anxiety and generally overuse their brains.

When a person is struck by neurasthenia, his life is as if placed under a strange spell. Forgetting things becomes commonplace, like being a goldfish with only fleeting memory.

He is listless all day, as though all the vitality of life had been drained away. Whatever he does, he cannot summon any energy, and in the end he only wants to find a quiet corner to sit or lie down.

His reactions slow, and he grows indifferent to the people and things around him, which may lead others to mistake it for depression. His emotional swings are large: over some small matter he may sink into deep gloom, or suddenly erupt in anger.

Sleep is no longer an easy matter: he is often startled awake by the slightest sound, and then tosses and turns, unable to fall asleep again.

This state is often classified as 'psychoneurosis,' 'autonomic nervous system dysregulation,' or 'psychosomatic disorder.' But on examination at the hospital, one often receives an answer that leaves one not knowing whether to laugh or cry: 'There is nothing wrong with you!' — which makes one feel all the more helpless.

At this point, Chinese medicine provides another angle from which to view and treat neurasthenia, offering an entirely new line of thinking!

records.etiology_en:
The simplest way to treat neurasthenia is to slow one's pace, keep away from computers and mobile phones, and let the brain rest completely. Since the ancient Chinese had no modern technology, their probability of contracting this disease must have been very low.

To understand what the true cause of neurasthenia is, the simplest and most direct method is to find a person with neurasthenia and test his or her meridians long-term; one can then know which meridian abnormalities produce it.

Because the members reporting themselves troubled by neurasthenia over the past several years have been truly numerous, by summarizing these meridian patterns one can identify several principal underlying causes, chiefly the following:

1. Liver Qi stagnation, Heart-Spleen dual Deficiency, Heart Blood Deficiency

Traditional Chinese medicine holds that 'the Heart governs the blood and vessels.' When a person worries and deliberates excessively, Heart Blood is consumed and damaged, leading to insufficiency of Heart Blood, with symptoms such as palpitations, insomnia, profuse dreaming, easy fright, forgetfulness, dizziness, and so on.

When the Heart's mental-spiritual functions are disordered, this may manifest as disquiet of the Heart-spirit, mental abstraction, sorrow and a desire to weep, inability to control one's emotions, vexation and turmoil in the heart, restless sleep, and repeated yawning; in severe cases even abnormalities of speech may appear.

The ancients called this symptom-complex 'visceral agitation' (zang zao); it bears some resemblance to what is now called neurasthenia, and it is improved with Gan Mai Da Zao Tang (Licorice, Wheat and Jujube Decoction).

The ancients held that 'worry damages the Spleen': excessive thinking not only damages the Heart's Blood but also affects the functions of the Spleen and Stomach — the vital parts of the body that generate Qi and Blood; when both are impaired, the spirit cannot be kept stable.

The ancients held that 'worry damages the Spleen' — excessive thinking harms the Spleen and Stomach.

Chinese medicine also holds that 'the Liver governs the Qi of the whole body,' directing the movement of all Qi within the human body. Liver Qi must stretch out and flow freely; if it becomes 'constrained and stagnant,' the seven emotions (joy, anger, worry, thought, sorrow, fear, fright) cannot be regulated smoothly — so Liver Qi stagnation also produces neurasthenia.

If this Liver Qi stagnation accumulates in the body for a period of time, the phenomenon of 'transformation into Fire' appears, and at that point the neurasthenia becomes still more severe.

All the descriptions above can be fully corroborated by meridian testing. From the large number of meridian patterns of neurasthenia, one can see a relatively high probability of the 'extreme manifestation of the Iron Triangle meridian pattern.' (Open and read for deeper understanding.)

In this meridian pattern there is Spleen Deficiency with Stomach strength, Liver-Stomach disharmony, Liver-Spleen disharmony, and Heart-Spleen dual Deficiency, with the Heart and Pericardium channels Deficient at the same time. The Shaoyang and Yangming channels are Excess, so the interior of the body is very Fire-Hot.

A certain proportion of people present this meridian pattern in all four seasons; it is a meridian model in which neurasthenia most readily appears.

The extreme manifestation of the Iron Triangle meridian pattern.

In this meridian pattern above all, the Bladder channel and Kidney channel are Deficient in nearly all four seasons. The 'Bladder channel' and the 'Du (Governing) vessel' act upon the central nervous system, and the Kidney is closely related to the brain; the excessive consumption of energy may very well be the main cause of the neurasthenia.

When the Bladder channel and Du vessel lack Qi and Blood, neurasthenia readily appears.

In 2024 one member shared that the saying 'worry damages the Spleen' was something he could completely understand: whenever he spent a stretch of time using his brain especially hard writing programs, he would develop stomach bloating and indigestion, and in the end a feeling of neurasthenia would indeed appear. And his meridian phenomenon was indeed the Iron Triangle meridian pattern.

People who present this meridian pattern have usually gone everywhere seeking medical care in the past without ever being cured — this is the classic phenomenon of autonomic dysregulation and neurasthenia.

2. Heart-Kidney non-interaction, insufficiency of Kidney Essence

Heart-Kidney non-interaction also causes neurasthenia. This is a concept unique to Chinese medicine: according to Five-Phase theory, the Heart belongs to Fire and the Kidney to Water.

Under normal circumstances, Water and Fire blend together, and Heart and Kidney should cooperate with each other. When the two cannot commune smoothly, the state of Heart-Kidney non-interaction results.

Chinese medicine holds the view that 'the Kidney stores the Essence,' and the Kidney of Chinese medicine has a close connection with the brain of modern medicine. Insufficiency of Kidney Essence affects the body's hormonal balance, and may in turn give rise to various brain-related diseases.

One member has suffered from neurasthenia for at least 10 years. He began observing his meridians in 2020 and found his meridian data to be extremely stable. Why? Because he could constantly see in himself the phenomenon of Heart channel Excess with Spleen and Kidney channel Deficiency.

The meridian pattern commonly seen in men with long-term neurasthenia.

He said that his everyday symptoms matched the symptoms of neurasthenia 99%. Evidently the Heart-Kidney non-interaction and Kidney Essence insufficiency spoken of in Chinese medicine can indeed cause neurasthenia — this appears to be true, and by observing the meridians one can corroborate the phenomenon.

From the meridian data of large numbers of modern people, it emerges that Spleen and Kidney channel Deficiency is the norm; on this basis modern people have a very high probability of developing neurasthenia.

Traditional Chinese medicine holds that people with 'Kidney Yin Deficiency transforming into Fire' may also develop neurasthenia. In the extreme manifestation of the Iron Triangle meridian pattern mentioned above, a certain proportion of people show precisely Kidney channel Excess — perhaps this can be used to explain what Kidney Yin Deficiency transforming into Fire means.

3. Deficient above, Excess below; Ren and Du vessels not communicating

There are many further types of meridian pattern in neurasthenia. Since the pandemic, the most common type has been 'Deficient-above, Excess-below'; the characteristic of this meridian pattern may be described as blockage of the meridian Qi and Blood across the entire chest and abdomen.

Viewed from the meridian angle, one may also say that the Ren and Du vessels are not open, the above and the below cannot communicate — so neurasthenia may also appear.

People who are Deficient above and Excess below, or Excess above and Deficient below, readily have Ren and Du vessels that do not communicate.

4. Excess above, Deficiency below, with deep-seated Cold

Since the composite meridian pattern is the most common meridian pattern, a certain proportion of the people who develop neurasthenia do so from this phenomenon produced by the 'Iron Triangle' plus 'Yang Deficiency' meridian pattern.

In this meridian pattern the energies of the Gallbladder, Stomach, and Bladder channels are all very weak, which leads to insufficient Qi and Blood reaching the head — so the phenomenon of cerebral neurasthenia very readily appears. In severe cases, 'Excess above, Deficiency below' appears, leading to non-communication of the Ren and Du vessels.

Since neurasthenia is produced by overuse of the brain, the best treatment is not to use the brain — frequently empty the mind; patting the meridians and acupoints is a very good method of improvement.

Whichever meridian pattern it may be, as long as one knows one's own abnormal meridians and frequently applies meridian patting or massage to unblock these abnormal meridians, the phenomenon of cerebral neurasthenia can be relieved.

If one can combine this with meditation and yogic breathing methods, this is the most fundamental way to improve neurasthenia. The renowned physician Dr. Chen Mu-Chun has long guided patients in practicing the inner-core breathing method, using it to treat insomnia without dependence on sleeping pills.

The principle of using Chinese herbs to improve neurasthenia is mainly to regulate the body's Spleen-Stomach system, letting the so-called 'brain-gut axis' flow freely (open and read), which naturally also improves the phenomenon of neurasthenia — evidence that the Spleen-Stomach of Chinese medicine is closely related to the brain.
